reviews.name: Rebecca Roberts
reviews.text: Super unassuming massage close to Melia Hotel. I went twice - foot massage the first time and so impressed I went for an hour’s full-body relaxing massage. Both of my masseuses (one male, one female) were lovely and they focused on discretion (when the man did my foot massage, I was given some freshly laundered shorts to wear under my sundress) and hygiene (disposable underwear and hairnet provided for full-body). Kind, non-pushy and incredible treatments - first stop when next in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We are very happy that you were interested in getting a massage at our shop and that you kindly gave us such a wonderful review. We are delighted and will do our best to provide the best service. We wish you good health and look forward to seeing you again.

reviews.name: George M
reviews.text:
The best place in Chiang Mai to go relax and enjoy an exceptional high quality massage!
The friendly experienced and skilled staff provide personalized care for the best outcome. The shop is super clean too.
After several visits here the massages remain consistently first-rate.  Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for returning to our shop. We will do our best to improve even further. We hope you enjoy your trip to Chiang Mai and we look forward to seeing you again.

reviews.name: M. Martin
reviews.text: I visit Chiang Mai at least twice a year from elsewhere in Thailand. Each time, I go to Nidtaya Thai Massage to get an excellent Thai-style massage. I have her increase the message pressure and I also point out areas which to focus upon especially the legs as I am a bicycle rider. She deals with that expertly! Also, I am a talker and she is a very good conversationalist. But if you want silence to further enjoy the massage , no problem. Each person is an individual to her.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review. It's very encouraging and motivates me. All the staff and I work hard to ensure you have a relaxing and refreshing experience . We wish you good health and hope to see you again.

reviews.name: Claire
reviews.text: I have done quite a lot of massages in Chiangmai and this is by far the best! Nidtaya is so skilled I didn’t even need to tell her the specific spots of pain in my body - she just magically found it. And it’s just the right amount of pressure! The price is very affordable, and the place nice and clean. I left the massage shop feeling extremely relaxed. Would highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, thank you so much. I'm so happy and have more and more energy every day. I wish you good health and happy travels. I hope to see you again🙏💖💖

reviews.name: Xol Cat
reviews.text: This massage was absolutely amazing! My body aches have gotten so much better. Every time I visit Thailand, I always recommend this place to everyone I know. If you like a stronger or lighter touch, you can easily ask the therapist to adjust the pressure for you. The shop is located in the Night Bazaar area in Chiang Mai, Thailand, right across from the Night Bazaar Inn Hotel. You have to come and experience it for yourself — all the therapists are incredibly kind and talented. I promise you won’t be disappointed!”
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your review. We will do our best to serve all customers. See you again next time.🙏💓💓

reviews.name: Toppeter
reviews.text: This shop has excellent massage therapists; it's clean and they are very attentive to customers.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. We will do our best in our work. We hope to see you again.

reviews.name: John Truitt
reviews.text: Over the years, I have had hundreds of massages in Thailand; none better than Nidtaya. A small shop with owners focused on high quality massages. If you’re looking for a quality, therapeutic Thai massage, you can’t find a better place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much, Mr. John. We were very happy to have given you and your wife a massage. We hope you have a wonderful trip and we look forward to seeing you again.

reviews.name: Cierra Sharene
reviews.text:
I only got one Thai massage while in Chiang Mai and I would come back everyday if I stayed longer!

I’m a petite, yet strong woman and my masseuse provided the perfect amount of pressure! Throughout the massage, she asked if I was doing ok and made sure I was calm and relaxed the entire time!

I had a dress on and they provided a change of clothes which was very comforting!

This shop is near the Night Bazaar so it’s perfect to get a massage before or after!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your lovely review. We are very happy and will work hard. If you have a chance to visit Chiang Mai, please come to our shop again.💖💖💖💖

reviews.name: Cel Top
reviews.text:
Four of us had our first Traditional Thai massage here and now we know why it is famous.  Nidtaya Thai Massage provided us with comfortable clothes to change into and we received head to toe massages with traditional stretching.  My masseuse was very attentive to my body and applied the exact pressure I needed in very specific spots from head to toe.  Gentle and firm massage delivered with strong thumbs and hands, and elbows and knees and feet!
Lots of smiles and lots of care to make sure we were comfortable and happy as soon as we arrived.
We came back again for a second massage and wish our trip was longer to have another!
This is definitely a place to visit anytime we are in Chiang Mai!
Thank you Nidtaya team!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you to all customers. Thai massage helps improve blood circulation and relieves physical fatigue. Relax from stress. Our Thai massage team in every shop works hard. We hope that customers and their families will have a happy trip to Chiang Mai and Thailand. Hope to see you again soon🙏💝💝

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. I hope you will come back again when you come to Chiang Mai. All of our staff work hard every day.🧡🧡

reviews.name: paresh virji
reviews.text:
Hello, I am returning to Chiang Mai after two years.

This was the first establishment I visited.

I am very pleased that I returned again.

The service was truly excellent, and I was very fortunate to meet the owner, Nong, who provided an absolutely amazing massage.

I returned twice.

Hey, so I went to this awesome place for a Thai massage when I was in Chiang Mai for the first time.

The ladies there are super professional and their technique is on point! I enjoyed it so much that I took my friend with me the next day.

We both agreed that this is the place to go if you want a good, professional massage. And their prices are really reasonable too. We even gave the girls a decent tip because they took such good care of us.

reviews.name: Nevin Goh
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful 60min foot massage at a reasonable 450baht per pax. The massage is great and comes with a delicious welcome drink to fight the heat. At the end of the foot massage came with a short wonderful shoulder & neck massage.
Experience overall is a 10/10 highly recommended this place for anyone looking to get a great massage experience.

reviews.name: A K
reviews.text: I had one of the best massage ever. I requested a medium massage and get what I want. Never felt so relaxed after. Before I got bael fruit juice that was refreshing, and after I got tea with a cookie. The room was cozy and music made me more relaxed.

reviews.name: Mitch Hawkins
reviews.text: The best massage during our two weeks in Thailand! Flawless massage service with consideration for your unique needs. A very nice foot scrub to start and then an excellent mixed Thai (dry) and balm massage with amazing relief from strong pressure and techniques. Very nice rooms for couples, comfortable sturdy wooden beds with no movement or creaking, nice background music and comfortable temperature. Be prepared for stairs to reach rooms at upper levels of this converted building (previously a home maybe?). Lovely welcome and post-massage drinks. Very impressed by this brand and their new branch and we returned the next day for 1.5 hr massage.

reviews.name: kamen nikolov
reviews.text:
I am truly impressed. Independently from the fact that the place is modern, professional and pleasant, I just had the best massage of my life - by a wide margin!

An older thai lady showed me professionalism beyond anything I had experienced before…and I have been getting thai massage in Thailand since 1998.

I am deeply amazed and thankful!

reviews.name: Laura Gallagher
reviews.text: Unfortunately my daughter and I experienced the worst massages last night. Hygiene levels not followed, lack of attention to massage areas led to pain on my daughter spine where she had to tell the lady to take her elbow out the spine, the fact the two ladies talked to each other the whole way through was anything but a relaxing environment. Lights left on throughout, no relaxing feeling, the massage was as if they wanted to rush to be finished.. would not recommend to anyone. Clearly these two ladies were not familiar with equipment or rooms. Not the standard I would expect. I woke up with cramp on leg… should never happen after a 90 mins treatment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re so sorry to hear that your recent massage experience didn’t meet your expectations. That’s never the impression we want to leave with our guests.

We’d really like the chance to make it up to you. Please feel free to contact us to receive a complimentary voucher for your next visit. Thank you so much for your patience and understanding.

Warm regards,
Sense Massage Night Bazaar Team

reviews.name: Absolutepurple
reviews.text: VERY PRETTY massage place! Probably one of the most fancy I'd been to. Beautiful interior. The team were very lovely and polite. I had 1 hour deep tisse aroma for 1K. Not recommended for faint hearted people lol It was quite hard-core. My masseur, Mint, was very good. She had firm hands. Will definitely come back whenever I come to Chiangmai again. Highly recommended! 💯💯💯

reviews.name: Anja Hofer
reviews.text: I am extremely satisfied with my experience here, booked a 2h set with Thai Massage and Head, Shoulder, Back-Massage and I feel amazing. The masseuse got the pressure just right, was very experienced, professional and friendly.  The atmosphere in the shop is excellent - smell, light, music, cleanliness. Great service also with tea at the beginning and end of the treatment. Thank you so much! I will definitely come back 🙏🏻

reviews.name: F Khan
reviews.text:
We stayed in Melia and Sense was close by. It stood out based on the ambiance. We decided to go here after checking out many locations.

Massage was excellent. We took the 2 hour massage deal  - one at full price and second person at half price.

They have private rooms for couple which are quiet and there are no distractions. Everything was great from booking to intake to actual massage. Drinks were very refreshing.

reviews.name: Miko Sin
reviews.text:
Terrible experience—avoid at all costs!
My friend and I had an absolutely dreadful experience here. Instead of a relaxing environment, the staff constantly chatted incredibly loudly, making the entire session feel like torture.
We did the oil massage and hot herbal treatment, but once it was over, the staff left us completely covered in oil without even a basic wipe-down. To top it off, they refused to let us take a shower before we left. Walking out of the store with drenched bodies and slippery feet was both disgusting and hazardous. Extremely unprofessional and unacceptable service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely apologize that your massage experience did not meet your expectations. Your satisfaction is very important to us, we would like to make this right. 

Please feel free to contact us to claim a voucher for your next visit. Thank you for your understanding.

Warm regards,
Sense Massage Night Bazaar Team

reviews.name: Mark Schenkel
reviews.text: Such a great experience here! We stayed at the Melia across the street and came here 2 times for massages. Staff members are incredibly kind and give the best massages. Great value and great experience!

title: Mandala Massage and Nails Spa
subTitle: Mandala Massage
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Mandala Massage, a professional massage and nail salon in Chiang Mai dedicated to helping you relax, recharge, and look your best.

Our experienced therapists offer a range of treatments including Traditional Thai Massage, Oil Massage, Aromatherapy Massage, Foot Massage, Neck & Shoulder Massage, Deep Tissue Massage, and Relaxation Massage. We also provide professional nail services including manicures, pedicures, gel nails, nail art, and beauty treatments.

Conveniently located in Chiang Mai, we are committed to providing exceptional service, a clean and welcoming environment, and personalized care for every guest.

reviews.name: Vincent Chen
reviews.text: I had such a great experience at Chimi Massage. The place is really clean, cozy, and welcoming from the moment you walk in. The staff are friendly and professional, and my therapist was amazing—she knew exactly where I carried the most tension and worked it out without rushing. The pressure was perfect, and by the end I felt so much lighter and completely relaxed. I also appreciated the little details, like fresh linens, quality oils, and tea afterward. I’ve tried a few massage shops before, but this one really stands out. Definitely a place I’ll be coming back to and highly recommend to anyone looking for a proper massage.

The owner also has an Airbnb upstairs, so you should look into that for your next stay in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: GARY HIDU
reviews.text: 7/4/2026 Siam Orchid Health Massage.  After pounding the pavement all day in my flipflops, my feet bottoms became sore and rough so I decided to do something a little different than the usual reclining chair foot bath and go instead for a foot scrub, an experience I hadn't tried before - boy was I glad.  The sawatdee-calling ladies on the sidewalk do the easy work of leading you in to where Kuhn PuChai does the hard work where he has you lay face down on the massage bed on a peppermint fragrance pillow. He first gently hand washes your foot bottoms before painting on a mask thoroughly along the bottom, sides and in-between the toes which may tickle.  While waiting for the gel to dry set, he'll perform a quick leg massage.  PuChai then uses a razor clam-like tool to peel away the mask, a cheese shredder to cull dead skin, a sanding block to fine-tune and then finishes off with soothing aloe lotions.  A minor glitch of an unbeknownst blister that was grated off caused some discomfort but was apologetically and quickly contained with some healing aloe and a bandage.  Tea and candies available by the payment desk.  All finished, my foot bottoms felt like walking on silk pillows!

reviews.text: Best Thai Massage on Samui. We went there today with a group of four girl friends and the staff was taking really good care of us. Super friendly, very nice and funny and the massage was just relaxing. We absolutely recommend going there. :)

reviews.name: Ashleigh Fodeades
reviews.text: Best back massage I've ever had in my life and I religiously get remedial massages in Australia. The massage was strong and targeted my problem areas in my neck and shoulders. Also went back for a foot/leg massage and my god it was so good too. The ladies here are so lovely and fun.

reviews.name: Marya Borysová
reviews.text: Best massage over had in Thailand so far. Already have been twice and will come back again. Thank you!

reviews.name: Antoine
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at Kranok Massage Salon! The atmosphere was tranquil and welcoming, perfect for relaxation. The therapists were professional and highly skilled, ensuring a rejuvenating session. I left feeling refreshed and de-stressed. Highly recommend for anyone needing a break from the daily grind!

reviews.name: Natalia Villa
reviews.text: My husband and I both got Thai massages here. My husband had an alright massage (nothing special) but I had a terrible experience with mine - thus my overall rating of 3 stars. Good prices, but I hated how aggressive and abrupt mine was, even after I asked to make it softer. I left in pain. I've had much better massages elsewhere on the island!

reviews.name: wojtek
reviews.text: I've been in Thailand for over two weeks now, indulging in massages almost daily. I've experienced some really good ones, but this one takes everything, absolutely top the best. Highly recommend.Tomorrow, I'm going for a repeat
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir à nouveau demain pour une autre séance de détente inoubliable. N'hésitez pas à partager vos préférences pour personnaliser davantage votre expérience.

reviews.name: Hermann Fleischmann
reviews.text:
Highly recommended!
One of the best Thai massages I've ever had.
Strong and soft where needed. Atmosphere was really good and relaxing.  Also quite positive and fun energy.

reviews.name: Kasia Górska
reviews.text: I’ve been living in Thailand on and off for 8 years now and the massage I got from Sugar today was one of the best massages I’ve had here over that time. Very professional, she didn’t only stroke me, but you could tell that she knew where the muscles and tension was, especially after a pretty challenging yoga class in the morning. I’ll be back!

reviews.name: Rachael Cunningham
reviews.text: Had an amazing time here. The staff were absolutely lovely! The facilities were clean and tidy. Had the BEST ever Thai massage, had to go back for another one!!! Between the two of us, we had Foot massages, Thai full body massage and even had my toe nails done! 💅 definitely recommend if you are in the area!

reviews.name: Alexey Grebtsov
reviews.text: I had back and shoulders massage. And also neck massage. It was perfectl strong but gentle. Especially May have amazing knowledge of body and her skills are great.

reviews.name: Isa Anderson
reviews.text: Went in for a manicure, without colour, so I just wanted my nails cut, shaped, cuticles done etc. They told me they were waiting for someone to come and do it but then when I said no colour I think they changed their mind and had someone already there do it. They clearly didn’t usually do nails and didn’t clean under the nails, didn’t ask how long I wanted until after they started cutting (then cut them even more when I said was short enough), didn’t ask what shape (see photos id say uneven was the choice), they didn’t do my cuticles at all and used the cuticle tool to cut the sides of my nails. They also nearly cut my skin when trying to cut my nail I had to tell them to stop and be careful! So now I have very short, uneven nails which still need cleaning and even had some bits of cotton wool stuck at the end because they used the cuticle polish stuff all over my nails :// definitely not worth 300thb especially without colour. Could’ve done a better cut and file myself.

reviews.name: Tommy Twohearts
reviews.text:
It would have been a good idea to say, that the experienced staff already left.
The massage sadly was poor. After calling in somebody from outside, I got a massage of somebody who obviously does not do massaging professionally. My daughter only got massaged on one side. The room upstairs was freezing cold and the light awful. Sadly I have to say, these were the worst massages we had in Thailand.

Sorry for having to make this review.

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing massage. My friends and I stumbled onto this place late in the evening and they were able to accommodate all 3 of us in a room. We selected the head, neck, back and foot massage. Easily the best massage I have ever had; all 3 therapists were kind and skillful. The staff provided tea and fruit following the massage. I would recommend this place to anyone wanting a great massage!

reviews.name: Gio
reviews.text: My wife and I went for the oil massage and the foot massage. They were both fantastic and we came out feeling relaxed and refreshed! The room was quiet and peaceful with soothing music in the background at just the right volume. The oil massage was not too strong, but strong enough to feel like it was helping to work out some tighter areas. The prices were great as well, with a deal for the foot massage between 10am and 6pm. We would definitely come back again!

The receptionist was friendly and the ambience was pleasant. However, the actual head spa treatment was far below expectations. The products used felt like regular shampoo. Instead of feeling nourished and refreshed, my hair felt noticeably drier after the session.

The blow-drying and finishing were also poorly done, and my hair was left looking untidy. For a head spa service, I expected a relaxing experience with healthier-looking and softer hair afterwards, but unfortunately, the result was the opposite.

While the service at the front desk and the environment were good, the treatment itself was unsatisfactory. I rarely leave negative reviews, but this was one of the few times I felt truly unsatisfied with the overall experience.

Your comments are very valuable to us, and we will carefully review them with our team as we continue to improve our service and guest experience. reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Madeleine,

We are sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

Regarding the billing issue, we would like to clarify what happened. Your original booking in the system was for a 90-minute head spa. However, due to the schedule and timing on the day, we were only able to provide a 60-minute service, and this was communicated to you.

When our front desk staff presented the bill to you, they went through the items and prices with you one by one. At that time, you noticed that the duration on the bill was still showing incorrectly as 90 minutes. Our staff immediately corrected the bill once this was pointed out.

We sincerely apologize for the mistake on the bill, but we would like to clarify that there was no intention to overcharge you. You ultimately paid only for the 60-minute service that you received.

Regarding the service itself, we are sorry that you felt the head massage was not sufficient. We have shared your feedback with our team and will continue to improve our service quality and communication.

Thank you for your feedback.

The massage was followed by some lovely tea, a sweet treat, and a walk around the beautiful garden.

I would have returned for a head, neck and shoulder massage but unfortunately I will be leaving for Bangkok.

title: The V Spa
subTitle: The V Spa by The Vijitt Resort Phuket
ownerDescription:
Located in The Vijitt Resort Phuket, The V Spa set amongst nature in the tropical gardens of luxury Phuket spa and resort. From the moment you arrive the journey of the five senses begins – represented by the roman numeral “V” – you can enjoy the sights, smells, sound, taste and touch of our well crafted massages and treatments.

Our Phuket spa hotel offers a choice of spa treatment rooms with quaint grass roofs creating the atmosphere of a traditional Thai village. Enjoy a soothing soak in the Jacuzzi and deep cleanse in the steam room, and indulge in a handpicked treatment or package that best suits your mood and leave with a renewed feeling of peace and wellbeing.

reviews.name: Josh Elizetxe (Josh Snow)
reviews.text:
We had such an incredible and lovely experience with a 90 minute Swedish massage (highly recommend this one!) the spa is literally perfect and the staff are so professional and serene. You can hear the birds while you get treated, surrounded in natural beauty.

We had Cha and Ji as our therapists. You should request them. We get massages all the time & this was simply one of the best in our lives.

reviews.name: ChanandSam Subramanyam Paul
reviews.text: The V Spa at the Vijitt Resort is a tranquil, peaceful and beautiful experience. Cha and Tangmo were very welcoming. The back, shoulder and head massage was perfect. Big thank you to Tangmo for a perfect massage during which the pressure really opened up my lower back and shoulders. The whole experience was lovely with a short foot scrub to begin with followed by treatment and tea to finish. The spa is well designed and maintained with serene music to really help calm your senses. I highly recommend the spa to anyone who stays at Vijitt.

reviews.name: Taye Adeniyi
reviews.text: Very pleasant and relaxing, great hospitality. Received a welcome drink with lemon grass and Pandanus tea after the massage. The staff were very friendly and provided a nice and relaxing atmosphere. A great addition to our time at the Vijitt resort.

reviews.name: Thilaksi Elango
reviews.text:
I had a foot massage at the V Spa and it was honestly one of the most relaxing experiences of my trip so far.

From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was calm and welcoming, with a really peaceful setting that instantly helped me unwind. Tangmo was professional, attentive, and clearly experienced, she adjusted the pressure perfectly and made sure I was comfortable throughout.

The massage itself was incredibly soothing, especially after a day of exploring in the heat. It struck a great balance between relaxing and properly relieving tension in my feet and lower legs. I left feeling noticeably lighter and refreshed.

The overall experience felt very high-quality and in line with the luxury feel of the resort. If you’re staying at The Vijitt, I’d definitely recommend making time for a treatment here, it’s well worth it.

reviews.name: chelsea lee
reviews.text: We had the honeymoon couple massage 💚🤍 it was amazing! Thank you V Spa for taking such good care of us! What an amazing way to end our honeymoon vacation 💍

reviews.name: Homourbanis
reviews.text: The ambiance of this spa was as relaxing as the Vijitt resort itself. The staff were super friendly and warm, and the service was amazing. Spouse and I had the couples massage - head, back, and shoulders, foot massage and the experience was nirvana to say the least. As you get in the room, you first have your feet rinsed and scrubbed (warning if you get ticklish lol) and then brought into the room for your massage of choice. The music, the staff were amazing and make you feel lost in the most relaxing way, I even had a few epiphanies in life (such as life is too short to live in drama, and you just need to enjoy life). If you want a great way to end your vacation after the frenetic activities Phuket has to offer than this is it! Keep it up you guys!

title: Jivana Spa

Beneath the pavilion-style roof of a Thai sala, let the sound of flowing water lull you into a state of total bliss. Feel stress melt away as Phuket’s soft breeze caresses your body, joining forces with the healing hands of our expert massage and beauty therapists.

Traditional Thai full-body massage is the specialty here. Combining muscle stretching, acupressure and meditation, this 2,000-year-old discipline is an authentic healing art that was developed to align and harmonize the energy flowing through the body.

reviews.text: My husband and I had a great massage experience here. The place is clean and the staff are very accomodating. The masseuse are very skilled and really good at what they do. We booked the dream package with foot, hand, back and shoulder massage and this was the best we had here in Karon. Would highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Punit Kanwar
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at Let’s Relax Spa Karon. The place is spotless — super clean, hygienic, and very well maintained. The rooms were extremely tidy, comfortable, and felt premium the moment we walked in.

The staff were outstanding. The therapists were highly skilled, professional, and genuinely excellent at what they do. We did the 90 minute Thai massage and it was mind-boggling. It opened up every muscle, left us feeling refreshed, loose, and completely recharged.

Service was five star from start to finish. This was easily one of the best spa experiences we have had in Phuket. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Aden Gan
reviews.text: Let’s Relax Spa in Phuket offers a truly rejuvenating experience in a tranquil setting. From the moment you step in, the calming ambience and courteous staff put you at ease. The therapists are professional and attentive, tailoring the massage pressure to your comfort level. The rooms are clean, well-maintained, and thoughtfully designed to enhance relaxation. Their signature Thai massage is a must-try—deeply therapeutic and expertly delivered. A complimentary herbal drink after the session is a lovely touch. Overall, a consistently high-quality spa experience worth returning to. Visited twice in my short stay in this area.

reviews.name: Christina Stempfel
reviews.text:
It’s been such a blessing that I have found this amazing place… I have had the chance to go to many massage place… But this place me has literally changed everything. From
The reception of my request. To the welcoming drink and the exceptional rooms they have specially prepared. I got a body & soul treatment aka full body scrub followed by an aroma oil massage…. Believe me or not they let you choose the scrub and the oil… and the second those products hit my skin I understood that I was on another level of treatment. Some may get scared away by the prizes in comparison to those massages offered around but you can’t compare a service like this is worth it ! every single dollar is worth it! Just try it out for yourself ❤️ stay blessed Namaste 🙏

reviews.name: Aqeela Al-Asfoor
reviews.text:
My husband and had foot massage there.
It was a lovely experiance
The welcome tea was really refreshing and yummy.
Then we got out feet washed  and we were guided to the room.
The atmosphere was relaxing and beautiful.
Upon completion we got escorted out  and served a nice calming tea.

reviews.name: Vivian Lau
reviews.text: Excellent service and massage! Helping you to relax and enjoy the rest of your trip. Highly recommend if you want a good massage. Will definitely come back again for more sessions.

reviews.name: tamadhir sultan
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Let’s Relax in Thia Phuket. My masseuse, Boonrod, was absolutely wonderful. She was professional, attentive, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire session. The massage was incredibly relaxing and helped relieve all the tension in my shoulders and back.

The atmosphere at Let’s Relax was calming and clean, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. Boonrod’s technique was excellent—gentle when needed and perfectly firm at the right spots. I walked out feeling refreshed, relaxed, and completely rejuvenated.

I highly recommend Let’s Relax, and especially Boonrod, for anyone looking for a top-quality massage experience in Phuket. I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Jonathan
reviews.text:
Awful branch. Don't go!

We had an awful experience a day before another appointment.
My girlfriend back is now hurting because of an awuful massage therapist and when ahe complained the staff did absolutely nothing!
When we tried to cancel the second appointment they just refused to help us in any way!
Just sending us off. They basically "stole" my money.
Also their contact number isn't available or real.
Ruined our vacation. Never coming back here.

reviews.name: Gone bush
reviews.text: Best Thai massage you can get. Legitimate professionals and  extremely competitive prices. 3hrs for 1600bht, half the price of what resorts are charging. Professional service. Honestly give them a go, you will come out relaxed and refreshed.

reviews.name: David Yin
reviews.text: Good massage at a decent price. Staff are friendly and attentive. More expensive than a few of the other massage parlors nearby but provides better privacy and service

reviews.name: Houria El Yazidi
reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful time at Let’s Relax Spa. From the warm welcome at the reception to the serene atmosphere, everything was perfectly arranged.
A very special thanks to the staff and the therapists for their kindness, professionalism, and genuine care. They made us feel comfortable and truly pampered throughout our visit.
Honestly, this was the best massage I have ever had in my life – absolutely incredible. It was not only relaxing but also deeply rejuvenating.
I recommand it for anyone staying in Karong Beach, or  Phuket.

reviews.name: Linda Chua
reviews.text:
I am a regular at Let’s Relax whenever I visit Thailand and I usually go daily throughout my trip. This was my second visit to this same outlet on this trip, and while the massages were as good as usual (I did the 45 mins foot + 15 mins hand + 30 mins back), I had one disappointing experience this time.

I requested twice to change my clothes because I was wearing a delicate dress and was heading straight to the airport for my evening flight after the massage. Unfortunately, the staff rejected my request. I didn’t want to make things difficult so I proceeded, but I was very bothered throughout the session.

As expected, my dress ended up pulled loose, wrinkled, and crumpled, which affected my mood for the flight. A spa visit is supposed to relax you and put you in a good mood — not ruin your outfit and overall experience.

I hope the management can be more accommodating in such simple requests in the future.

reviews.name: Drake
reviews.text:
I had an incredible experience at Let’s Relax in Karon, Phuket! I came in two days in a row because the service was just that good. On my first visit, I tried the back and shoulder massage and was genuinely surprised by how effective and relaxing it was. The therapist was highly skilled and attentive, working out tension I didn’t even realize I had.

The next day, I returned for a warm oil massage—and wow, it was absolutely blissful. The room was calming, the oils were soothing, and the pressure was just right throughout. I left feeling deeply relaxed, refreshed, and completely recharged.

The staff are friendly, professional, and clearly well-trained. If you’re in the Karon area and looking to treat yourself, I can’t recommend Let’s Relax enough. This is self-care done right!

reviews.name: Юлия Шу
reviews.text: Very nice and professional massage, clean and cosy space. Highly recommended to everybody who wants to experience authentic thai massage!

reviews.name: Iris Ho
reviews.text:
This was the worst Let’s Relax I’ve ever been; it was nothing like those in Bangkok or the one at Patong. I have always enjoyed Let’s Relax spa but this one at Karon was so disappointing. The rooms we had were bad, there were mold on the ceiling & the wall. As the beds were not massage beds; they were on the floor; it does not have the support when facing down. I had to put the pillow on my chest & support my head on my hand. The masseuse was not good at all ; I didn’t enjoy the massage & for the first time couldn’t wait for a massage to be over. I brought my family as I told them it’s one of the best spa in Thailand. Everyone was so disappointed. I’m sorry I had to give a poor review coz it’s a spa
that I always looked forward to whenever I’m in Thailand.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Let’s Relax Spa, Sawasdee Ka. 
We sincerely apologize for the disappointing experience you and your family had at our branch. We are very concerned to hear about the condition of the treatment rooms, and that the beds did not provide proper support for a comfortable massage.  Additionally, we apologize that the therapist’s performance did not meet the high standards we strive to maintain. Please rest assured that the therapist has already been sent for additional massage retraining to improve their technical skills and customer service. Your feedback has been shared with the relevant department for immediate review and action. We truly appreciate you bringing this to our attention, as it helps us enhance our services and ensure that every customer at Let’s Relax Spa enjoys a consistently excellent experience.

reviews.name: Chanell Henry
reviews.text: Had a truly wonderful experience here. The décor is chic, and the hospitality was top-notch—from the welcoming drinks and towels to the thoughtful after-massage tea and biscuits. The massage room was spacious, inviting, and beautifully designed, complete with a private shower. I would definitely recommend this place!

reviews.name: reham hinai
reviews.text: My experience was amazing.! Its a very clean professional place to get best thai massage especially with Boonsong, I highly recommend 👌  .. women safe as well

reviews.name: hihi
reviews.text: worst experience ever. The pillows are smelly. The therapist went to toilet during the massage. My skin got scratched by nails.

reviews.name: Court Simons
reviews.text: Exceptionally professional and curated experience. I had 3hr body scrub, wrap, aroma massage and facial.

reviews.name: Matte Black
reviews.text: Had a Thai massage here and therapist was OK-ISH. What I didn't like were the beds. Imagine lying face down on a pillow, and being pressed on your back. What you need is a pillow with a hole in it (like spa beds) to actually feel comfortable. This is what other places have but unfortunately not here. I went out having a neck pain which I did not have prior. Kind of a shame.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Let's Relax Spa Sawasdee Ka 

We appreciate your valuable feedback and sincerely apologize that your experience was not as comfortable as expected. We would like to clarify that Thai massage is typically performed on a flat mattress on the floor, which unfortunately makes it difficult to incorporate a face cradle like those found on spa beds. However, your suggestion is truly appreciated and will be taken into consideration as we continue to explore ways to enhance the comfort and overall experience for our guests. Thank you once again for sharing your thoughts with us.

title: Tong Fa Massage and Spa
ownerDescription: Thailand's premium relaxation and beauty experience located on the island of Phuket in the heart of Patong, offers a wide range of spa, massage & beauty treatments in a clean, affordable and relaxing enviroment Our skilled and professional staff are dedicated to creating an environment in which to renew and refresh, mind, body and spirit.
address: 108, 12 Thaweewong Rd, Pa Tong, Amphoe Kathu, Phuket 83150, Thailand
plusCode: V7RW+J3 Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Summer
reviews.text:
It’s been our 7th time here, and the massage is still consistently amazing! 🥰 Shoutout to our favorite massage therapists, Pui and Tai! They’re both so good, and if you have any special requests, they’ll make sure everything is done to your satisfaction.

We’ve recommended this place many times, and everyone we’ve brought here has absolutely loved it. Definitely one of our favorite places for a good massage!

reviews.name: Frank P
reviews.text: 20251206 - cheapest massage place near patong beach that only cost foot massage for only 200 thb/hour. As place is not along the main street, this hidden gem is not crowded. Massage is good and enjoyable in the quiet and peaceful shop. Did 2 hours foot massage and gave 100thb tip. Highly recommended and I WILL BE BACK!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much Frank for taking the time to share your experience at TongFa massage and spa. We happy you enjoyed your time with us and look forward to seeing you again soon.

reviews.name: Peter P
reviews.text:
If you are travelling to Patong in Phuket Thailand and are looking for an amazing massage. Come to Tong Fa Massage and Spa (Opposite Patong Beach). I have been coming here for many years and I highly recommend you stop by. They provide many services, massage, pedicure, manicure etc. All the staff are amazing, but I always come back to see Aom. She is amazing. My back isn't the best, but when I see Aom she makes me feel like I don't have an issue with my back at all. I wish I could see her every day. FYI, Aom recently got promoted (as per Tong Fa Facebook page) and I'm so excited and happy for her. Congratulations Aom.
See you when I come back 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Peter for being a long time loyal customer and for taking the time to share your experience at TongFa, we hope to see you again soon

reviews.name: Lee Finch
reviews.text: This place has quickly become our new fave massage place in all of Patong! We came upon this place from a Facebook group where they often advertise their services. The foot massages are amongst the cheapest and definitely the best in the area in our opinion. The girls are all lovely and who doesn’t want a 99 baht cocktail delivered directly to your chair while relaxing in style! We have returned again and again on this trip and will continue to visit on future trips. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for sharing your experience and photos of your time at TongFa massage and spa. We’re happy you enjoyed your time and we hope to see you again. Thank you for your kind words.

reviews.name: Glenn Shaw
reviews.text: We come to Phuket every 6 months and Tong Fa is where we go for massages every time. They are so lovely and professional and also have the best prices in town which is an added bonus. If you are in Patong you must visit Tong Fa for a massage and say hello to all the friendly ladies who work there. We highly recommend it 👌
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time and recommending and to your experience at Tong Fa Massage and Spa.

reviews.name: Hayley Rona
reviews.text: This is not your typical massage parlour in Thailand, my daughter had her birthday party planned by the lovely staff at Tong Fa, they organised food, and a cake. My girl had the whole package today and was made to feel so comfortable. She was so happy and definitely felt like a princess. If you’re wanting a safe place to treat your young ones on holiday this is definitely the place to go.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind words and for letting us share Lexie birthday with her! 
We are very happy Lixie left us feeling like a princess on her special day! 
Thank you for supporting us and sharing your experience at Tong Fa Massage and Spa.  We hope to see you again and we hope you enjoy the rest of your holiday in Phuket.

reviews.name: Heather Connell
reviews.text: OMG, after my knee replacement 6 months ago, I had a loss of movement. After a few treatments/massages with Aom, wow, I now have full bend and flexibility! I am extremely happy with Aom. I 100% recommend her 🙏🙏🙏 Aom speaks very good English, which is a great help with explaining what problems you have.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your experience and your recommendation. Fantastic to see the improvement in your knee. Our staff aren’t medically trained however are amazing massage therapists.  Thank you also for your kind words and support for Khun Aom.  We will share your experience with her. 
We hope too see you again soon.

reviews.name: May
reviews.text:
Bait and switch. On their poster ad it said it was 250 Baht for shoulder, neck and head massage. I asked them for someone strong to do deep massage and they gave me someone who didn’t know what she was doing and was not strong at all.

Did not do my head or neck. She massage barely my shoulders and barely my back.  I kept telling her I need stronger and she just couldn’t do it, but the worst thing is when I went to pay it was not 250 baht as advertised. They told me it was 300 baht. Lies. Stay away. Plus, I got mosquito bites all over me while getting the massage, including my face. 😡😡😡
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are sorry we didn’t meet your expectations. Did you talk with our manager as we would have provided you a full refund or another therapist? 
I am sure you don’t understand the Thai defamation laws as you have just committed a crime under the thai laws.  I would strongly recommend you remove your post if you wish to return to Thailand.  All our therapist are professional trained and licensed by the Thailand government. I personally check all of my staff. I informed our lawyer about your post and he will be in contact with you shortly.

reviews.name: Dominika Strela
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this place!

Togethed with my boyfriend we were looking for a massage place in Patong and came across multiple comments on reddit which were mentioning Tong Fa. We decided to give this place a try and we definitely don’t regret it!

First of all, girls in massage salon are very nice and welcoming!

I saw that some in the comments called premises “dated”, however, I would like to mention that place was extremely clean!

We started with foot massage, our therapists washed our feet, massage was performed in very comfy chairs, I saw some people even falling asleep. Massage was very nice and adapted to the needs of the client in the chair. And it was only 200 THB!

Second time we did return for the Thai massage. We came in the evening and even then massage was performed perfectly, girls had whole day of work behind them and were still giving it all while doing massage!

Highly recommend and thank you for perfect service!^.^
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your kind words and taking the time to share your experience at Tong Fa Massage and Spa. We are happy you had an enjoyable time with us. We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Shelley Esler
reviews.text: My husband and I came here for a couples massage with oil for one hour and it was very relaxing, as well as reasonably priced - highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Shelley for visiting us and for also taking the time to share your experience at TongFa. We hope to see you again next time you’re in Phuket.

reviews.name: Sarah Bak
reviews.text:
This place literally was the best. The massage was amazing and well done. Clean,
Lovely girls we had 1.5 hour massages here everyday for 4 days.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Sarah for sharing your experience at Tong Fa Massage and Spa. We are so happy you love our Massage Spa and visit us so many times. We hope too see you again soon.

reviews.name: Lachlan Scully
reviews.text:
Fantastic place for a massage that is well worth more than what we paid for.

We would be going every day if our accommodation was closer!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Lachlan for taking the time to share your experience at TongFa. We really appreciate your kind words and hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Danryn
reviews.text: I have been going to Tong Fa for several years now. They are very professional and friendly. They have massage tables with face holes and a clean facility. Kn Nut is very courteous and does a wonderful massage. She has just the right touch and feel and she just knows the perfect pressure without having to tell her. I highly recommend Tong Fa.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words and for taking the time to share your experience at Tong Fa massage and spa. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

reviews.name: Stacy Clark
reviews.text: WOW is an understatement. Travelling with children, particularly a 2 year old can be challenging, especially trying to treat yourself to a massage but the team at Tong Fa went above and beyond for our girls and were so accommodating, they made us all feel welcome. My girls loved the attention and treats and they wanted to go and see their "nail friends" every night. We managed to make 3 visits but definitely could have gone every night. I can see why they are highly recommended and we will definitely be back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Stacey for your kind words and sharing your experience with us at Tong Fa Massage and Spa. We can see by your photos your children loved their time a Tong fa. The staff love have them there too!

Thank for visiting us have a safe trip home and we do to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Melvin
reviews.text:
Nice, clean hygienic place. Came for a Thai massage and oil massage - would recommend the oil massage for 2hrs because that's what I did, and it really helped to relax my muscles.

Will definitely come back if I'm in the area!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Meru for your feedback and kind words and sharing your experience with your review. I agree with you 100%. A Thai massage first to losses everything up and then an Oil massage to relax.

We hope to see you again soon and thank you for supporting our business. Enjoy your holiday and thank you again for tell everyone about your time with us a Tong Fa Massage and Spa.

reviews.name: Karen Busch
reviews.text: Great family friendly massage parlour, awesome staff, very affordable, will definitely recommend! The staff were amazing, always ready to make you feel welcome! Will definitely be back! Visited Dec 2022 & 2024
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Karen for your kind words and sharing your experience at Tong Fa massage and spa. We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Brian Mackay
reviews.text: The best massage in Phuket, all the lady’s are brilliant and manager Nop is fantastic. We have been going for years and never disappoints. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Brian, thank you very much for taking your time and sharing your experience at Tong Fa Massage and Soa. Thank you for your kind words about our manager. K Nop and your recommendation for Tong Fa Massage and Spa. We hope to see you again soon. Travel safe.

reviews.name: דוד דלאל
reviews.text: The best massage parlor in Thailand, especially in Phuket. I've been doing massage there for 20 years. Especially Suriname. She's really professional and does massage. It's a waste of time. Don't miss it. Even if there's a line, wait in line. You should.♥️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words and your public recommendation of Tong Fa massaging spa. We appreciate you taking the time and recommending our staff we hope to see you again soon. And we thank you for your ongoing support and being part of the Tong Fa family for the last 20 years.

reviews.name: Eunha Hong
reviews.text: The pressure here is excellent, and they have highly skilled massage therapists working regularly at this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words and we hope to see you again at Tong Fa Massage and Spa

reviews.name: Nicole Sadej
reviews.text: I had an amazing Thai massage - they worked out every knot and ache I was feeling. Very great price for the area as well, highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to do a review on your kind words. You hope to see you again soon.

title: Patong Sabai Sabai Thai massage
subTitle: สบาย สบาย ไทย มาสสาส
address: Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket 83150, Thailand
plusCode: V8X2+5P Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Edward McFadyen
reviews.text: Despite the look of this place it was actually quite good. I opted for a 60 minute head and neck massage. The lady who done this was very professional and experienced. The price was reasonable as well. I would go back.

reviews.name: Gilio
reviews.text: The prices are extremely affordable, which is definitely a big plus. The massage itself, however, was rather below average and, at least for me, too gentle. There were also fairly loud conversations between the staff in the background, which made it difficult to fully relax. The session ended about 10 minutes earlier than expected. Overall, it’s okay for the price, but there’s still room for improvement.

reviews.name: Gaian
reviews.text: Don't go here. A typical tourist trap—cheap version. I got rashes all over my shins after getting a foot massage. Most probably they use cheap and dirty oil (or it was the masseuse' dirty hands?); no wonder it costs as little as 150 baht to get massages around this area. And the massage itself was the opposite of relaxing— it hurt. You are warned!

reviews.name: Ashley T (Shark and Eagle)
reviews.text: 1 hour oil, only serve for 45 mins and my friend who start after me was even less, around 40 mins. Next door in green is much better. I was gonna give tips but eh, I won’t complain much because it’s still really really cheap.

reviews.name: Merve Yildiz
reviews.text:
This was the worst massage studio I have ever been to. The bed sheets are not changed between customers, and there is a complete lack of hygiene. Although the price is cheap (150 Baht for one hour), the overall experience was extremely uncomfortable.

During the oil massage, the curtains were opened, and men were able to see me, even though I clearly did not want to be seen. The staff were on their phones during the massage, the studio was noisy, and it was impossible to relax. The massage itself was also very low quality and not professional at all.

I would not come back and cannot recommend this place.

reviews.name: Aleksandra Sawinska
reviews.text: It definitely a budget place - they offer cheapest prices in entire Patong. Don’t ask for fancy and quiet room because you won’t find it here. If you need a professional who will do relaxing feet massage, Thai massage or sport massage it is the place to go. I have great experience with lady called Mam, very good and strong guy Supan and Sweet Didi!

reviews.name: Jacqui R
reviews.text:
Absolutely shocking. My masseuse, an older lady was so rough with my legs to start, then the pressure was extreme and I like hard massages. I had to ask her to make it softer multiple times, she would rub my back for 2 minutes lightly and then go straight back crazy hard. She also was rubbing so fast I also asked her to slow down. It felt like she was in a race to get it over with. I ended up wanting to cry and felt so so so stressed from the whole experience.

The place is packed, everyone is shoved in and the staff are non stop talking.

I felt like I needed a massage to relax from my shocking massage so I went two doors up to Jup Jang and omg she was incredible!

Be ware of Patong Sabai Sabai!

Try Jup Jang instead! It’s also 150 baht

reviews.name: Ben Bainter
reviews.text:
2 hour Thai massage with oil for $500 baht including the tip. Best massage for the price if your wanting an actual massage to work out tight muscles.

I hiked over 4 km up and down steep inclines and got a massage the same day. I wasn’t sore at all the day after the massage.

reviews.name: #TJA Travel Avocation
reviews.text: I had read the negative comments and was hesitant. I was planning on going to the one next door with better reviews but I gave it a chance. Everything went well and I will visit again. Very very good massage. Initially I wanted him to make me a man, I feel more comfortable and I had talked to a man out there but he referred me to a girl

reviews.name: Helen
reviews.text:
I had an amazing oil massage at this place—สอน! The technique was strong and precise, very different from a typical French massage. It was a bit intense at times, but in the best way possible. Despite the firmness, I left feeling deeply relaxed and refreshed. If you’re looking for an authentic and revitalizing experience, I highly recommend it!
She was super professional and respectful 😃

reviews.name: Gagan Gangwal
reviews.text:
Stay away....smelly dirty fraud place!!!!
I asked for 90 minutes thai massage and the girl in front said 200. Later after massage asking for 300 and manager saying front girl has no authority to tell rates. Ok but then where were you when we agreed on a price? Avoid this shop if you don't want to get cheated. 100 baht no big deal, but it's the wrong attitude of manager and staff. Manager asking me to complain to police. 1 hour massage vosts 150 then how does 1.5 hour cost 300? The math doesnt add up....Stay away if you want peace of mind. They act ro not understanding English. Thai Massage was done by an old lady who pressed on my back so hard that it hurts even more. I had rod in my left elbow to which she twisted me so hard it hurts even there. Would have given 0 star if possible. Cheaters

reviews.name: Lailo 018
reviews.text: First and Su are the best !!! Thank you so much for everything ❤️ best massage salon ever !!! 5 💫

reviews.name: Summia Nasser
reviews.text:
The place was not clean at all, with a bad smell and dirty towels.
However, the masseuse Nikki was very kind, professional, and her massage was truly excellent.

reviews.name: Platoo
reviews.text:
No sex , Good sevice nice and clean, foot massage 1 hour 250baht
Thai massage 250 baht
Oil massage 350 baht
Body crub 500baht
Ear spa 400 baht
Gel polish 500baht
French get polish 500baht
Remove gel polish 250 baht
very comfortable the shop opposite Patong Beach Dental Clinic if you next to Said nam yen junction.

reviews.name: Anna Dmitrieva
reviews.text: It's the most budget-friendly spot in Phuket (just 150 bhat) but I was truly impressed by the quality ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐.There are several salons in the area, each with its own unique vibe, and every massage therapist adds their own personal touch. I really appreciate that they offer strictly professional massages, with no extra services whatsoever, just pure, quality care. The complimentary water is a nice touch too. I visit regularly and highly recommend it! 😊💆‍♀️💧

reviews.name: PIERRE DE VILLIERS
reviews.text: Worst massage I've had in Thailand. I don't think she was trained properly 🤔 I had to stop the massage as she was hurting me so badly. I asked for my normal oil massage,and she gave me some serious torture 😩 😂anyway. The manager apologized. I don't remember her name, so be careful😂

reviews.name: Andy Ng
reviews.text:
How do people actually give this spot more than 1-2 stars? This was hands down the worst massage we had gotten our entire trip.

My friends and I were lured in by the 150 baht foot massages that everyone writes about. It's cheap for a reason. The space was packed given the affordable cost, so all of us were in different locations and it felt really cramped.

My 60-minute massage was only 45 minutes in practice, and they did not hit all the areas I've come to expect with a foot massage. It was poorly executed and I left feeling like nothing happened.

For my friends, one was asked if they wanted something 'more' from a masseuse, and another complained about it being very lackluster in general.

Save your money and spend a little more for an actual massage and not this tourist trap.

reviews.name: Alan Fraser
reviews.text: I have visited many massage shops in patong over the years and I rate this the best so far for quality of massage and value for money. I presented with lower back pain and received very professional treatment from both female and male therapists. Up to 1/4 the price of some clinics and a thorough, professional service. Come here first and forget the rest!

reviews.name: Czt
reviews.text: Terrible massage. I was served by an older lady who was distracted with other things the whole time and paid no attention or dedication to my foot massage. I do not recommend getting a pedicure at this salon.
All the tools were dirty. The foot file appeared to have been used on a previous client, and when I pointed this out, the staff member only wiped the scissors with nail polish remover. The nail files were old and worn. The foot baths were extremely old, yellowed, and clearly not disinfected.

Additionally, the pedicure itself was painful. The woman who performed the service was polite and kind; however, she is not responsible for the hygiene standards of the salon — this responsibility lies with the owner.

I sincerely hope I did not contract any infection due to the unsanitary tools, and I feel it is important to warn others about this place. The price was stated as 200 baht upon arrival, but at the end I was charged an additional 300 baht for heel cleaning. This reflects a serious lack of respect for the customer. I am willing to pay more for a service if it is of good quality, hygienic, and professional — unfortunately, this was not the case here.

reviews.text:
⚠️Lost and stolen report⚠️ 27th April 2025

Hello,

I would like to share an unfortunate incident we experienced at Chang Massage, located in Kamala Beach, Phuket.

Like many other tourists, we decided to get a massage and visited Chang Massage. We chose a foot and back massage. During the back massage, as pressure was applied to my neck, my necklace kept getting caught on a mole on my neck, which caused significant discomfort. Because of this, I took off my necklace and placed it on the chair in front of me. The masseuse behind me clearly saw this.

After the massage, feeling relaxed, I sat down on the chair and completely forgot about the necklace. I realized a few hours later that I had left it behind. Since we had an early tour the next morning, I immediately informed the hotel reception and asked them to contact the massage salon and let them know I would come by to pick it up the next day. The hotel staff did their part, but the salon staff claimed they hadn’t seen any necklace and stated that they never ask customers to remove jewelry. The hotel also advised us to request to check the security cameras, which they said should be available.

After our tour, we went directly to the salon. However, the owner would not allow us to speak with the masseuse and insisted that we only speak with her. She pointed to the chair and said, “There is no necklace here, we didn’t see anything.” But I clearly remember placing the necklace on the chair in front of me. In short, the necklace disappeared, and the staff kept repeating “we didn’t see it,” trying to dismiss the matter. Moreover, there were no security camera around.

Despite repeatedly explaining that it was impossible for the necklace not to be noticed after we left, and that it might have been taken or hidden by a staff member, the owner continued to insist they had seen nothing and that they never ask customers to remove their necklaces. It’s true that no one asked me to take it off, but due to the strong pressure applied to my neck during the massage, I was forced to remove it because it was causing discomfort. Then, the owner changed the subject to the dry cleaning process and said we sent everything to dry cleaner. But as I stated above it was IMPOSSIBLE NOT TO SEE the necklace on the chair. Even though they pull the cover for dry cleaning after every customer they must have seen it on the cover!

To summarize, my necklace went missing, and we believe the staff have not been honest about the situation. I’m writing this once again to say that the NOV hotel management is aware of the incident and has stated they will return the necklace to me if it is brought to them. Please respect professional ethics and ensure that my personal belonging — which we believe is with one of your staff — is returned to the hotel.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Sorry

After the long New Year holidays and lots of traveling, I really needed some proper care. This was my third visit, and this time I tried the 2-hour Thai Balm Massage. It’s described as a Thai-style massage using balm mixed with oil — but there was almost no herbal scent at all. The therapist explained that they use a fragrance-free formula for guests who don’t like strong smells, especially if they need to go out afterwards. The warming sensation is also mild. It might feel unusual for Thai guests, but it makes the treatment feel gentle and refined.

The massage felt like a mix of oil massage and traditional Thai techniques, working along the muscle lines with a slow, relaxing rhythm. At first it felt a bit light for me because I usually prefer strong pressure, but once I mentioned my lower-back and hip tension, the therapist gave special attention to those areas — and I felt so much lighter afterward. It finished with a lovely, gentle head massage.

The whole experience was thoughtful from beginning to end: a welcome drink (butterfly pea lemonade), foot wash and scrub, and after the treatment, hot bael tea, a warm towel, and beautiful Thai alua sweets. Such a lovely finishing touch. I really loved it.

Before starting, our legs were washed, and we were led to our respective spots. The foot massage was amazing—just the right amount of pressure, with a consistent and skilled touch.

The aromatherapy massage took place on level 3, which offered a quiet, serene environment. The massage itself was very relaxing, with smooth, effective strokes that eased my body aches. The fragrant oil added to the experience, and towards the end, they included some cracking techniques and hot stones, which were wonderful finishing touches.

For 750 baht in total, it was definitely worth it! If you’re in the area and looking for a quality massage, I’d highly recommend Lavender Massage.

I recently had the privilege of embarking on a 4 day Thai traditional massage course at Chivana Day Spa in Bangkok, and it was nothing short of extraordinary. Led by the skilled instructors Jiffy and Bua, and expertly translated by Amber, the course exceeded all my expectations.
From the moment I stepped into the serene ambiance of Chivana Day Spa, I knew I was in for something special. The instructors, Jiffy and Bua, exuded a profound understanding and passion for Thai massage, which they seamlessly imparted throughout the course. Their guidance was not only thorough but also infused with a genuine reverence for the ancient art form.
What truly set this experience apart was the invaluable contribution of the translator, Amber. With her impeccable language skills and deep understanding of both Thai culture and massage techniques, she ensured that every concept and nuance was conveyed accurately, fostering a seamless learning environment for all participants.
Throughout the course, I was amazed by the depth of knowledge and hands-on expertise demonstrated by Jiffy and Bua. They patiently guided me through each step of the massage sequence, emphasizing the importance of technique, intuition, and mindful presence. Their dedication to preserving the authenticity of Thai massage was truly inspiring, and I left the course feeling not only proficient but also deeply connected to this ancient healing tradition.
Furthermore, the facilities at Chivana Day Spa were impeccable, providing a tranquil and supportive setting for learning and practice. The staff were warm, welcoming, and always on hand to assist, further enhancing the overall experience.

This is by far the best massage experience I have ever had in Bangkok. They have very professional knowledge where your blockages are and genuinely wanting to help you release the knots and blockages.

And once again, another excellent experience . We had the two hour oil massage, and since it was so good, then we decided to add another 30 minutes of foot massage.

We had some really bad massage experiences in some other places in Bangkok; let along the masseuses were basically touching you all over without any strength; on top of that, the masseuses were chatting to each other during the whole section. It felt like they were just having a nice time chatting to each other instead of giving the customers a massage. We felt so uncomfortable and really wanted to ask them to end the session early. So please make your choice wisely.

The owner lady speaks perfect English, and they have a masseuse that speaks fluent Chinese Mandarin as well, it makes communication so much easier.

I highly recommend this massage store for anyone, looking for a really good massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: LetMeEatThat
reviews.text:
Nice, clean, and well-maintained space. The staff were professional and the overall atmosphere was pleasant.

The only downside was the layout. There’s no partition separating the reception area from the massage area downstairs. Because the store is quite busy, you can hear customers coming in and speaking with reception, which takes away from the relaxation experience.

If they could improve the separation or soundproofing, it would make a big difference.

reviews.name: Jack Carter
reviews.text: This place was the perfect spot after a busy day of travel. The staff were very nice and attentive to making sure you were satisfied. Whenever you walk in please don’t be that person who can’t read a room (be quiet). Everyone is together getting the foot massage but respectful of each other’s relaxation time. Which is itself is beautiful. How it works: You start off by paying for your massage, then the staff washes your feet, then your masseuse takes you to your recliner with your personal belongings in a basket, from there they massage your feet and if anything bothers you they make sure to check if you’re okay, lastly they’ll have you sit on the foot rest where they can massage your back briefly and run through some stretches. Before you leave you finish with some warm tea.  Overall very clean, peaceful and perfect! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Matthew Lee
reviews.text:
I haven't noticed this place before and I thought it was rather new, but it has been opened for quite some time.
I was staying at the hotel opposite and I came across this place one night on my way back and decided to give it a try.
There were quite a lot of people waiting but I didn't take long to get someone to serve me.
Furnishing is quite modern and the massage chairs looks new and clean. I requested for a male masseur and got one and I was impressed with his skills and his pressure.
As usual, there was washing of the feet before massage and tea was served after the massage. It is one of the most quiet place I have done a massage so far, seems like they refrain the customers and the staff from talking so the environment is very conducive.
I would return and would also recommend this place to try foot massage. Price is slightly more expensive then the usual massage places but I guess it is worth it for the environment and the quality of the massage.
It deserves more than a 4 stars, maybe a 4.5.

reviews.name: Neeru K
reviews.text: Superbly efficient foot massage place. You walk in, you pay, occupy a sofa. No talking, no noise. The massage and the quiet atmosphere will make you fall asleep. Just across the road from the marriott marquis. Open till 2 am. Get a foot massage daily during your stay there.

reviews.name: MsOmNom
reviews.text:
Foot Massage Balsabai, located on Sukhumvit 22 right opposite the Marriott Marquis Queen’s Park, is a nice and clean place for a relaxing massage. The ambiance is comfortable, though the air conditioning can get a bit chilly if you’re sitting directly under it—don’t hesitate to ask for a blanket if you feel cold.

The masseuses are skilled and provide a good foot massage, and the prices are reasonable for the quality of service. I haven’t tried their Thai massage yet, but based on my experience with the foot massage, I  had a good session.

One thing to note is that the place accepts cash only, so make sure to have some on hand. It’s also customary to tip the masseuse after the session, which is a nice way to show appreciation for their work.

Overall, Foot Massage Balsabai is a solid choice for a relaxing massage in the Sukhumvit area. I’d recommend it for anyone looking for a clean and professional massage experience.

reviews.name: E.PAK, slow eater
reviews.text:
I really don't like leaving unfavorable reviews (see my other reviews), and with a place like this, it really depends on who your masseuse is. I've actually been here before and had a fine foot massage (nothing remarkable, nothing bad). However, the other night – it was just plain not great. I had a young man who seemed so disinterested in giving a foot rub. This is a "FOOT MASSAGE" place and he touched by feet for about a total of 7 minutes during the hour massage. And just pressed my shins for 50% of the time. He also got REAL close to my crotch too many times... yeah, that was weird. The place needs to vet out their staff a bit once in a while.

The space itself is great, really quite nice. And I would like to think 95% of their staff is doing a great job. But I'm sorry here, this last experience was really not great. Kind of a waste of money.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We deeply apologize for the dissatisfaction with your massage. Furthermore, we are deeply aware of the behavior you felt offended by. We will review the CCTV footage inside the shop and have the offending masseuse terminated. We at FOOT MASSAGE BALSABAI will continue to strive to provide safe and healthy foot massages so that our customers can enjoy them with peace of mind. Once again, we apologize.

- There's a small 50 THB extra charge after 9 pm, but it's well worth it.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text:
I've had massages before. They're usually soft music and aromatherapy, where I drift off to sleep. This was not that.
This was a highly effective, full-contact wrestling match with a tiny woman named Ree, who I suspect is secretly built entirely out of steel cables and good intentions.
When I walked in, I felt like a sturdy oak tree. An hour later, I was folded up like a suspiciously complex piece of origami, hearing joints crack that I didn't even know had names. At one point, she had me in a pretzel position, using my own leg as leverage, and I swear I heard her whisper, "Don't worry, mai pen rai (it's nothing), I am just finding the soul of your back."
Five stars because I genuinely believe I grew two inches and my persistent neck pain has been replaced by a faint, bewildered sense of awe. If you enjoy feeling simultaneously disassembled and reassembled, and you want to leave feeling looser than a forgotten spaghetti noodle, book now. Just remember to eat your last meal at least three hours before your appointment.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sir, thank you for your feedback. We are sorry that the massage session was not as good as you wished for. We take all feedback seriously so we investigated what happened.
As for the time, CCTV footage from the lobby shows that you left the lobby to go up to the room at 16:05 and that you came down again at 17:07. You didn't shower after the massage, so we cannot find proof of cutting of time by the girls.
As for the massage session, from what we understand, you wanted to have 2 shots and negotiated some extra option with the girls but in the end there wasn't that much time for the 2nd shot.
You had Bee and Ella, it is hard to verify how sensual their massage style was during the session, but it can happen during FourPlay that the girls will talk to each other as communication with you in another language is often difficult. It is a challenge, both for the customer and for the girls to keep engaging each other. This is a natural risk of FourPlay as there are two girls, we always remind them to engage more with the customer. In a private session with one girl, this problem disappears.
As for our receptionist, we are aware that she can come across as less friendly than average Thai. Inside, she is a friendly person but she can have this appearance and we have discussed this with her. She has shown improvement and let this be another reminder for her.
Overall, thank you for all your feedback, we'll try to use it to improve.

I did the fourplay massage here last night before closing. I arrived around 21:45. They told me i could only do one hour as they are closing, which is understandable. reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sir, thank you very much for your detailed review. We appreciate your remark about massage tables.
Massage tables have some benefits and some disadvantages, both for customers and for masseuses. One disadvantage is that with a massage table, the girl cannot move around the customer as freely as on the ground. For the type of intimate massages that we offer, this is one of the biggest disadvantages of massage tables.
We had some massage tables before, but over time we moved them out. Depending on the needs of customers, we may consider putting one or two back in.
Thank you for your suggestion.
We look forward to see you anytime again.

title: Old Medicine Hospital Thai Massage School Shivagakomarpaj
subTitle: Old Medicine Hospital-Shivagakomarpaj Thai Massage School (OMH)
ownerDescription:
ยินดีต้อนรับสู่โรงเรียนแพทย์แผนไทยชีวกโกมารภัจจ์
Learn from the original source of all Northern-style Thai Massage.
The Old Medicine Hospital, the historical gem of Chiang Mai, is the birthplace of Northern Style Thai massage. Established in 1962 by Master Sintorn Chaichakan, this lineage has set a global standard, establishing Thai massage as a recognized style worldwide. Here, you will learn from the very foundation, inheriting a legacy of knowledge passed down through generations. Step back in time into the living history of Thai folk massage. Train in an authentic setting where centuries of wisdom have been cultivated. Surround yourself with a rich cultural atmosphere and the familial lineage's historical connection.
address: 238, 8 Wua Lai Rd, Haiya Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand

plusCode: QXCH+P8 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: MÁRIO MIGUEL
reviews.text:
I had an incredible experience with Old Medicine Hospital Thai Massage School in Chiang Mai — it truly is a remarkable place to learn and grow. This school has a rich heritage as the birthplace of traditional Northern-style Thai massage, and you can feel that history and authenticity throughout the entire learning environment.
The staff and teachers are not only highly skilled but also genuinely warm, supportive, and professional. They create such a welcoming atmosphere that makes every student feel encouraged and valued. The way they share their knowledge with patience and care makes the learning process deeply rewarding.
In particular, I want to express special appreciation for Teacher Lek. Her level of professionalism, kindness, and respectful communication with every student has been truly inspiring. She teaches with such clarity and dedication, always ensuring every student feels supported and understood. Her positive energy and never-ending patience uplift the entire class, and her guidance has made a profound impact on both my learning and confidence.Txs Lek and Gap.
Overall, this school and its people have exceeded all expectations — a perfect blend of tradition, expertise, and heartfelt teaching that I would highly recommend to anyone looking to deepen their skills and understanding.

Mário Ribeiro
