reviews.name: Wen C
reviews.text:
I arrived at the Old Medicine Hospital as a stranger, with zero knowledge of massage, only curiosity in my heart. Over five unforgettable weeks, I was gently guided into the ancient art of Lanna Thai Massage. What began as a journey into the unknown became a profound experience of learning, healing, and connection.

Now, I leave not only with a solid foundation in this sacred tradition but with a heart full of warmth, gratitude, and memories that will linger like the scent of the herbal balls we made 😄. It is a complex scent that will always remind me of the wonderful time we all have spent together.

I'm grateful to have met the kindest and most generous souls who not only taught us massage skills but also how to respect and take care of each other as a family, how to enjoy life, how to find a balance within the nuances of life itself and everything else that matters.

Chiang Mai and the Old Medicine Hospital have etched themselves into my soul — a place of peace, kindness, and timeless wisdom. They will forever hold a special place in my heart.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your heartfelt message. 🌿

It means the world to us to hear how deeply your time at Old Medicine Hospital touched your heart. From arriving as a curious beginner to leaving with both skill and soul, your journey is exactly what we hope every student experiences.

We’re so grateful you allowed us to share this path with you — learning not only massage techniques, but the values of kindness, balance, and connection that are at the heart of Lanna Thai tradition. Your words are a beautiful reminder of why we do what we do.

You will always be part of our family, and Chiang Mai will always welcome you back with open arms. May the memories, scents, and teachings stay with you as you continue your healing journey.

With love and respect,
The OMH Team 💛

reviews.name: Lisa Gough
reviews.text:
I have had the incredible opportunity to study traditional Thai massage at the Old Medicine Hospital Thai Massage School in Chiang Mai, and my experience has been nothing short of amazing. I completed Levels 1 through 4 in Thai massage, as well as courses last year in foot reflexology and Thai herbal compress.

The teachers here are not only highly skilled but also incredibly engaging and fun, making the learning process both thorough and enjoyable. Their expertise and dedication to preserving and passing on this ancient healing art are truly inspiring.

I was extremely happy with the quality of education I received, and I left each course feeling confident and deeply connected to this beautiful tradition. I am already looking forward to returning to continue my journey with the teacher training program.

If you’re considering studying Thai massage, I cannot recommend the Old Medicine Hospital enough. It’s an experience that will enrich both your skills and your soul.

Update:

Old Medicine Hospital – reflections and recommendations for future students

I attended several courses at Old Medicine Hospital, drawn by its historical significance and its role in the preservation and dissemination of traditional Thai medicine. The school has a special atmosphere and a warm environment, and it’s clear that students from all over the world come with curiosity and an open mind.

That said, I’d like to share a few observations that may be helpful for future students:

In one of the courses, we were issued a Tok Sen toolset – a traditional instrument with deep roots in Thai therapeutic practice. I was surprised that the teacher brought in to lead the class neither used nor acknowledged the standard toolset provided by the school – which ultimately holds responsibility for the course content. She openly stated that she was unfamiliar with the tools, which also raises concerns about her familiarity with the school’s curriculum. Instead, she offered to sell her own set for 1,500 baht, even though a similar set could be purchased outside the school for around 450–550 baht. I don’t mind paying a bit more for good equipment, but it becomes problematic when you join a course where the instructor doesn’t know the tools provided and simultaneously promotes her own for sale. It felt like an unfortunate blend of teaching and personal business.

It is also noteworthy that Tok Sen is one of the few subjects at the school without any kind of examination or formal assessment, unlike other programs. Given Old Medicine Hospital’s status as a cultural institution and authority within traditional Thai medicine, it seems particularly odd that this valuable heritage practice is treated with such minimal emphasis.

Examinations in the other subjects are oral, and students are allowed to use their notes, which is appreciated. However, I experienced some inconsistency in how the use of materials was evaluated. In one course, using the textbook was not an issue; in another, it was considered a negative – even though I approached both in the same way.

Teaching is generally structured around students practicing on each other, which can be a great learning method. Instructors are present, but their supervision tends to focus on what the techniques look like, rather than how they feel to the receiver. This means that important sensory aspects of the work can easily be missed.

If you’re considering taking multiple courses in Thai bodywork, I strongly recommend spreading them across different schools. Each school offers a unique approach, and some provide the opportunity to practice on teachers or models who are familiar with the techniques – which makes a big difference in understanding what the methods should truly feel like.

All in all, Old Medicine Hospital offers a historical setting and can be a valuable starting point – especially if you come with curiosity and a willingness to take responsibility for your own learning. By asking specific questions before enrolling – such as about the use of materials, exam structure, and the level of supervision – you can make the most of your experience.

reviews.name: Rachel Spanner
reviews.text:
Brilliant aroma oil massage course! I completed the 5 day course, 30 hours, and learnt so much! Small class size, they give you an informative booklet explaining all the massage positions and techniques and the teacher explains these in simple steps on a model. You then complete the steps yourself after learning the information. 3 days learning information and practicing techniques, 1 day practice on entire body. And final day practical exam and certification. Very relaxed environment and very friendly and helpful teachers! Course taught in English and lunch and coffe/tea included in price. Definitely recommend this school for all masseuses. I was a beginner and I have learnt so much! 100% recommend.
Rachel from England!

I’d definitely come back and highly recommend this spa to anyone visiting Chiang Mai.

reviews.text: Amazing experience! reviews.text:

Midway through the massage, the therapist left to clean the bathroom — which was really unprofessional. The air conditioning was also way too cold, and I was only given a thin cloth to cover myself. I felt cold throughout the entire treatment and honestly thought I might catch a cold.

reviews.text: Went in for their 90 minutes massage at 890 or 990? Can't remember. The  service room is spacious and the bathroom/toilet is nice, clean and dry which is very good. I hate wet toilets. The massuer is trained and knows what his doing - named Nick if I am correct and if I remember. The location is also very good around Nimman area. Overall, good massage shop. Come and try!

Thank you very much for your kind review and recommendation. 😊
We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back to The Glam Massage again soon. 🙏✨

reviews.name: Johan
reviews.text:
Best therapist Yu (5 stars)
Strongly recommend the therapist Yu. Received both Thai massage and oil massage from him 4 times and he is skilled at both. He seems to be best at soft to medium pressure, but could do harder. It is easy to communicate with him and he checks throughout the massage the pressure and the massage is good for the receiver. He is also the only therapist I had the massages the full time (+a few extra). Even during power outage he continued to massage while getting warm due to no AC.

2nd therapist:
Clothes provided was too small and the therapist did not get any alternative size. I changed to my own shirt as I could not close the one provided. The leg massage was quite uncomfortable as the fabric cut in to my skin and I could not feel any of the stretches. After completed front legs, I changed to my own shorts.
The technique was average and he slipped a few times. One the lower leg back side he massaged through a thick blanket missing some of the pressure points.
The massage was supposed to be 2 hours, but he finished 15 minutes early.

3rd an 4th therapists:
Good massage, but compared to Yu, they put a bit less effort and both cut the time 10-15 minutes.

For the shop overall, wish they ensure that the therapists respect the treatment duration and perform training to the therapists to maintain a good quality experience for the customers.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely thank you for your kind compliments and detailed feedback 🙏
We are truly delighted to hear that you were satisfied with the service from the first therapist. Your kind words mean a lot to our team and are a great source of encouragement 💖

This includes the issue with the clothing size, the discomfort during the massage, and the shortened service time. These are matters we take seriously, and we will use your feedback to improve our service and ensure better attention to detail from our team.

Thank you again for giving us the opportunity to serve you. We truly hope to have the chance to welcome you back and provide you with a much better experience on your next visit 🙏✨

Benz completely changed that for me. His touch was caring, intentional, and deeply effective. He instinctively knew exactly where to work to melt away every layer of tension. Truly professional hands.
I started my session with the body scrub, and I'm so glad I did — it added a whole new dimension to the experience and felt like a full-body reset before the massage even began. The combination left me feeling completely renewed.
What also stood out from the moment I walked in was the front staff — warm, welcoming, and genuinely inviting. And the foot soak before being taken back for treatment was a lovely touch that set the perfect tone for everything that followed.
If you're visiting Chiang Mai and looking for a massage that goes beyond the ordinary, Glam Massage delivers. Request Benz — you won't regret it. Hands down a 5-star experience I'll be returning for. 🙌

reviews.name: 4Leaf Clover
reviews.text:
Update :

As I mentioned in my review, I was never given an intake form to fill out. If you have no record of my visit, how do you even know which therapist to ask?

You claimed I had a 'deep tissue massage' and the therapist was being cautious. However, I did not book a deep tissue massage. This proves you are either confusing me with another customer or simply making up an excuse.

Bottom line: Compared to every other shop I’ve visited at this price point, your service and skill are dead last. Thank you for the reply, but honestly, it addresses nothing.

************************************

I’ve been living in Chiang Mai for a month and have visited over 15 different massage shops. Hands down, this was the absolute worst experience I’ve had.

It was completely unprofessional from the start, no consultation form to fill out. Worse yet, the masseuse had zero technique. It felt like a total amateur was practicing on me. Do not let untrained staff work on customers. You need to train your staff properly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Sincere apologies regarding your recent massage experience

We sincerely apologize that the massage pressure during your recent visit did not meet your expectations.

We have spoken with the therapist who attended to you. We would like to clarify that he has over two years of experience and is generally skilled in deep tissue massage. However, in this instance, he explained that out of an abundance of caution and concern for your safety, he intentionally started with lighter pressure to avoid causing any bruising or injury.

That said, we unreservedly accept full responsibility for the "lack of communication." The therapist should have checked in with you more frequently regarding your preference. This failure to communicate led to a misunderstanding, and we missed the opportunity to adjust the pressure to your satisfaction in time.

We are truly sorry that his caution resulted in a disappointing experience. We will use this incident to strictly instruct all our staff to consistently check pressure levels with clients throughout the session.

Thank you for giving us the opportunity to serve you.

Sincerely,
Tha Glam Massage

reviews.name: 闕若宇
reviews.text:
The place looks beautiful, and the welcome drink was nice, but the massage… not so much.
For a while, I honestly couldn’t tell what the therapist was doing…
it just felt like she was gently stroking my calves the whole time.
Kind of like paying someone to softly stroke your calves instead of getting a real massage. 😅

reviews.name: 韋Aaron
reviews.text:
This spa has a beautiful environment and a pleasant atmosphere. The reception staff are polite. If you simply want to enjoy the lovely space and are not focused on getting a truly relaxing massage, I would recommend giving it a try.

However, if you’re genuinely looking for a massage to relieve tension, you should think carefully before booking. Many friends have mentioned that the massage therapists tend to use very light pressure and don’t apply much force. I personally experienced this as well. Before the session, I indicated on the pre-massage questionnaire that I needed stronger pressure. During the massage, I repeatedly asked the therapist to apply more pressure, but there was no difference—it felt almost like being lightly touched rather than an actual massage.

After the session, I reported this issue to the reception staff, who said they would inform the manager, but I never received any follow-up. When I raised the issue again for the second time, the manager came over and said, “Oh, I thought you just wanted to let us know that our massages are very light. Got it. Others have mentioned this before too…”

I found this way of handling customer complaints completely unacceptable.

reviews.name: Priscilla Tsang
reviews.text: Had a great spa experience this morning at Cheeva. Therapist MO (as shown on name tag) is excellent at her oil  massage technique :) Highly recommended.

Lotus Thai Massage is a traditional massage shop on Wualai Road, Chiang Mai. We offer Thai massage, foot reflexology, aromatherapy, oil massage, Thai balm massage for muscle pain relief, and cannabis oil massage for deep relaxation and recovery.

Our therapists are skilled and take time to understand what your body needs. Our staff and owner are friendly and welcoming, and will make sure you feel comfortable from the moment you arrive.

reviews.name: Svenja Harvey
reviews.text:
I am writing this more of a precaution to future women being massaged at Lotus Thai, rather than a review per se.

I was massaged here a few months ago when I was travelling - the massage was done by a man and I felt extremely uncomfortable throughout. He spent a disproportionate amount of time++ on my glutes and inner thighs, and I felt he massaged too close for comfort around the groin in general. I know it is normal for massages to feel in quite close physical proximity, but there is a line. I am a big fan of Thai massages, having had ~15+, and have never felt this way.

I want to stress that I do NOT think I was assaulted, but I do not think he would have massaged a male customer in the same way. Furthermore, I did not have an issue being massaged by a man and have been previously with no issues. Apologies, I did not get his name so cannot be more specific in my review - from reading other reviews this does not at all appear to be a common theme/issue at Lotus Massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Talulah
I hope you should have informed us right after you felt uncomfortable. As you mentioned you came to us few months ago we could have taken an action about inappropriate behaviour of our staff immediately. 
And I believe that the staff whom you mentioned about he gave massage to many female customers and we didn't get any complaints like this instead they keep coming back as he helped them fix their problem at the right point. 

As we are doing a hospitality business we understand that we can't satisfy everyone and I apologise for that if his way of giving massage made you uncomfortable.

reviews.name: Liv Ward
reviews.text: Really wonderful massage - I am a runner and needed sports massage style work on my feet & legs. Lek my masseuse was brilliant and identified the exact spots that needed some therapy! I will be returning after more running.

reviews.name: ga b b y
reviews.text:
The massage from the elderly masseurs (you can totally imagine it):
No strength or skill at all—basically just slathering oil on your legs and rubbing back and forth for dozens of minutes on end.

They chatted nonstop for the entire 90 minutes of the massage—seriously, such chatterboxes! When they got carried away talking, their hands would even stop moving. If a police car passed by outside, any little commotion like that would make them pause too.

When there were customers, they’d call in part-timers instead of having regular therapists. The staff were friendly enough, but that’s about it. The hygiene was just so-so: the wet towel used to wipe my feet was directly placed on a stool for me to prop my calves on—super questionable cleanliness.

Really hard to put into words. Actually, I’ve had a massage every day in Chiang Mai these past few days, and this one was by far the worst—total letdown! It’s pretty out of the way, but the price was on par with other shops. Too bad the quality didn’t keep up.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your experience — we truly value your feedback.

We are sincerely sorry to hear that your recent visit did not meet your expectations. Providing a relaxing and high-quality massage experience is our top priority, and it’s clear we fell short during your session. We also apologize for any discomfort caused by the level of service, cleanliness, and the interruptions in your massage – your comments are being taken very seriously.

We have already spoken with our team to address the issues raised, and we are committed to improving both our techniques and atmosphere so that this does not happen again.

We would love the opportunity to make it right. Please reach out to us directly or visit us again and mention this review — we would be happy to offer you a complimentary massage or alternative service of your choice as a gesture of our apology.

Thank you again for your honest feedback and for helping us grow. We hope to have the chance to welcome you back and provide the quality experience you deserve.

They also provide drinks / snack before and after which is a nice touch.

reviews.name: Dustin Steller
reviews.text:
Strolling through the heart of Chiang Mai, we were drawn to Melati Relax and Health Massage by its inviting facade and serene ambiance and kind staff that was not pushy at all. The spa’s was perfect to unwind after a day of working in a cafe. ￼

Upon entering, i was warmly greeted by the friendly staff, who made me feel immediately at ease. Opting for the traditional Thai massage, I was impressed by Alexa’s skillful techniques—strong yet attentive to individual pain points and details. The treatment effectively alleviated my travel-weary muscles, leaving me refreshed and rejuvenated. The spa’s commitment to reducing stress and relieving aches was evident throughout our session. ￼

As a couple passionate about immersing ourselves in local wellness practices, our experience at Melati was truly special. Sharing this authentic Thai massage not only provided physical relief but also deepened our appreciation for Thailand’s rich cultural heritage.

Melati Relax and Health Massage is a must-visit for travelers and expats seeking an authentic and affordable Thai massage experience in Chiang Mai. The combination of skilled therapists, welcoming atmosphere, and reasonable prices makes it ideal for anyone looking to unwind and rejuvenate. We highly recommend it and look forward to returning on our next visit to Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for liking our place and environment. We are honored and grateful that we were able to treat our customers with the valuable art of Thai massage. We hope to take care of you again.🙏😍

title: Nalina Spa
ownerDescription:
Nalina Spa
สปาเพื่อสุขภาพย่านเจริญนคร ที่จะพาให้คุณผ่อนคลาย หายจากความเหน็ดเหนื่อยเมื่อยล้าเป็นปลิดทิ้ง ให้คุณสบายตัวไปกับโปรแกรมแพ็กเกจนวดและสปาที่หลากหลายตามความต้องการ ทั้งนวดไทย นวดน้ำมัน นวดอโรม่า นวดสปา ขัดผิว อาบน้ำนม อบซาวน์น่า หินร้อนบำบัด นวดอินเดีย นวดเท้า ฯลฯ ในบรรยากาศร้านสวยผ่อนคลายสบายทุกอิริยาบถ พาคุณมาเปิดประสบการณ์บริการสปาที่เยี่ยมยอด Nalina Spaได้รับการออกแบบมาอย่างประณีตเพื่อให้คุณได้รับประสบการณ์การผ่อนคลายที่เรียบหรู ด้วยทีมงานผู้เชี่ยวชาญที่มีประสบการณ์และฝีมือระดับห้าดาว เรามุ่งมั่นที่จะให้บริการที่เหมาะสมกับความต้องการและความพึงพอใจของคุณทุกครั้งที่มาใช้บริการ เพราะเราเชื่อว่าการดูแลรักษาสุขภาพและความผ่อนคลายเป็นสิ่งสำคัญ ลองพบกับบริการของเราและสัมผัสความเป็นอิสระและความผ่อนคลายที่ไม่เหมือนใครได้แล้ววันนี้

reviews.name: Stuart Morley
reviews.text: What a superb place!. This is a very high-end spa at very, very reasonable prices. They have great staff who are clearly very well trained. They pay great attention to detail and will even send a car to pick you up from your hotel or condo. We live locally for 3-4 months of the year, and this is where we go every time. We have been many times and are never disappointed. You feel relaxed the moment you walk through the door, and the staff speak English very well. We would thoroughly recommend this business. We have visited many top spas around the world, and this is our favourite. We can't believe it's on our doorstep!

reviews.name: itfocusdon
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve had in Bangkok! The facility is spotless, modern, and very peaceful. I loved the foot scrub and the tasty welcome drink before the session. The staff really pays attention to your preferences and are very professional. Huge plus for the complimentary shuttle service! If you’re in the Charoen Nakhon area, don't miss this place.

reviews.name: Kim URBAIN
reviews.text: The best spa in Bangkok ! It’s a shame we only discovered it on our last day 🥹 but we had amazing treatments, we did an hydrating facial and a relaxing full body massage just before going to the airport. They offer a car service to pick you up for your appointment and drop you off right after. It’s real luxury, friendly and professional staff, well decorated spa. Thank you, we will be back.

reviews.name: Padel Pedro
reviews.text:
This was a fantastic experience.
I asked for a 60 minute massage.
The spa is beautifully appointed.
It is a haven of calm and serenity.
The staff were very expert. Very courteous.
Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Melissa Rivera
reviews.text: The owner came over to us gave us a flier with specials and services offered at the spa. They had a driver pick us up from our hotel in a very nice luxurious van. Upon arrival we were greeted with very welcoming smiles. They offered us ice cold tea and took us up to have our feet washed. Next took us up to our room where we would have the best couples massages. Gorgeous luxurious spa! Everyone was so friendly. We went back for a facial and ended our trip with a second massage as well which by the way they offered to take us to the VIP room. They took very good care of us. If we ever visited again Nalina is a must! We had the best experience.

reviews.name: Linda Laudal
reviews.text:
I recently visited this incredible massage spa with my mom, and it was hands down the best experience we’ve had in Bangkok! From the moment we walked in, we were blown away by the stunning décor – a perfect blend of traditional Thai aesthetics with a modern, luxurious touch. The atmosphere was so serene, it instantly made us feel relaxed.

My mom opted for a 60-minute body massage, and she couldn’t stop raving about how rejuvenated she felt afterward. The therapist was highly skilled and attentive to her needs, ensuring she left feeling completely refreshed. As for me, I went for a facial massage, and it was beyond amazing! The products they used were top-notch, and my skin felt so soft and radiant afterward.

The facility was spotless, from the massage rooms to the waiting area. You can tell they take great care in maintaining a clean, inviting environment, which made the experience even more enjoyable. The staff were extremely professional and made sure we were comfortable throughout the entire session.

A special thank you to Jack, the owner, for maintaining such a fantastic spa, and to Nina, our wonderful host, for making us feel so welcome. If you’re looking for a top-tier massage experience in Bangkok, this place is an absolute must! We’ll definitely be back next time we’re in town!

reviews.name: BlueCat Transportation
reviews.text: If you’re looking for an upscale spa , this is your place.  From the luxury car ride to and from my hotel , to the 5 star service soon as I entered the spa.   Bo , will greet you upon arriving and will have a brief conversation on your particular needs.  After discussing the type of massage you would like , you’ll be on your way to an experience you’ll never forget.  And please get the 6 hands massage. Very rare to find.   It will certainly surpass your expectations!!!  A must visit if your in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jezebel Zavala
reviews.text: My goodness I loved this place!!! I went with a couple of friends two days in a row because of how awesome it was. The owner there was very kind and absolutely welcoming. The wait was almost nothing and the entire time he chatted with us and we got along incredibly well!! They also provide you with tea before and after the massage and it’s sooooo delicious. The massage itself was incredibly nice and they really got into it, at some points I was sooo relieved after pressure was released from my body and I fell asleep. I got a facial on the second day and that was nice as well, I fell asleep and was nicely awoken both times. We also stayed nearby at a hotel and they offered us a ride back home in the nicest car, we arrived safely with tremendous care. Please go here, much love to all the employees!!! 💕💕

reviews.name: James Wei
reviews.text: The best spa ever ! I took my parents here , Highly recommended We had very good experiences with Four Hands Massage , Thai Massage & Oil Massage. If you were here in BKK this rehabilitation place is recommended , After finish with the services once gentleman came to talk with me he is the owner name Jack very kind & sweet so he took us to a bit of tour for a nice family picture of Wat Arun view. Thank You Jack for warm welcome, We are going to be back.

reviews.name: yuanyuan bao
reviews.text:
I recently visited the Nalina on the Mother’s Day and it was an absolute delight! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm smiles and a cozy, inviting atmosphere. The drinks, soft lighting and soothing music instantly melted away my stress.

The therapist’s techniques were a perfect blend of firm pressure to relieve tension and gentle strokes to relax my muscles.

I would highly recommend Nalina to anyone in need of some relaxation. Whether you've had a long day at work or just want to treat yourself, this is the place to go for an outstanding massage experience!

reviews.name: Gioula Chelten
reviews.text:
I convinced my teenage son to join me for a visit to the spa, and we ended up having an absolutely phenomenal experience. It was so great that we returned the very next evening and brought along friends from our tour group.

When we first walked in, I was worried that the prices might be beyond our budget, but to my surprise, they were very reasonable. The spa’s menu was so enticing that I wanted to try almost everything, but our time was limited due to our tour schedule.

The spa itself is stunning, with a luxurious ambiance that rivals upscale spas. The staff were incredibly professional and skilled in their craft. Upon arrival, they had us fill out a brief questionnaire about our preferences and expectations. My son and I both opted for relaxing massages, and they were so soothing that we both fell sleep—it was that relaxing. They began the session with a refreshing cold drink, and afterwards, we were treated to delicious tea, which added to the feeling of being pampered.

The staff truly made us feel like royalty, going above and beyond to ensure our comfort and satisfaction.

If you find yourself in Bangkok, I highly recommend treating yourself to a visit to this spa—you won’t regret it. They even offer a convenient pickup and drop-off service, so after our rejuvenating spa experience, we were conveniently transported back to our hotel doorstep.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review.Hope there will be another opportunity to serve you again.

reviews.name: Valentina Sánchez
reviews.text:
When coming in we were received with great attitude, attention and hospitality. The teas they served were splendid, I regret not taking a bag with me. I had a relaxing massage and a facial. The massage was really amazing. Yes, it is a bit pricier than other massage places in Thailand, however the facilities and the personalized massage really accounts for it. I was able to choose the oil for the massage! The facial was okay, but I am currently you going through some skin problems so I am not expecting miracles. In the end I felt my face really dry.
Overall, I would come back again and again if I could😊❤️

reviews.name: Soozhee Pearce
reviews.text:
As Australians now recently living in Bangkok, my husband and I are always on the lookout for quality massages, exceptional service, and value that matches the investment we make in our health. Recently, we stumbled upon Nalina Spa—a hidden gem that offers a boutique spa experience rivaling any five-star hotel spa I’ve encountered in my travels around the world. This was more than just a spa visit; it was a luxurious retreat that went beyond expectations.

From the moment we walked through the door, Nalina Spa exuded an unparalleled five-star experience. The attention to detail is remarkable. Their immense reception area is adorned with luxurious touches that reminded me of the private lounges in Louis Vuitton stores. Crystal chandeliers hung from the ceilings, while plush seating areas invited us to relax before the treatment. The staff, dressed in immaculate spa uniforms, welcomed us with genuine warmth, immediately setting the tone for the experience that followed.

I’ve visited countless high-end hotel spas across the globe, and I love my massages and facials. However, even at prestigious locations, I’ve often felt like just another number, with therapists going through the motions without truly caring. At Nalina Spa, I felt the exact opposite. Every detail—from the iced tea served on arrival to the crystal containers of high-quality oils and scrubs presented to me like a professional perfumer’s selection—demonstrated their commitment to creating a personalized and deeply caring experience.

Before the treatment, I filled out a form specifying the areas I wanted them to focus on, and they really listened. It was clear that the therapists were not just skilled but genuinely connected to their work, intuitively finding and addressing the tension in my body. So far, I’ve indulged in their full-body massages, foot massages, facials, and body scrubs. Each treatment left me feeling revitalized, with every knot and stress point thoroughly worked on, something that is often missing from other spa experiences.

Nalina Spa is more than just a place for treatments—it’s a complete wellness journey. Their couples’ treatment rooms feel like a five-star hotel suite, complete with luxurious showers, and their penthouse rooms feature a sauna and jacuzzi, adding another level of indulgence. It’s a far cry from the impersonal, overpriced massages I’ve had in shopping centers back home in Australia, where an hour-long session can cost $100 and often leaves me questioning its value.

For around the same costs, Nalina Spa includes a complimentary luxury hotel pick-up and drop-off in a limo, making me feel as pampered as I do during my visits to designer stores. The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, with a team of masseuses who are not only talented but also exude positive energy, creating a space that feels welcoming and safe.

On my first visit, I was simply seeking relief for my tired feet after a long day in Thailand’s humidity. The massive floor-to-ceiling windows and grand entrance immediately caught my eye. I saw the chandeliers through the glass and thought, “If they’ve put this much thought into their decor, the service must be just as detailed.” I was not disappointed. The owner, Jack, and his team, greeted us with such warm hospitality, making us feel like VIPs from the start. Their professionalism and genuine care for our comfort left a lasting impression.

If you’re looking for more than just a massage—if you want an experience that feels personalized, luxurious, and memorable—Nalina Spa is the place. From the beautiful setting to the thoughtful details, from the warm, attentive staff to the high-end amenities, it’s a sanctuary of relaxation that surpasses many five-star hotels. Whether you’re a local or just visiting Bangkok, Nalina Spa will leave you feeling pampered, rejuvenated, and eager to return.

reviews.name: Brian Pearce
reviews.text:
Nalina Spa in Bangkok has completely won me over and deserves the highest praise. This spa isn't just a place to get a massage; it's a true game-changer, offering a meticulously crafted and reasonably priced luxury experience.

From the serene ambiance and elegant décor to the exceptional quality of their treatments, Nalina Spa rivals, and in many ways surpasses, the spa experiences I've had at renowned luxury hotels like the Mandarin Oriental, The Peninsula, and Hilton.

Even before you step through the door, you're already  greeted with a level of professionalism and sophistication that one expects from a high-end establishment, but sadly, isn't always a given, even in hotel spas.  The staff are attentive and welcoming, making you feel instantly at ease.

As an increasingly frequent customer, I can confidently attest to Nalina Spa's unwavering commitment to excellence. They consistently exceed my expectations, delivering impeccable service with an extraordinary attention to detail. This consistency is absolutely crucial when you're investing your time and money in a spa treatment.

Unfortunately, many spas feel like a gamble; you never know if you'll get a therapist who is genuinely invested in your well-being or just going through the motions. I have no such worries here at all.

Nalina Spa is in a league of its own. It simply wouldn't be fair to compare it to the typical street massages you find throughout Bangkok.  This is a truly elevated experience.

Jack and his team have poured their hearts into creating something truly special, a haven of tranquility that is absolutely worth your time and money while in Bangkok.

The complimentary pickup and drop-off service is a fantastic added touch, ensuring a seamless and stress-free experience, especially after a deeply relaxing treatment.

Beyond the exceptional service and treatments, Nalina Spa cultivates an atmosphere of genuine warmth and positivity. You can sense it in the air – the genuine smiles, the calm energy, the palpable good vibes. It all contributes to a truly holistic and rejuvenating experience.

reviews.name: Nin V.
reviews.text: Best massage of my life! The place is very clean and has a very soothing atmosphere. The staff is very friendly and professional and will make sure you feel welcome and relax. reviews.name: T L
reviews.text: 3 of us visited 3 nights consecutively, receiving 90-120 mins treatments. The masseuse are amazing & very professional, the spa is very clean and modern & the pick up, drop off service makes the whole experience stress free!

reviews.name: adile korumaz
reviews.text: From the enterance till the end of their service you will definitely feel a member of a royal family or a VIP person. A great place to enjoy the massage and an exclusive service if you are 5kms nearby they even have a service to drop you.

reviews.name: Melody Hidalgo
reviews.text: TOP SPA IN BANGKOK!!! This is one of those times when 5 stars aren’t enough. Nalina Spa delivers high end luxury and pampering at reasonable prices. The attention to detail is everywhere they use high end products, heated treatment beds, pick up and drop off in VIP style and the best therapist Thailand has to offer make this Spa the best kept secret in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Victor Chua
reviews.text:
A wonderful spa which will make you feel like royalty! From the moment you step in, they provide drinks and a wet towel to refreshen you up.

reviews.name: xuan hu
reviews.text: I have been practicing here for nearly ten days, and I have regarded it as my second home in Chiang Mai. The venue here is very new, with air conditioning, and the people are very friendly. The group class here can be played five rounds, all of which are taught in small classes, so I can also get a lot of personalized advice in the group class. At the beginning, I was one-on-one. Coach James was very patient and the guide of my interest in Muay Thai. In short, this is a niche treasure boxing gym. If I have a chance, I would like to come back.

reviews.name: Tracy Pui
reviews.text: We took PT one on one class. We had lots of fun. This place is very clean and tidy. Adequate air conditioner. Coaches are friendly and educated. Very worth the price. They also offer group class as well. Will come back again when visit Chiang Mai again.

reviews.name: Sarah Maxwell
reviews.text:
We loved our family Muay Thai session so much. Trainers Frame and James were patient and encouraging coaches. We can’t recall when we could do an exercise session with our 10-yr old and everyone was loving it!

The workout was tailored to our level and they provided just the right amount of stretch and encouragement for each one of us!

One of our favorite Thailand experiences!!

reviews.name: Lynn Stolte
reviews.text:
In April, I was looking for a Muay Thai gym where I could train for a month. I had absolutely no experience, but after taking my first group class at Kru Frame Muay Thai Training Club, I immediately knew this was the right place for me.

I ended up training here for a full month, and it was an incredible experience. I learned many Muay Thai techniques from Kru Frame and Kru James, and there was also always room for laughter and fun during the training sessions. They make training both enjoyable and motivating.

What really makes this gym special is the family atmosphere. Everyone is welcoming and the group classes are relatively small, which means you get a lot of personal feedback and attention during training. Another plus is that you can rent equipment for only 10 baht, which is perfect if you’re traveling like me:) The gym also has air conditioning, which is definitely appreciated because the training sessions are intense and you will sweat a lot😅

I would highly recommend this gym to everyone. Training here was one of the highlights of my time in Chiang Mai and whenever I come back, I will definitely train here again🥊

reviews.name: Carson S
reviews.text:
BEST GYM IN ALL OF CHIANG MAI

Have been to many gyms all throughout Chiang Mai and this is the best quality training you will get. Equipment is clean and new. Trainers are very professional and knowledgeable of muay thai. They put emphasis on details and perfecting your skills to the highest level. Whether you are a beginner or advanced they can suit a training that is perfect for you. Come to train here, you will not regret. 💯

reviews.name: jinhao zeng
reviews.text: Stumbled across this gym randomly and honestly didn’t expect it to be this good. The coach was super friendly, patient, and made the training really enjoyable, even for a beginner like me. The vibe between everyone at the gym was great too — very welcoming and supportive. Definitely recommend this place if you’re looking to train Muay Thai in Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Chris Wong
reviews.text:
I started my Muay Thai training exactly 4 days ago. The first one was a private lesson at Dang Muay Thai which was a really intense crash course. The gym was packed with people of all different skill levels and very warm. It felt a little too commercial for me which is why I wanted to try lessons again somewhere else.

Here comes Kru Frame’s gym. He and Kru James were fantastic during my morning group sessions. They focused heavily on technique and paced the 1.5 hr sessions so I wouldn’t pass out before the sessions ended. The gym has air conditioning which is a huge plus and very clean. Gear rental is only 10 baht as well. The trainers are very friendly and patient and can communicate instruction in English (my DMT coach didn’t know much English). Group classes usually small, no more than 3-9 students per session for a 3:1 student to kru ratio. After my first class, I fell in love with the gym and bought the 3 session pack for 1000 baht.

My morning sessions were basically private. It was usually one other person or just myself. Although I’m still very new, I feel that I’m walking away from Kru Frame with enough understanding of proper technique to practice the basics on my own and continue training when I go home.

Thank you to the Kru Frame gym for an amazing experience. I will continue training, get better, and return one day. 🙏

THE B E S T MUAY THAI GYM!!!
full long rounds, closed place with air conditioning and air filters, and amazing people.  Kru Frame and Kru James are excellent teachers, and the class is so enjoyable the time just runs without even noticing although you are sweating 😁
We trained there (the whole family) every day for two weeks and so sad we have to move on..
The best choice u can make when choosing muay thai gym 🙏

reviews.text: A great gym run by amazing people and Milo the dog.  We had three generations training together. Grandad, Dad and Son.  An amazing experience for us all and they made a superb effort training my 9 year old son.  His skills have improved dramatically over one week.  We will be back on our next visit to Chiang Mai.  All the best.

Staying in Chaing Mai for a few days so we booked a lesson with Kru Frame for my son aged 12  the attention and tuition was top class and he was thrilled with the session. When I spoke to Kru Frame after training he has had over three hundred fights and held six different belts in his career so no wonder it was so good. I would recommend anyone to go to his gym which is top class and air conditioned. The other staff were equally attentive and helpful...Going back for second session before we leave
Pierce Healy
Kilkenny Combat Academy
Ireland

reviews.name: zoya zilberfarb
reviews.text:
We came as a family with three kids, and it was an amazing experience! The session was well-structured and suitable for all levels. The coaches were patient, professional, and taught us the fundamental Muay Thai techniques in a fun and engaging way.

We got a great workout, burned tons of energy, learned new skills, and had an absolute blast together. It was a fantastic activity for the whole family, and the kids loved every minute of it.

Highly, highly recommended if you’re looking for an authentic Muay Thai experience!

reviews.name: Lars
reviews.text: Had an amazing Muay Thai training here. Perfect for all levels, not just for beginners. They give more than enough personal attention with the group lessons. Learned a lot in just one lesson, thanks again guys. Awesome coaches, great gym and good vibe overal. Will definitely come back here when I visit Chiang Mai again.

reviews.name: Charles Timm
reviews.text: Truly brilliant club.  I was there with my son and grandson as beginners and we were all welcomed, professionally assessed and encouraged at every stage.  i never write reviews, but feel compelled to make an offering as this was a great experience for our three generations, we all learned great moves and we were made so welcome and felt part of the gym team.  We even attended local fights as part of Kry Frame Muay Thai, although not actually fighting of course.  I would highly recommend KRU FRAME MUAY THAI for all levels of ability.

All the coaches are incredible, it's a tough work out for sure but they push you in all the right ways. Will defintely come back when we come visit Chiang Mai again.

Tony, Mary, Bernhard and Christiane from Switzerland

reviews.text: Sammy and his wife are very accommodating, extremely friendly and amazing when it came to explaining what we were eating. Pickup and drop off was easy and efficient. I booked through stamps and would recommend 100%. Also very good value!

reviews.name: Abigail Grant
reviews.text: Sign up for Sammy’s cooking class and you will not be disappointed! It was a blast, I learned a lot and he showed us how to make coconut milk which I really enjoyed. Sammy’s class was one of my favorite parts of our two week trip.

reviews.name: Ora V.
reviews.text: So much fun! Cooking my own Thai food with such an amazing view was unforgettable. If you’re visiting Chiang Mai, don’t miss this place!

reviews.name: Sophia
reviews.text: Booked this through our hostel - Stamps. He picked us up bang on time, brought us to his beautiful home and showed us through his garden and explained every herb we were using. Some of the ingredients are pre-semi- cut so all we had to do was chop them a bit more (saved time) , and after every course you sit down to eat it. He showed us how to make coconut milk too! Very well run, a lovely family, and a lovely place. Sammy was very funny and helped to explain everything. There’s alternatives for whatever dietary requirement/ allergies you have. :) Defo recommend.

reviews.name: Breda 85
reviews.text: An unforgettable afternoon at Sammy’s Organic Cooking Class. Not only a fantastic cooking class with products from his own farm, but also the whole ambiance in his wonderful garden. We would recommend to book an afternoon with Sammy and his family to anyone visiting Chiang Mai who loves cooking. Thank you so much for the wonderful afternoon. Absolutely recommended!

reviews.name: Niamh Walsh
reviews.text: An incredible experience! Sammy is an amazing host and head chef. The food we all cooked is incredible and such an amazing setup. Also the best toilets in Chiang Mai!!

reviews.name: Henri Tourtet
reviews.text: A really fun experience; exceeded my expectations. Sammy and his wife made us all feel very welcome and the food we made was surprising delicious (I’m a terrible cook). Also make sure you visit the toilet there, best one I’ve seen in all of Thailand.

reviews.name: Michael Steibl
reviews.text: We had an amazing cooking class at Sammy’s school. Great organization, great place and a really cool vibe during the class. Sammy also showed us his farm. Really liked the concept of mostly using ingridients that also grow on his farm. 5 stars without a doubt.

reviews.name: chiangmaicharlies
reviews.text:
An excellent, undemanding day out. I had visitors from overseas who wanted to go on a cooking class. I had done so myself, but over a decade ago, so I checked reviews and eventually settled on "Sammy's Organic Thai Cooking School".

Reviews for his course (and most others) were very positive. The negative reviews were the most helpful and I must say that Sammy has listened to them and thereby improved his course.

I preferred going out of town for a course rather than attending one in town, and the half hour ride each way showed my friends some more of Chiang Mai. The rural surroundings of 'Sammy's' was very popular.

We all enjoyed the course very much as a day out - rather than as a intensive cooking course. I have only one complaint during the day: we cooked one meal and ate that, then we cooked three meals before eating them. I think that was a mistake and that Sammy should encourage eating the meals after their preparation.

I was pleasantly surprised how well my individual meals turned out!

The visit to the market was fine with enough information. The cooking stations themselves were good and clean. Sammy and his wife had good language skills and were good instructors. As with any course, the more attending - the less individual attention you will get. On our course were about 12, which seemed about right.

Highly recommended for those preferring a course out of town.

reviews.name: Taia Hara
reviews.text: Amazing cooking experience with Sammy on his property! We got to walk around the farm, check out all the things he was growing, feed the fish, try fresh coconut milk, and of course do lots of cooking. All the dishes we turned out so delicious! There were multiple options for which dishes you wanted to cook but I chose to make tom yam soup, chicken stir fry with cashew nut, red curry, and mango sticky rice. Out of all the cooking classes I’ve done this was by far my favourite. Sammy is the most friendly man and he really just made the whole experience.

reviews.name: Emily Blackwell
reviews.text: Had the absolute best time yesterday at Sammy’s cooking class! Sammy is so passionate and clearly loves his farm and teaching others about his food and culture. The food was so fresh and delicious! Sammy and his other staff members made the whole experience so much fun and it was one of the highlights of my time in Thailand!! Thank you Sammy!!

reviews.name: Nica Morris
reviews.text: Sammy’s cooking class was my favorite thing  I’ve done so far after 2 weeks in Thailand! He is so charismatic, kind, and passionate about what he does. He makes you feel so welcome, explains each ingredient, and guides you in making many delicious dishes. The farm is beautiful, and everything is grown there with love. I highly recommend doing a class here!!

reviews.name: Fontana
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful experience.  This is my second time at Sammy’s.  I took the class 2 years ago and loved it so much that I had to come back.  The second time was just as fun. They let you choose what you want to cook, so everyone gets their own menu.  Sammy is knowledgeable, welcoming, and has a great sense of humor! His home is beautiful, and he allows you to rest in paradise in-between meals.  It’s a great way to see the countryside, and to spend an entire day.

reviews.name: Annika Svea Marie Frost
reviews.text:
Sammys cooking class is just the best in Chiangmai! The farm is beautiful and they grow their own herbs and spices, as well coconuts.

The course is hold in English and they explayn every ingredient you put into your dish. Just relax and have a good time with amazing food!

In the end you even get a cooking e-book for free.

reviews.name: bea baby
reviews.text: The best thing we did in chiang Mai!! Food was fun and delicious, you never get bored or impatient. The real highlight is Sammy himself, he is so so funny and just the best!! We will recommend to everyone for an authentic experience. The views of farm & sunset are just stunning too

reviews.name: James Hamlett
reviews.text: Although we were in a class, it felt like all of us had plenty of time for one on one help. Sammy took care of everything, pick up & dropoff from hotel, provided bottled drinking water and fresh lemongrass tea, break areas, took us to a local farmer's market, and ofcourse taught everyone how to make some of our favorite thai dishes. All of this for nearly half of the competition's rates. This class will truly be one of the better highlights of our thailand trip. We also got to meet some wonderful travelers from across the globe. 10/10 worth every baht and some.

reviews.name: Sophie Davies
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience today at Sammy’s Organic Thai cooking school - I would really recommend this to others. We were picked up from our hotel and enjoyed a scenic drive up to Sammy’s private farm. The cookery class was wonderful - they gave us help when we needed it and provided clear instructions for really tasty dishes. There is a photographer who also takes lots of photos so you can look back on the experience. Love how thorough the cookbook is that you can use when you are back at home (44 pages in detail!!). I actually forgot my water bottle and sunglasses and they drove back to make sure I was reunited with them. The small details are really appreciated - thank you so much Sammy I will be telling everyone I know about it!

reviews.name: Bethany Friend
reviews.text:
We booked via Instagram a day in advance, and just had to provide our hostel for our collection. We were collected on time, and driven to the Farm. Sammy is very welcoming and passionate about his farm and cooking. The class was great making lots of dishes which you can choose. Our class had about 16 people in but Sammy and his Wife (I can’t remember her name I am sorry!) have a talent for making it feel like a small cooking class! So don’t be put off by the group size. Also the people who we did it with were lovely and friendly.
Sammy’s sense of humour really adds to the experience.
Can’t recommend enough! Especially the toilets!

reviews.text:
Fantastic! Sammy and his family were so awesome and hospitable!  Sammy picked us up at our hotel and drove us to his home, where he showed us around the lush garden and introduced us to the various herbs and vegetables that we'd be using.

reviews.name: Gavin Tan
reviews.text: I did 2 private sessions with Coach Mac during my vacation. Overall, it was a great learning experience. Prior to my arrival, I informed the gym of my interest and they asked me what I was looking forward to learn. I told them what I wanted and added some basic details about myself (belt, weight and age) and asked them to recommend me a suitable coach. They got me Mac, a black belt, just about my size. We  went through the problems I had in my training and worked on some solutions and specific training. Mac was patient, clear in his instructions (English) and rationales behind the moves. I got to refine the techniques that I like to do, not so much learning brand-new techniques. This was what I wanted and I appreciate the student-centred approach in private training. Locker and shower facilities are clean and functional in this gym. The place is air conditioned. Last thing: bring along your own towel, soap and water as not all gyms provide them free. Attached a pic that u can show to your bike taxis on your destination. Have fun!

reviews.name: Rita Alpoim
reviews.text:
House Arete. Where to start...

I found Arete exactly one year ago when I moved to Thailand in pursuit of the career of my dreams. At the time, I was on an intern's tight budget, and Andrew and Mitsu welcomed and supported me from the beginning by sponsoring my training. It is, without a doubt, more than a business. It's a second home, for me and many other lucky ones, built on a great deal of (often unknown) kindness.

On a good day, it would take me one hour to get there from work and back home in the evening, and it was worth it. Arete has a very flexible approach to training, which I believe it doesn't necessarily lead to sacrificing discipline. In my case, it actually allowed for consistency, since I was able to tailor my training schedule. Plus, training here brought out the competition bug in me. At Arete, it doesn't matter if you're late or have to leave early; if you have the energy to do every single roll or just watch the whole class: you are welcome to show up, hang out, and enjoy yourself. How great is that?

Whether it's due to BJJ's own nature or Arete's characteristic environment, spend enough time here and you'll discover a place where you can let out your 'inner idiot'. And although you should also be prepared for a lot of inappropriate jokes and tough love (if you're lucky) that come with it, you'll make friends for life.

One thing I can say wholeheartedly: I was happy here.

reviews.text:

Worked with Mac for 10/11 sessions private coaching and he is a true gentleman. Very knowledgeable, patient and understanding as well as good to talk to. Really learnt a lot here and was a very positive learning experience. Cannot recommend Mac and Arete as a place to train highly enough 💯

I hope to train again here if I am ever in back in Bangkok in the future.

Big thanks to Mac and the team here 🙏

Syd

reviews.name: Danny Chou
reviews.text:
I had a great experience training at Pinpetch Muay Thai Gym. The gym is clean and well-maintained, and on hot days they turn on the air conditioning, which makes training much more comfortable.

One thing I really appreciated is that hand wraps and gloves are provided free of charge when you take a lesson. The coaches will also help wrap your hands properly, which is especially helpful for beginners who may not know the correct technique.

The coaches are highly experienced, patient, and attentive. They take the time to break down each technique step by step, correct your form, and explain the proper mechanics behind every movement. As a complete beginner, I found their coaching style easy to follow and understand. They clearly communicated what they wanted to see, and their guidance helped me perform the techniques correctly and build confidence quickly.

Overall, Pinpetch is a welcoming and beginner-friendly gym with excellent coaching and a great training environment. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking to learn Muay Thai, regardless of experience level.

reviews.name: Dimitrios Tsaprounis
reviews.text:
If you are in Chiang Mai, you absolutely have to visit Pinpetch Muaythai Gym! Located just outside the Old City, this gym is a hidden gem that perfectly balances professional, intense training with a warm, family-like atmosphere!
I had never done Muay Thai before in my life, and I was a bit nervous about starting. However, those nerves disappeared the second I walked in! The team at Pinpetch are some of the loveliest guys you’ll ever meet—humble, welcoming, and incredibly supportive!
I stayed for a week, and I was blown away by the results. In just one week, I saw a massive improvement in every single area: my stamina, my strength, and especially my technique. It is incredible how much you can progress when you have experts who truly care about your development!
The sessions are tough and undeniably effective—you will sweat like never before! But what makes this place unique is the vibe. Between the heavy kicks and the clinching, the gym is constantly filled with laughter and jokes! The trainers have a unique way of pushing you to your absolute limits while keeping a huge smile on your face!
For Beginners: They are patient and break down every movement (stance, punches, kicks) until you get it right.
For Intermediate/Advanced: They know exactly how to sharpen your skills and refine the technical details that make a difference.
Location is super convenient, just a stone's throw from the Old City walls.
Don’t think twice! Whether you are a total "newbie" like I was or an intermediate trainee, Pinpetch Muaythai Gym will change your perspective on training! You’ll leave with sore muscles, a sweat-soaked shirt, and a massive smile!
Highly recommended!
See you guys again next year!

reviews.name: Jas Lee
reviews.text:
Enjoyed a drop in WOD here during my week vacation in Bangkok. Staff were friendly and the class was a mix of foreigners and locals. Seemed to be good friendships between regulars but during my drop in no one attempted to chat with me.
Warm up was fun but then the coach only demonstrated the movements for the WOD super briefly and then expected us to warm up to our WOD weights in only a couple minutes before starting. I was shocked that there was no particular technique coaching or checking our form before starting. It was very different to what I was used to. Luckily I am not new to Crossfit but I would be worried for beginners.
The gym facilities were also a bit outdated and my medicine ball was all cracked. But everything else seemed alright.
There are also showers and toilets on the second floor of the gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jas,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed your drop-in WOD and found our staff to be friendly! Your feedback regarding your experience during the class is greatly appreciated. Ensuring a welcoming atmosphere where everyone feels included is our top priority. We apologize if there was a lack of engagement during your visit, and we're committed to improving our interactions with everybody :)

Regarding the structure of our classes and coaching techniques, we understand your perspective. Our approach often varies based on the experience level and familiarity of our participants with CrossFit movements. However, your insights highlight areas where we can enhance our instruction and support, particularly for newcomers. As for the condition of the medicine ball, we believe we know which one you're referring to, and it was promptly tossed out on that day to ensure a more enjoyable experience for everyone!

Thank you once again for your valuable feedback!

Warm regards,

Nat 
TenFive

reviews.text:
This is not my first time having a massage at Panpuri Organic Spa, but it was the first time for me to visit their branch in Park Hyatt. Right off the bat you feel immersed in a tranquil space with very polite and knowledgable service. We had the Soontharee Experience and chose our preferred oil (the rose is always such a winner!). Then we were led to the treatment room-- which was very spacious and well appointed. Then the massage started.

What I really appreciated was the attention to the little details of the treatment, the special care during the foot scrub pre-treatment, the pauses throughout to wrap us in warm towels (very relaxing) and some very soothing massage techniques. I soon drifted off at parts, which is always a sign they are doing something good. After the massage was done, you could then enjoy a nice view on some day loungers along with organic fruit and some lovely flower(?) tea. Special props to my massage therapist K.Emmy, her magic hands have made my nagging back pain disappear!

reviews.name: เมสา
reviews.text:
I would like to share my perspective as a regular customer of this spa. I have visited multiple times and have consistently experienced professional, courteous, and respectful service from the entire team. (I have wait for my partner who also done spa there last time)

On the day mentioned in the previous review, I was physically present at the spa while waiting for my partner’s session and witnessed the situation firsthand.

From what I observed, the original booking was scheduled for 4 PM. The customer arrived at 5 PM and stated that the time had been changed. When the staff reviewed the messages, there was no written confirmation from the spa acknowledging any approved time adjustment. Without confirmation, it cannot reasonably be considered a confirmed change.

Despite this, the staff made efforts to accommodate him by looking for an available slot, even though the spa was busy.

Throughout the interaction, the concern about the booking continued to be raised repeatedly, even after a solution had been offered. At one point, a video recording was initiated during the discussion, which noticeably increased the tension of the situation. Even so, the staff remained calm and professional throughout.

At no time did I witness rude or inappropriate behavior from the team. On the contrary, I observed patience and composure in what had clearly become a stressful interaction.

As someone who was present and who frequently visits this spa, I believe it is important that reviews reflect the full context of events. Public statements can significantly impact real people and their livelihoods.

Context matters.
And so does accountability.

Sometimes the hardest thing to do is simply acknowledge when we were wrong.

title: Gin Restaurant - Since 2014 by Chef Aoun
subTitle: กินกับเชฟอั๋น
ownerDescription:
A hidden gem tucked away in a quiet corner, led by a five-star hotel–trained chef who previously built the reputation of Gin Restaurant, the number one restaurant in Nan province. Today, we have carefully selected our most distinctive signature dishes and brought them to Bangkok with pride.

In particular, we present seemingly simple yet exceptionally challenging dishes to perfect—such as shrimp paste fried rice (Khao Kluk Kapi) and traditional Northern Thai Khao Soi prepared from an authentic old recipe rarely found today. Crafted through meticulous and intricate techniques, each dish delivers refined, nostalgic flavors that have impressed many guests—evoking the comforting taste of childhood memories.

We ordered Khao Kluk Kapi and Pad Thai—both were absolutely delicious. The Khao Kluk Kapi was rich and well-balanced, with a fragrant shrimp paste flavor and a perfect mix of side ingredients that complemented each bite.

The Pad Thai was equally impressive, with perfectly cooked noodles, a great balance of sweet, sour, and savory flavors, and fresh, generous-sized prawns.

reviews.name: LM
reviews.text:
Mixed feelings about this place.

What I loved:
The space is beautifully designed — you can really tell they pay attention to every detail, from the interior to the overall service experience.
The onsen was excellent — all three pools were at just the right temperature, not too hot or too cold.
Service from arrival through the onsen experience was warm and attentive.

What I didn’t love:
The deep tissue massage didn’t meet my expectations. I had heard great reviews, so I was quite looking forward to it. While the masseuse was polite and professional, the pressure — although strong — didn’t quite target the areas of tension, especially around my shoulders. At some point during the 90-minute session, I found myself wishing it would end sooner, which was disappointing.
The reception staff at checkout felt a bit rude and disorganized, which slightly affected the overall experience.

Overall:
It’s a lovely place to relax once in a while, especially for the onsen, which I would definitely return for. However, for massage quality and value, I would still prefer a traditional Thai massage place that can more effectively relieve muscle tension.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share this with us. We’re truly glad to hear you enjoyed the space, onsen — that means a lot to us. At the same time, we’re very sorry that the massage did not meet your expectations. We will ensure better personalization and technique. We thrive to do better always.

We take your comments seriously. This is not the standard we aim for, and we are already addressing this with our team to improve. Again, we truly appreciate your honest feedback — it helps us grow.

If you’re open to it, we would love to welcome you back and tailor a massage experience that better suits your needs next time.

Warm regards,
White Wood Green Team

Instead of taking responsibility or looking for a solution, they blamed my daughter for not replying—even though she explained that they hadn't requested a confirmation and she had already responded to their initial text.
​Long story short, they called in another massage therapist, and we had the hydrotherapy and massage. I was very disappointed with how they handled the situation. Furthermore, the steam room wasn't working.
​While my daughter enjoyed her aromatherapy massage, my facial treatment turned out to be just a facial massage, and it wasn't the best I've had. Honestly, I don't think there is any value for the money they charge; the prices are higher than what I pay in Singapore for a much better experience

We do hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future and provide you with a more seamless experience that wwg always strive to deliver.

Best regards,

White Wood Green Spa & Wellness

reviews.name: MaE Khetmongkol
reviews.text:
I just finished a fantastic two-hour session here, blending their "Office Syndrome" treatment with a relaxing massage. The therapist was highly skilled, effectively targeting deep knots in my shoulders, neck, and lower back before transitioning into a relaxing flow that helped release all the stress.

The location in Soi Somkid is a hidden gem. It’s a quiet, leafy neighborhood that feels miles away from the usual Bangkok chaos. The spa interior is modern but very serene—it feels like a genuine escape from the city. The staff were also warm and welcoming, making the whole experience feel comfortable rather than stiff or formal.

Here is a tip on how to get there.  I highly recommend using public transport as parking at the YOLO Forest Community project is very limited.

- Take the BTS to Chidlom.
- Walk through Central Chidlom and exit via the "Mozza by Cocotte" food area on the 1st floor.
- From there, it’s a pleasant 400m walk down Soi Somkid.
- Reception is on the 3rd floor.

I will definitely be back. It’s a perfect spot if you need serious relief for office syndrome but still want a peaceful, restorative experience.

P.S. It’s worth checking out soon; they have a great promotion running for Nov-Dec 2025.

My boyfriend and I were next to each other which was nice, the beds all had the whole for your face in which was a massive benefit.

Kopkhunkaa🙏🙏

reviews.name: Elizabeth Bolt
reviews.text:
Had the best coconut oil massage here since being in Thailand.

My partner and I decided to have a massage to relax before our 18hr journey back home, and it was a great decision.
The coconut oil massage smelt amazing and I felt like it was the perfect balance between gentle and relaxing (I was so sleepy!) and also going a bit deeper to loosen me up.

My partner had the head, neck and back massage and said it was very good, the masseuse targeted tight areas and could change her pressure to his needs.

Highly recommend, thank you!

reviews.name: Girard Jeune Bauyon
reviews.text: Had an oil massage the other day with my partner and it was the best massage for both of us. First time I felt actually relaxed during a massage and every tension in my body was released! Very reasonable price too

reviews.name: Luisa Behrens
reviews.text: Amazing massage! I went two days in a row and it was perfect both times. Paid 250 Baht for a Thai massage and 300 Baht for a back & shoulder massage – great value and really high quality. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Maya Woods
reviews.text: We had a lovely massage from two ladies who welcomed us even though it was fairly late and we had the best foot massage for half an hour. Thank you so much. Would definitely recommend :)

reviews.name: Russ B
reviews.text:
So good we made a huge detour to revisit on our last day.

Normally my mind is running constantly - I'm pretty sure I dozed off a couple times during my coconut massage.

I'd also had terrible lower back pain for a month prior after carrying something far too heavy - the stretches at the end fixed that almost immediately and I slept better that night than I had in weeks.

Highly recommended and we'll definitely be visiting again in the near future.

Thank you Són and Nisa (I'm sure this spelling is incorrect, sorry!)

I did the Aloe Vera massage and all the time she was very respectful, did massage in the face also and some more strong massage in my neck and shoulders to relax more!
At the end they offer tea or water and some biscuits that was delicious! Great experience!

reviews.name: Harsh Agarwal
reviews.text: One of the best and most affordable thai spa (250 bhats) places near Patong beach. The therapists are thorough professionals. Visited twice during my 4 days stay in Phuket. It’s a safe place for authentic massage without ‘extra services’. Only problem is the staff there keep talking to each other while giving the massage. The cookies they give at the end of the massage are delicious though!

reviews.name: Dennis
reviews.text: Excellent massage shop. Clean, nicely decorated and staffed by pleasant masseuses. Definitely a cut above most similar places. I had one of the best massages ever followed by a cup of ginger tea. Until 3pm the 'happy hour' price is 300 baht for a 1hr oil massage. Great value! Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Misty R
reviews.text: Service was good, but the massage itself was average. Asked the lady if she could use more pressure and she wasn't able to. You could also tell that they were not professionally trained because they did not get to the correct grooves of the muscles. My partner and I went and we both agreed it was a body rub, not a massage. They also don't have proper massage beds that would correctly support your head and neck during deep pressure around the shoulder area. The price is cheap though!

reviews.name: James Ng
reviews.text: If you are looking for authentic massage that leaves you relaxed and happy, this is the place. Small massage place hidden in a darker alley off the Main Street, their service is very good. Me and my friends took thai massage and both were really satisfied and would want to visit again. The masseuses are polite and skilled. They know what they are doing. They offer beverages (tea/ coffee/ water) after the massage. They also offer a little discount for the following visits.

reviews.name: Lukas Ny
reviews.text: Took 4 different massage here and was satisfied every time. If you are searching for authentic traditional thai massage, this is the place.

reviews.text: My husband and I stopped in for a foot massage and it was great! We really enjoy the foot massage which ended with a quick shoulder massage as well. We paid 250 baht per person, worth every cent! Highly recommend stopping in during the heat of the day to cool down and relax!

reviews.name: Vivek Sharma
reviews.text: If you are looking for authentic massage that leaves you relaxed and happy, this is the place. It is a small place but their service is very good. I took thai massage and my wife took foot massage. We both were really satisfied and would want to visit again. The masseuses are polite and skilled. They know what they are doing. They offer beverages (tea/ coffee/ water) after the massage. Thai massage costs 250 baht and foot massage a little more (270 baht). They offer a little discount for the following visits. Very recommended. Also a general advice - always explore the places in the narrow alleys. The ones on the main streets are generally not great and way more expensive.

Having being taken with the approach of the women out front of this store I asked for a strong foot massage. It was wonderful; given by an older lady with an attentive lovely manner…a great way to end my stay. I definitely would have returned if I’d had the time!

The best massage in Chiang Mai!
A group of 5 of us traveled to Chiang Mai and we fell in love with this place. The staff is professional, friendly, and the atmosphere is incredibly relaxing. We ended up coming here every single day of our vacation after a long day of sightseeing. It was the perfect way to recharge. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Linda Yao
reviews.text:
Had an amazing massage experience with Tum! Ask for Tum! During the session, he noticed I had an injury in my lower back area and took extra care to focus on providing relief there. I really appreciated how attentive he was. he spent more time working on that area and adjusted his treatment thoughtfully. His skill, professionalism, and genuine care really stood out.

By the end of the massage, I felt incredibly relieved, relaxed, and completely stress-free. The place itself is cute, clean, and welcoming, and the staff were all very polite and friendly.

Highly recommend Tum if you’re looking for a skilled and attentive massage therapist. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.text: I went there four times during my stay in Chiang Mai and loved it every time. The service was very good and friendly. Nang was my favorite but all of her colleagues were great as well. I felt very relaxed afterwards and enjoyed the tea and cookies they serve for free.

reviews.name: 멜로
reviews.text:
This place was a literal oasis after an entire day of walking around the city. The sweet boss lady took one look at us, made us take a long drink of water first and assured us we were in good hands. The shop was super clean and peaceful, the staff were friendly and professional and the massages (we got our head+foot+backs done) were some of the best we’ve ever had, at a very fair price! We immediately booked a session for the next day.

The gentleman who handled me was an older man with kind eyes and the fiercest hands I’ve ever encountered - he somehow deduced what sports I play and what digestive problems I have just by poking my foot. It felt like he literally popped my spine and shoulder blades back into place and my back felt lighter than it has in years (I regularly get doctors and acupuncturists shaking their heads when they see my back)! Apparently he’s only available during the daytime and has a long list of regulars, for reference.

Definitely worth visiting if you’re near the Old City. We will return for sure the next time we’re in Chiang Mai!
