reviews.name: Rebecca Yao
reviews.text:
Of all the places I’ve had massages in Thailand (Bangkok/Chiangmai/Phuket), I found this place does the massages the best. Between my partner and I, we’ve had 6 massages done here in total and we were both satisfied with the outcome of the massages- we felt relaxed at the end.

We found that the other places we’ve visited just massages without finding and correcting problems like RMTs in North America does. I also found that most other massagers don’t put very much effort on me or use much pressure because I’m a very petite person.

Thoughts about oil massage (relaxing): 400 baht/1 hour- this is our favourite since we actually do feel relaxed at the end. Note that the blanket they use to cover you is very thin so you might feel bare.

Thoughts about aloe massage: 500 baht/1 hour- we brought our own aloe and managed to negotiate this to 400 baht/1 hour. We also loved this since this came with a face mask.

Thoughts about foot massage: 400 baht/1 hour- they worked on the leg below the knee, foot, and finished off with a brief shoulder and scalp massage. I thought my massager didn’t use enough pressure for my foot that always feels fatigue despite asking for strong so I’m not in love with the foot massage. I’m not sure what the difference between a foot massage and their foot & shoulder massage, which is priced at 500 baht/hour. So it might be better value for just foot massage.

All massages end off with a complimentary small cup of tea and cold water.

This place is cash only.

Manicure is 200 baht but the colour selection seems limited so I did not try.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you

reviews.name: Queenie LAM
reviews.text:
I've always loved this massage chain on my Thailand trips, but this branch really let me down—huge quality gap between locations.

It looks massive and fancy outside, but the front desk wasn't welcoming at all. Bangkok traffic is crazy, so I called ahead saying I might be slightly late (but rushed and arrived ON TIME). They immediately hit me with: "Kindly note if you arrive late, we may shorten your session due to the next booking." Super stressful! Then I ended up waiting 20 mins because it was busy. Why say that upfront? Felt unwelcoming.

Chose 3-hour session: 1h body scrub + 2h oil/hot stone massage = ฿7,800 for 2. Room was FREEZING—I turned down the AC myself, but therapist blasted it right back up, ignoring my comfort. Scrub was just basic (no extra massage like other branches, not as clean). Oil/stone part had ZERO pressure and sloppy spots—zero pro skill. So disappointing for the price.

Heard other guests in the lounge call it "average" too. Pricey but mediocre—won't come back here.

** The receptionist was nice.**

reviews.name: Doraemon
reviews.text:
Kitty and I, along with our friends, decided to visit 5 Star Massage & Beauty Salon after dinner for a relaxing massage. We both opted for the neck, back, and shoulder massage, plus a foot massage. The salon was clean and cozy, with a calming atmosphere thanks to the aroma therapy, music, and soothing scents.

The massage itself was good.  It helped to relieve Kitty's back pain and my back and hand pain. The foot massage was also enjoyable. However, we did have a few concerns.  Kitty wasn't comfortable with the massage bed because it didn't have a hole for resting the face and was also on the floor.  Instead, they used a pillow, which made her neck stiff after an hour.  We also felt that the lack of curtains around the massage tables impeded our privacy, especially since we were massaged late at night (after 11 PM) and finished at 1:00 AM.  Kitty also felt uncomfortable because her towel kept slipping, and she was worried about her privacy since the curtain was not drawn.

Overall, we had a good massage experience, but these issues definitely detracted from the experience.  We recommend that 5 Star Massage & Beauty Salon consider addressing these concerns to improve the comfort and privacy of their clients.

We're giving 5 Star Massage & Beauty Salon 3 stars. While the massage itself was effective, the lack of privacy, the discomfort caused by the massage bed brought down our overall rating.  We hope they make improvements in the future.

reviews.name: Parag Raithatha
reviews.text:
Truly lives up to the name!

I had an amazing experience at 5 Star Massage & Beauty Salon in Phuket. From the moment I entered, I could tell this place was special. The premises are clean, well-maintained, and have a calm, peaceful vibe that instantly makes you feel relaxed. The interior is simple but tasteful, with a focus on cleanliness and comfort.

The staff is professional, polite, and very skilled. They explained the different massage options clearly and made sure I was comfortable throughout the session. What I appreciated most is how legit and professional everything felt.

I tried a couple of massages during my visit, but the foot reflexology was absolutely the highlight. The therapist was amazing—she had the perfect balance of pressure and technique. It wasn’t just soothing, but it felt truly therapeutic.

Hygiene and cleanliness are top-notch here, which is something I always look for in a massage place.

If you're in Phuket and want a real, high-quality massage experience, this place should be on your list. I’ll definitely be returning the next time I’m here!

ownerDescription: At Amaya, we are committed to offering a safe space for full deep relaxation and rejuvenation. reviews.name: J D
reviews.text:
Excellent experience at Amaya Massage & Wellness!

I visited Amaya Massage & Wellness in early October 2025 and booked the Smooth Skin Package (body scrub, body mask, and 1-hour aroma oil massage) on the same day. Communication was quick and easy through WhatsApp, and everything was confirmed straight away.

The spa is clean, calm, and very well presented — a relaxing space that feels professional from the moment you walk in. The atmosphere is peaceful, the lighting soft, and everything’s spotless and comfortable.

My therapist was skilled, professional, and attentive. Each stage of the treatment — the body scrub, body mask, and one-hour aroma oil massage — was carried out with real care and precision. I liked that I could choose my own massage oil for the final hour, which made it feel personal and tailored.

After the session, I was offered a cup of tea and some lovely cookies, which was a thoughtful touch. I also had a chance to speak with the owner, who was genuinely friendly and welcoming — you can tell she takes real pride in her spa and cares about her guests’ experience.

The whole treatment was invigorating yet deeply relaxing, and I left feeling refreshed, recharged, and with noticeably smoother skin.

Amaya really stands out for its quality, professionalism, and attention to detail. Definitely worth visiting if you’re after a proper, well-run spa in Pattaya.

And after your massage, it’s also worth stopping by Folks & Flour Homemade French Bakery nearby — a great place to unwind with a iced coffee or light bite afterwards.

My wife and I had an incredible 2-hour oil massage at Amaya Massage & Wellness in Pattaya, and it was worth every single baht.

A special thank you to Pad and Fern for their exceptional service. They were highly skilled, professional, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the entire session. Their techniques were excellent, and we both walked out feeling completely relaxed and refreshed.

The spa itself is spotless, beautifully maintained, peaceful, and has a very calming ambience. Everything, from the cleanliness to the professionalism of the staff, was truly top-notch.

If you’re visiting Pattaya and looking for a quality massage, I highly recommend Amaya Massage & Wellness. We would definitely come back on our next visit. Thank you again, Pad and Fern, for such a wonderful experience!

After that, I chose the "smooth skin" package, and again...the therapist was amazing!  Both the body scrub and massage were fantastic and I left feeling wonderful!  I will be back on my next trip to Pattaya and highly recommend this business for those seeking an excellent and rejuvenating spa experience.  :)

reviews.name: CT
reviews.text:
Another solid option for massage between high end luxury (resort) and corner shop massages. Great massage value at this relatively small shop. My reviews reflect value for money and whether I would return - I would (and did).

I booked a 2hr aroma therapy / Thai massage. It cost just over thb1000. Standard welcome drink, washed feet, and headed to the massage room.

Why I enjoyed this massage:
- High quality relaxing aroma therapy massage paired with a great Thai massage
- Masseuse (both times) was quite skilled
- At just over thb1000 this was great value for money

Some items of note:
- Appears there are only two massage rooms, each with two massage beds (there is a separate common area for foot massages as is often the case)
- Why the above is important: if you book with someone else, you’ll get your own room. If you book solo, you may end up with someone else in your room. I typically don’t mind for Thai massages, but for an oil massage (you wear essentially disposable underwear) having someone else in the room can be feel awkward. I assume they limit to same sex, but IDK.

I don’t have any complaints and the massage was high quality (both visits).

title: Atlas Valley
description: Simple dorms in a bright hostel offering dining & hillside views, plus free yoga classes.
address: 234 หมู่ที่ 5 Mae Hi, Pai District, Mae Hong Son 58130, Thailand
plusCode: 8CWX+R6 Mae Hi, Pai District, Mae Hong Son, Thailand

reviews.name: Sara Fernández Fuente
reviews.text: Atlas Valley is one of the best hostels I've ever been to. If you are traveling solo to Pai and want to find a community of amazing people and a beautiful place in nature with a program full of activities, I highly recommend you stay in here. Yoga in the mornings, cold baths in the afternoon when the heat hits the most, lots of fantastic workshops and wonderful people to share your experience in Thailand with. It is very important though that you have in mind this place is about 40mins walk to the city center of Pai and to move around you will definitely need a scooter (or you could hitchike like I did✌️)

reviews.name: Sim Marchesini
reviews.text:
Hands down the best hostel I have ever been to (and i am traveling across Asia since 2022).
I found a wonderful community, very open and inclusive. I gave my first proper sign language lesson in this place, it was an incredible experience.
The staff is amazing and kind.
The dorm is spacious and clean.
This is definitely a place where I'd go back whenever I am in Pai.

reviews.name: RaeBailey Dunstan
reviews.text: This hostel was in a sick location & the staff were sweet. Big warning - to anyone that does not smoke weed or cigarettes.. I would not recommend going there. It basically the main activity -  I was incredibly excited to go for the workshops but the workshops were "puff & paint" and "how to roll a joint". So it wasn't my thing, but for different personalities I get why people love this place. I left cause I felt weird there.

reviews.name: ashtbt12345
reviews.text: I stayed in the 12 bed mixed dorm, which was comfortable and extremely clean. The staff here are amazing as is the hostel. Just outside of town you manage to escape all the noise. The hostel offers a shuttle so it's easy to get into town. You can also hire scooters too. It's not a party hostel which suited me perfectly, it was extremely social and very easy to make new friends as a solo traveller. There are daily activities on offer including morning yoga classes. The classes were fantastic and cater for all abilities. I would 100% stay here again and highly recommend this place to any solo traveller looking for a social, comfy and clean place to stay whilst in Pai.

reviews.name: eveh swahn
reviews.text: I had the best time at the hostel. ll staff and volunteers were amazing and so accommodating and the vibe here in unmatched!! Lots of activities and a community feel. Thank you to Mary for being an angel, settling me in and making me feel at home. 💖💖

reviews.name: Noa Olya
reviews.text:
Wooow!! This place is brilliant. Resort-hostel style. Gorgeous facilities. You can feel the thought were invested in every detail of the place.
Great vibe. Very happening place !
So many different activities. From wellness oriented to canabiz tasting .
Amazing space  that attracts amazing people
Thank you ♥️

reviews.name: Mardin Najat
reviews.text: Love this place so much. My faraway home, I can’t skip this place when I’m in Pai. Whether I stay in the hostel or just visiting. It has a chill, friendly atmosphere and the view from the hostel is beyond stunning ✨

reviews.name: Kyran Camilleri
reviews.text:
Atlas Valley has a really amazing setup and the hostel itself is great. It’s very social and people are open to talking, which makes it easy to meet others.

Unfortunately, the atmosphere is heavily affected by the type of guests it attracts. Many people don’t clean up after themselves despite it being expected. There were dirty plates left around, cigarettes and ash everywhere, and shared areas often felt messy. At one point, there was even a used sanitary pad left in the bathroom and outside on the floor, which was pretty  disgusting shocking.

There are only 2 toilets for men and 4 for women, which doesn’t feel sufficient for the number of guests.

Considering the price, it’s hard to justify when you can find a private room elsewhere for cheaper. Great potential, but the overall experience didn’t match the cost.

reviews.name: Sally Blake
reviews.text: love this hostel. not too far out from the city centre insane vibe, guaranteed to make amazing friends here. beds aren’t insanely comfy but is worth it for everything else the hostel offers

reviews.name: Helena Austin
reviews.text: Stayed here for 5 nights and was very sad to leave! One of the best hostels I have stayed in. Lots of actives on offer including free yoga, some expect a donation. Rooms were big so plenty of space for your belongings. Beds could do with an extra curtain for more privacy but they do have 1 each - could also do with a slightly bigger blanket on the beds. Good food available to order. Everything you need is available really. Best to rent a bike as it’s about a 30 minute walk into town. Staff were helpful at organising a taxi quickly the one time we needed it. Manager was very friendly along with most staff. Expect a very hippie/chill vibe! Felt reasonably sociable, made friends here to go out with.

reviews.name: Kim Goeler von Ravensburg
reviews.text: The hostel seemed great, they offered lots of free daily activities and people were very welcoming. However, we found bed bugs on both of our beds so we didn’t feel comfortable staying there and made the choice to leave the same day. The bugs were underneath the plastic wrapping that was on all the mattresses but the wrapping was ripped in many places so it doesn’t offer much protection. The staff was understanding and gave us a full refund, which was very nice. I hope they will take the necessary measures to resolve the issue as soon as possible.

reviews.name: Dario
reviews.text:
The hostel has a very distinct "alternative" hippie vibe, similar to the general feel of Pai but more concentrated. Many guests end up staying for weeks, which speaks to the community here.
• Activities: They offer plenty of options, from morning yoga to various sports. Note that while some are "free," a 200 THB donation is expected for participation.
• Facilities: The showers and bathrooms are quite clean. A nice touch is the natural soaps and shampoos provided for eco-conscious travelers.
• The Beds: They are quite hard. I didn’t mind them, but several people in my group struggled to get a good night's sleep.
• Food & Drink: Like most places in Pai, Western breakfast is pricey (120+ THB). However, I highly recommend the Thai omelet (3 eggs, rice, and veggies)—it’s the best value there! Free water is available, but unlike some other hostels, coffee, tea, and snacks are not complimentary.

reviewContext.Rooms: Big dorms with 13 people, beds are quite hard
reviewContext.Nearby activities: Many things to do in the hostel, yoga, sport courses and other activities
reviewContext.Safety: Quite safe, dont need to lock up stuff
reviewContext.Food & drinks: Are cheaper places in Pai, but for the comfort quite fair.

reviews.name: Jarryd van der westhuizen
reviews.text:
This hostel has such a lovely energy to it, a real sense of community found with the other backpackers and staff, the views are gorgeous from the common area, overviewing the whole of pai.
Workshops and other things are always haplening every day, you wont want to leave.
Sammy was such a helpful member, always assisting and showing others around, making them feel welcome.

reviews.name: Céline
reviews.text: The best decision I made for my stay in Pai was booking this hostel. The room and bathroom are clean and spacious. The outdoor is beautiful and peaceful with a stunning view on the mountain, perfect spot for the sunset. And the team is really nice, always organising activities and workshops. You can easily find your own space as you can choose to socialise with travellers.

reviews.name: Roisin Jordan
reviews.text: I would not recommend anyone stay at this hostel. Full disclosure: we didn’t end up staying here. We checked in and got a nice tour of the hostel from a friendly volunteer. However the room wasn’t very clean and very basic and when we checked the mattresses there was clear evidence of bed bugs with black marks all over the sides of the mattresses. They were also wrapped in cling film which wouldn’t do anything against bed bugs and it was falling off it anyway. We decided to leave the property and check in somewhere else. We knew we wouldn’t get a refund as we’d paid in full through booking.com we just wanted our deposit back and to let the staff know we were leaving. Instead we had a very unpleasant interaction where the two girls at reception barely looked at us and kept saying to get a refund through booking.com (we weren’t asking for a refund just the deposit that we had given them ten minutes before) until eventually they gave us the deposit back after us asking three or four times and it was literally sitting in front of them the whole time. I wouldn’t have been overly annoyed about the issue with the beds if the staff had been remotely pleasant about it.

reviews.name: Julie
reviews.text:
What to say! Just an amazing place to stay, amazing people to meet with a lot of talent, many activities organized (donation based except the morning yoga) and just a good vibe around! You will just feel like home and never get bored!

Note that the dorms are very basic, especially the curtains could be better but it’s still amazing for the price!

reviews.name: Carbon Disaster
reviews.text:
5 Hearts 💜 ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ 💜

Atlas Valley – Pai, Thailand

Stunning Location: Nestled in a beautiful valley with breathtaking mountain views.

Peaceful Escape: Quiet, serene atmosphere perfect for relaxation and recharging.

Unique Design: Thoughtfully built spaces that blend naturally with the surroundings.

Comfortable Stay: Clean, cozy, and well-maintained rooms with everything you need.

Friendly Hosts: Warm, welcoming staff who go above and beyond to make you feel at home.

Great Food & Drinks: Fresh, tasty meals and refreshing beverages available on-site.

Natural Beauty: Surrounded by lush greenery, rice fields, and stunning sunsets.

Relaxed Vibe: Calm energy that reflects Pai’s slow and easy lifestyle.

Good Value: Fair pricing for the quality, setting, and overall experience.

Ideal for Couples: Romantic and private, with plenty of space to enjoy nature together.

Community Feel: A place where travelers connect while still respecting the peaceful atmosphere.

Memorable Experience: More than just accommodation—it feels like being part of Pai’s landscape.

Cons

None.

Overall
Atlas Valley is a true gem in Pai. With its gorgeous setting, welcoming hosts, and calm atmosphere, it’s the perfect spot for travelers seeking both comfort and nature. A five-star experience all around.

reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Great view, Quiet, Kid-friendly, Great value

reviews.name: Annie Dudin
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing hostel - would 100% recommend, and would definitely come and stay again! The staff were very welcoming, serving yummy food, and they helped us arrange transport/motor bike hire very easily and cheaply. Yoga every morning looking out at one of the most stunning views of our whole trip is something I will never forget!

reviews.name: Maria Nowosielska
reviews.text: Loved this hostel! Big rooms, and the common areas were super nice, a lot of places to sit. Beautiful scenery and many fun social events (not necessarily parties). The walk to town is actually doable and there are always people going so easy to hitchhike! Loved it!

reviews.name: Thiago Eduardo
reviews.text:
An incredible place to few in a community, to meet people, and socialize, especially for their classes and workshops happening all day around everyday.

The hostel itself is amazing, the food they offer in the restaurant is very good and great value.

The dorms are clean and the bed is comfy, the only downside is that it’s very crowded and there is no clear rule on silence time in the evening, so people would come in and speak out loud and turn the lights on at anytime.

The place is 30min walking further from downtown, if you have a bike no problem with that.

Other than that, very cool place.

สตูดิโอพิลาทิสบรรยากาศดีมาก เครื่องครบ ครูสอนละเอียด ช่วยปรับท่าทางได้ดีมาก
มีเสียงบำบัดช่วยผ่อนคลายด้วย
พร้อมวิวสีเขียว โปร่งโล่ง สบายตา เหมาะกับการรีเซ็ตร่างกายและจิตใจ
ถึงจะอยู่นอกเมือง ก็คุ้มค่ากับการเดินทางจริงๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
The Pilates studio has a great atmosphere, complete equipment, and a very attentive instructor who helps correct posture effectively.
There's also sound therapy to help you relax.
Plus, the view of greenery is bright, airy, and pleasing to the eye, perfect for resetting your body and mind.
Even though it's outside the city, it's definitely worth the trip.

reviews.name: bubie Theworld
reviews.text: ครูรุ้งน่ารักมากอีกแน่นอน ใส่ใจมากๆค่ะ เครื่องเล่นสะอาด บรรยากาศร่มรื่น หนีในเมืองมาคือเริศศมากก
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Rung is so lovely and attentive. The playground is clean, the atmosphere is pleasant, and escaping the city is fantastic!

reviews.name: sukanya tangmonkhong
reviews.text:
เรียนรู้ง่าย การสอนเป็นกันเอง สถานที่ร่มรื่น
ระหว่างเล่นได้เรียนรู้ทักษะจากครูรุ้ง แนะนำให้ลองมาเรียนนะคะ แล้วจะประทับใจค่ะ 🌳😊
reviews.textTranslated:
Easy to learn, friendly teaching, and a shady, pleasant environment.
While playing, you learn skills from Teacher Rung. I recommend trying a lesson; you'll be impressed! 🌳😊

reviews.name: Hathaikarn Deeparsert
reviews.text: ดีมากครูสอนน่ารัก สอนดี ใจดีเฟรนลี่ ดูแลเรื่องความปลอดภัยดี เครื่องเล่นก็แข็งแรงมาก บรรยากาศวิวธรรมชาติ ชอบมากๆ ประทับใจที่สุด
reviews.textTranslated: Excellent! The instructors are lovely, teach well, are kind and friendly, and take good care of safety. The playground equipment is very sturdy, and the natural scenery is beautiful. I loved it! I was very impressed.

reviews.name: Sirikul Mekhora
reviews.text: ได้มาลองเล่นพิลาทีสที่นี่ครั้งแรกรู้สึกประทับใจมากเลยค่ะ คุณครูน่ารักอธิบายละเอียดทุกขั้นตอนวิธีใช้เครื่อง การหายใจแบบพิลาทีส เป็นคลาสเล็กๆคุณครูสามารถดูได้อย่างทั่วถึง แนะนำเลยค่ะสำหรับคนที่อยากมาลองเล่นครั้งแรก สถานที่สะอาด มีที่จอดรถ บรรยากาศสบายตามากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time trying Pilates here, and I was very impressed! The instructor was lovely and explained every step in detail, including how to use the equipment and Pilates breathing techniques. It's a small class, so the instructor can give each student personalized attention. I highly recommend it for anyone wanting to try it for the first time. The place is clean, there's parking, and the atmosphere is very relaxing.

reviews.name: PRAPAPORN RATIPANICH
reviews.text: เป็น Beginner แต่ครูสอนดีมากๆเลยค่ะ ใส่ใจทุกรายละเอียด คอยให้กำลังใจตอนเล่นดีมากๆเลยค่ะ สอนเข้าใจง่าย ใครที่อยากลองเล่นพิชาทิสแนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I'm a beginner, but the instructor was amazing! They paid attention to every detail, were very encouraging during the lesson, and taught in an easy-to-understand way. I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to try Pichatis!

reviews.name: Aa Ta
reviews.text: ครูสอนน่ารักมากค่ะ ประทับใจมากค่ะ มาลองคราสทดลอง ตอนแรกตัวแข็งมาก จบคราสยืดเหยียดแตะพื้นได้เริสสสสสสสสส :) ปล.บรรยากาศดี มาช่วงเช้า ฟีลกู้ดดด
reviews.textTranslated: The instructor was so lovely! I was very impressed. I tried a trial class. At first, I was very stiff, but after the class, I could stretch and touch the floor perfectly! :) P.S. The atmosphere was great. Coming in the morning felt good.

title: original one massage
subTitle: original one1 massage
ownerDescription: นักบำบัด ที่ดีที่สุด
address: 108, 11 ป่าตองทาวเวอร์ Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket 83150, Thailand
street: 108, 11 ป่าตองทาวเวอร์
plusCode: V7RW+M2 Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Sandra Weston
reviews.text: Excellent massages!!! Highly recommend this neighbourhood gem "Original One". The team were great - friendly, attentive, skilled and professional.I can’t wait to go back.

reviews.name: Géraldine Gruber
reviews.text: Best Massage in Patong! I have been 2 weeks there for holiday and i was enjoying every day a massage. Wan was my favorite massagetherapist, thank you lovely Wan. Highly recommend ❤️

reviews.name: Marichelle Martin
reviews.text:
Great experience! Clean salon, skilled therapists, and a very relaxing environment. We came here almost everyday when we were in Patong.
Debbie is a very good masseuse. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jim Evans
reviews.text:
My wife had a manicure and pedicure. She didnt like the colors available and that her nails were cut short when she specifically asked to leave them longer.

Ive had a foot massage every day for 2 weeks here and the one I had here was definitely in last place. After I paid I mentioned to the manager that Aom may need more training. She immediately pushed back and didn't want to hear about it even though she wasnt busy. We were the only ones in the shop at this time. I only mentioned so they could improve their service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏Thank you for your review. We will improve and address our customer service. However, since you and your wife were visiting for the first time, you weren't coming for massages every day as you claimed

reviews.name: steven347
reviews.text:
Amazing professional foot & body oil massage with Pong yesterday.
Another wonderful massage by Pong after an early morning 2 hour walk on Patong Beach.
I have included photos including the entrance from Beach Road. They are down the walkway on the right.
Too bad I leave for Bangkok tomorrow.

reviews.name: Victor Teo
reviews.text: Clean environment with skilful therapists. There are 4-5 massage shops along the same street but I’m happy with my choice.

reviews.name: Andaleeb Mansoor
reviews.text: Very poor service, extremely , We reached around 10:30 pm, and the ladies seemed upset upon our arrival. They expressed dissatisfaction throughout the service, with one elderly lady complaining about the excessive pressure during the Thai back massage. After switching to a foot massage due to pain, she just applied the lotion with almost no pressure, seemingly just because she had to stay back longer.

reviews.name: Lucy Kim
reviews.text:
So happy to have found this massage shop tucked in from the main road of Patong beach. The Thai massage is a must and if you have Eye as your therapist, her service was incredible that I went to see her again.
The shop is very clean, all the staff are very friendly, and I like that they place a relaxing music unlike some places, so you are not in silence!

If I come back to Thailand, i would come back to Patong just to see Eye! Hope you get a chance to see her too.

reviews.name: อ้อม อ้อม
reviews.text: I come to get massages at this place regularly. I really like it—the staff are lovely, the prices are cheap, and it’s definitely worth i

reviews.name: Mogann Nair
reviews.text: Best foot massage ever by Waan for only 200 baht!! Also got a head and shoulder massage which was awesome. Will be back for more!!

reviews.name: chieh wen cheng
reviews.text:
Good experience.
I chose Thai massage and it's 200Baht only.
First they use scrub to washing my feet then change their own clothes.
And the lady - Bee ,she did a great massage.
Go and try you won't disappoint!

reviews.name: ชาอึน ชาอึนอู
reviews.text: I got a foot massage at this place and it felt amazing. I’ll definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Pinaasang Pinoy
reviews.text: the best massage ever, when it comes to massage quality i prefer this one, ive been to premium massage and spa in phuket and bangkok, but i can say this one is different, especially Pong, she handles me all the time, very professional and expert in her job, i will definitely come back again here in future

reviews.name: Bradley Eston
reviews.text: Good massage been here 3 days in a row. A real massage parlour !

reviews.name: Shushil Jindal
reviews.text:
Had 3 full body massages with oil  in 3 different companies on this road at the exactly the same price

This company was the best for me

reviews.name: Ramunas Krasauskas
reviews.text:
Genuinely looked for a proper, no funny business massage place during my first day in Patong to have my first ever thai massage. It was absolutely marvellous, professional and very timely. The price was also extremely good. I recommend wholeheartedly.
Would come for a another visit.

reviews.name: Hitansh Singla
reviews.text: Got a head and foot massage. Definitely worth it. Nothing shady about it :)

reviews.name: Pisamai Wimun
reviews.text: I've been here many times. The staff is very friendly. ❤️🙏 Thank you for your care.

reviews.name: chan shinkiu
reviews.text: The price is reasonable in Patong area with good quality. Worth to come everyday if you stay nearby. But just depends on who is your therapist, most of them are nice, but a few will ask for tips (they didn’t give me back the change of $400batt) Although I was willing to pay a tip to the therapist, they should not get my money directly by noting returning my change.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm very sorry to you on behalf of my employees. And we looked at the cameras at the store and we couldn't find anyone who didn't refund your money. Do you remember who didn't refund your money? You can come and tell me

reviews.name: Swapnil Jain
reviews.text:
I was researching rigorously to find a good and cheap place for foot massage when I ultimately decided to go to this one.
It was amazing. The foot massage was done with good force applied, not too soft, not too strong. The masseur was always smiling and asking if I was okay. Both legs were given equal time and at the end, we even get a quick arm, shoulder, back and head massage !!
For 200 bahts, this place is a hidden gem. There was absolutely 0 nagging about tips, give if you want.

title: Thai Kitchen Cookery Centre
subTitle: ไทย คิชเช่น คุ๊กเคอรี่ เซนเตอร์ THAI KITCHEN COOKERY CENTRE.
ownerDescription: Cooking school
address: 32 Loikhro Rd Chang Khlan Sub-district, Changklan Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXMV+MW Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Angel Samich
reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful experience at this cooking class! One thing we especially appreciated was how thoughtful the staff were—Ju went above and beyond by helping keep our 22-month-old son entertained so we could fully enjoy the class. She even brought out extra toys for him to play with, which made a huge difference for us.
Another pleasant surprise was that the company didn’t book any other guests during our session, even though we hadn’t paid for a private class. It made the experience feel much more personal and relaxed. We made several delicious dishes and were able to take leftovers home when we couldn’t finish everything—definitely a bonus! Our instructor, Tawan, was fantastic. She gave us an in-depth tour of the market before the class, answered all our questions, and pointed out Thai desserts we could try on our own. To top it all off, we received a cookbook at the end of the class, which was such a nice touch. Highly recommend this experience!

reviews.name: Rae C
reviews.text: We loved this place! Ju was wonderful and friendly. She answered all our questions and was very attentive and helpful. I loved that we got to visit the market in the morning. We went back the next day more informed and bought many things! The class was fun and the food was VERY tasty. I couldn't finish it all and had to take it home. Lots of great fresh food!!

reviews.name: May Woods
reviews.text:
Brilliant Thai cooking experience - very informative demonstrators and a lovely group of students too! Started with visit to the market where we learned about Thai ingredients and how to use / store etc. - enjoyed.

Cookery lesson was fab - loads of food and it all tasted fantastic. A bit of theatre with fire wok too!  Curries and sticky mango rice best eaten on holiday xx

reviews.name: Jawahar
reviews.text: I've attended the full-day course here. The chefs were very approachable and welcoming. The class was fun as well. The food I made tasted good. I've had a great time and I'm glad that I chose here for my Thai cooking experience. I would recommend this center to everyone looking to try Thai culinary learning.

reviews.name: Rick and Ami Bergstrom
reviews.text: Taking a Thai cooking class at Thai Kitchen Cookery Center was one of the highlights of our visit to Chiang Mai!  And we don't even like to cook, haha! The staff/chefs made it so much fun!!!  And the food we cooked, with their help, was really amazing.  If you choose the morning class, which we recommend, it will include a trip to the local street market, which was fascinating and we learned a lot about local food and ingredients.  This is a must-do activity for anyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Kaye L
reviews.text:
Amazing place! I got the whole day cooking course (7 dishes) and it was the best experience. The team are all lovely and super helpful and there was someone giving me their kind attention at all times. First we had a trip to the market where the guide pointed out all the ingredients we’d be using and explained things about Thai cooking. This was just educational as all the ingredients are provided, but you can buy things if you want to.
Then we were transported back to the school to begin cooking and it was not only fun, but also next level delicious. Thank you so much for the best day 🙏

reviews.name: D R
reviews.text: Amazing cooking class! Very kind people. First you get a tour through the market and the they show you some really good recipes! The fire wok is a real highlight! I truly recommend this place! I had the best time and learned a lot!

reviews.name: Clara Le Hir
reviews.text: Helpful and kind staff! We took a half day morning cooking class where we first went to a local market and learned about ingredients. After that we made our 4 dishes + curry paste. We were only four people in our group which was nice. Very happy with our choice of cooking school!

reviews.name: Kimberly Davis
reviews.text: Some friends and I attended a cooking class here and had a great time. The staff is really friendly and they were even willing to substitute ingredients for me because I am vegan! (I didn't even ask them to--I just told them I was going to leave the egg out of a dish because I don't eat eggs. They asked if I was vegan and when I said yes, they made sure to give me substitutions for the fish sauce and fish paste too!) Loved it!

reviews.name: Julia Hewusz
reviews.text:
The best way to experience thai food!!!
The staff is super nice, pays attention very much, helps a lot and I couldn't find anything to complain even if I tried hard. The class is very well organised, teachers are well-prepared and the whole experience is very professional.

Market visiting is super insightful, the guide knows a lot about thai cousine and is open to any question. Ladies that work in the cookery centre are also very nice and help the visitors with cooking, giving helpful tips.

Before taking part in the class they ask about your allergies which is very nice. There is option to cook vegeterian meals.

By far the best decision during visiting Thailand!!!

reviews.name: Harry Spencer
reviews.text: AMAZING! Such a wonderful day learning to cook delicious Thai food and explore the local market! Everybody was so lovely and the food really was great. We are STUFFED!! Thanks for the best day! Highly highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ian Hume
reviews.text: Amazing cooking lesson. High quality, fresh ingredients. The instructors had excellent knowledge and were also very fun and friendly. 10/10 I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Carolina Stucchi
reviews.text:
We had the half day cooking class and was really amazing. The six of us could choose differente plates and they accomodated us in every needs. Super teachers, they followed each of us very well :) we enjoyed every moment
Really recommended

reviews.name: Maci and Christian Peterson
reviews.text: PHENOMENAL experience, the food was delicious. The market and explanation of Thai cooking we will be taking back with us to continue to enjoy at home. Highly recommend, we only did the half day but wish we would have done the full. It’s very filling, plan on eating a lot of food!

reviews.name: Abi Gregory
reviews.text:
Ju and her two interns Mai and (I'm sorry I've forgotten the young guy's name) were so nice! The market tour was fun as they explained what was usually used in Thai cooking and pointed out interesting things to eat or see and explained them. The cooking itself was well run and extremely fairly priced I thought (800 baht with pickup and 700 baht if you walk there). They taught me some new techniques and I enjoyed making all the dishes and asking when they might be typically eaten. Ju's English was excellent and she was very kind. A really fun, interesting and enjoyable experience ☺️
I'd definitely come again and I think doing the full day course would be even more interesting as I just did the morning class.

reviews.name: Colton Korne
reviews.text:
One of the best cooking classes I have ever done!

Something that my wife and I do in every country, and this one was truly unique!

Ju was extremely helpful in coordinating pickup from our hotel, took us directly to a local market near our hotel, and then we went to their restaurant to begin cooking.

Her English was very easy to understand which was very helpful when learning about Thai cooking and the different tips while we were preparing the food.

Another unique thing was that we got to select what types of dishes we got to make that day, something I have never had before, and it was fun because my wife and I were able to make separate dishes and learn even more recipes to take home.

Absolutely would recommend this place to anyone traveling to Thailand!!

reviews.name: Evan W
reviews.text: I had a really great time at the school. All of the teachers are very helpful, energetic, and seem to love what they do. They pick you up and drop you off at your hotel, they take you to a local market to learn about Thai ingredients and how they taste what they’re used in, and at the end you get a little cookbook. I got a chance to make some Panang Curry, Pad Thai and Prawn & Coconut Milk Soup, all of which were delicious. For a half-day class this well worth the price and I highly recommend anyone to take this class.

reviews.name: Simon Heath
reviews.text: This is by far the best cooking class I've done. It started by picking out the dishes you wished to cook, then a market tour to pick out ingredients and then a fun and thorough explanation of the cookery process. Did I mention it was fun? Because it certainly was. All the food you cook is excellent and you get a pdf cook book too. If I could give this 7 out of 5 stars I would.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Simon❤️

reviews.name: Robert
reviews.text: Great place near the centre of Chiang Mai. We were looking for a quicker class that didn’t take up 4-5 hours of the day and the 2hour express course they offered was absolutely perfect. We were able to cook 4 courses each in that time and they were brilliantly prepared and efficient. The Khao soi was also the best we had in Thailand (and we ate a lot of Khao Soi!). There was still so much food we couldn’t eat it all and had to take it home with us. The fire wok was also lots of fun. After the class we were given the recipes so we can try and replicate them at home and show off some new skills to our friends. Great price too, I’d recommend it to anyone.

reviews.name: Sarah Faller
reviews.text: Ju and her Team were exceptional from hotel pick up to market tour to 4 hearty and delicious Thai meals. Moreover the team balanced educational and fun, by being extremely organized and knowledgeable.

title: The Core Classical Pilates Boutique Studio
subTitle: The Core Pilates Studio
ownerDescription: Pilates Studio
address: 89, วิชิต, Chalermprakiat Ratchakan Thi 9 Road, Tambon Wichit, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83000, Thailand
street: 89, วิชิต, Chalermprakiat Ratchakan Thi 9 Road
plusCode: V9V9+Q6 Wichit, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Kankawin Aom
reviews.text:
Beautiful and welcoming Pilates studio 🤍 I really love that they check your body and posture before starting, so they can understand what areas need attention and guide you properly. The instructor is so kind and attentive, and makes you feel comfortable even as a complete beginner. This was only my second class ever, and I’m already obsessed 💖

The place is clean, cozy, and beautifully designed. The instructor is explains everything clearly and pays close attention to each movement and posture.✨Great atmosphere and highly recommended! 💗

reviews.name: Lins JF
reviews.text:
Had an incredible private session at The Core Pilates Studio. The cues was thoughtful, precise, and deeply rooted in the classical repertoire. Every exercise was explained with clarity and intention, making the entire session feel purposeful and empowering.

Kru’Aom’s knowledge and attention to detail truly elevated the experience, challenging me while still feeling supported throughout. If you’re looking for classical pilates taught with care and expertise, this studio is an absolute gem. Highly recommend! 💫
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank ypu so much for your positive energy and your support ka Khun Linda

We are looking forward to see you again,In the meantime please stay healthy 🙏🫠🤍🤍

reviews.name: Chantip Khokittipaiboon
reviews.text:
I had an amazing one-on-one session at The Core Pilates Boutique Studio in Phuket, Thailand. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt calm, welcoming, and beautifully designed. My instructor, Poy and Omm, was friendly, attentive,  and tailored every movement specifically to my needs and goals.

The personalized guidance made such a difference — I could really focus on proper form, breathing, and control without feeling rushed. It was challenging in the best way, and I left feeling stronger, more aligned, and completely refreshed.

If you’re looking for a high-quality, private Pilates experience in Phuket, The Core Pilates Boutique Studio is truly exceptional.

reviews.name: Dr T
reviews.text: Excellent location with the added convenience of easy parking. The studio is impressively well-equipped, and the instructors are both professional and highly skilled.

reviews.name: Jen Wangcherdchukiat
reviews.text:
This studio is so lovely! It always smells delicious, is super clean.
Great atmosphere, and the staff is especially welcoming, super friendly and attentive.
It was our first time trying Pilates and we booked private classes with Kru Poy.Definitely my go-to for a good Pilates class and experience, recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review and Support 🤍🤍🙏

reviews.name: Mayrisa R (Risa)
reviews.text: I absolutely love The Core Pilates Studio. The space is clean, calm, and full of good energy. Kru Aom and Kru Poy are both so friendly and supportive, with deep knowledge of the body and posture correction. They really take the time to help you move correctly and safely. A wonderful studio for anyone looking to improve strength and posture.

reviews.name: Watanya Rattanawasee
reviews.text: I’ve had a class with Khun Aom and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Their professionalism, positive energy, and commitment to quality truly stand out. The Pilates sessions are always well-structured, and the atmosphere is welcoming and empowering. It was a fun class with besties 🤍

reviews.name: Kawinna Koaysomboon (Touang)
reviews.text: Been practicing Pilates at The Core Pilates studio for multiple months, and were impressed from the start. The equipment and studio is very clean and new. Kru Om is exceptionally nice and professional teaches with a clear understanding of the body. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a Pilates studio near town

reviews.name: Titapa Carter
reviews.text:
A highly recommend Pilates studio in Phuket.

The Core Pilates Boutique Studio is beautiful, well-decorated, cozy and clean. All equipment is high quality and brand-new. The location of the studio is perfect for me which is right at the center of Phuket - is located on the main road, easy to find, and with lots of parking space.

Above all, Kru Aom is AMAZING -  professional, knowledgeable, good communicators, energetic, friendly, encouraging and fun. She pays lots of attention in small details. I’m now setting my weekly routine to have 2 classes with her, one group class and one private class. She truly made a significant difference in my body, I really felt the benefits of strengthening my core and already feeling more flexible especially in my hamstrings.

The price is reasonable as well.

Thank you Kru Aom for always giving us a superb class ka. 🫶🙏🏻

reviews.name: Natkamol Jeamsinkul
reviews.text: Always an amazing experience at the Core Pilates studio! The space is clean and calm, and both instructors are very welcoming always with lovely smiles. Both instructors are very knowledgeable and always make sure classes are tailored towards each individual. My mum and I both take classes with Kru Poy and we love her professionalism, clear and directed instructions, and gentle encouragements.

reviews.name: Arwin Ittiwiwatthanakit
reviews.text: A beautiful studio loft space set amongst the backdrop of minimal style. The instructor was an excellent instructor and created a friendly and inclusive community vibe. I absolutely loved the class! Her instructions were super clear, and she made sure you're following well. I thought the class was very well structured strengthening all different muscles. She gave great cues throughout to keep us checking in with posture and technique, and both sides were balanced time-wise. Highly recommend her class for both beginners and intermediates.✨️🧘‍♂️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much to K’Winn for taking your time and give us a review and welcome you to The Core Pilates Studio family🙏💕 we’re looking forward to get stronger together with you🥰

reviews.name: Nat C.
reviews.text: Absolutely love this Pilates studio! The instructors are fantastic and really know how to guide you through each move, each with their own unique teaching style. The space is super clean with a warm and inviting atmosphere that makes you feel at ease as soon as you walk in. It's also conveniently located in the city center, so easy to get to, plus there’s plenty of parking available. Highly recommend checking it out!

reviews.name: Ingrid Lotze
reviews.text:
In just two classes with Ncha, we already noticed a remarkable difference in our bodies. She has a wonderful ability to be both gentle and firm, guiding us through each movement with precision. I adore this Pilates studio!

The instructors are amazing, each bringing their own unique teaching style to ensure you’re supported every step of the way.

The space is impeccably clean, with a welcoming, cozy atmosphere that instantly puts you at ease. Located conveniently not far from Central Phuket Centre and Decathlon as markets and there is plenty of parking. I highly recommend giving it a try!

reviews.name: Aya Sugai (AYAJAZZ)
reviews.text: You can receive high-quality lessons in Phuket. Although I am not good at English, they taught me very carefully and I was able to move effectively. The location is near the center of Phuket and I think it is easy to access. The studio is spacious and stylish, and all the necessary equipment is available, making it an environment suitable for any type of exercise. It is always kept clean, and you can take a shower after the lesson. It's great to be able to do Pilates even while traveling!

reviews.name: Tittada K
reviews.text: I had such a great experience taking a Pilates class here with khun Aom, the instructor. The space is clean, welcoming, and well-equipped with everything you need. Khun Aom was incredibly knowledgeable and attentive, making sure to guide each student with proper form and encouragement. ownerDescription:
Lanna Smile Thai Cooking Chiang Mai : Thai Cooking Class in Chiang Mai.
If you are looking for a Thai cooking class with a friendly, fun and pervade with traditional Lanna environment in organic garden where you can pick some herbs and vegetables for your dishes and learn how to cook with skilled instructors at your own station...You are in the right place.
Pleasant service and high quality are what we pride ourselves on. We offer a fun, engaging and friendly environment to all our guests to make you feel at home while learning to make classic Thai recipes which are famous around the globe. Our goal is making sure that all the guests leave Lanna Smile full of joy, and with a smile, just like our school name!

reviews.name: Katherine
reviews.text:
We had a great time with Pim and Nim learning how to cook authentic Thai dishes while also learning about local ingredients and cooking techniques and tips. You get to choose what you make and eat it after: an appetizer, a soup, a noodle, a curry, and a dessert. Come hungry!

The trip starts with a pickup in the Old City, and then a stop at a local market where you get to see what’s in season and ask questions. Then you arrive at their home, where they take you through each dish step by step. Very hands on and educational, and super cool to see how some of the popular dishes are made and how the flavors are balanced out.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your big support - it's been amazing time with you from start to finished! We wish you all the best Katherine :)

reviews.name: Emily He
reviews.text: This was the highlight of our Thailand trip and I would recommend to anyone coming to Chiang Mai!! We went as a group of 4, Pim & Nim were so friendly and welcoming. We had a great tour of a local market and got to learn about all the different vegetables and seasonings/sauces. Then we had some time to explore before going to the cooking class. The class was easy to follow and it was so fun to learn all about Thai cooking. The dishes were extremely delicious and because there was a group of us we were able to try all the different dishes between us (each person selects the noodle, soup, curry, appetizer, and dessert they want). The studio was very clean and comfortable. Come hungry, you will make a lot of food and they can pack leftovers. They also gave us a recipe booklet full of Thai recipes + ingredient descriptions, with many recipes not included in the class for more home cooking adventures. I can’t speak highly enough of the class and our hosts, sign up if you have the opportunity!

reviews.name: Hannah Williams
reviews.text:
We did this cooking class in Chiang Mai and absolutely loved it. We started the day at the local market where Pim walked us through all the different ingredients and spices we’d be using. It was so interesting (and really helpful!) to learn what to look for when buying our own ingredients back home in the UK.

We then arrived at the cooking class and kicked things off by making Pad Thai. Pim was fantastic and guided us through each step. We then made a soup each and spring rolls, which were so fun to prepare and so tasty!!

Next we prepared the curry pastes and curries, which were honestly the highlight. They tasted incredible - I’d highly recommend making the Massaman! We finished with mango sticky rice for dessert, beautifully plated by Nim.

There was such a great range of dishes to choose from and Pim & Nim were so accommodating to everyone’s dietary requirements and spice preferences, making sure each of us could tailor our dishes to how we liked them.

There’s also a lovely seating area where you can relax and enjoy each dish as you make it, with drinks available to buy. You can take any leftovers home too, which is a great bonus. At the end, we all received a lovely recipe book so we can recreate these amazing dishes ourselves at home.

Pim and Nim were so welcoming, hospitable and made the whole experience so enjoyable. Couldn’t recommend this class more, it is a fantastic way to learn about Thai food and take some new skills home with you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your big support - it's been amazing time with you from start to finished! We wish you all the best Hannah <3  
Hope to see you again if possible!

Picked up some neat cooking tips from Khun Pim who conducted the entire class in clear good English. She was ably supported by Khun Nim who did all the pre-cooking preparation efficiently. The class size is intentionally kept small to facilitate interaction and Q&A.

reviews.name: Lu
reviews.text: We took this cooking class on 10/29 and it was a great experience. The booking process is very practical, done entirely through the website, where you can schedule, choose your dishes, and pay by card. The classes are small, with a maximum of 10 students, ensuring a quiet environment and allowing the instructor to be more hands-on. The class location is very clean, and the instructor, Sky, is super friendly and explains things very well. All ingredients are provided washed and pre-cut, which speeds up the process. Between one dish and the next, assistants clean and organize the station. The portions are small, focused on learning, so don't consider it a full meal. One note is that all chicken dishes, including the Khao Soi and Massaman Curry, use breast fillet. It's a basic-level class, ideal for beginners, and offers great value for the price. At the end, you get access to the online cookbook. The only weak point was the transport van, as the air conditioning didn't reach the back area well and it was very hot.

reviews.name: Olivier Cagnat

I gained 5 kg eating every dishes I made but was totally worth it!

reviews.text: The highlight of my time in Thailand! The teachers are exceptional 🌟 especially how kind and humorous they were. My partner and I cooked different dishes and got to try EVERYTHING! Thanks again for joining us and for sharing your photos. We hope to see you again next time you are in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Francis Frederick Lacap
reviews.text:
If you’re in Bangkok and even slightly curious about Thai cooking—this is your sign. 👩‍🍳🔥

I just wrapped my session at Bangkok Thai Cooking Academy and honestly? Worth every minute and every baht.

✨ The experience starts smoothly—someone from the school meets and picks you up from the designated meeting point (super convenient).
🛒 Then you go on a market tour where you get to see and learn about the ingredients you’ll be using—very informative and immersive.
🥤 Upon arrival at the school, they welcome you with refreshments and a well-structured orientation that’s both practical and easy to follow.

Now for the highlight:
🍛 You get to choose 5 dishes from a menu of 15+ options—love the flexibility!
🔪 You prep your own ingredients and cook each dish step-by-step.

And gurl…
👨‍🍳 You’re guided throughout the entire process by Instructor Leky—very hands-on, attentive, and supportive.

Best part?
🍽️ You get to enjoy everything you cooked—yes, a full feast! (And if you can’t finish, they let you take it to go 😆)

Cleanliness? ✔️
Ambience? ✔️
Even the market was impressively clean and fresh.

Overall: Highly recommended. I’d definitely come back to learn more dishes. 💯

#BangkokExperience #ThaiCookingClass #TravelEats #WorthIt #CookLike
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Francis, this is an incredible review. Thank you for taking the time to share it in so much detail.
Really glad you enjoyed the full experience from start to finish. The pickup, the market tour, the class itself, we put a lot of thought into making it smooth and easy so you can just enjoy it and focus on the cooking.
Leky will be very happy to read this. She puts a lot of energy into guiding everyone step by step and making sure you feel comfortable the whole way through.
Also great to hear you appreciated the flexibility with the menu and the chance to cook everything yourself. That’s exactly what we want people to take away from it, not just a class but something you can actually do again later.
Thanks again for coming to cook with us. You’re always welcome back anytime to learn a few more dishes.

reviews.name: Nguyen Linh
reviews.text:
One of the highlights of my trip to Thailand was joining a Thai cooking class. 🇹🇭👨‍🍳

Cooking these dishes myself made me appreciate Thai cuisine on a whole new level. It’s not just about following a recipe—it’s about understanding the balance of sweet, sour, salty, and spicy flavors that make every dish so unique.

I also learned so many little techniques and local tips that you would never discover just by eating at a restaurant. From selecting fresh ingredients to preparing traditional curry paste, every step was a fun and memorable experience.

If you’re visiting Thailand, I highly recommend taking a cooking class. It’s more than just learning how to cook—it’s a chance to connect with the culture, bring home authentic recipes, and create memories you’ll never forget.

Definitely one of the best experiences from this trip. ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Nguyen. We are very happy to hear that our cooking class was one of the highlights of your trip. I had to delay our class and the place was super friendly and understanding about that. When I said I am vegan, not just vegetarian they were super cooperative and there was no problem whatsoever.
The food was amazing, we learnt new things about the Thai cooking, in the classroom and outside in the market tour as well.
The cost is so reasonable, in relation to the time, the learning, the materials, the great staff and the big meal in the end of the class! I cannot recommend it enough. If you hesitate and looking for another reassurance I give it to you ;)

P.s
Another bonus is that all of these dishes were for me only. It's as going to the most generous restaurant and even get a takeaway like I had to do.

reviews.name: Azjargal Gankhuyag
reviews.text:
So disappointed especially after reading all these reviews! Booked a massage yesterday from 9pm, oil massage for an hour (couple)

Masseuse: very soft hand, basically rubbing my body with oil.
No nerve/pressure point pressing, and no proper head massage. No thai body stretching.

Asked to turn off the AC, as i was feeling cold but just increased the temp instead of turning it off.

We thought that maybe it was because of the end of a day, they might have been tired but no, both of us left very disappointed.

Left 2 stars because it was clean environment and served tea/biscuit after the massage.

No idea how it’s so overrated 🧐
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi, 
Thank you so much for sharing your thoughts! We are always thrilled to get feedback from our customers about our business and our services. Two things to note about the massage, firstly oil and Thai massage are different so generally oil is much lighter to the touch but if you had asked for more pressure to be applied we would have of course obliged. Secondly your partner informed us before the massage specifically for ‘no stretching’. So to complain about no stretching after the fact is rather confusing. As for the request to change the temperature our masseuse obliged both times you asked, changing the temperature firstly to 25 then to 27, which is by all accounts quite warm. 

Lastly as you mention we are somehow ‘overrated’ I would like to point out the many fantastic reviews we receive is because we offer such amazing services and rarely have complaints, let alone bad reviews. Generally a quiet word at the end of the massage is all that is needed to communicate any issues. This is not however to deny your experience as everyone is different. Yet again we apologise that your were left unsatisfied.

title: Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort
description: Polished villas in an upmarket adults-only resort offering an Ayurvedic spa, a restaurant & a pool.
ownerDescription:
Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort is a family-owned, adults-only boutique wellness retreat in Phuket, Thailand.

Specializing in authentic Ayurveda, Panchakarma, longevity and holistic healing, our resident Ayurvedic doctors create personalized wellness programmes combining daily treatments, yoga, meditation and nourishing cuisine.

Enjoy 10 spa treatment rooms, two yoga spaces, a 680 m² saltwater pool, Finnish sauna, cold plunge, fitness facilities and lush tropical gardens. A member of Healing Hotels of the World, Mangosteen offers a peaceful setting for rejuvenation, stress relief and lasting well-being, with private villas, personal service and beautiful sea views.
address: 99, 4 Soi Mangosteen, Rawai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83130, Thailand
plusCode: Q8VH+VH Rawai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand
hotelDescription:
Surrounded by lush gardens, this upscale, adults-only resort is 3 km from Ra Wai Beach and 7 km from the Wat Chalong Buddhist temple. It's 46 km from Phuket International Airport.
 Airy, tropical-style villas have flat-screen TVs, Wi-Fi and minifridges, as well as balconies, living areas, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Upgraded villas add hot tubs, kitchens and/or private gardens. Room service is available.
 A breakfast buffet is available. Amenities include a wine cellar, a bar, and a Thai and Mediterranean restaurant, along with an outdoor pool, a gym and an Ayurvedic spa. Batik, cooking and yoga classes can be arranged.

reviews.name: Corina Krawinkel
reviews.text:
I spent four weeks at Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort and can wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a genuine reset for body and mind.
The combination of a personalized Ayurveda program, daily yoga classes, and two-hour Ayurvedic treatments every day was truly transformative. The varied and delicious vegan cuisine, together with freshly pressed juices served with meals, played a major role in helping my body recover and recharge.
One of the most remarkable results for me was the improvement in my physical well-being. The pain I had in my right ankle, knee, and shoulder gradually disappeared thanks to the treatments, massages, and holistic approach of the program.
The resort itself is a peaceful oasis. The large and beautiful swimming pool encouraged me to swim twice a day, which further supported my recovery. There are also many additional activities such as sound healing sessions and cooking classes, making it easy to relax, learn, and reconnect with yourself.
The staff is exceptionally kind, attentive, and caring. Everyone goes out of their way to make guests feel comfortable and welcomed. Tea is available throughout the day, and every detail is thoughtfully considered.
The medical consultations were thorough and professional. I had four consultations during my stay, allowing my program to be adjusted according to my progress and individual needs.
Mangosteen is much more than a wellness resort—it is a place where true healing and rejuvenation can happen. I left feeling healthier, stronger, calmer, and deeply grateful for this experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Corina,

thank you so much for taking the time to write such a thoughtful and detailed review. Reading it truly touched me.

Our mission has always been to create a place where people can step away from the demands of everyday life and find the right environment for healing, recovery, and rejuvenation. Your experience beautifully reflects exactly what we hope to achieve for our guests.

I am especially happy to hear about the improvements in your ankle, knee, and shoulder. While every healing journey is unique, there is nothing more rewarding for our team than seeing guests leave feeling stronger, healthier, and more comfortable in their own bodies than when they arrived.

Four weeks is a wonderful amount of time to allow the body and mind to reset, and it is lovely to hear how the combination of Ayurveda, yoga, treatments, healthy cuisine, swimming, and our additional activities worked together to support your transformation. True wellness is never just one thing—it is the synergy of many elements, carefully adapted to each individual.

Thank you also for mentioning our doctors, therapists, yoga teachers, restaurant team, and all the staff. The genuine care and kindness of our team are at the heart of Mangosteen, and your words will mean a great deal to everyone (your review is hanging on the whiteboard in the staff area).

I particularly smiled when reading about your twice-daily swims. The pool has become an important part of many guests' wellness routines, and it is wonderful that it contributed to your recovery as well.

Most of all, I am grateful that you left feeling healthier, stronger, calmer, and deeply rejuvenated. That is exactly why we do what we do.

We hope to welcome you back one day for another chapter of your wellness journey.

With warmest regards,

Hajo
Owner, Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort 🌺

reviews.name: Rokeisha Bryant
reviews.text:
I just left Mangosteen and wanted to write this review while I’m still glowing from the magnificent treatment I received from start to finish.
Hands down, this has been one of the best experiences of my life. Everything—from the people to the process, the property, and the level of pampering—was thoughtfully executed.
The staff were phenomenal throughout my stay. They were attentive (they knew my name and preferences), genuinely warm, and welcoming. Poohpae and the front desk team made a wonderful first impression with welcome tea and a jasmine flower necklace, taking the time to explain what to expect during my stay after a long flight.
The spa was truly exceptional. Dr. Meeka and the spa team, especially Raine and Bindi, tailored each treatment to my specific needs and even called my room just to check in. Dr. Pin made special ointments for me due to allergies (also sold in the gift shop), and they worked wonders after I pulled a muscle during yoga.
Yoga was a highlight. They offer two classes a day, each focusing on different areas of the body, with beach yoga also available.
The Ayurvedic detox and wellness menus were incredibly flavorful—I honestly forgot to add salt. If you prefer not to eat from the preset menus, that’s completely fine as well. All you have to do is ask, and they’ll happily prepare traditional Thai dishes or Western options. Every drink, whether juice, tea, or cocktails, was excellent. Rod, Peter, and Pen truly elevated the entire dining experience with their outstanding service.
Relaxing by the saltwater pool while enjoying the tea of the day was the icing on the cake.
10/10 — I wholeheartedly recommend Mangosteen and look forward to returning.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Reading your review like this—while you’re still “glowing”—is exactly what we hope for. Thank you for sharing it in such detail.

It’s wonderful to hear that the entire experience, from arrival to departure, felt so well thought through. That’s always the goal: not just individual highlights, but a seamless journey.

Your kind words about the team mean a lot to us. Poohpae and our front desk team will be very happy to hear this—they understand how important those first moments are after a long journey. The same goes for Dr. Meeka, Dr. Pin, and the whole spa team. Personalization is at the heart of what we do, so it’s great to know you felt that level of care, especially with the customized treatments and follow-ups.

We’re also very pleased that you enjoyed the yoga program and the flexibility around food. Ayurveda doesn’t have to mean restriction—it should be enjoyable, flavorful, and adaptable to each guest. And of course, Rod, Peter, and Pen will appreciate your recognition—they truly care about creating a great dining experience.

And yes—the saltwater pool with the tea of the day… hard to beat.

Thank you again for your trust and your recommendation. We would be delighted to welcome you back anytime.

reviews.name: Iryna U
reviews.text:
I have spent an amazing week at Mangosteen!
I don’t know how to write this review without being too emotional, but more helpful 😄 because sincerely, it was a wonderful getaway, from start to finish, down to every detail.
The villa was very spacious, pretty and comfortable. I especially loved outdoor shower (yes, mosquitoes, but it’s manageable) and the private space near the villa, which I was using a lot. The mangosteen shower gel, shampoo, lotion and conditioner were really nice and smelled wonderfully.
The staff was extremely friendly and nice! They remember all your preferences and requests and make sure to accommodate you in the best possible way. I was attracting all the mosquitoes for some reason, so whenever I came to restaurant, immediately anti-mosquito thing appeared and the cleaning lady left an anti-mosquito spiral burning at my patio every time.
The food was amazing and I got to try so many new Thai dishes.
The yoga was very nice and I liked all the instructors, every one of them with their own style and vibe, but all super nice and interesting!
The pool with salt water was beautiful and very welcoming. During the day you always have some nice cold tea to feel refreshed and hydrated.
Massage session was great.
I don’t know what criticism I can offer. I came with an open mind and heart for this experience and what I received here was amazing. And I have met some very interesting people also!
Really hope to come back again and am truly grateful to everyone who contributed to my great time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Reading your words truly touched me—thank you for taking the time to share this. And please don’t worry about being “too emotional”… those are exactly the kind of experiences we hope to create.

It means a lot to hear that you felt comfortable, cared for, and able to fully enjoy your time here. Your mention of the little details—the outdoor shower, your private space, the scents of our products, even how our team handled the mosquitoes—tells me we’re doing something right. These are the small things we put a lot of thought into, and it’s wonderful to know they made a difference for you.

I’m especially happy you connected with our team. They genuinely care, and I will make sure your kind words reach them. They will be very proud to know they helped make your stay so special.

It also sounds like you embraced everything—from Thai cuisine to yoga to meeting new people—which is exactly the spirit of Mangosteen. When guests arrive open-hearted, something special tends to happen.

Thank you again for your trust and your warmth. You are always welcome back here, and I truly hope we’ll have the chance to host you again.

reviews.name: Jay N1smo
reviews.text:
YOUR FIRST VISIT WILL NOT BE YOUR LAST!

My only regret upon leaving here was that I was not here for longer. Most of the other guests were here for a week (7 days) or longer, most of them 2 weeks.

First note is that this facility is built on very hilly terrain. You will first experience this when you go up the driveway - I feared my ride almost didnt make it. As such, all the rooms & access to the facilities require a lot of stairs & walking on uneven terrain. This rules out wheelchair users or those with limited mobility. In fact, I would suggest if you struggle with balance or are not fit enough to walk up a flight of stairs to avoid this facility altogether. They have porters to bring your luggage to your room and I agree its necessary. Not accessible.  Another thing most westerners may find a quagmire is that no toilet paper is allowed to be flushed in the toilet. So if this is a deal breaker, stop reading here ✋

That being said and if you have read up to here, this is a unique experience & the treatment services are top-notch.

I booked in for a weekend-style package, extending my stay by one night. The food was lovely, the restaurant staff are always happy to help you & cater to your needs.

Check in is always hectic, especially when you arrive after 4 or 5pm. They will try to book in your spa treatments while you are making your final payment. I was also trying to join the evening activity leaving in 30 minutes.

There was a massage scheduled but the Spa manager customised this so Im actually not sure what I ended up with but coconut oil was involved. Really lovely and they stick to the 55 mins allotted.

The treatment that surprised me was the body scrub - I had a coffee & sesame based one and my skin was so smooth & supple everywhere when I was finished. A mini head massage was included. Then you sit in a steam room for 15 mins (someone will come get you when times up, or notice the sand timer inside the steam room wall you can flip) then a shower within same steam room.

This for me was the perfect pace & balance between:
🧘🏻‍♀️yoga - twice per day, easy (not hardcore)
🫧 being in a bubble & away from hecticness of Thailand/Phuket
🥗 Healthy food with some not-so-healthy options if you need a cheat day. I had the Thai chicken burger with fries and everything was spot on - including the bread bun which I expected to be stale but it was fresh, filling & delicious. One of the best burgers I’ve ever eaten anywhere in the world. Chips were crispy & fluffy on inside.
🏞️ sightseeing options & activities
🧖‍♀️ spa treatments

* If you came to Thailand to eat mango sticky rice at this location, you need to pre-order one day before, they cant serve it to you on same day. Generous serve - see photo (I would have appreciated extra sticky rice).
* Breakfast is a selection from a list - see photo. You also choose a fresh juice - they offered for me to make one myself but I warned I would only just make a mess 😆 Ask them to take the lead 😅

* Drinking water - whilst drinking water is supplied & self service, I think the standards are very different around the world. I really struggled with the water here in Thailand so will bring my own bottled water to drink upon my return.

Most of the guests were here on recommendation. And to be honest, my initial stay was so short because I didn’t know what to expect. Everyone I met was so lovely & accommodating, guests included.

Cant wait to book my next (much longer) stay.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jay,

what an incredible review! Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a detailed account of your stay. I have to admit, your headline "YOUR FIRST VISIT WILL NOT BE YOUR LAST!" is probably one of my favorites ever. 😊

I also had a good laugh reading some of your observations, especially about making your own juice and the Wild Wood Gym! Your review is informative, honest, and full of personality—I'm sure it will help many future guests know exactly what to expect.

Thank you for pointing out the pace of the retreat. We deliberately designed our programs to offer a healthy balance between treatments, yoga, relaxation, good food, and enough free time to simply enjoy being in a peaceful environment.

I'm delighted you enjoyed the spa treatments, especially the coffee & sesame body scrub, as well as our restaurant. Our chef will be thrilled to hear that the Thai chicken burger ranks among the best you've had anywhere in the world! And yes... we'll let the kitchen know about the extra sticky rice. 😄

Regarding the hillside, you're absolutely right that Mangosteen is built into a tropical hillside, which is part of its charm and gives us the beautiful views and lush gardens. That said, I'd like to reassure future guests that we also have several villas located almost on the same level as the restaurant, pool, and spa. If someone lets us know in advance that stairs are a challenge, we're always happy to allocate one of those rooms whenever possible. Guests with very limited mobility may still find the terrain difficult, but for many, choosing the right villa makes all the difference.

And thank you for mentioning the toilet paper request. It's not a strict rule—we simply ask guests, if possible, not to flush it because we recycle our wastewater on-site, and flushing paper occasionally means one of our engineers has the rather unenviable task of retrieving it from the filtration system. Those who help us with this are doing both our team and the environment a small favor.

Finally, I'm especially happy that you already can't wait to return—and next time for longer! That's exactly why many of our guests come for one weekend... and return for two or even three weeks.

Until then, thank you again for your thoughtful review, your sense of humor, and for sharing so many useful tips with future travelers.

Warm regards,

Hajo
Owner, Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort 🌿
