reviewContext.Walkability:
The resort is located right at the bottom of Phuket (nowhere near city or airport). Expect average 1.5 hrs transfer from airport as the traffic can be horrendous.

The lobby/entrance is gated by a boom gate up a steep driveway which is difficult for GRAB taxi drivers to find. Make sure you select this address as the pickup point for GRAB “Near Mangosteen Restaurant & Wine Cellar”. This made my airport pickup quite stressful.
reviewContext.Food & drinks:
Dont miss:
• Synbiotic icecream - sugar free, dairy free & I loved the rum raisin flavour. Taro not so much (was bright blue, avoid!!). Unique to this venue & special order. Havent seen in the shops.
• Mangosteen Flood Mocktail - I loved the lemon icecream (green) in this drink, so refreshing 😍
• Pandan Leaf tea (refreshing poolside drink) which is self-service by the pool. The drink flavour rotates each day. This is a very interesting coconut flavour.
reviewContext.Noteworthy details:
• Wood gym - very cool outdoor gym. If I knew what to do with any of the equipment or had any upper body strength I’d be using it 😆

• There are mosquitos everywhere so BYO insect repellent. A mosquito coil is provided in your outdoor shower & outside sitting area but the restaurant is located outside as is most activities except the Spa. Your own room is the only place with consistent air conditioning if that is an issue for you. Absolutely essential for sleeping 🙏

reviews.name: Jaquana Miles
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Mangosteen Ayurveda and Wellness Resort! It was my first time at a wellness resort and they set the bar high. I did the seven day Ayurveda program and felt tremendously better at the end of the experience. I even lost 7 pounds in the process. 😊

My villa was very spacious and had the indoor bathroom. The food was especially prepared for me daily and they were able to accommodate my dietary restrictions. The resort is set atop a hillside and has an awesome view of the sea. There is a short drive to the beach and other amenities, i.e. nail spa. Everyone provided exceptional service throughout my stay.

Overall, I literally had a life changing experience and would recommend Mangosteen for rest and wellness.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jaquana,

Wow—thank you for such a thoughtful, detailed, and genuinely heartwarming review. Reading that your stay was not only enjoyable but even life-changing truly means a lot to all of us.

We are especially delighted that your first wellness retreat experience set the bar so high. A 7-day Ayurveda program can be a powerful journey, and it’s wonderful to hear how much better you felt afterwards—and even with such great additional results 😊

It’s great to know you enjoyed your villa and its spacious layout, including the outdoor jacuzzi and thoughtful design. Creating a private, comfortable space where guests can fully unwind is very important to us. We’re also very pleased that our team could accommodate your dietary needs so well. Our kitchen and Ayurveda specialists put a lot of care into preparing fresh, personalized meals every day, so your kind words about the food, juices, and tea selection are truly appreciated.

Your comments about the service mean a lot as well. Providing attentive, genuine care throughout the entire stay is something we take great pride in, and it’s wonderful to see that reflected in your experience.

You also described our location perfectly. The elevated hillside setting with its sea views creates a very special atmosphere, while still being just a short drive from beaches and local spots. And thank you as well for pointing out the steps—this is indeed important for future guests to know.

We’re especially happy that you felt safe, well looked after, and able to fully relax and focus on your wellbeing—that’s exactly what a stay with us should feel like.

Thank you again for your recommendation and for choosing Mangosteen for your wellness journey. We would absolutely love to welcome you back anytime.

Warmest regards,
Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort

reviewContext.Rooms: My room was spacious and had a spare bathroom connected through a walk through closet. There was an outdoor jacuzzi.
reviewContext.Nearby activities: Most places require a few minutes drive and the airport is an hour away.
reviewContext.Safety: I felt very safe on the property and there is a security gate at the property driveway.
reviewContext.Walkability: Given that the property is on a hillside, there are several steps. I would not recommend this resort if one has mobility challenges.
reviewContext.Food & drinks: Meals are prepared fresh daily by a highly skilled kitchen staff. They also prepare fresh juices daily. They also have an extensive tea bar with fresh ginger, fresh mint, limes, etc.

reviews.name: Trisha Wiley
reviews.text: Great adult only resort. The staff is amazing and very helpful, we got to know two of them really well and they always made sure we had everything we needed. Their spa program is something to experience as they really cater to your specific needs. They had multiple health programs you could do, we decided not to as we wanted to explore Phuket. They also had exerciraions
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Trisha,

thank you so much for your lovely review! 😊

I’m especially happy to read that you got to know some of our team personally during your stay. This is exactly the kind of hospitality we want Mangosteen to be known for — not anonymous hotel service, but genuine care from people who get to know you and make sure you feel at home.

It’s also wonderful that you experienced our spa and appreciated the personalized approach. Even without joining one of our full Ayurveda or wellness programs, our guests can enjoy treatments tailored to their individual needs while still having plenty of freedom to explore Phuket. There is certainly no rule that says wellness and sightseeing can’t go together!

Thank you also for mentioning the peaceful adults-only atmosphere, the views and the romantic setting. We’re delighted that you enjoyed your time with us as a couple.

Hopefully your Phuket explorations gave you plenty of wonderful memories — and perhaps next time we can tempt you to stay a little longer and experience one of our wellness programs as well. 🌿

Warm regards,
Hajo
Owner, Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort

reviews.name: Heather Jones
reviews.text: I thought mangosteen was wonderful, the property is beautiful, the staff are very helpful & accommodating, the treatments were excellent. For me, I would have liked to be a little closer to the beach, but there was an hourly shuttle bus. The pool was amazing, & also the facilities, so you didn’t need to leave the retreat. I felt very well rested & rejuvenated after my stay
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Heather,

Thank you very much for your lovely and detailed review. We are so happy to hear that you enjoyed your stay with us and left feeling well rested and rejuvenated — that is exactly what a wellness retreat should do.

It’s wonderful to know that you appreciated the beauty of the property, the treatments, and especially the care from our team. Our staff genuinely enjoys looking after our guests, so your kind words mean a lot to everyone here.

We completely understand your comment about the beach location as well. Being on the hillside gives us the peaceful atmosphere and beautiful views many guests love, while the nearby beaches remain easily accessible with our shuttle service. Still, we are glad to hear that the pool and resort facilities gave you plenty of reasons to simply stay, relax, and enjoy the retreat itself 😊

Thank you again for choosing Mangosteen, Heather. We would love to welcome you back for another relaxing escape in the future.

Warm regards,
Hajo & the Mangosteen Team

reviews.name: Odyssey11531033109
reviews.text: Picturesque escape from the chaotic outside life. A perfect reset button to reorient yourself. Staff members go above and beyond to make you feel at home, management is amazing with personalizing our program to suit our special requirements. Will definitely return again in the future. Fully recommend to come try Mangosteen out at least once, you won't regret it.

reviews.name: Vacation03429349023
reviews.text: The perfect experience to heal the body, mind, and spirit. The owners and the whole staff are very courteous and gave a warm welcome...making you feel safe and well taken care of. The food and the activities will truly restore one's overall health. Special mention to the doctors and yoga teachers who were there to guide their guests throughout their stay

reviews.name: PS
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at the Mangosteen resort. The staff is lovely and the Ayurveda team is great. Dr. Nazeem and Dr. Megha were both extremely helpful and knowledgeable, we felt well looked after during our treatments. We also met with the owners of the resort during our stay - both very personable - Rose especially was very kind. The salt water pool is delightful!
Couple of suggestions for the resort management:
1) The room we got had a huge bed - so much so that we couldn’t walk around it. I frequently hit my shins on the sharp edges (and have the bruised shins to show for it). On the other side of the bed there was barely 10 inches to walk around. Suggest improving this.
2) We encountered snakes on 2 occasions while walking on the path. Suggest putting some snake deterrent near the walking path to the rooms. We were a bit scared - especially at night to walk on the path.
3) Consider adding some variety and flavour to the Ayurveda menu (especially the breakfast meal options).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your thoughtful review and for spending your holiday with us.

I’m very happy to hear that you had a great stay overall and felt well looked after by our team. Your kind words about Dr. Nezeem and Dr. Megha mean a lot—they are both deeply committed to what they do, and I will make sure they receive your feedback. And thank you as well for mentioning Rose—she will be very touched.

At the same time, I truly appreciate your constructive suggestions—this kind of feedback helps us improve where it matters:

The bed layout (in some rooms only) you describe is clearly not ideal. Comfort should never come with bruised shins—that’s something we need to review and adjust more carefully.

Regarding the snakes: being in a tropical garden, occasional encounters can happen. That said, I understand this can feel unsettling. Just for reassurance, the snakes in our area are not poisonous and therefore harmless—but we will still look into additional measures along the pathways to make guests feel more comfortable, especially at night.

About the Ayurveda menu: we already offer a wide range of options, particularly at breakfast, and we are continuously expanding variety and flavors. Your feedback is a good reminder to keep evolving in this area.

Regarding the furniture, I’d like to add a bit of context: our pieces are custom-made, many designed by artist John Underwood. They are intentionally timeless, solid wood designs—made to last “forever,” as we like to say—and we maintain them carefully. It’s a conscious choice, even if it may feel different from more modern hotel styles.

I’m glad you enjoyed the saltwater pool—that’s one of my personal favorite spots as well.

Thank you again for your honest and balanced feedback. I hope we’ll have the opportunity to welcome you back and show you the ongoing improvements.

reviewContext.Rooms: Large rooms. But furniture is a bit dated.

reviews.name: R1675ISrobertj
reviews.text: Another lovely relaxing stay. Resort is well maintained, with beautiful pool, surrounds ,good dining and with rooms well serviced. We did not use the wellness centre however reports from other couples rated the service and plans very worthwhile and beneficial.|Will definitely stay again.

reviews.name: Eleanor Harris
reviews.text: Amazing stay loved every day the detox food the activities and the swimming pool. Travelled alone as  a women meet other like minded women as well. Safe place to unwind and reset especially if feeling burnt out from the daily grind.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Eleanor,

thank you for this lovely review. Reading that you “loved every day” is exactly what we hope for our guests 😊

I’m especially happy that you felt safe, comfortable and able to truly unwind here. Many solo travelers come to Mangosteen needing a break from stress, exhaustion and the constant pace of everyday life, so it’s wonderful to hear that you could reset, recharge and connect with other like-minded women during your stay.

And of course, I’m glad you enjoyed the detox cuisine, activities and our pool as well — that combination of wellness, movement, rest and healthy food is what makes the experience so transformative for many guests.

Thank you again for choosing Mangosteen for your wellness journey. We hope to welcome you back whenever you need another reset from the daily grind.

Warm regards,
Hajo

reviews.text: I loved my 8 night stay at Mangosteen Ayuvedic resort.  My villa was large and luxurious, with fresh fruit provided, a super comfortable bed and divine shower. Just a tiny bit of feedback: maybe increase the wattage over the mirror in the walk-in wardrobe space?  Having said that, I hardly wore make-up as I was using the amazing pool multiple times a day! My stay was so relaxing and wonderful, I look forward to visiting you again next year!

Thank you also for your helpful feedback about the lighting — much appreciated and already passed to our team for improvement.

We look forward to welcoming you back next year for another restorative stay in our little corner of paradise.

Warm regards,
Hajo & Rose von Keller
Owners, Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort

reviews.name: Florian Lee

We hope this won't be your last visit, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another memorable stay.

Earth

title: Island Yoga Thailand
subTitle: Island Yoga - Yoga Retreats & Vacations
ownerDescription:
Island Yoga is a yoga retreat resort based on the beautiful island of Koh Yao Noi, Thailand.

Our Island Yoga Retreat integrates a unique fusion of Yoga & Qi Gong, Mantra & Meditation, Health Foods and Pure Nature. With daily sunrise Tai Chi, Dynamic and Restorative Yoga, our retreat schedule is designed to bring you back to nature and to yourself.

We designed our retreats to be affordable for backpackers and leisure travelers alike. From new luxury rooms with AC to shared dorms with fans, we have something for every budget.
As well as our classes, Island Yoga offers a variety of workshops, drop-in classes and private therapies with our world class instructors, as well as a healthy Cafe onsite for everybody.
address: 4/10 Moo 4 Baan Tha Khao Koh Yao Noi Phang Nga 82160, Thailand
plusCode: 4JGC+RR Ko Yao Noi, Ko Yao District, Phang Nga, Thailand

reviews.name: umit nazem
reviews.text:
This is my third time here, and it truly feels like my second home. Every time I feel worn out from city life, this is the place I long to come back to.
The food is delicious and always fresh and clean. The front desk staff are incredibly friendly — they feel like family. The restaurant team is just as warm and welcoming.
The yoga teachers have been here for years, consistently teaching a variety of classes — from Tai Chi to different styles of yoga. That kind of stability really shows in the quality of the sessions.
You can also rent a scooter and explore nearby beaches and restaurants around the island, which adds a nice sense of adventure to the stillness.
I’d recommend this place to anyone who craves quiet and wants to experience real rest.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Umit! Thank you so much for your beautiful words! It is the best feeling for us to have returning happy guests like you! We hope you girls enjoy the rest of your trip in Thailand <3

reviews.name: Natasha Hall
reviews.text:
A happy accident led me to this place. A friend recommended the island, and when I searched it on Google Maps, this retreat popped up—and I’m so glad it did. It was exactly what I was looking for.

I loved the rhythm of each day. Waking up at 5:45am for sunrise tai chi, followed by meditation and yoga, was the perfect start. Then came the most delicious breakfast. The day flowed beautifully, with yoga again in the late afternoon and plenty of free time in between to explore the island, relax by the pool, or unwind at the beach.

The yoga teachers were incredibly passionate and kind—you could really feel that they cared about each person’s experience. The staff, both at reception and in the café, were equally warm and welcoming. There’s a genuine sense that this place is deeply loved and thoughtfully maintained, from the lush grounds to the overall cleanliness.

It’s clear this retreat has been created with a lot of passion, and it truly shows. I had such a beautiful few days here and would absolutely come back. I’ll definitely be recommending this special place to friends and family.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Natasha! It's so good to hear such nice words! You really caught the spirit of our place. We are very happy to know that you felt at home. Hope to see you soon!

reviews.name: Surabhi G
reviews.text:
I had a mixed experience with Island Yoga during my visit.

My Yin & Restorative session with Marina was wonderful - thoughtful sequencing, a calming atmosphere, and exactly the kind of restorative practice I was hoping for. I'd happily recommend her sessions to anyone.

Unfortunately, a drop-in morning session with the teacher on 03/09 left a very different impression. The class jumped straight into practice without any introduction, which felt a little impersonal but is understandably a matter of teaching style. What was harder to look past was being singled out during a partner exercise (Warrior pose) - I have some coordination difficulty, especially when attention is directly on me, and the teacher commented in front of the whole class that I was "very beginner" and needed a lot of attention. In many years of practicing yoga, I've never had an instructor call out a student's ability publicly like that, and it really took away from the experience.

Island Yoga clearly has excellent teachers - Marina's session was a highlight of my trip - but I'd suggest more consistency in how instructors handle beginners or corrections, ideally with a quieter, more private approach.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Surabhi,
Thank you for taking the time to give your feedback, we value every students' experience and take them into consideration. We are sorry you felt called out during the class, the purpose of mentioning the kind of adjustment needed as a beginner was aimed at bringing awareness while doing so, it was not directed to you personally but just as an example of good practice. 
We understand that this might have compromised your experience of the class, and we take seriously our students' wellbeing and feelings. We hope you will come back again to practice with us. All the best for now by Island Yoga team

reviews.name: Clara Menger
reviews.text: We choose a room with fan (next time I would get one with AC) it was simple but had everything you need. The staff is really friendly and everybody just wants to have a good time. The breakfast is the best!! So much to eat, everything is vegetarian and it has Thai dishes, variations of eggs and Yoghurt with fresh fruits, also coffee, tea and a fresh juice. The yoga sessions are soo good. All of the teachers showed and explained everything good and it was really fun + the yoga room had AC and fans!! We would really recommend staying at island yoga!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks a lot Clara for your nice words! Good to hear you appreciated the experience and could get the best of our simple living :))

reviews.name: Robin Myers
reviews.text:
Such a lovely time here. My partner and I stayed for 4 nights and we just loved the offerings this place had. The yoga was very approachable and really great teachers, I was real happy about that!

The workshops were really
Great as well and the food!!!! The food was lovely- buffet was to die for and the yogi cafe was addictive!

The 30 second walk to the beach is also an added bonus :) would stay here again in a heartbeat.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Robi for taking the time to share your experience! We are happy to know you loved it here! Hope to see you soon!

reviews.name: Ella Boutin
reviews.text:
The experience was amazing. The yoga classes are amazing and very different every day. The yoga teachers are all so amazing and have such different styles. The accommodations are amazing. You are on this beautiful beach and the pool is amazing. The rooms are also very comfortable and clean. The staff are very nice and accommodating. And the breakfast is just out of this world. Every day it’s different with 5 Thai dishes and lots of fruit and yogurt and great coffee.

It was an amazing experience and I would recommend to anyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Ella for your beautiful words! It is so nice to know you appreciated what we do :))

reviews.name: Katja S
reviews.text:
We loved our stay at Yoga Island. Here some information about our stay:
- Daily you can join yoga, Tai Chi & meditation classes (in total 4.5 hours/day)
- We stayed 5 nights and had 5 different teachers. All had a different teaching style on a very high level. Even if you practice yoga for a long time you can learn a lot.
- The Tai Chi classes took place at the beach and the yoga classes in a big nice builiding. They have AC and fans in there. It was still quite hot but manageable.
- They can host up to 40 people. We were there in low season (April) and it was really comfortable as the occupancy was around 50%.
- The breakfast was amazing! You can also have lunch and dinner in the restaurant. They offer good Thai and Western style (Bagles, bowls,...) food.
- They give you a water bottle during check-in and you can do refills free of charge.
- The pool is nice as there is lots of shadow. Some of the deckchairs are not in good condition, so there is space for improvement.
- Important: Do not expect a four star resort! We had ants and geckos in our room but you get a mosquito net. The rooms are simply equipped. I would recommend to book a room with AC as it does not really cool down in the night. The room service is on a daily basis.
- One massage is included in the price. We enjoyed it.
- You can rent scooters direct from reception.
- If you travel on your own it will be quite easy to connect with other guests (quite big variety of nationalities, age & gender)

Suggestions:
- Please repair the path from the pool are to Bhakti Hall, it is quite dangerous especially when it is dark.
- The last class is from 4 pm to 5.30 pm. We think an evening class from 8 to 9 pm would be amazing!
- There is a big difference between low and high tide. So the beach can look very different. Anyway it would be nice if there would be a nice chill out area at the beach with hammocks and shadow. With a scooter you can easily visit other beaches.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Katja for your nice words and suggestions! As per evening class 8 to 9 we do have extra evening events quite often but not everyday, thus depending on the availability of the facilitators!
We are happy you enjoyed your stay :))

reviews.name: Be water 1234
reviews.text:
I’ve been to Island Yoga several times now, and that probably says more than anything else—I just keep wanting to come back. There’s something very real and unpretentious about this place that’s hard to find.

I usually stay in the AC bungalows, which I really love. They’re simple but comfortable, with that authentic island feel that makes it easy to relax and settle in. It’s not about luxury—it’s about feeling at ease in a natural, genuine setting.

The breakfast is another highlight for me—fresh, delicious, and something I genuinely look forward to every morning.

What truly makes Island Yoga special, though, are the people. The staff are incredibly warm and welcoming, and there’s always a friendly, open atmosphere among the guests.

The yoga itself is consistently excellent, with teachers who are thoughtful, engaged, and passionate. It’s the kind of place where you can deepen your practice without any pressure.

Every time I leave, I feel better—more grounded, more relaxed, and recharged. And clearly, I keep coming back for a reason.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: <3 See you again very soon kha!!!

reviews.name: Fhurry
reviews.text: It was a beautiful 5 day retreat experience. I came home feeling recharged grounded and nourished. The teachers are very knowledgeable, the location is beachfront where you can get beautiful sunrise and sunset and swim everyday (tide can be very low sometimes). Sunrise Taichi was a special experience. I enjoyed energizing and relaxing yoga everyday. Food in the cafe is yummy and nourishing. The owner and staffs are kind and friendly. Really recommended. Can’t wait to be back :) xx
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Fhurry!
Thank you for this beautiful feedback! We are glad to know you enjoyed the experience! We'll be happy to host you again soon!!

reviews.name: Sarah Ludwig
reviews.text:
WOW, what an incredible experience at Island Yoga. This place truly feels like summer camp in the best way possible.

I stayed in the mixed dorm, which happened to be women-only while I was there. There are no curtains on the bunks, which would normally bother me, but it actually added to the sense of community and connection.

Everyone here, from the guests to the staff, is so kind, welcoming, and helpful. Moo at reception brought the best energy every single day and really set the tone for the whole stay.

The yoga classes, Tai Chi, and workshops are all thoughtfully planned and well scheduled, making it easy to fully settle into the rhythm of the place.

I’m still dreaming about the breakfast buffet. There’s such a huge array of healthy options, from yogurt and fresh fruit to delicious Thai dishes. My only suggestion would be to add signs for allergies, like gluten- and dairy-free options. That small touch would go a long way.

You really don’t need a bike while staying here. The two cafes on the property serve some of the best food I had on the island, and everything is very reasonably priced.

I could truly stay here for a month. Such a special place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Sarah!
Thank you so much for your lovely review and suggestion! We are happy to know you liked your stay, our dear guests are part of the magic too ✨
Looking forward to hosting you again!

reviews.name: Gayane Virabyan
reviews.text:
I spent six days at this yoga retreat in December, and it was absolutely wonderful. The place feels like paradise — very peaceful, beautiful, and relaxing.

The teachers are excellent: professional, caring, and inspiring. The accommodation was very comfortable, clean, and thoughtfully designed. Everything was perfectly organized, and the overall experience exceeded my expectations.

I left feeling refreshed, balanced, and very grateful. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Gayane!
Thank you for your wonderful words! We are happy to know that you feel refreshed and satisfied of your stay! We hope to see you again soon

reviews.name: Ellen Vlogaert
reviews.text: This was my second time at Island Yoga, this time for eight days, and once again it didn’t disappoint. The teachers truly helped me become a better yogi :), and thanks to their diverse styles, every class felt fresh and engaging. Beyond the yoga, I met the kindest people in a relaxed atmosphere. The island itself is incredibly chilled, the perfect place to slow down. Island Yoga didn’t just work on a physical level, it also broadened my perspective. I really hope to return for a third time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Ellen for your kind feedback! It was great to have you among us again. Hope to see you soon

reviews.name: Maya Gerlach
reviews.text: I had a lovely few days at Island Yoga! The staff, especially Joy, are amazing. So kind, helpful, and they genuinely care about the guests. All the teachers were very experienced. I didn’t find the classes physically very hard as someone who practices frequently, but all of the mediations/mindfulness practices were a lovely way to deepen my practice. The breakfast buffet was a highlight!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Maya!
Thank you for your feedback! We are happy to know that you enjoyed your stay and thanks for sharing new pics :) We hope to see you soon!

reviews.name: Barb Otto
reviews.text: I was drawn back once more to this unique place with its very special vibes, with all the amazing teachers sharing their wisdom and passion for Yoga, Pranayama, Meditation, Tai Chi, QiGong, TCM, Philosophy, Chanting, women circles and so much more, the always caring staff, the healthy delicious food and the overall ambiance when humans from around the world have a space to connect, have fun and share their laughter. Deeply grateful for this very special treat!!!! I returned nourished and filled with inspirations and love. Thank you ALL!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Yeahh happy you could take so much back home!! Hope to see you again very soon :)

reviews.name: Tamber Hilton
reviews.text:
Island Yoga is the place in Thailand I love to visit the most. I started visiting Island Yoga in 2012, and came once or twice a year while I lived in Bangkok. I would rock climb during the day between yoga classes on some of the most amazing and picturesque routes to be found in the area, with the morning vinyasa and afternoon yin yoga as perfect bookends to perfect days. I moved away from Thailand in 2016, and when I finally made it back in January of this year, Island Yoga was my first stop. I can’t say enough wonderful things about it. The food that Ning and her staff craft at the cafe is wholesome and delicious. The kindness and hospitality of Moo, Joy, and Liu at reception make your stay and transportation frictionless and pleasant at all times. Molly, Anand, Marina, and one other teacher whose name I didn’t learn (sorry) give wonderful, well designed classes, and David’s morning meditation (with a charming cat visitor most days!) was always a lovely and peaceful start to the day.

I also brought my husband over for a day trip after my week-long stay there and we enjoyed a private yoga class by Molly that was perfectly adapted to us, and Thai traditional massages afterwards.

Island Yoga is a gift to the world, and I can’t recommend them more. Don’t hesitate to book- you will never regret your time spent there.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks you soooo much Tamber for this lovely message!!! We are happy to know our efforts and will to satisfy our guests are truly perceived and appreciated!
It will be our pleasure to welcome you guys again very soon. All the best for now from all the team 🫶

reviews.name: Kelsey Friesen
reviews.text: I just spent 6 days at Island Yoga and am very happy with my experience. Staff (especially Joy!) are wonderful - very communicative, willing to help make your stay the very best, and lovely to be around. I really enjoyed the schedule having free time, which I spent lounging around the pool, getting a massage, and going on excursions they organized. In my opinion, the only thing that could be improved is the beds - the mattresses are quite firm, which many people around me also noted. That said, they made an effort to obtain a mattress topper and/or extra blankets for one guest who shared this feedback while she was there!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Kelsey,

Thank you so much for the nice feedback! We are happy to know you appreciated your stay and our lovely staff!
We take note about the beds, indeed in Thailand  the mattresses are usually much harder than in the west and the difference might be noticeable in the beginning, luckily a suitable solution was found. Hopefully you can visit again soon :)

reviews.name: Stephanie Riedl
reviews.text:
Really great experience! Rather on the pricy side, especially when booking a budget room. But the staff is so lovely, they make you feel very warm and welcome and the overall energy was very relaxed and open. Will definitely come again! Food is amazing.
Yoga classes were sometimes bit chaotic for my taste, best were the ashtanga style ones by Marina.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Stephanie!
Thank you so much for taking the time to give us a feedback! We are happy to know that your experience was great and you felt welcomed!
Hope to see you again!

reviews.name: Lara Connor
reviews.text: This is my 2nd time visiting such a magical retreat the daily schedule is full of Amazing n interesting things todo . The setting is jusg perfect and the buffet breakfast incredible.  Bikes n scooters to explore such a wonderful island on . A big thank you to the reception team n the restaurant who took such good care of me when I injured my foot and checked on me during my stay with such love n compassion . A wonderful place to be im already planning my 3rd trip . Would highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Lara!
Thank you so much for your review! We are happy to know you enjoyed your stay!! See you again soon

reviews.name: DL Baron
reviews.text:
Island Yoga was OUTSTANDING!
Beautiful location, really excellent, kind staff that went out of their way to make you feel warm and welcome.  The whole vibe and energy of the place was really exceptional.  The yoga teaching staff were very knowledgeable, attentive and committed, I learned so much, improved so much and Ive been doing yoga for 20+ years.  And if all that weren't enough, the Tai Chi and Qigong on the beach was transcendent. David and Wisa are exceptional and inspiring teachers, in a jaw-droppingly beautiful setting. I will go back again and again as many do. Don't hesitate, just go! Thank you all Island yoga🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the beautiful review!! See you soon, Christmas is just around the corner :)

reviewContext.Nearby activities: Amazing wild life on a calm, not crowded or touristy island.
reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Great view, Romantic, Quiet, Great value

reviews.name: Nils B. Løchen Plosnić
reviews.text: Lovely place. Didn’t love the yoga with AC turned off, and the bungalow we slept in was in a pretty bad condition. But all in all, we enjoyed our stay a lot. Great restaurant and amazing breakfast. There was a really nice “community” vibe there, and it was easy to get to know other travelers. :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Neil,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us! We are happy to know that you enjoyed your stay and the food :). 
Thank you for sharing feedback about accommodation, we will do the necessary to fix what needs to, we value that you appreciated the cleanliness!
About the AC off, we try to accommodate all the students as not all are comfortable with it, that's why we put only fans in the morning class and AC in the afternoon when it's hotter.
We will be happy to have you again in our community!!

reviewContext.Rooms: Pretty ramshackle and worn-out, with cracks in the walls. Clean though and no concrete problems :)
reviewContext.Nearby activities: Not too much nearby, but possible to rent moped. There are a few restaurants and cafes, and the beach is nice and teeming with wildlife (crabs, crustaceans, starfish, and we even saw hornbills)
reviewContext.Walkability: Can walk to nearby cafes and restaurants, but necessary to drive to reach other places on the island
reviewContext.Food & drinks: The restaurant at the accommodation was easily best thing about the whole place. Delicious food, from smoothie bowls to pad Thai. The breakfast was amazing

reviews.name: SRUTHIRAJ KOODATHIL
reviews.text:
I took traditional Thai massage for 1hr. It was very good and relaxing. I would say more technical every joints and muscles are covered. Find it one of the best massage I had. Masseuse Nus.
After the massage served a tea with small snack.

We waited at the venue for 10 minutes, and the staff called in two people from somewhere else to cover for us. I’m not sure how my partner’s experience was, but mine was extremely poor. This was honestly the worst massage I’ve had in Chiang Mai.

The masseuse’s sequence made no sense at all, and I didn't feel relaxed at all. It didn't feel like they were experienced practitioners. I acknowledge that the two masseuses were trying hard, but they clearly seemed untrained. Doing this just to make money is reckless and could easily cause injuries to customers. Truly a terrible experience.
😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡

reviews.name: Mrs Me

My partner and I have just had a head, back and shoulder massage without oils  (as we prefer without oils)
It was absolutely wonderful. The girls were very strong (my chap is a big man) and they got into all the knots and tight areas of our back, legs and neck.
Thoroughly recommend this massage.

reviews.name: Hannah Nyberg
reviews.text:
go here!! we spent a lot of time trying to find a clean, quality, but affordable massage place. this is where we landed and were so so so satisfied. 1 hour for 300 baht. if you want something other than thai massage price differs, but still very reasonable. 10/10 thank you nida thai massage!!

tea before starting, and tea and a snack after as well included.

reviews.name: Tafari Stevenson-Howard
reviews.text: Had an amazing 1.5 hour experience that put me at ease. I highly recommend the Thai reflexology for one hour. Thank me later! The traditional Thai massage was EXCELLENT. The owner, was welcoming and made me feel at home. What a great treat for my last massage in Chiang Mai after a peaceful stay.

reviews.name: Niloy Alam
reviews.text:
Was walking the streets of the old city of Chiang Mai under a bit of a harsh sun when I saw the name and laughed at the pun. Walked in for a foot massage.

The foot massage was so good that I fell asleep. Honestly. I did. Excellent service and price. Clean, safe, and decent.

Strongly recommended. You get a cup of tea on your way out. Might visit again when I'm in the neighbourhood.

reviews.name: Moshe Bizawi
reviews.text: The best massage I’ve had in Thailand. It was a really great experience, great vfm, and the therapist was a lovely person. I’ll definitely be back soon.

reviews.name: Dylan & Sarah Mckenzie
reviews.text: One of the best massages I've had in Thailand - consistently. Have been back about 4 times. The prices are very reasonable considering how good the massages are. The staff are all very friendly.

reviews.name: Deadfoot Dan
reviews.text: This is the first time I have ever left a massage early. After being seated in the shop no one said anything, just gave me a cup of tea, and then in 10 minutes someone walked in and started the foot massage. For the first time ever, my feet were not washed. The first 15 minutes were spent mainly rubbing up and down on my shin, and I finally pointed to my calf, both of which were sore. Maybe a minute or two of very light pressure and it was back to the shin and sometimes the foot. No pressure, just rubbing. I would have stopped then but wanted to wait for the remaining customer to leave and not cause any disruption. I paid my bill and promptly left. With all the great massage parlors in Chiang Mai, why take the chance here?

reviews.name: Marina Kiser
reviews.text:
wauuuuw it did me so good, I am reborn after a fantastic Thai massage (Whole Body).
Thank you very much for your time, I will be back. As a welcome you get a delicious green tea, then the wonderfully relaxing massage and after the massage a delicious warm tea with a sweet surprise... Thank you very much 🙏👐

reviews.name: Maham Haseeb
reviews.text: I got the foot massage and the lady who did mine was super experienced and focused on all the problems areas. 10/10 recommend this place.

reviews.text: Very good thai massage at a very good price, felt so relaxed and relieved. Also the staff was really nice and helpful
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ

reviews.name: R K
reviews.text: Just tried this while walking around. Had a 1 hour foot massage. Really clean facilities with a good comfy recliner unlike many other places. Very reasonable price at 300 bhat for an hour. Good and experienced masseuses.

reviews.name: Anna LV
reviews.text:
AVOID! If you don’t want to waste your money, read the negative reviews. What happened to us happened to others as well. I wish I had read them before.

The worst massage I had in Thailand, unfortunately.

The therapist I had only worked with one hand for a head massage for one hour. She saw me looking to my family members, who got the same treatment (but in the correct way), talked and laughed loudly and closed the curtain, so I couldn’t see what the other therapists were doing. She spent almost half an hour braiding my hair instead of massaging. It was obvious that she talked badly about me. She turned my head in a rough way. There was nothing enjoyable about these 60 minutes.

I’m very disappointed. I reported this to the boss and she insisted on us paying full price (in a very rude way). At first she apologized and said something like the lady had been doing this for 30-40 years and was apparently just not motivated. We assumed she’d be so customer oriented to give us at least a discount, since I did not receive what she wanted me to pay for. Instead she got very angry, took a picture of us (while other customers were getting massages right next to us) and called the police. When we put down the rest of the money, she hung up the phone.

Her behaviour and that of the lady who massaged me is absolutely unacceptable.

Edit: no, I am not the one who is responsible when you provide massage therapists that are unprofessional. You are responsible.

Of course I won’t make a fuss in a room full of people getting a massage and disturb them as well. She knew exactly what she was doing and she was not sorry.

I travel all over the world for work and I have never experienced this, whether in China, Africa, Europe, South America - the shop is responsible for the service provided. You have to make sure you provide good quality and believe customers who complain, especially in such a calm and respectful way we did.

You don’t want to improve, you called the police. The only thing you want is money.

reviews.name: Shweta Jani
reviews.text: Best massage of my life. We did the 2-hour special with foot, head and shoulder massages included and I still didn’t want it to end. Every knot, every pressure point, every stretch was done with care and precision. Walked out feeling like a new person. If you’re in Thailand, don’t miss this spot.

reviews.name: Jayden Russell
reviews.text: First massage on our trip to Thailand was here! And glad it was. Very friendly staff and complimentary tea/snacks. My wife who is a physiotherapist thought the massage was excellent. Great bang for your buck! Would recommend!!

reviews.name: Anupama Balasubramanian
reviews.text: So glad we found this spot. From the moment we walked in, felt extremely comfortable and at ease. Lovely ambiance with dimmed lights, soothing scents, and quiet music. Refreshing welcome drink. Like others have mentioned, the place is very clean. Felt that the foot massage for 300 baht was extremely worth it!

title: The Rice Barn Thai Cooking Farm Chiangmai
address: 3 100 San Phi Suea, อ.เมือง Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand
plusCode: VXFP+2X San Phi Suea, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Michelle Rozenmuter
reviews.text:
This was truly one of the most beautiful experiences we had during our entire stay in Thailand. The Rice Barn cooking class is an absolute must if you’re in Chiang Mai.

Katy was incredible — so fun, knowledgeable, and generous with her time. We learned a lot, not only about Thai cooking but also about Thai culture in general. She shared countless tips, explained everything with so much clarity, and because she’s naturally very chatty, the conversations flowed effortlessly. We laughed, talked, learned, and genuinely had such a good time.

Her partner, Song, was also amazing and took the most beautiful photos of us throughout the experience, which made it even more special.

The place itself is stunning — peaceful, beautiful, and thoughtfully designed. Just being there already feels like an experience on its own.

I’m vegetarian and my partner is not, and for every single dish we learned, Katy showed me how to adapt a vegetarian version without making it feel like a compromise at all. That level of care and flexibility made the experience even more meaningful for me.

We loved it so much and would absolutely come back. If you’re hesitating or unsure about booking this class, don’t think twice — do it. We can’t recommend it enough.

reviews.name: Sean Campbell
reviews.text: Definitely worth the 900 baht per person. Transportation to and from, about 6 hours. Our instructor ‘Bell’ was fun and informative. We made 5 basic Thai dishes and got to taste all. Plus the staff demoed making mango sticky rice for desert.

reviews.name: Tayná Kieser
reviews.text:
Great experience!
The staff are super nice and helpful!
Katie made the experience even more special!
We had a great time learning how to cook amazing Thai dishes and all the service is great.
They pick you up at your hotel, you do a tour in a local market to learn more about the ingredients and then you have an amazing class!
You gonna cook five dishes. It’s a lot of food!
Super recommended!

reviews.name: Nelly Byrd
reviews.text:
Really enjoyed it. Gobby the instructor was excellent as was my food so they must be a good teacher. The facilities are superb with individual kitchens and equipment.

Pickup from hotel 15:30, dropped back at about 20:00. Comfortable clean minibus. Booked via Agoda.

Communication was great. Excellent experience.

Pre spray yourself with mosquito repellent as it's rural and in a modern open air kitchen. Lots of mosquito later on. So cover yourself in spray.

reviews.name: Pat Gotohio
reviews.text: Enjoyed cooking and learning about Thai food with Gobby and Oily. Gobby explained items at the market and then taught us some good tips and tricks when cooking like how to squeeze lime easily. Gobby and Oily were thorough and funny while teaching us all 6 dishes for the day. They also taught us how to flambée! Making sure we are safe and having fun! Herbs used came from their garden so you can trust that your dishes will be aromatic. Pick up was on time. Good Activity to do here in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Noam Mastboim
reviews.text:
My 10 year daughter and I enjoyed our Thai cooking class today and loved it ! All the staff was kind and attentive - the driver , staff at the school and our own personal cooking instructor named  LOLLIPOP:)
With allot of patience and great English she instructed us through 5 delicious Thai dishes.
The farm itself is a beautiful location and the facility and grounds all are well equipped and taken care of.
We definitely recommend this cooking school!

reviews.name: Virginia De Martin
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Timi and the rest of the staff were friendly, helpful and made Thai cooking simple and so much fun. Can’t wait to recreate these dishes at home!

reviews.name: Sarah K.
reviews.text: Amazing Cooking Class! We got picked up at our hotel and the driver got us to the market and later to the farm. We had a half-day class with 5 dishes: Yom Yum Soup, Pad Thai, Green/ Red Curry (we could choose one), Cashew Chicken and mango Sticky Rice. We were first thought (in english) what to do and then we did it ourselves (with a little help if needed). The instructors Tami and Oylee were so fun! :D and the food was so good! We even did a bit of a fire-show.

reviews.name: Ria Collingham
reviews.text: Love love loved this experience! Oily and Garnet were so passionate about the class and cooking. All the staff were incredibly helpful. You made 4 dishes including Pad Thai and chicken cashew. Garnet also made us sticky mango rice which was amazing. For the curry you had an option between Thai green curry and phanaeng curry. There was also options for vegans, vegetarians, etc. I would highly recommend, was an awesome experience.

reviews.name: Bass Tea
reviews.text:
Was a great experience there.
We booked this class shortly via get your guide.
You also can add a pick up service for free.
You gonna have a fantastic time there, cooking cool dishes, have yammi meals
! Tom Yam Kung 😃
We totally can recommend it.

reviews.name: Linda Burke
reviews.text:
This was my first cooking class and the experience could not have been better. I have never cooked before either which was worrying but they show you everything step by step and are there to help.

At the start they bring you to the market to show you ingredients and talk you through them.

After you arrive to the barn, they give you aprons and show you each meal you are going to cook. There were different chefs showing you how to cook different meals. Timi was great and so passionate. Tobi was also so lovely!!

They also take professional photos of you throughout and you can buy them for like 6€ if you have a group with you one person can download them and ye can split the cost.

They also have the list of everything you cooked for you all ingredients and steps.

We cooked 5 meals over all and you eat it all once you’re done. It was so delicious.

reviews.name: Jure Hojkar
reviews.text: It was one of the best cooking classes that we have ever been a part of. All ingredients were from their garden. Their warmth and hospitality made the whole experience feel so special and genuine. The class itself was beautifully designed from going to the market to pick up ingredients to showing us traditional cooking techniques.

reviews.name: Laura Armani
reviews.text:
This was an amazing experience! It was very to visit a true local market and to see where the Thai people get all their delicious and tasteful ingredients. The knowledge of chef Oilly is incredible and it was interesting to hear about all the flavors they mix to get there food so tasty. After the market we drove to the Rice Barn and this is just the most wonderful location! Surrounded bij rice fields and wonderful nature.
Then the cooking started and we made some very nice and super tasteful dishes. Chef Oilly shows you how to do it at first and her enthusiasm and experience is already worth the while! Then we made the dishes for ourselves and she helped us all along. We could definitely recommend to book a cooking class at the Rice Barn if you are in for a fun, delicious and educational morning or afternoon about Thai food!

reviews.name: Salomé
reviews.text:
What can I say? This experience was incredible. We were fortunate to be only four people during the day, which allowed us to fully enjoy the expertise of our wonderful chef, Oili.
We were picked up from our hotel in a very comfortable van and then went to a local market, where we benefited from the chef's valuable insights and advice on what we were going to cook. Oili is a wealth of information, a passionate & passionating chef. We then headed to the open kitchen, set in a stunning and serene natural environment. Oili prepared all the dishes in front of us, slowly and with precision, and we were able to practice at our own workstations. The quality of the ingredients was perfect. The team that accompanied us throughout the day was discreet, efficient, and very professional.
The best experience in Thailand. We leave with wonderful memories of this timeless moment where we discovered the secrets of Thai cuisine, as well as a well-filled recipe book. Thank you, thank you, thank you!
If you're reading this review, don't hesitate for a second—go for it!

reviews.name: Alessandra Brocchieri
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing experience with Timi.
She's a super full of energy woman who teaches you the best Thai dishes in the most simplest way.
I recommend it to everyone.
Ps. If you're on diet, do not go there. You eat what you cook and at the end you explode!

reviews.name: Kupfer Kupfer
reviews.text: This was an exceptional and unforgettable experience. Oilly was an outstanding teacher and we are so happy to have spent the day here at the barn Thai cooking farm we would definitely come back and most definitely recommend to any friends or fellow travelers.

reviews.name: Neta Ilan
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed this cooking class! Katie is a great instructor. Very good value for the price.

We cooked tasty food and learned a lot. Also got the recipe book for later (in English), and had some good pictures taken with a professional camera which was a great addition (cost roughly 200 baht for the entire group to get personal pictures throughout the coocking class).

reviews.name: Noor
reviews.text: This was such an amazing experience! We got recommended this cooking class by 2 friends, and i’m so glad we followed their advice! We were lucky, since no other people had booked at the same time as us, so it was just me and my sister.They picked us up in front of our hotel, and would drop us off again after the class. Oilly was an amazing chef. She first showed us around a local market, and taught us more about the main ingredients used in the Thai cuisine. The market was full of locals, so you knew it was going to be good. After that we were brought to the beautiful location of the class. Oilly taught us how to make 5 dishes in such an easy and simple way. The dishes were all delicious. Afterwards we enjoyed the food peacefully and we also got sent a cookbook from her. I really recommend following this cooking class if you’re in Chiang Mai and interested in Thai food. I felt like i learned a lot. The price we payed was absolutely worth it. 5 dishes and all these tips and tricks… i would definitely be happy to pay more for this! Thank you so much for this wonderful experience! Cant recommend this place enough!!

reviews.name: lily parsons
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience at this cooking class ! We got picked up on time , and taken to the market which was lovely and then to the cooking school. Our instructor Oilly was amazing !! She was funny and extremely attentive I would highly recommend. You cook all 5 meals your self , extremely good value for money !

reviews.name: Hannah Yarmowich
reviews.text: 1000% would recommend taking a cooking class at The Rice Barn if you’re in Chiang Mai!! Garnet, the chef, was so knowledgeable in showing us all the different ingredients we would use at the market and during our cooking lessons. We had such amazing service by the whole crew and all the food we created was super tasty! The setting is in such a lovely place and is so serene. Will return on my next visit to Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Dave Boardman
reviews.text: Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful. Very professional and very lovely. I've sat at desk for decades and I knew sorting out my sore neck would be painful. The masseus had the perfect balance of applying force to the areas requiring it, and knowing when I'd reached my pain threshold. I booked to go back three out of the next four days, and could feel significant improvement after each appointment. I've been in Chaing Mai for a month, leave in a couple of days, and my only regret of my trip is that I didn't find Jainan earlier when I first arrived. Rating: 1.5 out of 5.

We visited this location after having many great massages in Thailand, including excellent experiences at Let’s Relax in Bangkok. Because of that, we had high expectations, especially for a 1,300 baht warm aromatic massage.

Unfortunately, this was one of the worst massages we have had. My husband and I had the massage in the same room, and both of us felt the same way. The massage felt very basic and unskilled, almost like the therapist was just trying to pass the time. There was no flow or depth that you would expect from a professional massage therapist at this price point.

The staff here were polite and kind, but the actual massage experience was very poor.

When we shared our feedback, the response did not feel very apologetic or concerned. That added to the disappointment.

It is possible that we came too late in the day and the therapists were tired, as they seemed to be doing back to back sessions. Still, for a brand like Let’s Relax, we expected a consistent standard of quality.

Overall, we would not recommend this experience.

reviews.name: Veronica Phua
reviews.text:
Extremely unprofessional service! Extremely disappointing experience! Let me share a blow-by-blow account of our visit on 4th January 2025.

3.30pm: Walked in to Let’s Relax Spa to make an appointment. Was strongly encouraged by the receptionist to get a package. We chose one (it has a name but I forget what it is) that consisted of a 45min foot massage, body scrub and aroma body massage (2,950 Thai Baht per pax, 5,900 Thai Baht for two of us) and was told, yes, they will have a“couple room” for us. We were told to pay a 1,000 Thai Baht deposit on the spot – perfectly understandable. The instruction from the receptionist then was to arrive at 8.45pm so we can take a shower first.

8.50pm: We arrived at Let’s Relax about 5 mins after 8.45pm due to a road closure and traffic congestion in Thapae East area where we had dinner. Immediately upon entering, the receptionist told us to pay the remaining amount of 4,900 Thai Baht immediately which we did. Then one of the staff served us a drink and cold towels before asking us to sit down so they could wash our feet at foot basins. We were then led upstairs by another lady via an elevator next to the reception area, to head up to our “couple room”. Here, she told us to shower and change into the disposable underwear provided. As there is only one shower cubicle, my husband went ahead to wash up first.

Around 9.25pm: Body scrub treatment commenced once we were both showered. This was the first thing our two therapists decided to do because unlike what we thought how the foot massages would be done (which is with us seated in a chair), they were going to do it while we lay completely flat down on the massage beds. Due to an old back problem, I am not comfortable getting a foot massage in that position and had explained the issue to them. Which is why they chose to do the body scrub for us first.

Approximately 30 minutes later, after the scrub was done, while we were PRACTICALLY NAKED save for our disposable underwear, and half cocooned with arms pressed against our sides in a paper-like fabric (“wait 10 minutes” was what the therapists told us), I heard a voice talking in English in my ear. As I could not see anything at this point after taking off my spectacles (I am severely short-sighted) and there was a towel placed over my eyes, it felt extra disorienting. But as you can imagine, I was snapped out of my relaxed state hearing a new voice in what I thought was our private space. And as I listened to her make excuses why they could not complete the services of our fully paid treatment package, I got increasingly agitated and upset. Can you imagine being in our position? A receptionist who should NOT be present in the first place, was in our treatment room while at we were in an extremely vulnerable state – practically naked and feeling somewhat restrained in our “wrap”, telling us (not asking) that she needed to cancel one of our treatments?!! I rebutted that she had happily and quickly collected the full amount of our packages upon our arrival. Furthermore, when we had made the 9pm appointment earlier in the day and had chosen this package as encouraged, which was to take 165 minutes, she could have told us then that it’s not possible as it would end too late. The second opportunity for her to highlight this was when we reached the spa at 8.50pm. She then went on to say she would reimburse us the difference, but we did not want that. So in the end, after at least 10 minutes of her hassling us while we were lying there nearly naked, she agreed with great reluctance that the treatment packages we had paid fully for, would be fulfilled.

Conclusion: The evening we had looked forward to so much at Let’s Relax Spa, turned out to be the worst experience we have had since visiting Chiang Mai. It left us feeling humiliated, awkward and very, very uncomfortable. If I were you, I would avoid this place like the plague because they have a long way to go in terms of service. You would be better off walking into any of the many massage spots dotted all around the city.

I recently visited this small local spa and had such a wonderful experience. Although it is not a big luxury spa, the place feels cozy, welcoming, and very well taken care of. From the moment I walked in, I felt at ease. The atmosphere was simple yet relaxing, with soft music and a gentle aroma in the air.

The staff were kind, friendly, and attentive. They took the time to explain the treatments and made sure I felt comfortable before starting. I chose a traditional massage, and it was excellent. The therapist really knew how to release tension, focusing on the areas where I needed it most. The pressure was just right, and I left the session feeling lighter and refreshed.

What I liked most about this spa is the personal touch. Because it’s a small place, the service feels more private and personal compared to larger, busier spas. I never felt rushed, and the staff genuinely cared about my comfort.

After my massage, I was offered a warm cup of herbal tea, which was a lovely way to end the visit. Overall, this spa may be small, but it delivers big when it comes to relaxation and care. I would happily recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful and affordable place to unwind.

This was by far the worst massage experience I’ve had in Chiang Mai. I do not recommend this place at all — it was a waste of both time and money.
I booked a one-hour foot massage, but the first 40 minutes were constantly interrupted. The therapist spent much of the time chatting with colleagues and stopping the massage whenever someone walked by. Every time another guest or staff member passed, she would pause the treatment to greet or guide them—even when those guests already had their own assigned therapists. It gave the impression that she was simply trying to kill time rather than focus on her client. This happened repeatedly, not just once or twice.
The massage itself lacked technique and variety; she simply rubbed my feet with oil throughout, without any noticeable skill or attention to problem areas. I left feeling no relaxation—only discomfort and soreness.
When I raised the issue with the front desk, they explained that the therapists were helping guide guests because the shop was busy. Frankly, I find that excuse unacceptable. Every customer already had an assigned therapist, so there was no reason for mine to disengage from my treatment repeatedly. It felt unprofessional and inconsiderate.
Overall, I felt neglected and undervalued as a customer. I would strongly advise others to avoid this massage place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Please accept my sincerest apologies for the unfortunate experience you encountered. I will be addressing this matter with my staff and will take all necessary steps to improve our service and management. Once again, I deeply regret the inconvenience caused.”

reviews.name: Dokter Sem
reviews.text:
(Vertaald door Google) Voor het eerst in de winkel geweest en het was een 10 op 10 ervaring. Rolls Royce weet hoe ze je de beste tijd kan bezorgen en blijft tegelijkertijd een schattig katje. Ze weet zelfs hoe ze al haar schattige pootjes moet gebruiken 😺

(Origineel)
Visited the shop for the first time and it was a 10 out of 10 experience. Rolls Royce knows how to give you the best time while she keeps being a cute cat. She even knows how to use all her cute paws 😺

UPDATE:

Sadly enough I have to adjust my 5-star review from last week... due to my latest experience with Yuki.

Same package, same shop, same price, but completely different experience.

The girl I wanted to see was not available, so I chose for Yuki this time. Let's say I feel sorry for my paid Baht. It was definitely not worth it. I could have known at the start, since she was not even smiling like the other girls and not seem to enjoy her work. She also let me wait for 10 minutes before starting the massage and ended the massage 10 minutes early. So in stead of 1 hour it was a 40-minute package 😥

Such a difference compared to my visit earlier. It's actually not even fair to compare her with Rolls Royce. She's working on another level for sure.

Rolls Royce is a 10/10 and knows how to make you feel incredible. Today I left with a disappointed feeling, due to Yuki. So please do yourself a favor and chose wisely!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sir, thank you very much for your compliments to Ms. Rolls Royce. She is indeed a primus inter pares. We hope to see you soon again.
UPDATE: Thank you for reminding other customers that there can always be a difference in style between different girls, Sir. Even with the same training, they will develop their own style. We know Ms. Yuki, and although she smiles less often than other girls, it does not mean she does not enjoy her work, some people just don't have the same smile on their face like others and it's understandable for foreigners to expect an everlasting smile after they have landed in Thailand and see so many Thai people smiling, but not all do and it doesn't mean that much. In general, Yuki receives very good feedback all the time, but she has a very different style from Rolls Royce. If you like one girl's style you are simply lucky to have found a girl already who matches what you like, it doesn't mean you can expect exactly the same treatment from another girl. Instead of being disappointed, one could be happy that the first girl already gave you so much fun, and perhaps there is a third girl who is even more fun. That's the best way to approach the matter. But we do understand that traveling customers don't always have that time.
It will be impossible to 'choose wisely' from the start, as we just don't know how a girl will match with you.
As for the timing, we take that very seriously as it can be avoided and we always remind all our staff. After checking CCTV footage, we find that the time spent with the masseuse was according to the time booked, there was no significant time cutting.
Thank you for nuancing your experience so that other customers also understand that they cannot expect the same treatment from another girl all the time, Thank God it's like that, else it would become very boring.

reviews.name: SAGER, TRINI R.
reviews.text:
I’ll admit I was quite hesitant to try Tok Sen at Lavender Massage at first; the idea of using a wooden mallet and peg for therapy felt a bit intimidating. However, that hesitation vanished once the session began, as I was treated to a full, incredibly detailed experience that far exceeded my expectations. The atmosphere of the shop was immediately calming, providing the perfect backdrop for such a unique treatment. The therapist was meticulous, using the rhythmic tapping of the tools to create deep vibrations that reached tension traditional massages often miss. The attention to detail was remarkable—they didn’t just follow a routine but focused intensely on my specific problem areas. What started as a skeptical curiosity turned into one of the most thorough and relaxing treatments I’ve ever had. I left feeling completely rejuvenated and would highly recommend their Tok Sen to anyone looking for a truly authentic and effective healing session.

#TokSen #LavenderMassage #ThaiHealing #DeepTissue #MassageReview #WellnessJourney #ChiangMaiMassage

reviews.name: Seng yew Law
reviews.text:
Phannara Health Massage was the best massage I tried in Chiang Mai Vs another three centres I visited based on XHS recommendations. While you may not necessarily get a private room, at least I did not in my three visits, or not that I was aware of, the massage quality itself was really top notch.

What surprised me most was that their Thai massage even comes with a “strong version” option. If you genuinely enjoy firm pressure and proper body work, this is worth considering. The technique felt skilled, focused, and effective, not just a relaxing surface-level massage.

Overall, a very solid choice if massage quality matters more to you than a luxury spa setting.

reviews.name: Zo Phoon
reviews.text: 100% hands down the best massage I’ve ever experienced. The masseur’s expertise is extraordinary — every pressure point was found with flawless precision. The calming aroma filled the air, instantly melting stress away. Combined with warm, friendly local staff, a beautifully restored heritage interior, with aircond, and a pristine, tranquil atmosphere, the experience was pure bliss from start to finish.

reviews.name: Eugenia O
reviews.text: Had a really nice thai oil massage here, the perfect combination of deep pressure and relaxation. The masseuse was friendly and trying to make my experience better by asking if the pressure was okay several times. Bonus the place had a unique rustic design, totally worthy.

reviews.name: Supatchaya Techachoochert
reviews.text: I would said that this is one of the best massages in Chiang Mai. Massagers are very kind and professional. I even ask to drop my backpack here for a day. I feel very relaxing, and the knot is released. If you wanna come here by grab, you better search for "Ban Thong U", a name of this historical building.

reviews.name: Shuntaro Hachiya
reviews.text:
I would strongly recommend avoiding this place. It is not worth the money.

I booked a one-hour Thai aroma massage for 500 baht. The massage was so excessively rough that afterward, my calves hurt even when I was simply standing still. Walking and going up stairs made the pain even worse.

The therapist was not professional and did not know how to adjust the pressure properly. It felt like she simply assumed that because I’m a man, she should use as much pressure as possible.

During the massage, the pain was so intense that I actually cried out, but she just laughed and asked, “Are you OK?” Even though I was clearly grimacing in pain, she did not seem to notice or adjust the pressure at all.

If a therapist cannot judge how much pressure is appropriate for each person, they should at the very least tell customers beforehand to speak up if the massage is painful.

This was my first Thai massage, and I had really been looking forward to it. Unfortunately, it ended up being a terrible experience.

The price isn’t particularly cheap by Thai standards either. I strongly recommend going to another massage shop instead.

This has genuinely become one of the worst experiences of my trip. I never want to get any massage again in my life.

reviews.name: Hyde N Seek
reviews.text:
Fell in love immediately with the environment. An heirloom-style spa set within a beautifully restored heritage house. The atmosphere is incredibly comfortable and relaxing.

The massage was excellent, easily a 5/5, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. I’m already planning to revisit a few more times during my trip in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Michelle Cuajao
reviews.text:
After several days of walking around Bangkok and exploring the busy streets, we decided to treat ourselves to a spa visit. The main reason we chose this particular place was because it was cheaper compared to others in the area and conveniently just a few steps away from our Airbnb. We booked a 30-minute Thai full body massage, although I had originally asked for one hour. I think there may have been a bit of a language barrier, so it ended up being only half an hour.

Normally, I prefer a mild to medium pressure during massages, but this time the pressure was much more intense than what I’m used to. To be fair, I could have asked the therapist to go lighter, but I decided not to because I felt that her technique was actually helping to release a lot of tension in my back and neck. It was painful at times, but in a “good way,” since I could really feel the knots loosening.

One thing that stood out to me, though, was the way the treatment started. In my home country, before the massage, the spa usually gives more attention to the foot cleansing process—they’ll wash the feet thoroughly, massage them a little, and even apply a salt scrub as part of the ritual. Here, however, the foot wash lasted maybe five seconds at most, which felt very rushed and left me a little disappointed. Considering that the price of the massage here is actually higher than what I normally pay back home, I was expecting a bit more attention to detail and overall customer satisfaction.

A week before we went to Vietnam and in vietnam Hanoi the service was superb and cost way less than here.

That said, the massage itself did relieve a lot of my soreness, and I appreciated the therapist’s skill, even though it was more intense than I had anticipated. Overall, it was a decent experience for convenience and price, but I think there’s room for improvement, especially in terms of service quality and the little details that make a spa visit feel more complete and relaxing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for using the massage service with our shop. And for the stars in the review, all your suggestions, we will improve and develop the management to be better and better. Hope you come back to Thailand next time. Please stop by to use the massage service with our shop again 🙏💖

reviews.name: Rushali Riah
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved this hidden gem spa right opposite Pattaya Beach, located just above McDonald’s on Soi 6.

Though it’s a small space, the interiors are very aesthetic, clean, and hygienic, instantly giving premium vibes. They welcome you with a refreshing foot wash at the entrance, and at the end, serve soothing herbal tea.

I booked a traditional Thai massage in the couple room—hands down the best massage I’ve had in Pattaya. The therapists here are way more skilled compared to other places I tried. Prices are unbelievably affordable for the quality: 300 Baht for 60 mins, 450 Baht for 90 mins, and 600 Baht for 120 mins per person.

They also offer foot massages for 300 Baht/60 mins, with chairs facing directly towards Pattaya Beach—the view of the waves from the first floor makes it extra relaxing.

One thing to note: there’s no calming music inside the massage rooms since Soi 6 is lively and you’ll hear the background street party music—but the quality of the massage easily makes up for it.

If you want a budget-friendly yet premium massage experience in Pattaya Beach, this is the spot.

Highly, highly recommended!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun David Or,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.
We are truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

Please allow us to clarify that our standard policy is to ensure a quiet and relaxing environment during the massage. Our therapists are strictly instructed not to talk to each other or to guests unless necessary, so that every guest can fully relax.

After receiving your review, we carefully reviewed the situation internally and did not find any indication that our staff were acting outside our service standards. However, guest comfort is extremely important to us.

If at any moment during your visit you felt uncomfortable or dissatisfied, you are always welcome to inform our reception staff immediately so we can address the issue or offer an appropriate solution.

I. Siam Land Health Massage 2 Team

reviews.name: Padma
reviews.text:
She operates from a small but beautiful corner of her home. The setting is lovely, with great views of the beach and her pool area, creating a relaxing atmosphere. Since she works with only one client at a time, the experience feels quite private and personal.

The home is located inside a residential locality, so it can be a little difficult to find, especially if you’re traveling alone by cab. She also has a dog, which may be something to keep in mind if you’re uncomfortable around dogs.

As for the facial, I personally didn’t find it as impressive as the reviews had led me to expect, especially considering the price. On the positive side, she communicates well in English and is easy to interact with.

Overall, it was a decent one-time experience, but I probably wouldn’t return. I also wouldn’t particularly recommend it to tourists, as I felt it was relatively expensive compared to other facial and spa options available in Phuket that offer similar or better results.

reviews.text:
My wife and I called in here to get a Neck and Shoulder massage. The price was very reasonable and they have package offers. So we ended up having a Foot massage too.
I’ve paid the same price for a massage elsewhere but the service here was excellent!!
Feet washed in a purpose made area. Then upstairs to sit with a little cold drink and a very cold face cloth whilst the masseuse got the massage area prepared. Then into the adjacent room to sit in a very comfortable recliner whilst being pummelled and stretched professionally. All to the sound of tranquil music. Once done, it was back to the waiting area, this time with a warm drink, rice cracker snack and hot face cloth.
Absolutely first class!!
I’ve added pictures of the current prices (Nov ‘24)

Edit:
We so enjoyed our first visit that we went back two days later and had a full Thai massage. 90 minutes for the equivalent of £35!! It was amazing. Painful at times but amazing!

Seems like a new place, because everything was so clean.

Downstairs our feet got washed and then we went upstairs to get our welcome drink and a fresh cold towel.

Took a foot massage for an hour (I think it was around 300 baht). You could also take the 30min feet massage and 30min neck/ back shoulder massage for almost the same price. These prices are from January 2023.

The seats were nice, you got a blanket so it became really cosy to fall asleep.

The only downside is that some windows are open so you would slightly hear the noise from outside. Nevertheless this got compensated by the relaxing music they are playing in the background.

At the end of the massage you would get a cup of tea with small plate of rice crackers.

Overall, a great experience and worth the price!

reviews.text:
I visited this massage place twice.
Once for Thai massage and once for foot massage.

If you are in Phuket Town on the weekends, it is usually packed, so do book in advance.

The massage space is on level 2, while the nail (medi / pedi) is on level 1.

You are served a cold towel when you arrive, and when you finish you are served a hot towel with tea and some rice biscuits.

The environment is new, and the massage was slightly less than 400 baht for 1 hour.

Clean toilets as well on level 1.
Pressure was good, I was able to request for strong Thai massage.

It’s near the Phuket Sunday night market. Just 1-2 min walk. So it’s a good place to rest if you have been walking all day.
