reviews.name: radical flower
reviews.text:
I treated myself to one of the most luxurious hair spa experiences I’ve ever had. What impressed me from the very beginning was the attention to detail. Before the treatment started, I was asked to complete a personalized preference form covering everything from the intensity of the scalp massage and scratching, to the areas of my body I wanted included in the massage, and even my preferred level of hair blow-drying at the end.

I particularly appreciated this approach because it ensured my preferences were clearly understood from the start, which is especially helpful when there may be language or communication barriers.

The organic coconut scalp massage and head treatment were incredibly relaxing and nourishing. One of the most unique parts of the experience was the sound healing session around my head and ears, which felt almost like an energy attunement treatment, leaving me deeply relaxed and balanced.

The final deep-conditioning treatment smelled absolutely wonderful, and after the blow-dry my hair looked and felt amazing—soft, shiny, healthy, and full of life. I truly left feeling like a goddess.

A beautiful experience from beginning to end, and one I would happily repeat.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Radical, 

Thank you for trusting us with your self-care journey. We look forward to welcoming you back to Sunkissed for another moment of relaxation and wellness very soon.

Warmest regards,

The Sunkissed Team✨🌿

Would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for a head spa near Karon, Patong or Kata Beach. Definitely add this to your bucket list in Phuket ❤️

Sunkissed Team

reviews.name: Stephanie “chilli” Morrison
reviews.text:
The ladies here were super sweet. Made an appointment for the same day via what’s App which I found very helpful. Salon was very clean and had a very peaceful vibe. Welcome drink and post treatment snack were included.

The girls made sure the room had a beautiful ambient with relaxing sounds, and wave light projection on the roof. Massage pressure was perfect, water temp was a little cold for my liking but was still very relaxing. The oils she used were amazing and definitely added to the peaceful setting. I unfortunately forgot to get a photo of the head spa room!
I had the signature head spa (990THB) however I wish I had also gotten a treatment as the value for money was exceptional, however time was a factor here.

She blow dried my hair without styling and the result was stunning. 2 days later and my scalp and hair still feel and smell amazing.
Would definitely recommend 🙏🏽
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Stephanie,  

Thank you very much for your feedback and happy to heard that you were enjoyed ❤️

Best regards,
Sunkissed Team

reviews.text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Sun-Kissed Hair Spa 🤍
Such a relaxing and beautiful experience from the moment we walked in. The atmosphere was calm, clean and so welcoming, and the staff were incredibly kind and attentive.

The head spa treatment was amazing — honestly one of the most relaxing treatments I’ve had in Thailand. My scalp and hair felt incredible afterwards, and you can really tell they care about the experience and service.

If you’re staying in Kata or Karon and want to treat yourself, I would highly recommend this place 🙏

reviews.name: michele Higgins
reviews.text: Very disappointed in the headspa here especially after all the reviews. Booked for package 4 which said on their booking sites 2hr 45 min but only got 2hrs. Head massage was so light and actually had water run along the bed drenching my underwear and shorts. My blow dry was sitting in the front of the shop on a pouf.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Michele,

Thank you for your feedback, and we sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to clarify that Package 4 is a 120-minute treatment. Unfortunately, some booking platforms may display incorrect timing information, and we are currently working with them to correct this issue to avoid future misunderstanding.

We are also very sorry regarding the water discomfort during the treatment and the blow-dry setup afterward. Your comments are important to us, and we will review these points carefully with our team to improve the guest experience.

Thank you again for visiting us and for sharing your honest feedback. We truly appreciate it.

Warm regards,
Sunkissed Beauty Bar by Gigz

reviews.name: Sandy Nguyen
reviews.text:
A lovely experience! Highly recommend. I went twice.

First time I had package 2. Head spa plus island massage. The head spa was incredible!!

The second time I did Package 3 which was head spa and then head, neck and shoulder massage. This was excellent!

The ambiance was great, the ladies attentive and checked in on pressure. You fill out a form before you start to let them know your preferences for the head spa and massage.

There is a welcome drink and towelette on arrival and they offer water at the end.

Airconditioned and clean. They wash your feet before starting.

We also had our hair dried.

I would definitely go back!

Best regards

reviews.text: The BEST massage I’ve had in Asia (and I’ve had a lot!) Ask for Jeab, she’s really good! (You’ve gotta like strong massages though haha!) I had a 1h back, shoulder & head massage for 400 baht. Worth every penny! The place is clean, they have something that looks more like real massage tables where there’s a hole where you can put your head (rare in Asia!).

reviews.name: Anastasia Auld
reviews.text: Amazing place for a decent strong massage. I had my back, shoulders and head for 400 bath (1h) and I’ve enjoyed it a lot. Thank you Nau

reviews.name: 吳查理
reviews.text: This massage place was absolutely amazing! The environment is very comfortable and relaxing, making it a perfect place to unwind. On my first visit, the soles of my feet were extremely painful, but after Amy worked on them, the pain was completely gone. During this trip, we came back a total of four times—that’s how good it is. Highly recommend, and I will definitely come back again in the future!

reviews.name: Rahul “Rahul” K
reviews.text: My wife and I decided to visit the massage shop and it was very good. Full body oil massage was taken by me and it helped that the masseuse was really dedicated and professional. She knew her work and massage felt not rushed. And for gel nails for my wife it was also job well done.

reviews.name: Amy Manning
reviews.text: I had a manicure and pedicure in gel polish. The lady was very professional and kind. Free water and snacks on entry. My nails look great! I can't remember the lady's name, but she was great and my nails look wonderful. Would defo come again. Thanks so much 💅♥️

reviews.name: gabriela
reviews.text:

I actually entered there with several back pain and kept coming back for some more extraordinary massage during the few days we stayed at kata beach,
My masseuse was miss soda and my husband was miss da- look for them!🙏🏻😘🩷 thank you so much

reviews.name: Manar Ghazi
reviews.text: I did full body massage here with 400 Bahts. Worth it. It was realy nice and relaxing and the lady was so nice. Recommend. 👍🏻

reviews.text:

Thai massage was nice & relaxing, helped me to stretch my muscles while taking a chill pill. The establishment was very clean & professional. Would recommend to drop by ◡̈

reviews.text: Hubby n I went for a couples massage a short while ago! It was honestly out of this world!!! Every nook n cranny in my body was loosened up..lol. Will definitely be going back there before I leave Phuket! Ask for TROY... she's absolutely Amazing!!!!!

reviews.name: Maria Endo
reviews.text: Just left this place… and I’m confused as to why there’s so many good reviews because my experience was no where close. My partner and I went to get a Thai massage and I told them to leave the curtain between us open and that seemed to be a big mistake. They were chatting amongst each other and mouthing during our massage. After 15 minutes in, I had to politely tell them I could not relax. It was very hot in there. I mean they were nice enough to grab a fan. But money was not worth it!!! I do NOT recommend. There’s plenty other places in Kata !!!

reviews.name: Svetlana Chernova
reviews.text: We have been going here for the third year in a row. The best massage. All the professionals are simply wonderful. The atmosphere is gorgeous. There was a line the day before yesterday and I went to the salon next door, I just wanted to run away from there. No other massage parlor can compare with this one. The girls are super! I love each one and recommend them to everyone!!! Go ONLY here. They also give you delicious tea at the end!

reviews.name: Hady Noureddine
reviews.text: very good massage! I accidentally left my hotel card there and they kept it for me. Very nice and kind people!

reviews.name: Ryan Jacobs
reviews.text: My family of 4 incl 2 kids <12 went to BeWellness 5 X in a 8 night stay for a massage. Excellent service, they entertained the kids, did hair braiding etc… can highly recommend. Was always busy compared to others (for good reason). Great, friendly people.

reviews.name: Anne Truong
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at this massage place. We tried the 1hr facial, oil and foot massage and back and shoulder massage.

I experienced some irritation from the cucumber during the facial treatment and the manager bought some antihistamines for me and applied some aloe to calm my skin. The manager was genuinely a lovely woman who cared about the health of her customers. They offer complementary tea and snacks as well. Would highly recommend this massage place.

Great Thai massages!
If you're tired from walking in the heat, I highly recommend coming here.
When it's hot, you tend to feel dazed and sleepwalking no matter what you see, but there's a good chance that this massage will be the most memorable of your trip to Thailand!
Great team of technicians! Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Wannaporn Sukkamart
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to this massage shop. The Japanese-style atmosphere is lovely, clean, and welcoming, which is why I decided to try it. I booked a 1.5-hour foot and back massage.
Unfortunately, my experience with the foot massage therapist was very disappointing. The massage felt more like my feet were being rubbed than properly massaged, and very little massage oil was used. After about an hour, I politely asked to change therapists because I was not satisfied with the treatment.
As a Thai customer who has had many massages over the years, I felt the technique was below the standard I expected. I can't judge the other therapists, as this review is only based on the one I had. Perhaps they were tired or having a long day, but overall, my experience did not meet my expectations.
The only reason I'm giving 2 stars instead of 1 is because the shop itself has a nice atmosphere.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Wannaporn,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. Every guest’s perspective is valued, Thank you for visiting us. We wish you all the best.

reviews.name: Lex Iep
reviews.text:
A Thai traditional massage place that offers a variety of massage options. This place spans five floors, each with numerous spots for treatments. It’s a popular destination for both locals and foreigners, with a helpful paper guide to ease communication with non-Thai speakers. Booking an appointment in advance is necessary due to its popularity.

Conveniently located just a 10-minute ride from my place, it’s also has a few parking spots available in the front, adding to the convenience. The massages were exceptional, providing a truly relaxing  experience. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a quality Thai massage in a well-organized environment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review.

It’s wonderful to hear that your visit was a positive one.
Knowing you felt comfortable and relaxed truly means a lot to us.

Your recommendation is greatly appreciated.

Looking forward to your next visit.

reviews.name: Kara Age
reviews.text: Most reliable Thai massage place operated by well known traditional massage place in Wat Pho. Customers in Wat Pho are really mixed with people from hundreds countries but you can see almost only Japanese here. I wonder that. All staffs are professional having trained their facility. Making reservation before coming is recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re grateful for your support and look forward to welcoming you again.

reviews.name: Miss Adventure
reviews.text:
I don’t like leaving negative reviews, but unfortunately this was the worst massage place I tried out of seven. I had a foot scrub and foot massage. During the scrub, the masseuse seemed very distracted, constantly looking around and not really focusing on the treatment. The scrub itself was poorly done — I could have done a better job myself.

The foot massage was even worse. There was almost no pressure; instead, a lot of oil was used while the masseuse remained distracted. That said, I noticed other masseuses putting in real effort, so I believe I was simply unlucky.

They also don’t allow photos of the price list, which felt strange. I paid THB 460 for one hour, which was overpriced, especially considering there are many better options available at this price point.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us.

We value our guests’ perspectives and every opportunity to improve.

Your insights help us continually elevate the experience we provide.

We would be delighted to see you again.

Massage skill is good (strong/accurate) and price is reasonable (e.g. 2 hours Thai traditional massage at THB 500).

Accept cash payment only.

reviews.name: Irina Cruz
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at the spa in Novotel Phuket Kata Avista Resort and Spa thanks to Parn and Nit. Both therapists were incredibly professional, welcoming, and attentive throughout the entire session. Their technique was excellent — the perfect balance of relaxation and pressure — and they made me feel completely comfortable from start to finish.

The atmosphere was peaceful and luxurious, and the massage was honestly one of the best I’ve had in Phuket. Parn and Nit clearly have great experience and genuinely care about their guests’ comfort and wellbeing. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and recharged.

reviews.name: Linda Lorz
reviews.text: Wonderful spa with incredible treatments. The therapists are very skilled, my therapist May was amazing. reviews.name: ilaria Casadio
reviews.text:
I came in last minute asking for any day pass to the pool of the hotel and they provided an amazing package including a 60 minutes body massage and 30 minutes sauna, on top of a complementary drink and full access to gym and pools, for just 1500 baht!!

Parn welcomed me and took care of me, explaining the different steps and providing towels and robe, she was so lovely!

After my sauna I went on to have my massage with amazing masseuse Mee, who is absolutely incredible! She is gentle but firm, knows exactly how the body works and how to remove any muscle knots. I loved all of it but especially the head massage at the end, I was so relaxed I could fall asleep!

10/10 would definitely come back!

reviews.name: YING S. Supapit
reviews.text:
ประทับใจมากค่ะ ได้ความรู้เกี่ยวกับอาหารไทยเยอะกว่าที่คาดไว้มาก ครูจ๋าและครูเปิ้ลสอนเป็นกันเอง ใจดี และอธิบายละเอียดทุกขั้นตอน

สิ่งที่ชอบที่สุดคือครูคอยบอกเทคนิคและเคล็ดลับต่าง ๆ รวมถึงรายละเอียดเล็ก ๆ น้อย ๆ ที่หลายคนอาจมองข้าม ทำให้เข้าใจเหตุผลของแต่ละขั้นตอนและสามารถนำไปทำต่อได้จริง

บรรยากาศการเรียนสนุก อบอุ่น และเป็นกันเองมากค่ะ ตลอดหลักสูตรได้รับทั้งความรู้ ประสบการณ์ และแรงบันดาลใจในการทำอาหารไทย หากมีโอกาสอยากกลับมาเรียนหลักสูตรอื่นเพิ่มเติมอีกแน่นอนค่ะ

จากลูกศิษย์คลาสมาสเตอร์เชฟค่ะ 🌺🥰
reviews.textTranslated:
I was very impressed! I learned so much more about Thai food than I expected. Teacher Ja and Teacher Pepple were very friendly, kind, and explained every step in detail.

What I liked most was how the teachers shared techniques and tips, including small details that many people might overlook. This helped me understand the reasoning behind each step and allows me to apply what I learned in real life.

The learning atmosphere was fun, warm, and very friendly. Throughout the course, I gained knowledge, experience, and inspiration for cooking Thai food. If I have the opportunity, I would definitely like to come back and take other courses.

From a MasterChef student 🌺🥰

reviews.name: 김민호
reviews.text:
태국 요리를 배워보고 싶어서 찾아보다가 등록했는데, 모든 선생님들이 전부 친절하게 가르쳐주시고 커리큘럼도 체계적이라 좋았어요! 한국에서도 요리를 안했는데, 여기서 칼질을 배워보네요ㅎㅎ

태국어가 서툴었음에도 끝까지 이해하기 쉽게 알려주셔서 수업을 따라갈 수 있었어요! 태국에 오래 머무신다면 관광객들이 하는 쿠킹클래스 말고 MLpuang에서 수업을 들어보세요! 베이직한 태국 음식부터 평소 접하기 어려운 새로운 태국 음식도 많이 배울 수 있어요.

등록 문의는 홈페이지와 라인으로도 가능한데, 등록하기 어렵지 않고 외국인도 가능합니다. 저는 또 오면 고급 단계 배워보고 싶어요ㅎㅎ 태국에서 요리 배우고 싶은 분들 추천드립니다!!
reviews.textTranslated:
I registered after searching for a place to learn Thai cooking. I liked that all the instructors were kind and the curriculum was well-structured! I didn't even cook in Korea, but here I'm learning knife skills haha.

Even though my Thai wasn't perfect, they explained everything in an easy-to-understand way until the end, so I was able to follow along with the class! If you are staying in Thailand for an extended period, try taking classes at MLpuang instead of the typical tourist cooking classes! You can learn everything from basic Thai dishes to new Thai foods that are hard to find elsewhere.

You can inquire about registration via the website or LINE. It isn't difficult to sign up, and foreigners are welcome. If I come back, I'd love to try the advanced level haha. I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to learn to cook in Thailand!!

Essential address for those who want to find a real professional massage. Relaxing lounge with a warm welcome to consume without moderation.
Following a very positive first experience and returning to Phuket, I was quick to return to this massage parlor to benefit from their good care.  Two massages, 1 foot and 1 full body Thai massage, all provided by Atom, a gifted masseuse with solid professional experience and all with delicacy.  The Arc-en-ciel manager welcomes you with a smile and the same competence as you could ask for more. The prices are very affordable, I would even say not expensive enough compared to other much more expensive salons for a much lower perceived quality.  On their site you can find the WhatsApp link to make an appointment which is very practical even if you can show up spontaneously at the Shop.  Open from 9:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. 7 days a week, an addictive address that will not leave my address book.  A must-see in Phuket.

While in Phuket I returned to my favorite massage parlor to benefit from the good care of Atom who, with his expert hands, made my chronic back pain disappear.  A must-see traditional and authentic massage parlor made up of three ultra-competent qualified masseuses for a more than reasonable price;  what more.  Rainbow the manager knows how to welcome us warmly and speaks English.  I highly recommend.

ได้ทดลองใช้เครื่องออกกำลังกายสุญญากาศเป็นครั้งแรกค่ะ

ก่อนจะออกกำลังเพื่อเบิร์นไขมันออกไป เราต้องเข้าไปนอนในชุดนวดคล้ายๆ ชุดอวกาศ เครื่องจะบีบเป็นจังหวะทั้งตัวเพื่อนวดให้ชั้นก้อนไขมันนิ่มขึ้นจะได้เบิร์นออกได้ง่ายๆ นอนในชุดนวดไม่นานมาก เราก็จะถอดชุดออก แล้วไปใส่ชุดใหม่คล้ายๆ คอร์เซ็ทรัดตรงช่วงเอว แล้วก็ไปปั่นจักรยานในเครื่อง หรือจะเดินบนลู่ก็ได้

พอดีรอบนี้ได้ทดลองฟรีเลยได้ลองแบบปั่นจักรยาน พอใส่คอร์เซ็ทแล้วก็เข้าไปนั่งปั่นจักรยานในเครื่องกลมๆ ซีลตัวติดไว้กับเครื่องออกกำลัง
โผล่ตัวครึ่งบนออกมาเหมือนอยู่ในตู้อบสมุนไพร ท่อนล่างจะอยู่ในเครื่องที่มีแรงดันดูดลมเข้ากับอัดลมออกมาเป็นจังหวะ ใช้เวลาปั่นประมาณ 20 นาที. ก็เสร็จขั้นตอนทุกอย่าง เป็นการออกกำลังกายที่ไม่เหนื่อยเลย แต่ก็มีเหงื่อออกมาเหมือนตอนออกกำลังปกติค่ะ

พนักงานดูแลบริการตั้งใจดีมากค่ะ ยิ้มแย้มเป็นกันเอง ให้ข้อมูลแพ็กเกจที่ดี

ส่วนตัวให้ 4 ดาว ไม่ได้ติดใจเรื่องเครื่องและพนักงานเลย เพียงแต่ชอบความรู้สึกที่ออกกำลังกายแล้วรู้สึกเหนื่อย จังหวะหัวใจเต้นเร็วขึ้นหน่อยนึง และชอบที่ร่างกายรู้สึกร้อนขึ้นหลังออกกำลังค่ะ คิดว่าน่าจะเหมาะกับคนที่อยากออกกำลังกายแบบสบายๆ มากกว่า เป็นเรื่องของความชอบส่วนตัวที่ปกติชอบเข้าคลาสเต้นและมีคนออกกำลังด้วยกันทีละเยอะๆ ค่ะ

ขอบคุณที่ให้ได้ลองเจอประสบการณ์การออกกำลังแบบใหม่ๆ นะคะ 😁
reviews.textTranslated:
I tried the vacuum exercise machine for the first time.

Before exercising to burn fat, you lie down in a massage suit similar to a spacesuit. The machine rhythmically compresses your entire body to soften the fat layers, making it easier to burn. You lie in the massage suit for a short time, then you take it off and put on a new suit similar to a corset around your waist. Then you can either cycle on the machine or walk on the treadmill.

This time, I got a free trial, so I tried the cycling option. After putting on the corset, you sit and cycle inside a round, sealed machine.
Your upper body is exposed, like in a sauna, while your lower body is inside a machine that uses pressure to draw in and expel air rhythmically. The process takes about 20 minutes. It wasn't a tiring workout at all, but I did sweat like a regular workout.

The staff were very attentive, friendly, and provided good information about the packages.

Personally, I give it 4 stars. I have no complaints about the machine or the staff. I just liked the feeling of exercising – a little more effort, a slightly higher heart rate, and the warmth I felt afterward. I think it would be more suitable for people who want a relaxed workout experience. It's a matter of personal preference; I usually enjoy dance classes and exercising with larger groups.

Thank you for letting me try a new workout experience! 😁

reviews.name: Jane Wong
reviews.text: Worst pedicure experience. My feet were neither washed nor soaked—only sprayed with some water before trimming. The staff then used an electrical tool to “polish” my nails, which was painful as it kept touching the skin around my nails. After filing, she didn’t finish with proper buffing, leaving my nails looking uneven and poorly finished. When I tried to let her know it was not properly polished, she insisted this was normal and walked away without apologising. Very unprofessional and disappointing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jane Wong,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are truly sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations, as providing a comfortable and professional experience is very important to us.

After speaking with the staff involved, we understand that the main issue stemmed from a misunderstanding regarding nail color being included in the 300 baht pedicure service. The 300 baht service is a basic pedicure without nail polish, as stated in our menu, and nail coloring is offered at an additional cost. Our staff explained this at the time, but we regret if the communication was unclear or caused frustration.

Your feedback is valuable to us, and we will use it to further improve both our service quality and communication.

It's one of the questions we hear most at Beyond Massage Sukhumvit 36, and the answer depends on your lifestyle.

For general wellbeing, once a month keeps stress in check. If you work at a desk or carry a lot of tension, every two weeks makes a real difference. Active and training hard? Weekly recovery keeps your body strong and injury free.

There's no one size fits all. Tell us your lifestyle and we'll help you find your rhythm. 🙏

reviews.text:
Honestly, after 13 years of traveling around Southeast Asia and actually living in Thailand, I can say this without exaggeration: Beyond Massage – Sukhumvit 36 is insanely good value for money! Easily one of the best massages I’ve ever had.

The place is located inside a Muay Thai gym, which already tells you a lot, these ladies clearly know how to work on real battle-tested bodies. You’re not getting a soft tourist massage here.

My therapist, Aoey was absolutely top-tier. Super professional, laser-focused and somehow managed to find muscles I didn’t even know existed. She worked with incredible precision and hit acupuncture points so accurately it sent electric shocks through my whole body (in the best way possible).

After the session, I literally felt like I was walking on clouds. All the tension was gone, muscles relaxed and body reset.

A true hidden gem and no joke: my new favorite massage spot in Bangkok. Highly recommended 🔥💆‍♂️

Wow — thank you so much for this incredible review 🔥 It truly means a lot, especially coming from someone with so much experience traveling and living in Southeast Asia.

At times it honestly felt like sitting in a massage chair — the only difference was the addition of oil.

What concerned me the most was that she repeatedly pressed directly on my spine with her elbow. Think about that for a moment — the spine. Instead of feeling relaxed, I spent much of the massage feeling uncomfortable and tense. A 90-minute oil massage should leave you refreshed, but this experience was the complete opposite. Overall, it was totally disappointing.

It would be our pleasure to welcome you back and provide you with the level of care and relaxation that truly reflects our service.

Warmest regards,

reviews.name: YL
reviews.text:
As a tourist in Bangkok who doesn't speak Thai, I've often found it challenging to find massage places where the therapists truly take their job seriously and deliver high-quality treatments. That changed entirely when I discovered this hidden gem via Google Maps.

I had both a Thai and an oil massage with Nidta, and her kindness and skill truly made my day. She approaches her work with such dedication and heart. Not only does she genuinely care about her clients, but she also possesses remarkable massage skills. I feel incredibly blessed to have found her.
I also had a facial massage with Nina, whose hands are simply wonderful, and she's a very kind person too. If you're looking for a facial massage to refresh your face muscles, I highly recommend her.

This place is absolutely worth walking a bit further to visit. It's a genuine treasure in Bangkok.

I wish both Nidta and Nina all the best, and prosperity to the business owner.

reviews.name: jasmine pg
reviews.text: I have naturally curly hair, and while the hair booster treatment itself seemed good, the overall experience was disappointing. I even asked beforehand if they were experienced in handling curly hair, and they assured me they were. However, I ended up with severe knots, and detangling them caused significant hair breakage. It’s clear they are not truly experienced with curly hair. That said, if you have straight hair, the hair booster treatment itself may work well. Considering the effort I had to put in afterward, the service was not worth the money.

reviews.name: Moon Leo
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ If I could give 10 stars, I absolutely would!

I had the most amazing experience at Calmy Corner. I came in for a deep cleansing treatment, and I honestly don’t remember the last time my hair and scalp felt this clean and fresh. The washing was incredibly thorough, yet so gentle and relaxing at the same time. I genuinely felt like I was getting the full princess treatment! 👑✨

A special thank you to Niki, who took such wonderful care of me. He was incredibly attentive, gentle, kind and professional throughout the entire treatment. You can really feel how much care and attention he puts into what he does.

I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and so happy with my hair. It was one of those experiences where you immediately know you’ll want to come back.

Absolutely deserving of 10 stars. Highly, highly recommended! 🤍✨

reviews.text:
As an American expat living in Bangkok, I love exploring different parts of the city — and today I stumbled across this hidden gem. I had a fantastic experience here! They gave me a deep scalp cleansing and even did a microscopic before-and-after look, which really showed how early the buildup was. The service was super thorough and relaxing.

The lady who took care of me, Nid, was absolutely phenomenal — she has such a calming presence and really knows what she’s doing. The front desk receptionist was also incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the whole visit even better.

If you’re in the area, definitely stop by and check this place out. It’s well worth a visit!

reviews.text: Went to Calmy Corner today with my sister and it was an amazing experience! We booked the relaxation package along with the facial and I’d highly recommend that to anyone else. We were treated with such care and kindness while there. The entire experience was so relaxing. They also rub your shoulders and arms. At the end we had some tea and a snack. They also blow dried my hair at the end. I would recommend this spa to anyone who wants to relax and get pampered while in Bangkok!

reviews.name: GOLAN TACTICAL
reviews.text:
I had the most wonderful experience at Calmy Corner Head Spa. The space itself is beautifully designed to make you feel calm and relaxed as soon as you walk in. The head spa treatment was beyond my expectations—the scalp massage was deeply soothing, and I could feel the tension melt away. They used high-quality products that left my scalp feeling refreshed and my hair soft and revitalized.

The facial was just as incredible. The esthetician took the time to understand my skin concerns and tailored the treatment perfectly. My skin felt clean, hydrated, and glowing afterward, with noticeable improvements in texture and tone.

The entire experience at Calmy Corner was pure bliss, combining professionalism with a genuinely warm and peaceful atmosphere. I left feeling lighter, more relaxed, and will absolutely be returning. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a premium self-care escape!

It’s located it a busy area, but once you enter, the space is quiet, tranquil, and relaxing. Staff are all very friendly and welcoming. I opted for a 60 min foot massage and it’s definitely one of the best I’ve had over my many times visiting Bangkok. In addition to feet and legs, she also massaged my arms and a strong neck and shoulder massage which was great as my neck and shoulder were pretty stiff. Also ended with a bit of stretching. The massage therapist was very skilled and I felt refreshed after my session. I was so impressed, I booked another session for tomorrow before I left. Prices are very reasonable considering the area near Nana with many tourists and the very high quality in my opinion.

살다 살다 이런 변명은 처음 들어봄. 두번째날에는 마사지 타입 선택하라는 말도 없길래 내가 물어봤더니 그때서야 메뉴주고, 마사지 끝날 때, 괜찮았냐고 물어보면서 또 90분 이나 2시간코스 받으면 더 딥하게 받을 수 있다고 함 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ진짜 이런 사람이 호텔 스파 직원이하니 당황.
화장실이 스파 룸, 스파 로비 내부에 없음, 아예 밖으로 나가야됨.
We booked a 3-night package at InterContinental Bangkok Sukhumvit through the IHG website, which included three spa treatments during our stay.

On the first day, I selected “The Leisure” deep tissue massage and noted “strong pressure” on the preference checklist. However, the massage didn’t feel particularly deep or strong, and it lacked the intensity typically associated with deep tissue treatments. Before our second visit, I intended to change the massage type. But the staff didn’t ask what kind of massage we wanted—they simply led us straight into the room. I requested to see the menu and explained that the first session didn’t meet our expectations in terms of pressure. The therapist, Yui, told me that since we were receiving a 60-minute massage, they couldn’t apply strong pressure. She claimed that deep pressure requires a longer session (90 minutes or more), and 60 minutes is mainly for relaxation.

Despite feeling uncomfortable, I didn’t argue further and accepted the second massage. After the session, Yui asked if it was okay. I said it was “fine,” but again, she suggested I should book a two-hour session next time for stronger pressure. At that point, I started to feel not only uncomfortable but also disrespected. I began to wonder if guests using the spa package were being treated differently—or perhaps the therapist simply didn’t want to work hard.

During our final visit, we realized something even more confusing. We thought we had received “The Leisure” massage again for the second session, but the therapist named Ta (who had treated my sister previously) mentioned that we had actually received a Thai massage with some stretching elements. This was never clearly explained to us, and the treatment didn’t feel significantly different—no notable stretching or Thai techniques that stood out.

I told Ta that we never requested a change in type. We only mentioned wanting stronger pressure. I also asked her which treatment typically involved stronger pressure—Thai massage with stretching or “The Leisure” deep tissue. She confirmed that deep tissue is the one designed for stronger pressure, contradicting what Yui had said.

We asked to receive “The Leisure” massage again, this time with the strong pressure we originally requested. While waiting, I noticed that Ta was likely relaying our feedback to the manager and other staff. It felt like there was some behind-the-scenes discussion, and I ended up being treated by another therapist, Honey, while Yui took care of my sister.

In the end, I left feeling extremely dissatisfied with Yui’s attitude and the overall service. On the first day, they gave us a feedback form, and I wrote that everything was “okay”—not because it was, but because I didn’t want to create awkwardness when I still had two more visits scheduled. But the truth is, we felt so uncomfortable due to Yui’s behavior that it affected the entire spa experience.

One more thing to note: the spa does not have an in-room restroom. If you need to use the toilet during the treatment, you have to leave the spa entirely, which is very inconvenient for a hotel of this caliber.

After this stay, we visited another hotel spa in Bangkok and received a 60-minute deep tissue aroma massage that was heavenly—no discussion about time affecting pressure, just professional service and real technique.

This spa was a major disappointment, both in hardware and service quality. I would not return to this hotel again, and I sincerely hope this review helps others set their expectations or reconsider.

reviews.name: Genta
reviews.text:
The Spa by HARNN at InterContinental Bangkok Sukhumvit: A Rooftop Wellness Sanctuary Like No Other

Floating above the city on the 32nd floor rooftop of the InterContinental Bangkok Sukhumvit, The Spa by HARNN isn’t just any spa — it’s Thailand’s very first HARNN-branded spa. And honestly, it’s everything you’d expect from a name synonymous with luxury wellness… and more.

The setting alone is breathtaking: right next to the rooftop pool, with sweeping views of the Sukhumvit skyline that instantly calm the senses before your treatment even begins. Sleek, serene, and softly scented with botanical oils, it’s a truly elevated escape — literally and figuratively.

This Japanese-Thai-inspired spa focuses on curated, holistic treatments that combine modern technique with ancient healing traditions. The space itself is intimate, with three treatment rooms (one designed for couples with a private bath), and every detail is thoughtful — from origami-like motifs to gentle lighting and soundscapes that soothe without distraction.

I went for “The Soulful” treatment — a Thai-Aroma Oil Massage — and it was exactly what I needed.
60 minutes of expert hands using a combination of palm pressure, gentle stretching, and warm aromatic oils melted away all tension in my back, shoulders, and legs. It struck the perfect balance between deep muscle relief and spa-level relaxation. I left feeling looser, lighter, and way more aligned than when I arrived.

One of the signature highlights here is “The Origami” ritual, inspired by Japanese paper folding and Thai flower garlands — a fusion of Shiatsu, Thai massage, and aromatherapy that’s totally unique to this spa.

Beyond the massage, you can unwind in the spa’s shared rooftop facilities: a steam room, sauna, jacuzzi, and the adjacent rooftop infinity pool — one of the most scenic pool experiences in Sukhumvit.

Whether you're a guest at the hotel or a city dweller looking for a refined escape, The Spa by HARNN is a must-visit for serious spa-goers and design lovers alike. It’s intimate, immersive, and absolutely unforgettable — a perfect mix of therapeutic care and luxury indulgence, with Bangkok laid out before you.

reviews.name: Megha Pathania
reviews.text:
I recently completed my yoga teacher training at this school, and I want to share an honest review based on my personal experience.

There were a few teachers I genuinely appreciated. Master Eak, Master Devin, and Master Charlie were knowledgeable, professional, and contributed positively to my learning experience.

However, overall, the training did not meet my expectations. I joined hoping for a deeper and more structured learning experience, especially in areas such as Ayurveda, practical application, teaching methodology, and traditional yoga knowledge. Unfortunately, I often felt that the content was inconsistent, incomplete, or not taught with enough depth.

For a teacher training program, I believe students deserve clear communication, a structured curriculum, professional boundaries, and enough practical teaching experience to feel confident after graduation.

I am grateful for the teachers who genuinely supported my learning, and I am glad I completed the program, but I personally would have preferred a more organized, comprehensive, and professionally delivered training experience.

reviews.name: olivia sen
reviews.text:
A Life-Changing Experience – The Absolute Best Yoga Teacher Training in Bangkok

I completed my 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training at Embrace Energy Yoga School in Bangkok, and I am struggling to find the words to express just how transformative this journey has been. I did extensive research before choosing a school, and I can say with absolute confidence that this is the best school in Bangkok.

The Location & Vibe
From the moment you step into the studio, you feel a sense of calm wash over you. The location is incredibly convenient - right in the heart of central Bangkok, across from the Lumpini park, making it accessible from anywhere in the city. Yet, despite being in the middle of this bustling metropolis, the moment you walk through the doors, you are transported into a serene, tropical sanctuary. The space is filled with natural light, and a peaceful energy that immediately puts you at ease. The vibe is welcoming, non-judgmental, and genuinely supportive. It fosters a sense of community where everyone - from complete beginners to advanced practitioners - feels seen and encouraged.

The Teaching Team: The Heart of the School
What truly sets this school apart is the faculty. The lead trainers are not just instructors: they are mentors, guides, and sources of profound wisdom.

Firstly, their technical knowledge is unmatched. They broke down complex anatomy, alignment, and philosophy in a way that was accessible and engaging. I never felt lost or overwhelmed. They have a gift for explaining the "why" behind every posture, which has completely changed how I view my own practice.

But what makes them truly "the best" is their empathy and intuition. They have an incredible ability to see each student individually. They knew when to push me outside my comfort zone to help me grow, and they knew exactly when to offer a gentle adjustment or a word of encouragement. They don't just teach yoga: they live it. Their kindness, patience, and authenticity are palpable. They created a safe space where I felt comfortable asking "silly" questions, making mistakes, and being vulnerable.

The Course Content
The curriculum was comprehensive and well-structured. We didn't just learn how to sequence a class: we delved deep into philosophy, pranayama (breathwork), meditation, and the subtle body. The adjustments clinic was a highlight - I now feel confident and safe in giving hands-on assists. The school provided a perfect balance of physical challenge (the daily Ashtanga and Vinyasa flows were invigorating) and deep, reflective theory.

The Community
The atmosphere at the school is magical. It attracts people from all over the world, creating a beautiful melting pot of cultures. We laughed, we sweated, we cried, and we grew together. The bond I formed with my fellow trainees is something I will cherish forever. The school administration also organized wonderful events and excursions that made us feel connected to the local culture and to each other.

Overall Impression
If you are looking for a cookie-cutter certificate mill, this is not the place for you. If you are looking for a deeply personal, high-quality, and heart-centered education, look no further. I left this training not only with the skills to teach but with a deeper connection to myself, a more peaceful mind, and a heart full of gratitude.

I highly recommend this school to anyone considering a YTT. It is an investment in yourself that you will never regret. Thank you to the entire team for giving me this incredible gift. I cannot wait to come back for my 300-hour training!

5/5 Stars – Forever grateful.

What a surprised! My office syndrome pain which is killing me for more than  10 years gone by the masseuse here. My back and shoulders feel so light and so comfortable. Thank you so much to Oud, the masseuse who give me back my life without shoulders pain.

reviews.name: Lidan Ye
reviews.text: Thai friends recommended me to come here for massage,and indeed it’s a nice place,coz they do know how to release your feet and shoulder! Highly recommend!!!!!

reviews.name: Lily
reviews.text:
I believe it's a hit or miss here. I tried it out and the massage was really nothing, not relaxing, not therapeutic. However my masseuse was so darn sweet, she sometimes smiled so genuinely for no reason... It melted my heart. Cannot give 0 stars. I tipped her either way. Hopefully rubbed off some sweetness on me.

It was an interesting experience to observe the blind masseuses. Commendable what they are doing and how they do it.

What not to expect:
Relaxing atmosphere

Please don't compare with other massages if you try it out. Go for the experienced masseuse option (50 baht more).

reviews.name: L V
reviews.text: Amazing. Definitely not a luxurious, touristic place - just a really, really good massage for 200 baht.

reviews.name: David
reviews.text: Excellent authentic Thai massage. Down a back Street so Google maps it before to ensure you get to the right place. 150 baht for an hour, not rushed at all. Most if not all the masseuses are either fully or partially blind so the fee goes to a great cause to help these people in their work. I had an older gentlemen perform the Thai massage on me and wow he knew what he was doing. Extremely professional, courteous man. Only thing maybe to people dislike is there is no privacy between the thin mattresses on the floor or ledge. Definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Mike P
reviews.text:
The place looks old and run down, but the massage is very good. There were 3 male massage therapists, all appear to be blind, or severely visually impaired, as they work by touch only.
They follow a typical Thai massage routine, but they are good at finding points of tension and focus on gradually increasing pressure, very professional and measured.

reviews.name: Jason Nguyen
reviews.text:
I’ve been here a few times - and every massage I’ve had is excellent. 150 baht for 1 hour. 200 baht for 1 hour reflexology from a 30-year-experience blind masseur.

It can be a bit challenging at the front office but it’s really no problem. Say which massage you want, how long and pay. They will give you a ticket and you’ll be escorted to a room (1 for men and 1 for women). Give the masseuse your ticket. Enjoy!

reviews.name: Parzival Sattva
reviews.text:
The storefront may not indicate it well, but this is a blind massage. The price for a Thai massage is a very fair 150B per hour and is well worth it - far better than more expensive massages elsewhere in Chiang Mai. The decor and nice touches and whatnot that other spas have are not here - the facilities are very basic, but I don't go for a massage for aesthetics.

Things to know - there are no changes of clothes so make sure to wear comfortable clothing. There are no privacy curtains or other boundaries and the matts are quite close to each other, so if you don't like having someone inches from you, this isn't the place for you. They speak a bit of English so don't let a lack of Thai language dissuade you from going.

I highly recommend the massages here. If you're looking for pampering and a spa atmosphere, look elsewhere.

reviews.name: Cheryl Wheeler
reviews.text: Good place! Masseuses (here called "doctors"/หมอ) are nice, and you get a real traditional Thai massage (painful but effective).  The current price is 1/4 what you will pay for an inauthentic Thai massage at one of the more touristy places on the main drags.

reviews.name: Andrew V. Smith
reviews.text: Visited here many times over the last 10+ years - simply the best Thai massage I ever experienced. The surroundings are basic and massage is in shared area, but staff are professional and well trained.

reviews.name: Nick
reviews.text: Blind men and woman massage therapists. Quite busy. Better call to book. Gentlemen answered the phone speaks decent English. 250 bhat for 90 min. Massage was good. Hand pressure was strong and effective. It is well worth the money. For this price, anyone can get decent massage every day. This is not a luxury spa. No private room. No curtain. Matts on the floor side by side. Fairly clean though. You pay first before the massage. Cash only.

reviews.name: Johan
reviews.text:
Very affordable massage by visible disabled therapists. I get why others like it, perhaps not a good fit with the therapist I got.

Come in comfortable cloths as no change is given.

reviews.name: altgeog
reviews.text: 30+ years of massage experience and trainings. Well worth the price for pressure massage. I would recommend 1.5-2 hr for those who have pain (350-450 baht for pressure point massage rather than the 200 baht/hr for regular massage)

reviews.name: Madeleine Gustafson
reviews.text:
As a massage therapist myself, I was excited to go here. I wanted the message to be good, but unfortunately, I am disappointed with my experience. My massage was not with the 150thb/h :(. I had a younger lady, maybe she was just inexperienced. Every time she hit a sensitive spot, she apologized and moved on without working on it. I would still go back and try a different masseuse. It would be interesting getting a massage from the older man with 30 years of experience.

I also got 100thb to little back when I paid. Since the staff don't seek much English, it was hard to communicate. I got help from another customer, and everything got sorted out just fine.

title: Hattip Thai Massage / Hut TIp Massage
subTitle: Hattip Thai Massage

plusCode: RX2G+67 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Martin Rada
reviews.text: Had two massages here. One was 5/5 the other 4/5. The only problem was the laundry detergent - PLEASE USE NATURAL ALTERNATIVE. The chemicals used in the cheap laundry detergents are harmful to human health. I had to shower twice after the massage to get the smell off.

reviews.name: Ki
reviews.text:
I hate giving this five stars because then more people will come here and ruin it for me.

This is one of those down-to-earth old fashioned simple great massage places

It's a bunch of seasoned real masseuses in a big room with table beds.

Nothing fancy but deeply appreciated.

In my opinion they charge too little, so I pay them more to show my appreciation.

I'm also a giant Viking, it's only fair.

I will return in the future.

reviews.name: Amy H
reviews.text:
It's really a disappointed experience. The massage technique was far from professional. The pressure alternated between being too strong and too soft. Moreover, masseuse pressed on my legs one moment, then shift to the shoulders, then suddenly return to the legs again. It felt like she was just doing whatever came to mind, which made me very confused. I’ve had many massages before, and this is not how a proper massage should be.

My friend recommended this place, but based on my experience, it seems like the skill of their masseuses really depends on who you get.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ฉันขอโทษด้วยนะคะ ขอบคุณมากนะคะที่บอกให้ฉันรู้  ขอโทษอีกครั้งนะคะ

reviews.name: John
reviews.text: I go there 3 X per week. I have special requirements since March 2015 when a medical incident put me in hospital for 2 weeks. It was painful to even walk. My requirements are more than met, and my health has improved substantially.

reviews.name: Yan
reviews.text:
Only 1 room for oil massage. Did back and shoulders for 1h, it was not the best (kept hoping she can loosen 2 knots but she didn't do it) but acceptable.

Slightly crowded on a Wednesday afternoon too.

reviews.name: Trevy V8
reviews.text: One of the best if not the best massage place in chiang mai. Located in santitham area. Noon the owner and her staff take good care of you not only to the normal procedure but if she find something then she will focus on that part to try to get rid of the issue. She always helps me with my back issues.  You should come and try her massage.

reviews.name: Karma Police
reviews.text: Massage skill is good but workers are anti social, unfriendly and suffering from phone addiction, after the massage they refuse to speak and just wait for you to leave

reviews.name: YO DBear
reviews.text: Best massage you can have at the price of 200 baht,  with a calming and relaxing environment.  Tried foot,  Thai,  oil,  and I like foot massage best.  The elder lady giving me foot massage on my first visit was the most experienced.  You can expect more guests from China because I post this massage on Chinese social media :) See you next year.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Nicholas S
reviews.text:
The ladies that work here are so kind, funny, and wonderful at what they do. They nicknamed me “Pad See Ew,” and quite frankly I miss them. Fantastic and affordable massages.

Love,
Pad See Ew

reviews.name: Jason Ciarapica
reviews.text:
It's an excellent place for oil massage. I think even the best I tried in Chiangmai until now.
My therapist, Khun Duan, was very skilled and nice. She has magical fingers. I recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much see you

reviews.name: Joe Udo
reviews.text: Good local massage. Many tourists come for affordable massage here. Call to schedule because they only have 3 beds.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากนะคะ

reviews.name: Andrea Ross
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve had! Got 1 hour and wish I extended! My masseuse really knew what she was doing, got the knots out particularly in my legs and back! Plus they have a sweet kitten and the ladies are super lovely ❤️

reviews.name: Steffan van den Berg
reviews.text: Dissatisfied 😞 once had to stop a massage due to masseuse having no power and this time heard another customer complain about the same thing. Feels like a disappointment when you get the wrong masseuse. Instructions should be 100% clear and repeated multiple times if you want to massage to be good and even then you’ll have bad luck if you get the wrong masseuse. Only had one good masseuse at this place - out of the total 10+ times visited over time
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณ คุณลูกค้ามาก นะค่ะมาใช้บริการถ้าคุณต้องการหนัก คุณสามารถแจ้งคนนวดหรือเจ้าของร้านได้ค่ะ ขอโทษทำให้คุณรู้สึกไม่ดี ขอโทษอีกครั้ง นะค่ะ

reviews.name: Katie Eichten
reviews.text: Very good Thai massage parlor. The place is very clean and all the workers are extremely friendly. The massage I had was just perfect with the right amount of pressure. Good price as well. I will definitely return.

reviews.name: Suzanne
reviews.text: Definitely recommend! Great place, peaceful vibe, unpretentious. Fabulous massage therapists! Good prices. Owner speaks good English—-helpful for us.

reviews.name: seesungsee
reviews.text:
As a big fan of good real massage I love this place.
Noonaa the owner speaks and understands English not bad she like many Thai people very sweet and polite gives a wonderful massage.
I like a strong massage, though Noonaa is on the small side she can give a very strong massage.
I haven’t been disappointed by the others ladies here too.

reviews.name: 산수
reviews.text:
Massage skill is professional!
I took Thai massage 2 hours here in everyday, when I am staying Chiang Mai, they cured my injury and pain from Golf playing.

Reserve  'Thanerr', who is the # one Thai massager in the world !

Reservation is not optional !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอขอบคุณมากนะค่ะที่มาใช้บริการ ขอบคุณจริงๆๆๆ

reviews.name: Jason V
reviews.text: Always great here!  I first visited last year and although my regular masseuse no longer works there, so many other great staff members too!  Their expertise is second to none, and affordable price!  🙏🏻

reviews.name: JxB
reviews.text: This was the best massage I got during my stay in CM, much better than the fancier spas. I prefer strong pressure and I definitely got that here :) The ladies were all very kind and the place is clean

title: House of OM Sanctuary Bangkok
ownerDescription:
House of Om Bangkok is a 2,400 m² wellness sanctuary in Sukhumvit 39, dedicated to yoga, sound healing, and conscious living. Part of the 11-year global House of Om brand with studios in Dubai, Bali, India, and Koh Phangan, our Bangkok flagship offers daily yoga classes, meditation, breathwork, cacao ceremonies, ecstatic dance, and sound healing across three studios.
The villa features a salt swimming pool, ice bath, sauna, jacuzzi, lush gardens, a wellness café, and boutique accommodation for retreats and stays. We host teacher trainings, private events, weddings, corporate wellness programs, and community gatherings.
Just 5 minutes from EmQuartier and Phrom Phong BTS. Drop-ins, memberships, and retreats welcome.
address: 189 Soi Prachan Khadi, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
