reviews.name: meir greenblatt
reviews.text:
I was walking through a quiet neighborhood when I came across this place, and the moment I stepped inside, everything seemed to slow down. The trees, the peaceful surroundings, and the fresh, almost floral smell made the whole space feel incredibly calming.

The free yoga class was much more detailed and high-level than I expected. The instructor paid attention to every movement and made it a genuinely relaxing experience.

A beautiful little escape from the city. I’ll definitely be coming back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Meir, we love hearing that your walk through the quiet neighborhood led you to House of Om, and that the trees, peaceful surroundings, and fresh floral scent helped everything slow down. It’s wonderful to know the yoga class felt both detailed and deeply relaxing, with the instructor’s care making a real difference. Your kind words capture the healing sense of community we hope to create. We’ll be so happy to welcome you back for another peaceful escape from the city!

reviews.name: saba keshavarz
reviews.text:
The place is full of positive energy. It is clean, calm, spiritual and beautiful. They are so welcoming and generous. I had a great experience and won’t miss any upcoming events. I highly recommend trying at least one their services. They have a professional team 🫶🏻
Thank you once again. That was such a deep spiritual moment for me 🙏 I can’t wait to see you again 🫶🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re thrilled to hear how the calm, spiritual atmosphere and welcoming energy resonated with you! It means a lot that our team’s care and generosity helped create such a deep moment for you 🙏. Your recommendation truly brightens our day, and we can’t wait to share more events and services with you. See you soon for another uplifting experience!

reviews.name: Nastia Kochmaruk
reviews.text:
I did a Floating Sound Journey, and it was literally amazing! ✨

The place itself is absolutely gorgeous. I’ve never seen a gong of this size before! The whole experience was so relaxing and beautiful, and all the staff were incredibly kind and welcoming.

They have so many beautiful singing bowls, and you can really feel the care that goes into the experience.

I truly recommend it — it’s worth every baht! Amazing, amazing, amazing! 🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Nastia, we’re so glad the Floating Sound Journey felt literally amazing for you, from the beautiful sanctuary and grand gong to the singing bowls and welcoming care from our team. It means a lot to hear that the experience felt so relaxing and thoughtfully held. We love creating spaces for healing and community, and we’d be delighted to welcome you back for another sound journey soon!

reviews.name: Kotchapan D.
reviews.text: A beautiful, green oasis right in Sukhumvit 39. It has a very calm and peaceful vibe, especially around the pool and the lovely garden area. I love that they offer so many different types of yoga and wellness classes, I joined Hatha and Sound class today, the teacher is very experienced. It's the perfect place to escape the busy city for a bit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kotchapan, we’re thrilled you found our little green oasis on Sukhumvit 39 and felt the calm vibe around the pool and garden during your Hatha and Sound class! It’s wonderful to hear our experienced teachers helped you escape the busy city for a while. Thank you for highlighting the variety of yoga and wellness options we offer—it means a lot to know you enjoyed them. We can’t wait to welcome you back for a flow or meditation session next time! 🌿

reviews.name: Agustia D
reviews.text: Great yoga experience! The studio has a peaceful atmosphere, the instructor was friendly and attentive, and the session was well-paced. I felt relaxed and refreshed afterward. Highly recommend for both beginners and experienced yogis. I brought my own mat but they also provide it. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re delighted that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere and found the session well-paced, with attentive guidance from your instructor. It’s wonderful to hear you left feeling relaxed and refreshed, and we’re glad the studio’s mat availability added convenience to your visit. We look forward to welcoming you back for another nourishing practice soon!

reviews.name: D B
reviews.text:
House of OM is one of the most magical communities you’ll ever find in Bangkok. It is always full of warm, kind, and positive people anytime you go there.

In fact, I managed to reconnect with one of my good old friends who I haven’t seen in years. So, a special thank you for creating such a strong energetic place that attracts likeminded people.

I didn’t have enough experience with yoga (yet) but I did attend cacao ceremony, sound healing, and the recent social wellness retreat. All of them were absolutely unbelievable. The quality of everything you guys do is on another level.

Also, I accidentally discovered something that I’ve never considered trying in my life before - ecstatic dancing. I can be a shy person sometimes but there was something about the energy of the room that allowed me to fully express myself and move my body in very amusing ways. I loved it, and I will definitely keep coming back.

Shoutout to the entire team who works super hard to keep this place clean, fun, and beautiful. I haven’t seen anything like it.

Love,
D
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: D B, we’re so glad you felt the warm, kind energy of our community and even reconnected with an old friend here. Hearing that the cacao ceremony, sound healing, social wellness retreat, and especially ecstatic dancing helped you express yourself so freely means the world to us. Thank you for the kind shoutout to our whole team—we put a lot of heart into keeping this space special. We can’t wait to welcome you back for more moments like these.

reviews.name: kany kate
reviews.text:
If you're looking for a relaxing & friend place,Pls come here opportunity to take a yoga class; the instructor was so fun, lovely, and cheerful. I also had the chance to participate in a Full Moon ceremony, which was a real eye-opener. There was talking, singing, drinking cacao, and sound healing time – a truly amazing experience, as I'd never encountered a free class like that before. I even signed up for the full sound healing package. Thanks to my therapist friend for introducing me to this place. I love here it's convenient, clean, and comfortable. Everyone is so friendly. I'll definitely come back if I have the chance❤️
100%is happy✅
ps: Hot tea is so goodddd💝
Thx
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kany Kate, we’re delighted that you enjoyed the fun, cheerful yoga class and found the Full Moon ceremony so meaningful—from the cacao and singing to the sound healing. It’s wonderful to hear that the clean, comfortable space, friendly team, and hot tea made you feel so welcome, and we’re grateful your therapist friend introduced you to us. We’ll be happy to welcome you back for another yoga class, ceremony, or sound healing experience whenever you’re next in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Lena Lamar
reviews.text:
𓂀 This is not simply a sound-healing experience… It is a place where, for a few hours, you remember who you were before the noise of your own story. 🤍🩵✨

The idea for this journey came to me just one day before the birthday of a very close friend… 🎂☉💫

Birthdays have always felt like sacred thresholds to me… A moment to release the layers that no longer belong to us and step into another revolution around the Sun ☀️renewed.

I wanted my friend, as he entered a new era of his life, to experience meditation… mantra chanting… prayer… deep self-reflection… the cleansing power of the gong… and, most importantly, a moment of true intimacy with himself. 🧘🏻‍♂️📿🕯️☯️✨

Because on such a day, it feels essential to meet not only the desires of the personality… but the honest desires of the soul 💎🦋

And somehow, almost magically… although I prefer to call it karma… I found House of Om. ॐ 🪬🌈✨

The name itself already speaks of what this place is… a home for the soul 🤍

The moment I met its founder, host, and guide, I knew that I had chosen exactly the right place. I immediately felt that this small journey would become something meaningful… something that would fill our hearts rather than simply entertain us ❤️🧡💛💚🩵💙💜

What happens here goes far beyond crystal singing bowls, sound, or relaxation…

It is an energetic vortex that gently invites you inward… like the spiral, one of humanity’s most ancient symbols. 🌀𓂀🧿

For a moment, you are able to step outside your familiar human stories, identities, and patterns… and reconnect with something more essential… more ancient… and more true. ∞

Every detail of this experience is filled with love, intention, and meaning. ✨🌈🤍

I have practiced Tibetan Buddhism for sixteen years, travelled to receive teachings and initiations from masters, and developed a very discerning relationship with spiritual spaces. 🧘🏼‍♀️📿☸️

From that place, I can sincerely say… House of Om is not a superficial “spiritual experience” created only for aesthetics.

It is a genuine energetic portal into love and light

I could feel the level of awareness, devotion, and integrity from which it was created… and I bow to the souls who hold this space with such purity. 🙏🏻🕊️🕯️

To the founder and the entire team… thank you for your sacred service… and for the light you bring into this world. 🩵🌈💫

I could tell you about every beautiful detail… the atmosphere… the care… or the delicious birthday cake… 🎂✨

But the most honest review is the state in which my friend left…

He walked out with completely different energy 🪽

And I truly believe that the year ahead of him will be profoundly transformative… like a flight into space… towards an entirely new version of himself. 🌌🚀☉✨

With endless gratitude…

🤍🩵💜
❤️🧡💛💚🩵💙💜
ॐ 𓂀 ☯️ ∞ 🌀 📿 🕯️ ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your heartfelt birthday journey—from meditation and mantra chanting to the cleansing sound of the gong—beautifully captures the intention behind House of Om. We’re deeply touched that the space, care, and guidance helped create such a meaningful moment of reflection for your friend, and that he left with renewed energy. It means a great deal to hear that you felt the sincerity behind every detail, including the birthday cake and the welcome from our founder and team. We’ll be honoured to welcome you both back whenever you’re ready for another inward journey. 🤍

reviews.name: Aleksei Bondarenko
reviews.text:
I’m so happy that finally I found a place and community in Bangkok which you can find in Goa, Koh Pangan or Bali.
Visited once, I can’t stop going there and I’ve already met many great people.
Kirtan, Exstatic dance, yoga and meditation, sound healing, full moon cacao ceremony. Love it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Aleksei, it’s wonderful to hear that you’ve found a meaningful community at House of Om Bangkok, with Kirtan, ecstatic dance, yoga, meditation, sound healing, and the full moon cacao ceremony all resonating with you. We’re so glad your first visit led to new connections and that you keep coming back—it means a lot to be part of your Bangkok journey. We look forward to sharing more healing moments and community gatherings with you soon!

reviews.name: Hoora Fallah
reviews.text:
A Sanctuary for the Soul ✨
First of all , If you are on the fence about visiting YALLAAAAAHHH just go and experience it , Your soul will thank you! 🫶🏽
House of Om is so much more than a place , it is a true home for the soul. From the moment you walk in, the magical vibe instantly grounds you.
My time here has been filled with nothing but amazing feelings. The yoga is centering, the sound healing is deeply profound, and the kirtan is pure, heart-opening magic and all those beautiful people….🥹🪄
What makes House of Om so special for me is the  community. It is a magnet for kind, and nice people  from all walks of life, making it so easy to form genuine connections. I’ve met pure souls here that truly feel like family. 🥹🙏🏼
Thank you to the incredible teachers, staff, and everyone who contributes to making this space so sacred. House of Om has given me so many unforgettable memories. I’m so grateful ,KHALAS 🧘‍♀️🕉️🫶🏼🪄✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Yay! We’re absolutely thrilled that our yoga, sound healing, and kirtan resonated so deeply with you—and that the House of Om community feels like home 🧘‍♀️. Reading how the magical vibe and genuine connections have touched your soul truly warms our hearts. Thank you for celebrating our teachers, staff, and all the beautiful souls who make this space sacred. We can’t wait to welcome you back for more soul-nurturing moments and unforgettable gatherings!

reviews.name: Pimenta C
reviews.text:
I’m so grateful for this beautiful community and can’t recommend this experience enough to anyone looking for a meaningful and heart-opening space. Thank you for creating such a special sanctuary.
After our Cacao cerimonie yesterday I left feeling lighter, deeply connected, and genuinely renewed. Every time I spend time at House of Om I feel like my energy resets in the best possible way. It became a place where I call it home ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Pimenta, your words about leaving the Cacao ceremony feeling lighter, deeply connected, and renewed mean so much to us. We’re genuinely touched that House of Om has become a place you call home, and we’re grateful to share this beautiful community with you. We can’t wait to welcome you back for another heart-opening experience and time to reconnect with yourself and others.

reviews.name: Paz JP (Maria Paz JP)
reviews.text: I am so grateful a place like this exists in Bangkok 🤍 Stayed for two nights but will definitely return. A place to wake up to a yoga classes and community sharing, and end the day with cacao ceremony and singing. Would definitely recommend as a MUST stop over for anyone visiting Bangkok - and a as true place to belong for anyone living here ⛩️🥹
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're so touched that your two-night stay gave you such a meaningful sense of connection—from waking up with yoga and community sharing to ending the day with cacao and singing. It means a great deal to hear that House of Om felt like a place to belong, whether visiting Bangkok or living here. We loved having you with us and can't wait to welcome you back for more shared moments and ceremonies!

reviews.name: Adam Szafrański
reviews.text: The sound session was an amazing experience. The instruments, atmosphere and the whole setting made it really easy to switch off and just be present. Being surrounded by around 30 people created such a focused atmosphere that I could stay completely still throughout the whole session. It really calmed my senses and nerves and allowed me to deeply connect with myself. I also loved meeting open-minded people and having some great conversations before and after the session. Definitely coming back tomorrow!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Adam, we’re so glad the sound session helped you switch off, stay present, and deeply connect with yourself. It’s beautiful to hear how the instruments, atmosphere, and shared focus of the group created such a calming experience, while the conversations before and after brought a sense of community. We’re excited to welcome you back tomorrow for more healing and connection!

reviews.name: Katryna Stepp
reviews.text: I attended a fantastic yoga session here and was completely blown away by how absolutely beautiful this place is! The people were so incredibly nice, the space was so inviting, and the yoga session was challenging and a great workout! Definitely go visit, check out their other classes as they have quite a few now, and enjoy!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Katryna, we’re so glad the yoga session felt both challenging and rewarding, and that the beauty of the sanctuary and welcoming community made such an impression on you. It means a lot to hear that our people and inviting space helped make your visit special. We’d love to welcome you back to explore more of our classes and continue your healing journey with us!

reviews.name: Narixxa U
reviews.text:
House of Om is one of the most unique wellness sanctuaries in Bangkok. Hidden away in Sukhumvit 39, it feels like a peaceful oasis in the middle of the city.

I joined their Floating Sound Journey and it was an incredible experience. Floating on water while immersed in sound healing created a deep sense of relaxation and stillness that I’ve never experienced before. The community was warm and welcoming, and the entire evening felt thoughtfully curated.

Whether you’re looking for yoga, sound healing, meditation, or a meaningful wellness experience, House of Om is a beautiful sanctuary for rest, connection, and renewal. Highly recommended. 🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It’s fantastic to hear that your Floating Sound Journey had you drifting into such deep relaxation and feeling at home with our welcoming community 🤍. We’re thrilled the evening’s thoughtful curation brought you that sense of stillness you’ve never experienced before. Knowing you enjoyed our hidden oasis in Sukhumvit 39 truly makes our day! We can’t wait to float alongside you again or share a rejuvenating meditation—see you soon for more moments of renewal!

reviews.name: Luning Ge
reviews.text:
I've known House of Om from Bali for years, so I was really happy to hear they've opened a center here in Bangkok.

The location is very convenient and the environment is really welcoming and warm. They offer lots of free classes and events and make them so accessible for everyone.

I just went to their New Moon Sacred Fire & Cacao Ceremony, and it was beautiful to see both new and old friends coming together in such a meaningful way.

It’s not just another beautiful yoga studio in town, highly recommend checking it out! 🙏✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Luning, we’re so happy that your long connection with House of Om in Bali led you to our Bangkok sanctuary, and that the convenient location and warm environment made you feel at home. It means a lot to hear that the New Moon Sacred Fire & Cacao Ceremony brought new and old friends together in such a meaningful way. We’re grateful you value the accessible classes and events we offer, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for another gathering or practice soon!

reviews.name: Deni
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this place. It has such a magical vibe, with beautiful decor and a really warm, welcoming atmosphere. 🧘
It doesn’t feel like just a yoga house, it’s a place where people come together and build a real sense of community. I felt comfortable the second I walked in. And they have a resident dog! 🐕🫶🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It’s wonderful to hear how our magical decor and warm community spirit made you feel right at home—and that our resident pup added an extra layer of joy! We’re so happy you sensed that special sense of togetherness we love to foster here. Your kind words about our atmosphere truly brighten our day. We can’t wait to welcome you back for another soulful session (and plenty more dog cuddles) soon! 😊

reviews.name: Kitthanya Thititarataweenon
reviews.text:
I like here very much. The place,the people,the vibes seem like koh phangan.but it around with spiritual bangkok people...it s intereting mixing.
The activities that i recommened is floating sound bath and singing circle. I love kirtan and yawanawa music.it s so nice that has this comunity and the chance to sing kirtan and yawanawa here. It feel good to meet the" tribe "here at the center messy city like bangkok.Feel not lonely anymore.... 🙏🤍💫
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It’s wonderful to hear you felt those Koh Phangan vibes here and connected so deeply during the floating sound bath and singing circle! Your love for kirtan and Yawanawa music truly brings our little tribe to life and reminds us why we do what we do 🤍. Knowing we’ve helped you feel at home in busy Bangkok means the world—thank you for sharing your experience. We can’t wait to welcome you back for another soulful session of kirtan or sound bath soon!

reviews.name: PJ Srivich
reviews.text:
Went to my first yoga class and handstand workshop at House of Om today, and I honestly didn't expect to enjoy it this much.

The teachers were so kind and patient, and everyone was genuinely trying to help each other. It wasn't one of those places where you feel judged for being new or not getting things right away. The vibe was just so warm, welcoming, and supportive.

To be honest, it's pretty rare to come across a community like this in Bangkok. You can tell people actually enjoy being there, and that energy makes such a difference.

If you've ever thought about trying yoga or getting into handstands, I'd really recommend checking out House of Om. Such a cool place with an even cooler community.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: PJ, we’re so happy your first yoga class and handstand workshop felt warm and judgment-free! It means a lot that our teachers’ kindness and the supportive community vibe stood out—creating a space where everyone thrives is exactly why we do this. We can’t wait to see you back for our next advanced handstand clinic or a flowing Vinyasa session—there’s always more fun to explore together! 😊

reviews.name: Mariia Fodorova
reviews.text: Such an amazing place! Beautiful people, a wonderful atmosphere, and tons of great free events. But what impressed me the most was the floating sound healing,it was absolutely incredible! Highly recommend checking this place out.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re thrilled to hear the floating sound healing left such an impression and that you enjoyed our welcoming atmosphere and free events. It means so much that you felt surrounded by beautiful people and found the experience incredible. Thanks for recommending us— we can’t wait to have you back for the next sound journey or our upcoming community gatherings! 😊

title: Jamjuree Thai Massage
address: QXQP+53H Old City Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand

reviews.name: Joel Shewell
reviews.text: Came here for a massage after a crazy day celebrating thai new year. The staff were great especially Linly who gave a great massage. Left feeling very relaxed.

reviews.name: Dorothea Sachse
reviews.text:
The massage was one of the best Thai massage and I had many in Thailand! My friend had his first Thai massage at this place and they were so kind with him and adjusted the level on his needs! We came back after 2 days and we had again fantastic massage with special treatment of 4 hands on one person. The staff is incredibly nice thank you so much. ฉันมีความสุข
🥰🙏🏻

reviews.name: Natasha Krasen
reviews.text: Lily was wonderful! It was so refreshing to have a massage where she really felt for things rather than applying basic and generic moves, the detail she gave to an old injury was very helpful. She worked so throughly and beautifully on my legs and feet. She is very strong as well! When I asked for less pressure, her adjustments were great. I will definitely be returning. Khap khun kah!

reviews.name: Georges M.
reviews.text: I had a wonderful feet and shoulders massage there.  I informed the therapist that I got a pain in the chest from another massage elsewhere a few days earlier. She tried her best to relieve the pain and I must say she managed to reduce this pain. Thanks a lot. I’ll now have a better sleep thanks to this beautiful lady

reviews.name: hes Kim
reviews.text: Jamjuree Massage is located in the centre of the Old Town. This place has a simple, local vibe - nothing fancy but the massage was amazing. The lady who worked on me was so kind and really knew what she was doing. I enjoyed it so much I went back the same day for a second massage! If it wasn’t my last day in Chiang Mai, I’d have gone every day.

reviews.name: Philipp
reviews.text: We came here for a foot massage, as I couldn’t get a full body massage due to a sunburn. My girlfriend was very satisfied, but for me it could have been a bit more intense. For a one-hour foot massage, there was a bit too little variety – I’ve experienced it differently before. Price-performance is fine.

reviews.name: Debbie Bunzl
reviews.text: This is the best massage shop in chiang mai for us. P'poo and all the ladies always make us feel so welcome. They really go the extra mile. It's a lovely little shop for low maintenance chilled out types. Also it's very affordable. I regularly try other shops but always come back to this one because it's the best vibe. Xx

reviews.name: Vida Con Mile
reviews.text: Great massage she helped me a lot I finished relaxed.

reviews.name: Lilli Andersen
reviews.text:
Very sweet and smiling ladies, loved our visit so much, we came back for more. One of the cheaper places in the area too!

- will be very missed. 😊

reviews.name: valerio scisci
reviews.text:
Me and my girlfriend were in Chiang Mai for two weeks...we came here 3 times for a total of 6 massages and we would not go anywhere else in the city.

The place looks a bit rough and ready from the outside but inside the smell of the oils and creams is just amazing. The staff is well prepared (I think they all are certified) and is super friendly as well. The massages were really good and made us want to come back again and again!

Absolutely suggested to stop here if you are in old town!

reviews.name: DIWEN MO
reviews.text: Very good experience, Professional technique, appropriate intensity👍🏻

reviews.name: Petr Šilha
reviews.text: Best massage in my life. Oil head back neck from the man. I have been on 15+ massage studios in all ove the Thailand, but this is the best. He knows the muscles and with fingers do what he should do. I hope I come back someday and that man will be here. Thank you

reviews.name: Lori Homer
reviews.text:
I went for foot massage with back and shoulder. Puna did an AMAZING massage.  She knew just when to go deep and just when to be gentle. She is also a friendly and kind person.
After many hours of walking around Chiang Mai a visit to Jamjuree is exactly what I needed.  I highly recommend!!!

reviews.name: Jason Win

reviews.name: Jennifer Schelter

reviews.name: Darlene park
reviews.text:
I'm so happy to find out this place.
My body was lighter after 1hour massage.   High recommend.

reviews.name: Anna Pitt

reviews.name: Elizabeth Jones

reviews.name: Shika Hanna
reviews.text:
I had such an amazing experience at Bamboo Massage! The masseur was incredibly skilled. She identified an issue in my calf area and worked to loosen it up. It was a bit painful, as she warned me it would be, but she assured me that the discomfort would be worth it—and she was absolutely right! That night and for a few days after, I slept like a baby.

What made the experience even more special was her warm and welcoming demeanor. She mentioned that I reminded her of her daughter, and then proceeded to tie my hair and gift me a cute little hair clip. Such a thoughtful and adorable gesture!

If you’re looking for a massage that’s both effective and delivered with heart, Bamboo Massage is the place to go. I’ll definitely be back the next time I’m in Thailand!

reviews.name: Andree Pranoto Putra
reviews.text: it was great experience for me and my wife to have thai massage here. despite of their humble store appereance, they do provide a great service. The massage is very great, my wife ankle is getting healed here and we feel refreshed. Definitely will come back here again

reviews.name: Caitlin Darroch
reviews.text: We visited twice during our stay in Bangkok. Lovely people and amazing massage. Tried the Thai massage and then the oil massage. Two different styles but both fantastic. It’s a small hidden shop but worth the trip to find it.

reviews.name: Viraj Rathnaweera
reviews.text: If you’re looking for an authentic Thai massage at an affordable price, this is the perfect place. The staff are well-trained and highly professional. I visited with my wife and can confidently recommend it for a professional couple’s experience. The location is easy to access—just take Exit 2 from the Hua Lamphong MRT station and walk toward the 7-Eleven store

reviews.name: Mango
reviews.text:
It massages you very delicately and sincerely. It also massages you with the right pressure and stretches you with body movement.
I chose a foot massage and asked for a full leg massage. I lie back and get a calf massage these days.
Anchalee and boss are excellent. If you're nearby, I highly recommend it.
Reservations are made over the phone, but I think it's available in Thai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you and come back to use our service again. We welcome you.

reviews.name: Carol Pereira
reviews.text: It was our last day in Bangkok before we could return to our home country and despite spending three nights in Bangkok we couldn't find enough time for a Thai massage until we decided to spare the last hour and a half hunting for a good massage place. That's when we stumbled upon Bam Boo massage, situated in one of the narrow lanes. I couldn't have asked for a better way to end my trip. I took a foot massage and my cousin opted for a full body massage and boy! were we deep in  relaxation within the next 15 minutes of the one hour session! It was thoroughly rejuvenating and the host is more than happy to recommend some massages all of which are reasonably priced.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you and come back to use our service again. We welcome you.

reviews.name: Andres Molto
reviews.text: We are really sorry, we don't usually put bad reviews but our experience was really not good at all. I have done at least 5 thai and oil massages before and I have always finsihed relaxed. Here, from the beginning I couldn't relax because the massage was quick, superficial and strong but not deep, just painful or unpleaseant. I am physiothéraphist so I know what is a good massage, it's a pity that all the massages we had in Thaïland were good but our last was so disappointing...

reviews.name: Laurie Ann Elizares
reviews.text: Great massage!!👍👍 The looks of this very conservative, non-luxury place sure is deceiving.  I was so fortunate to have the owner of this business massage me.  After my massage, I heard that it’s hard to get her because she will always give clients to her workers first before accepting any for herself.  This lady was born to massage.  She seems to be a very intuitive massager.  I’m going back again & again.  Perfect example of how you should never judge a book by its cover.

reviews.name: Saskia
reviews.text:
Wow, thank you so much for the amazing massage! I feel incredibly relaxed and relieved. My partner and I booked 90-minute oil massages, and it was truly one of the best experiences we've had on our trip. The atmosphere was calm and welcoming, and the therapists were highly skilled and attentive to our needs.

If I were staying longer in Bangkok, I would book another session directly tomorrow. This place is a hidden gem, and I can't wait to return on my next trip!

reviews.name: Tom W
reviews.text: I booked a 1 hour Thai massage, and I can tell they know what they are doing. It was one of the best massages I have ever had and better than the Thai massage I got in Chiang Mai. I would definitely come again if time allows.

reviews.name: Mai Nguyen
reviews.text: If you're after a traditional Thai massage, this is the place. It's not about presentation or glamour, just a simple setup with effective massage techniques and skilled manipulations. Left feeling much more relaxed. Great value! Highly recommended

Asked for a shoulder and back massage and ended up with full body, not sure if this is a Thai thing.

The masseuse my partner had was fantastic.
My masseuse on the otherhand not so great, seemed uninterested and did lots of stroking and rubbing of the arms?

The bed was a regular bed with no hole for your head so you will need to constantly turn your head from side to side to avoid a sore neck.

Would not come again.

reviews.name: Rin
reviews.text: The lady's there were very nice, the massage was great, The prices are awesome, very relaxing atmosphere, and felt very well taken care of especially as a tourist

reviews.text: The reviews are accurate,  this is a great massage shop. The staff are focused,  experienced, and friendly. I got the oil massage, and my wife got the thai massage. Both of us were happy with our choices, and each had a great experience that got deep into our muscle aches and pains.

reviews.name: Bee Hartwell
reviews.text:

Their treatment left me with such feelings of joy, gratitude and good will for the extremely respectful, attuned and kind way they took great care of me.

Takki is really great at Thai massage too and she adjusts pressure regularly during the masaage will be back!

reviews.name: Miri Pour
reviews.text:
I had two very very good massages here. I tried around different 20 massage places in CM in the last 6 months and this was definitely the best.  The owner and the staff are very helpful and friendly and there is always someone there who speaks fluent English and can translate if needed. The massages I got seemed to really follow a concept and not just fill the time with some random touches. She had good pressure on her fingers from the beginning to the end and at the same time never caused me pain. This was the first time I tipped someone in Thailand.
My favorite massage was the back, head & feet. I can truly recommend this place to everyone looking for a great massage in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: eva erhardt
reviews.text: the best massage i’ve ever had! backpacking thailand and i’ve received many massages during my time here. this one is by FARRR the best. not sponsored or asked to review, just wanted to spread the word 😩 get it now

reviews.name: Adrian Planterose
reviews.text:
I can only describe my experience here as outstanding.
I will be honest and say that I was an “accidental” customer here. The (highly reviewed on Google) place I tried first in Chiang Mai (no names mentioned - but it’s the opposite of short), was almost twice the price as Lull and Chill for what would be best described as a lacklustre massage.
My next choice was the next most convenient location to my hotel that was also highly reviewed on Google - except that was a walk in - the first appointment they could offer me when I asked at 8.30 in the evening involved waiting for another hour until 9.30. That’s a “No” then when there are so many other choices.
I very nearly walked back to my hotel - but instead walked the other way down the road and found Lull and Chill. I don’t know why - but the name (more about that later) almost put me off - but I decided to give it a go.
Best choice of my two weeks to this point of my time in Thailand.
This is when I met a tiny little powerhouse called Paula. How someone so little is so strong I do not know.
The best part is that she will focus on the areas that you want her to. She has the sensitivity in her fingers to find all the knots, and gently (or not so gently - the key thing is that it’s your choice - she will listen to what you tell her).
It was all a little bit of Heaven for an hour.
So good - I went back the next day for an action replay - and based on the day before - she was like a laser guided missile heading straight for the trouble spots. Her elbows and thumbs should come with a government good health warning. The best 400 baht I have spent in Thailand and worthy of a good tip.
Had I not been leaving Chiang Mai later that day - I’d have gone back for a third visit.
Oh - And the name - Lull and Chill?
Just the best ambient music playing in the background to fall asleep to during a massage.
Don’t think twice - if a massage to relax you or ease your aches and pains is what you need without any messing around - just go there…….

Update - travel plans for going home went all wrong - and back in Chiang Mai. You don’t need to guess who I got to give my back, neck and shoulders a work over, do I?

reviews.name: bartyem
reviews.text: After a day-long journey, we visited this massage studio. The lady at the reception greeted us and offered us tea when we arrived and as we were leaving. We were taken to the first floor and seated comfortably. I was attended to by Mr. Chai. He clearly knows what he's doing. Without me having to describe my ailments, he intuitively "sensed" the areas that needed attention. He was very precise and gentle at the same time. I will try to go back there because I am very satisfied!

reviews.text: After having had massages at many places in the past, I found this place to be satisfactory, both in terms of service and cleanliness. They have hot tea and fruit juice. reviews.name: גל מסיל

reviews.text: I was 4 Times in Long massage during my stay in Chiangmai. Fantastic place, friendly people and a great massage - specially back and neck massage!🙂 After this massage I was feeling very light, without stiffness that I had in my neck for a long time. Thank you very much 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Bo Zheng
reviews.text:
It was my first Thai massage arriving in Chiang Mai. Came to this place as it is very close to where I stayed and has good reviews.
The massage itself was ok,nothing impressive or worth special mention.
Place is clean and looks fairly new.
I'd like to bring about an unpleasant experience with the manager/owner: checking on the menu I was interested in "hot oil massage" and posed questions about this, she clearly saw my interest and ended up telling me that she would "offer me HOT oil massage" for the normal price on "oil massage", I took the deal and felt like getting a nice offer.
It was about 10 mins into my massage that I realized there wasn't "cold oil" massage so what I paid for was meant to be HOT oil in any case! That's probably also why I heard a burst of laugh when the manager went in to the masseuses with my order (made a joke with my enthusiasm/lacking of knowledge about HOT oil?)
I confronted her while paying later telling her that she is smart and a good salesperson in doing so and she gave me a wink.
It could be called a benign gesture or a dishonest conduct. Personally I would have much preferred a simple answer as "All the oil massages are hot oil".

reviews.name: Stéphanie Gerbandier
reviews.text: I tried the 30-minute foot massage. I came back the next day for an hour. The welcome was fantastic, with tea at the beginning and tea + cake at the end. The masseuses were very attentive to my requests. I highly recommend it.

reviews.name: jp
reviews.text: My favorite massage place in chiang mai to be honest. The massages were not really painful for me and they managed to release my lower and upper neckpain instantly! Love it! And they are really kind and friendly there with a awsome service :)

reviews.text: Great experiences! We stayed nearby so came here  at the end of our days while in Chiang Mai. reviews.name: Mai-Lan Tran
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed in Chiang Mai last week and had the pleasure of visiting Aree Thai Massage three times in three days! The ladies were massage experts and very pleasant, and great pricing!

Day 1: Aroma Oil massage, you can choose from a few different scents. Hubby chose lavender and I had the rice scent. The massage was relaxing, and though the scent of the oil was not strong during the massage, afterwards our skin had the pleasant smell of the oils.

Day 2: Body Scrub and Hot Oil massage. The scrub was very thorough and needed after hot days exploring the city! The oil was warm and soothed the muscles.

Day 3: Thai Herbal Hot Compress massage. The smell of the herbs was fragrant, and I found the compress very hot whereas my husband said the temperature was just right for him. Great for opening the pores and softening the skin.

reviews.name: Kylie M
reviews.text: After spending a month in Thailand, today we are heading back home, so we had to get one more Thai massage before our long journey. All the places we tried to go to weren't available, but Aree was, and thank goodness they were! One of the best Thai massages I've ever had, and I've had a lot. They really used those elbows haha, worked out all the kinks and knots, and the environment is so peaceful. The massage ladies are very sweet, and give you tea at the end too. Thank you! Will have to come again next time~

We highly recommend Cozy Spa to anyone looking for an outstanding massage experience in Bangkok.

The staff were very welcoming and professional, and my therapist had amazing skills, she knew exactly where to focus and adjusted the pressure perfectly, I had problems in my right upper back for the last three weeks, when I walked out, it felt like they were gone! reviews.name: Razvan Barac
reviews.text:
Disappointing Massage Experience in Bangkok

My partner and I recently visited this massage parlor in Bangkok for a two-hour relaxation package. Unfortunately, our experience was far from relaxing.

About 30 minutes into our session, a venue across the narrow street (only about 2 meters wide) started playing live heavy rock music. The loud noise completely ruined any chance of relaxation. We were not informed about this potential disturbance beforehand, which was frustrating.

The massage itself was underwhelming. We visited on a Tuesday evening at 9:30 PM, and it was clear that the masseuses were inexperienced. Their techniques lacked the proficiency we've experienced at other establishments.

Unlike other massage places we've been to, this parlor required payment upfront. This policy suggests they may have had issues with dissatisfied customers in the past, which is telling.

Overall, the combination of the unexpected noise pollution, inexperienced staff, and questionable payment policy made for a disappointing and stressful experience. I cannot recommend this establishment for those seeking a truly relaxing massage in Bangkok.

reviews.text:
⚠️ DISHONEST SHOP. Would NOT recommend 请避雷 ⚠️

We were a group of 5 deciding between several massage shops in Nimman when a male staff member approached us and convinced us to visit their other branch. The sign outside advertised a 1-hour foot massage for 300 THB, but after arriving we were told it was actually 350 THB as promotion ended.

He promised female therapists and complimentary coconut water, which influenced our decision to choose this shop. However, after 3 of us had already started washing our feet and preparing for the massage, we were suddenly asked whether we would accept male therapists because there were not enough female therapists available. The assurance that all 5 of us could receive massage together with female therapists was one of the main reasons we chose this shop. As a result, 2 of our friends left and went to other shops.

After the massage, we asked about the promised coconut water and were told it was only available if we left a review — a condition that was never mentioned beforehand. When we questioned this, the receptionist became defensive and claimed she would check the CCTV footage, but no footage was ever shown. She then called over the same male staff member, who changed his story and claimed he had informed us from the beginning, which was simply not true.

The massage itself was so mediocre and certainly not worth being pressured into leaving a review for a complimentary drink.

This review is not about coconut water. It is about misleading promises, inconsistent information, and the way customers are treated when they raise legitimate concerns.

This was one of the most disappointing service experiences we had in Chiang Mai. Would NOT recommend this shop and would strongly suggest that tourists look elsewhere, where there are plenty of massage shops nearby.

reviews.name: C.R
reviews.text:
This salon was a truly special place.

Since it is exclusively for women, I felt completely at ease during my visit.

Everything, from the interior design to the smallest accessories, was tastefully arranged and kept very clean.

Before your treatment, you fill out a form describing your preferences and requests. The form is available in either English or Chinese.

You can also take a shower before your treatment if needed. The shower room was stocked with everything you might need, including cotton swabs, cotton pads, soap, toothbrushes, and makeup remover. I could really feel the thoughtful attention to detail that you would expect from a woman-owned salon.

I was very nervous at the beginning of the massage, but my therapist, TOON, was so gentle that I gradually relaxed and was able to enjoy a truly blissful experience.

At one point, I felt a little cold because of the air conditioning, but when I mentioned it, he immediately adjusted the temperature, and I was comfortable for the rest of the session.

Since I do not speak Thai, I had to use a translation app whenever I wanted to communicate something in detail. This sometimes meant interrupting the treatment to use the app.

For this reason, I recommend clearly writing down your preferences and requests on the form beforehand so that the session can proceed smoothly without unnecessary interruptions.

Since this was my first time receiving this type of massage, I did not fully understand my own preferences before the session.

I booked a two-hour session because several reviews recommended it. However, if you have enough time and budget, it may be better to book several one-hour sessions on different days. This would give you time to gradually discover what works best for you.

That does not mean the experience was disappointing. On the contrary, it was a wonderful massage session that helped me become more aware of how my body responded to different sensations.

For me, not having to constantly exchange words with the therapist actually helped sharpen my senses, which made the experience even more meaningful.

I am sure that another session on a different day would lead to even more discoveries.

My stay in Chiang Mai was short, so I was only able to visit once. However, I would definitely return if I had another opportunity to visit Chiang Mai.

One issue was that I wanted to make a reservation through LINE, but the LINE account listed on the website did not appear to exist, so I was unable to contact the salon that way.

I also received a souvenir, which made me very happy. It came in a cute paper bag with the shop’s logo on it. I felt a little scared walking down the street at night carrying this paper bag (I was worried I might run into someone on the street who holds prejudices against women who use this kind of service). If you’re concerned like I was, I recommend bringing a larger bag with you when you visit.

As for LINE, we have checked our contact details but they seem to be update, if there is any issue we'd appreciate if you let us know by direct message.
We also agree with your suggestion for the logo.
We look forward to welcoming you a next time. Be well for now.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

One of the best massage experiences I've had in Thailand!

I booked a 2-hour deep tissue massage, and the therapist was incredibly skilled and professional from start to finish. During the session, I was dealing with a stuffy nose, and she was very attentive, helping me adjust my position so I could breathe more comfortably.

The pressure was excellent, and whenever I asked for a stronger massage, she adjusted it perfectly. You can really tell that the therapist has extensive experience and knows exactly how to target tight muscles and problem areas.

For the entire two hours, I experienced authentic Thai massage techniques combined with deep, effective pressure. I walked out feeling relaxed, refreshed, and much lighter than when I arrived.

If you're looking for a genuine, professional Thai massage, I highly recommend this place. I'll definitely come back on my next trip to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Sarah Goh
reviews.text:
Relax Smile massage was a life saviour to me and my husband!

We booked a massage at Spa Yuko earlier on, but when we arrived on time, Spa Yuko was closed and no one answered our phone call. I was quite upset, especially it was already almost 9pm and most massage parlours would be closing soon. Covid has made massage businesses close much earlier than before as there are really no many tourists in BKK.

Thankfully, Relax Smile, which was just beside Spa Yuko, was still well-lit and open! A very kind lady walked out to see if we need any help. She was not imposing at all. My husband thought, since we were here, let’s just try an hour massage.

Lo and behold. After 10min, we looked at each other and asked if we can extend our massage to 2 hours as the massage was really good. I had foot massage followed by thai massage, while my husband had head, neck, shoulder massage followed by thai massage. We were very glad that we gave Relax Smile a try. The people here are kind and down to earth, which makes us feel very comfortable.

The place is homely and no frills. Although it has no nice decorations, most importantly, it is clean. They keep the prices low but they did not compromise on the service.

If you are tired after walking around Jodd Fairs, you can walk over to Relax Smile to give it a try. The kindness of the locals here is just so awesome. Special thanks to “Meow”, the kind lady who attended to us. We are truly grateful. :)

The absolute best massage place we've been to in Chiang Mai! I had the 90 minute memories massage and the lady who did it was so sweet; gentle but firm and checking in regularly if I was ok.
It was a lovely combination of rhythmic Swedish style massage using oils and some Thai style stretches and movements, starting with the feet and legs and moving on to the back neck and shoulders / arms. Afterwards we were served a large pot of Thai tea and enjoyed relaxing in the beautiful space with the cats. The staff are all really friendly and loving. Wonderful atmosphere great massages. My boyfriend who is physiotherapist said he had the deepest/best head and foot massage he's ever had and he is thorough himself. These people really put love attention and care into their work and you can feel the difference. Worth the slightly higher price than other massage places 🙏 5 ⭐✨

title: Spa Cenvaree
ownerDescription:
The Wellness experience at Centara Grand Central World is taken to new heights with the state-of-the-art facilities on the 26th floor. The award-winning SPA Cenvaree, spread over 1,000 sqm, provides guests with a mini-oasis in the heart of hectic Bangkok. Traditional therapies from Thai and Ayurvedic philosophies combine with modern rejuvenation practices, creating an extensive choice of over 60 treatments that are available from a menu uniquely designed to rejuvenate and reinvigorate the senses. Gift vouchers, spa memberships and beautiful spa retail items are available.

Guests are invited to arrive 30 minutes before their treatment to enjoy the hydro facilities, including steam, sauna and Jacuzzi.

reviews.name: Nora Vale
reviews.text:
My first visit to Cenvaree Spa, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish.

The booking process was smooth and flexible. I called directly, there were plenty of available time slots, and when I asked to move the appointment earlier, the team kindly accommodated the request without hesitation — a small detail that already speaks of high service standards.

We booked a 1-hour relaxing oil massage for two.
Upon arrival, we were warmly welcomed by the reception team, offered warm towels and complimentary tea, and asked to fill in a short wellness form to personalize the treatment (health conditions, focus areas, pressure preferences).

Our private treatment room was spacious, elegant, and beautifully designed:
•	Two massage beds
•	A large private jacuzzi (optional, included within the treatment time)
•	Separate shower and toilet
•	Full amenities with the hotel’s own spa-branded cosmetics

The spa facilities are impressive — multiple themed rooms (including Moroccan-style rooms), a hammam, sauna, hot jacuzzi, and relaxation areas. There is also a refined retail section offering spa products for hair, face, and body.

The massage itself was outstanding.
I chose lemongrass oil, which was gently warmed before application, adding an extra layer of comfort. My therapist, Choepet, was excellent — attentive, intuitive, and professional. She checked the pressure several times and adjusted perfectly. I drifted into sleep twice during the session, which says everything about the quality of the massage.
My partner fell asleep completely — which, frankly, is the best compliment a spa can receive.

After the treatment, we were served a delicious ginger tea with dried fruits, and invited to leave feedback.

Cenvaree Spa delivers a true luxury spa experience — calm, refined, impeccably organized, and deeply relaxing.
Highly recommended for anyone seeking quality, professionalism, and real relaxation in Bangkok.

The price is definitely high, but with the quality of service and overall experience, I’d say it’s worth it.

Dear Khun Pearploy Stp, 

Thank you for your lovely review!  We are very glad you enjoyed the aromatherapy massage.  Your feedback on the pressure is noted, and we have shared it with our team to better tailor future treatments.

We truly value your kind words and are happy to hear you felt the experience was worth it. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

Warm regards,
Spa Cenvaree

reviews.name: Nikita Wong
reviews.text:
My experience at the hotel’s spa on the 26th floor was mixed. The 90-minute full-body massage with therapist Mint was exceptional—relaxing and focused on my tense areas, making it the best massage I’ve ever had. However, the foot massage was average, so I’d recommend choosing the full-body treatment. Complimentary tea and preserved fruits were a nice touch at the end.

On another occasion, two of us had the facial treatment, which was disappointing. We weren’t informed that it excluded extractions or standard facial steaming equipment. For nearly SGD 50, it felt like basic exfoliation and cream application, which seemed misleading. After raising this concern, the hotel duty manager addressed it professionally by offering alternatives.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Nikita Wong,

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed experience with us. We are truly pleased to hear that you enjoyed the full-body massage with therapist Mint—it’s wonderful to know it stood out as one of the best you have ever had.  We will be sure to pass along your kind words to her.

We also appreciate your honest feedback regarding the foot massage and facial treatment.  We are very sorry to hear the facial did not meet your expectations and that the service details were not clearly communicated beforehand.  Your comments are invaluable in helping us improve, and we are glad our Duty Manager was able to address the concern professionally.

Thank you again for your thoughtful review—we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for a more consistently enjoyable spa experience.

Best regards,
Spa Cenvaree

reviews.text:
Wow! Super impressed. I got a Thai and oil mixed massage from La herself and it was amazing, and that’s not something I say often. I’ve had dozens and dozens of massages around Phuket, and this one was certainly amongst the best.

The technique, pressure, and speed were great. She really knows what she’s doing as I could feel her finding knots in my back and working on them until they loosened up. I also appreciate how she asks beforehand whether you like it strong or not.

Next, I loved all of the aromas throughout. The area of the massage table where you put your head smelled really nice, as did the sheets, towels, and oil. There were also a couple of warm towels used throughout (one at the beginning for your feet, and one at the end for your face), which was a nice touch.

On my way out she gave me some suggestions of stretches I could do to help loosen up my back and correct some imbalances in my shoulders. A+ for customer service.

Thank you La! I’ll be back :)

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Before we begin, thank you for your feedback. We will use it to further improve my and my team's work. This isn't our first meeting; this is actually our second visit, and it's during a very busy year-end holiday period. Let me explain further. We are a small shop that provides attentive and caring service at every step. Regarding arrival times, we attend to you according to your arrival time. Before treating you, we always inquire about the location of your pain and discomfort so we can provide the correct and appropriate care. This is something we do and pay close attention to. I am 100% confident that we always provide you with full care and even exceed the allotted time. Inquiring about your pain and discomfort takes at least 15 minutes. We also offer discounts on our services, which you often seek. You want discounts and cheaper prices, but you expect exceptional service and extra time. I had to attend to other clients who needed assistance and support because they couldn't communicate in English like you. Before leaving, I always asked for your permission and informed you of my needs within 10 minutes, not twice as you lied. You also received a lower massage price than other clients, which you shouldn't have been entitled to; the price you paid was already discounted.  We provided you with full care and advice without concealing any information. Secondly, you said you had to wait 45 minutes. When did you actually wait for me for 45 minutes? That's untrue; you're lying to everyone. We consider the time we start working as working hours. The 15 minutes we spent asking about your symptoms and giving advice before starting work haven't even been included in the work time; in fact, we should have deducted that time. Don't lie. I can check the time you arrived and left because we never cheat clients on their time. We provided full care for your muscles for the full duration of the treatment. You spent an hour with an injury you had elsewhere, and we provided full care. You didn't even pay the full price we displayed for deep tissue treatment. Your wife also inquired about the price before you came, and you could stop before the scheduled time. We charged you based on the time you used. We should have charged you for the full time. We are transparent about this. If we didn't treat you like a god or a goddess, we regret not being able to, because everyone who comes to us wants the same care and help they need.  If you knew how to share and thought that everyone was waiting for help, you would share those 10 minutes. And I massaged you for 15 minutes longer than you expected, but you didn't pay me for that. You didn't even think about paying. Tell me the truth, don't lie, because I'm telling the truth in every word. And we are all real masseurs and therapists; none of us are freelancers, which you don't know the truth about. Don't judge based on lies in writing.

title: Lar Thai Massage หล้านวดแผนไทย
subTitle: Lar's Thai Massage หล้านวดแผนไทย
ownerDescription:
A master Thai masseuse with more than three decades of experience, what you won't find at Lar's humble establishment is a long list of treatments in a gimmicky environment, nor will you find a man who seeks to squeeze as many massages into his day to maximize profit.

What you will discover is a generous healer who believes that his skill should remain affordable to those who need it and that in order to do his best work, he must limit himself to a handful of treatments per day.
In a modern Thailand where tourists are so often called into massage parlours only to encounter superficial services at unjustified prices, Lar serves as an inspired professional whose focus remains to share his culture’s healing tradition with those who seek it.

Halfway through, a male client walked into the main room, and that’s when I realised the therapist hadn’t even drawn the curtain, so I had no privacy. They then proceeded to chat loudly throughout the rest of the massage, which completely ruined any chance of relaxing.

To make matters worse, my fiancée had an awkward experience too. While she waited downstairs, I was taken upstairs for my treatment, and both therapists were giggling and whispering in Thai while treating other clients - giving off the very uncomfortable vibe that something inappropriate was going on.

Needless to say, the whole experience was disappointing. There are plenty of great Thai massage places in the area. I’d strongly suggest avoiding this one!

It was an excellent facial massage. After the session, my skin felt so soft, especially after being exposed to the sun at the beach. I could see a clear improvement in my skin right after the massage. I highly recommend this place — I’m very impressed!😍😍

reviews.name: Miriam Marshall
reviews.text:
Hands down best massage place in Chiang Mai. Lovely warm, family vibe here and consistently attentive masseuses who put their heart into each and every massage, even if you're the last customer at night after their long day. I ended up going around 3 evenings a week on average for the 90 minute oil massage (520 baht / leaving a generous tip of 100 - 200bht) because they are generally consistently good and are happy to focus on whatever areas you ask / open to instruction etc (not often, but some can, at times, press in the 'wrong' places when massaging, so I just laugh with them and explain where is better / I've built relationship with them all now, so they know what I like, what to do and not do. Sometimes you can ask for a specific masseuse, but usually it's a walk-in vibe and you get whoever's free. I haven't had a bad massage yet (and I've tried a LOT of places in the city before frequenting this gem). It's not like one of the fancy spas in the city, but more of a quaint traditional family vibe and they keep everything so clean, providing lovely warm Thai tea after. I'm sooo happy I found this place only 6 mins ride from Central Festival so I can scoot home and into my bed after. Sometimes I've paid more in a fancy city spa and honestly haven't had as good a massage as I've had here. Lovely place with genuine, kind-heartee people to build a rapport, tip well as they work hard here - 12hr shifts everyday and always with a smile and deep pressure right to the end, never on their phones etc.
Best massage in Chiang Mai 👌👌👌👌👌✨✨✨✨✨

reviews.text: This is quite a nice massage parlor. I have been here a few times and each time a have a different experience. Sometimes great and sometimes terrible. It's the good ones that make me come back since the prices are fair, and the atmosphere is relaxing. Little overcrowded with noisy tourists sometimes but as I have been here for 2 years, you kind of get used to it. The people need to learn to treat the customers with the gentleness they are looking for when walking in rather than seeing them as a payment after an hour walking through the door. Some of them are quite rough and not attentive at all which ruins the experience completely. Overall, if you are at the bus station having to wait I would recommend but if not, seek a different parlor.

reviews.name: Klvn Kn
reviews.text:
Look no further.  If you live anywhere close to this area and are looking for a proper massage, this is it!   Well-trained staff with excellent skills, and ample parking right outside the shop.  Located within the Star Avenue retail enclave, this is perfect if you need a massage before or after shopping for groceries, or doing any other weekly retail activities here.

I’ve lived in Chiangmai for quite sometime and in different locations and this by far, one of the best massage shops I’ve been. With professional quality at an incredible price, this is definitely the place to go if you happen to be in this area—and I would even say worth a ride all the way here if you’re not in this area.  Just because of the quality and also other things you can do before or after the massage.

Just like with any massage, it is important to communicate with your masseur regarding their applied strength.  If it’s too strong, let them know you want it less strong.

At the time of this review, which is mid-July 2020, the massage is at the incredible price of 200baht/hour for Thai massage, which is incredible for this area, and for this quality.

Highly recommended!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sir, thank you for sharing this so that all future readers can know. The fact that our staff can "refuse" a customer is a sign that we respect our staff as much as we respect our customers, unlike some other shops, which act unethically and force their girls to accept any size and any number, making the girls to be in pain or worse.
We had some customers before with very large size and the girls tried to accommodate them in many, many different ways to make him happy, in the end he still wanted to have it his way but it was too painful for the girl, although she did much more than is standard, and so finally he was still not happy.
So it is much better that the girl announces politely that she may not be capable enough to satisfy him while also safeguarding her own body. This is the respectful thing to do, although it may feel like a rejection to some men at first. But we trust that you now understand.
Our receptionist tried to introduce other girls to you, who may be able to take your size without being in pain, but you didn't want that.
It is good that every prospective customer reads this and realises that this is actually a sign of an ethical and respectful business manner to all involved.
We know that there are some shops which force the girls, you can perhaps get there what you want but it will be at their costs, and we don't do that.
Thank you for understanding.

reviews.name: Ksenius Nonauskas
reviews.text:
Made a booking a couple of days in advance, confirmed the time several times, and upon arrival was invited to wait in a room in another empty building. After that, it was just waiting, waiting, and waiting, until 30+ minutes later I lost patience and decided to leave. As I was leaving the room, the masseuse finally came in, still completely unprepared. However, at this point, there was no mood or time left to wait even longer for her to get ready.

The receptionist’s whole reaction was “oh, sorry,” and she even admitted she was too busy texting other clients to be bothered informing the only client on the premises about the long delay.

Delays happen, but it’s how you deal with the situation. The total lack of communication - ignoring the client who is paying for a premium service and pretending it’s normal - is definitely not the right approach.

To anyone who still decides to try this establishment: come prepared to wait endlessly, and keep in mind that their supermodel photos differ from reality, which likely says something about the rest of their crew as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sir, we apologise for not informing you about the delay. You are entirely right that our receptionist should have informed you once she got the message from the freelancer.
The reason for this is that freelancers do not belong to our shop, we do not train them, we do not monitor them and we do not manage them, they fall under the responsibility of an outcall agent, with whom we cooperate in case a customer is not content with the girls present in our shop and needs to see more faces.
We always inform the customer that these are freelancers and not under our responsibility, however we failed to inform you that we heard that the girl will be late, as can happen with freelancers.
There was a review form of the outcall agent in the empty building where you were waiting and so this review actually belongs to the outcall agent, it does not concern our girls whom we train, who are in time and perform according to our standards.
We once again apologise for failing to be the communication link and we will improve for the future.
Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

A 6-minute walk from buzzing Patong Beach, this low-key hotel on a bustling city street is 8 km from Tiger Kingdom Phuket and 19 km from Wat Chalong temple.
 Featuring tile floors, the airy rooms come with free Wi-Fi and cable TV, as well as minibars and safes; most rooms include balconies or terraces. Upgraded rooms add minifridges, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Room service is available.
 A casual restaurant serves Thai and European fare. There's also a spa offering a fitness room. Parking is available.

reviews.text:
รีวิวจากใจคนเคยปวดหลัง!! เล่นมาหลายที่ แต่ยกให้ Soulfit เป็นอันดับ 1 ในใจ 🧘‍♀️✨

เริ่มเล่นเพราะปวดหลังจากหมอนรองกระดูกปลิ้น พอมาเจอ Soulfit คือประทับใจมาก สตูดิโอสะอาด โทนมินิมอล มีความเป็นส่วนตัว สิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกครบ (มีห้องน้ำ ห้องอาบน้ำ ไดร์เป่าผม) เดินทางสะดวกใกล้ BTS

คลาส Private ได้เล่นกับ ครูเบสท์ ประทับใจที่สุด!! สอนดี เป็นกันเอง คอยจัดท่า และแนะนำการหายใจให้ถูกต้อง เล่นแล้วไม่เจ็บหลังหรือเกร็งผิดจุด แถมมีท่าใหม่ๆให้เล่นตลอด ไม่เบื่อเลย (จริงๆครูท่านอื่นก็สอนดี ใส่ใจมาตรฐานเดียวกันหมดเลยค่ะ ^^)

ใครคิดว่าพิลาทิสเล่นเบาๆ บอกเลยว่าคิดผิด!! เล่นแล้วเหนื่อย ได้เหงื่อ ตอนนี้อาการปวดหลังดีขึ้นเยอะ ร่างกายแข็งแรงขึ้น ใครเป็นออฟฟิศซินโดรมหรือมีปัญหาเรื่องหลัง แนะนำเลยค่ะ 10/10 ไม่หัก!!

ป.ล. แนะนำให้รีบจองคิวล่วงหน้านะคะ คิวครูเบสท์เต็มไวมากกก!!
reviews.textTranslated:
A heartfelt review from someone who used to have back pain!! I've tried many places, but I rank Soulfit as my number 1 favorite 🧘‍♀️✨

I started Pilates because of back pain from a herniated disc. I was very impressed with Soulfit. The studio is clean, minimalist, and private. It has complete amenities (restroom, shower, hair dryer), and is conveniently located near the BTS.

My private class with Instructor Best was the best!! She's a great instructor, friendly, always adjusting my posture and explaining proper breathing techniques. I didn't experience any back pain or tension during the classes. Plus, there were always new exercises to try, so it was never boring! (Actually, the other instructors are also great and maintain the same high standard of teaching ^^)

Anyone who thinks Pilates is easy is wrong!! It's tiring and makes you sweat. My back pain has improved significantly, and I'm stronger. If you have office syndrome or back problems, I highly recommend it. 10/10, no complaints!!

P.S. I recommend booking in advance because Instructor Best's schedule fills up very quickly!!
