reviews.name: P.s
reviews.text: Really impressed with this place! The massage therapist was highly skilled with perfect pressure - found all the right spots and relieved my muscle tension completely. The facility is very clean with a relaxing atmosphere. Staff were friendly and professional, not pushy at all. Convenient parking and reasonable prices for the quality you get.

title: Ark Pai
ownerDescription: Nestled along the tranquil banks of Pai’s river, The Ark is a sanctuary for soulful living, where nature, wellness, and conscious community converge. Wake to birdsong and the gentle flow of water, then step into a day of yoga, healing therapies, and riverside coworking designed for clarity and connection. Our restaurant nourishes body and spirit with vibrant, seasonal dishes, while our thoughtfully crafted accommodations offer rest, renewal, and a deep sense of peace. Whether you're joining a retreat, working remotely, or simply seeking stillness, The Ark welcomes you with seamless check-in and intuitive bookings—your journey begins the moment you arrive.
address: 826 Wiang Tai, Pai District, Mae Hong Son 58130, Thailand
plusCode: 9C2V+93 Pai, Pai District, Mae Hong Son, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text: Ark's neighborhood, mapped for you. From the 2-minute walk to Barbari Bakery to the scooter ride out to Pai Canyon, our interactive guide shows exactly what's nearby and how long it takes to get there. Save it before you arrive — you'll thank yourself later.

reviews.name: Veronika Schreiner
reviews.text: For everyone who is looking for a calm vibe without parties. The facilities are amazing, great sauna, two beautiful yoga spaces (one with a view on the river!). The staff is great - Nat cooked for all of us a dinner and we shared a beautiful evening together, I really appreciated that family vibe. I felt great there!

reviews.name: ASTER
reviews.text: This is my first time to Pai and this is the only hostel I have stayed. But I loved it. The people working there, everyone is so kind and they are willingly to provide you every information of daily activities there. The cleanliness is very good. 👍

reviews.name: Sophie Graves
reviews.text: Supa clean rooms and bathrooms, all brand new. The beds are very comfortable, the mattress is nice and the bunks are very modern. Comforter and nice pillow. Towel included. The ark main building offers drinks, sauna, ice bath and yoga ect classes.

reviews.name: Daniel Kok
reviews.text:
Ark Guesthouse is a beautiful hostel with a very nice and relaxed atmosphere. The common areas are inviting and it’s a great place to unwind and meet other travelers.
One downside was that the shower water was cold.

Additionally, free yoga classes are offered, which is a great idea, but unfortunately they were already full when we arrived, a bit disappointing when you show up in your workout clothes.

It might help to work with a sign-up list in advance so guests know whether there is space available. Overall, a lovely place with a great vibe.

reviews.name: Son Chie
reviews.text:
A 5star + Business.
I'm so grateful to come to the Ark Family.
The place is full of beautiful energy, right next to the vibrant Park of Pai & the peaceful river.
I extended my stay in the lovely hostel. The rooms are clean, full of light & spacious. You can feel the quality everywhere & every detail was thoughtful created.
What many hostels in Thailand lack, this place has a well functioning kitchen & you can choose to take care of your own nutrition.
One of the best for me: Free Classes during the day. The teachers are skilled & create wonderful atmosphere. So far I tried yoga with Courtney & Bhrigu & wow, they are just amazing.
As well I had the pleasure to have a meditation class with Omi, he is a wonderful spirit who really connects with the whole group & create magic moments.
The owners Ami & Fred are super warm-hearted & ultra Inspirational humans. A blessing for Pai ☀️
Thank you a lot, I love you, Sonia Sunshine ☀️

reviews.name: Kristof Van Hecke
reviews.text:
had a wonderful stay at ARK Pai Guesthouse. Everything was very clean and well maintained. from the room to the bathroom, everything felt fresh and carefully looked after.

The place itself is very peaceful and quiet, a true oasis in Pai. Perfect for relaxing and unwinding. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Martina Frank
reviews.text: I really liked my stay at Ark Hostel. It is a bit pricier and further away from the center than other hostels, but that definitely pays off considering the fact that they offer lots of yoga classes (more during the week than on the weekends), sauna, ice baths etc. For me being away from the center was perfect, as I really enjoyed the little park in front of the hostel where I could meditate and do yoga. Also, I rented a motorbike (and would anyone staying in Pai recommend doing so, because it just makes things much easier) and the hostel lies very conveniently for being on the road and has many parking spots. It is very peaceful, clean, modern, the staff is very nice - all in all a very good hostel! ❤️

reviews.name: Inbar Shacham
reviews.text:
This amazing place made my stay in Pai! It’s a lovely quiet area in the centre of Pai which made it a peace from heaven but nearby for me. It’s located next to the river so I love dipping in the river and even just chill here. They offer many amazing classes, workshops and retreat. Also they have new lovely sauna and ice bath. I’m in love with this place! So calming and developing for me.
Recommended for people who want to take care of them selves or just have fun!

reviews.name: Carolina Ortega
reviews.text:
We really loved our stay here. The building where the hostel is located is quite new and modern. We had a private room with a beautiful balcony, which we enjoyed a lot. The beds were very comfortable, and the bathrooms were kept clean. However, the men’s bathroom seemed to have an issue, as it had an odd smell most of the time.
There is also a kitchen—pretty basic, but perfectly fine for preparing breakfast and storing a few things in the fridge.
The building they are constructing behind the hostel already looks very nice, with an absolutely beautiful yoga studio right by the river. The classes were excellent as well; we really liked the teachers. We also enjoyed the sauna and ice bath. It looks like the new building will be amazing once it’s finished.

reviews.name: Ruby Mills
reviews.text: This place is beautiful!! I did Courtney’s morning yoga class, it was amazing, the pace was perfect, gentle start and then totally activating. In the evening I did Lily’s workshop, truly stunning - both sessions I would highly recommend! The place itself is so well done, lovely environment to be in

reviews.name: Albina
reviews.text: Ark is a wonderful place! The people are very friendly, kind and caring. The rooms are beautiful, new and clean. Thank you so much, I'm glad I stayed here ❤️

reviews.name: Larra Bayley
reviews.text: A beautiful, beautiful spot right by the river (you can even hear the water when doing a class or workshop in their river yoga shala!). There's a sauna and ice bath wellness area as well for recovery. Definitely recommend the power yoga and mat pilates classes by Courtney, they will kick your butt in the best way.

reviews.name: Curt McCormac
reviews.text: Very average cold plunge / sauna experience.  The cold tubs were super small, and not temp regulated. Also no circulation so water got grimy. For 200 baht it was fair price though. Didn’t do any classes so can’t comment on that.

reviews.name: sam beeby
reviews.text:
A beautiful hostel, very new and modern vibes. The rooms are gorgeous with comfortable beds and shower that have hot water and great pressure. Can't fault the location and the private rooms are spacious and roomie

For a new hostel it's fantastic

reviews.name: Fly with Lily
reviews.text:
I had such a beautiful experience at Ark.

From the vibrant DJ dance party to the relaxing sauna, every moment felt nourishing and full of good energy. I also joined two voice activation classes, which were truly eye-opening and empowering.

Thank you for creating such a welcoming and inspiring space. I’m grateful for the experience and will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Adam Goh
reviews.text: I attended a yoga class here with Sammi. Beautiful setting on the bank of Pai River, new place as well. Unfortunately ice bath / sauna wasn't operational when I visited, but looks good - hope to visit again when they're up and running!

reviews.name: Sonja Forster
reviews.text: I had a great time at the Arc! In the beginning I thought I would just stay the night and then find something better, but after comparing other options I truly valued the kind and organized service, the cleanliness and the modern and luxuries facilities for an amazing price. Thank you so much for having me!

reviewContext.Rooms: Clean and great curtains that totally block out the sunlight on every bunk bed
reviewContext.Nearby activities: The park with the popular Saturday market is just next to it

reviews.name: 김민영
reviews.text: The Ark has a very welcoming and beautiful vibe. Each morning yoga session held here is incredibly rich and mindful, helping you start the day in a truly beautiful way. Being right next to the river, the place constantly gives you the soothing feeling of being close to water. In addition, there are many great restaurants and cafés nearby, making it an easy and enjoyable place to hang out and connect with others.

reviews.name: Elisabeth Van Lent
reviews.text: Stayed here for 10 days, in the first week after it opened. Everything is brand new. They had a few startup problems with too little water pressure in the shower, but immediately when we let the owner know he took action and 2 days later they had a stronger pump, problem fixed. The owner is very dedicated to make everything work and wants everyone to have the perfect stay, so whenever something was needed we just had to ask and it was done. The bathrooms are spacious and clean with more than enough toilets and showers for the amount of guests. And there is enough water pressure now for all those showers to work at the same time :-) I booked a private room which was spacious and clean. I couldn't here people in the other rooms, but you could hear everything from the hallway. The location is next to the Saturday market which has a great vibe, it's on walking distance (1/2min) from a great bakery and coffee place, and only 4min by scooter (or 15min walk) from walking street, so the location was really great. The building with the common areas like a restaurant, sauna, ice baths, massage rooms, rooms for yoga and other workshops was almost finished but unfortunately not completely finished by the time I was leaving. It was separate from the building with dorms and rooms, which is nice to have a quiet place to pull back to when wanted. I will be back!

reviews.name: Andra Nickerson
reviews.text: What a beautiful place! Incredible views from the yoga shala overlooking the river. The facility is brand new, very clean and well maintained. Offering a range of various workshops, events, sauna & cold plunge, yoga & Pilates classes.. what’s not to love? The Ark is magical and a comfortable place to be. Nearby cafes, restaurants, laundromat, massage parlor; and a local Thai market that’s open seemingly on Tuesday mornings! Great spot overall. Highly recommend.

reviewContext.Rooms: Both the dorm & private rooms are well equipped and comfortable!
reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Luxury, Great view, Quiet, Great value

reviews.name: Kaman Kwok
reviews.text:
They offer a free gift for posting a 5-star review. However I prefer to post an honest review so I decline the free gift.

Friendly service. I reached out with WhatsApp to book appointment in advance. English menu available for the various facial options. The staff is skilled and the facial experience is delightful. I shared the same room with my friend. She chose a different facial and started off with hot stone massage. Her staff made a lot of noise in opening / closing closets, moving the chair etc for quite a long time and it’s very disturbing. I finally voiced up and asked her to restrain the noise she’s making.

The environment is okay - we are aware of the price point however the towels and bed covers in use seem quite old and faded in color. This creates an unpleasant visual impact to question the cleanliness and hygiene of other equipment or tools they use. We will not visit again.

Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts with us. We appreciate your feedback regarding the noise during your treatment and the condition of our linens. We strive to maintain a pleasant and relaxing environment, and we apologize for any disturbances experienced. Your comments are valuable to us, and we will address these concerns to ensure improvements are made. We hope to have the opportunity to serve you better in the future.  

Regards, Vonae Beauty & Korean Facial Spa Asoke BTS

reviews.name: Don Nguyen
reviews.text:
Was in Bangkok for a 4 day business trip. Did my research on this most recent trip (I travel to Bangkok 3-4 times per year) for a good facial and massage place, since I am also a "medical and therapeutic tourist" on business trips because these types of services in the San Francisco Bay Area are expensive and advanced reservations in California are required at the best places. So I decided on Vonae Beauty & Spa. Note: They focus on beauty upkeep and maintenance, so for facials and aesthetic care, this is their specialty and niche.

I arrived at Times Square mall in downtown Bangkok (Sukhumvit area) and took the elevator to the 3rd floor, where Vonae is located. Nice and air-conditioned, and tucked away from the busy and noisy street. Was met by Brian, who worked the front desk. Brian was nice and professional, and offered me an ice-cold drink as I re-confirmed my choice of a 60min facial treatment + 60min Aromatherapy combo package, which was a BARGAIN considering I used to frequent Diora Luxe Spa for over 2 years on past business trips and spending 3500-4000 Thai baht for a 2-hour session there. I stopped going to Diora Luxe due to the way they treated my favorite masseuse there so much that she quit and left. So looking for a new facial and massage replacement, I found it in Vonae. Clean, professional, and they even offered me use of their showers there, which I didn't need since I was staying at Grande Centre Point Terminal 21 which is right across the street. So close.

My facial technician and massage therapist was named "Thae". She was excellent and so skilled at her work/specialty. From starting off with the full body Aromatherapy massage, Thae asked me at least two times whether the pressure was right. This showed that she cared about her work, and most importantly, her customer...ME! After thoroughly giving me a 60min 5-star massage, Thae then performed a 5-star 60min facial session which was so gentle, so skilled, so perfect. This session was on par with my sessions at Diora Luxe when my favorite technician "Fon" was working there. The only difference? At Vonae, the price is HALF. Yep, you guessed it, it only cost me 1700 Baht for the 120min combo package. Remember, at Diora Luxe it cost me routinely 3500 Baht to 4000 Baht. What a bargain VONAE Beauty & Spa is. I will be visiting and repeating at Vonae again on my future business trips to Bangkok. I have found my "go-to" place and best of all, it is in the heart of downtown Sukhumvit.

Khap Khun Krap, Brian & Thae!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are so grateful for your kind review. We hope to service again in your next visiting in BKK. Thanks for sharing your review with us and the community.

We'll be here whenever you're ready for round two — looking forward to seeing you again! Cheers!

reviews.name: Alan Guan
reviews.text:
I wanted to share feedback about my recent experiences at your establishment. Three days ago, I had an exceptional experience with Daisy while receiving Package A. It was truly outstanding, which led me to return today to try Package B.

Unfortunately, Daisy was unavailable, and I was assigned to Jessy. While Jessy was polite and professional, the key part of the service that distinguishes Aloha  was very disappointing - it became the same as other run of the mill places and not "exquisite" at all. She spent less than 5 minutes for what I thought should have taken 20 minutes, and besides rushing through things, there were clearly steps missing. The key part was very mechanical.

If I didn't experience the real deal the first time, I would have thought Aloha is just another so-so place and moved on. I think the consistency of the service delivery could be improved.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Alan,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We truly appreciate your return visit and are delighted to hear that your first experience with Daisy was outstanding!

We’re sorry to hear that your second visit didn’t meet your expectations. Our goal is always to provide an exquisite experience, and we take consistency very seriously. We will certainly review your feedback with our team to ensure every guest receives the level of care and attention that makes Aloha special.

That being said, we’d love the opportunity to make things right for you. Please reach out to us directly so we can better understand your experience and ensure your next visit is nothing short of exceptional.

We look forward to welcoming you again and providing the five-star service we’re known for! 🌿✨

– Aloha Massage Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Phenix
reviews.text:
A good parlour in general. A good bit away from busy streets. Clean environment. One restroom per floor. Services are handled with a certain professional distance. If that's not what you want, gotta go somewhere else.
Karsai and  Chi Nei Tsang are very interesting Massages and the staff is trained to perform them. They are therapeutic and intense, not meant for pleasure. In any case, remember this: The masseuse you picked could, for whatever reason, be an absolutely bad fit for you. In that case, immediately request another girl to take her place. That is company policy and they themselves pin this info in every room. A foul temper can ruin more than just a massage in this kind of business.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sir, thank you for highlighting that, you are entirely right. As a business, we do everything we can to provide the best massage experience to our customers. However, it is still possible that you as a customer don't immediately find the right match with a girl. A girl with silk touch and shy can be a perfect match for one customer, while she can be a bad match for another customer who needs a more talkative girl with firm pressure. Besides that, it is also possible that a girl is not always in good temper, even despite our management, she is a girl after all.
This is exactly why we have the policy that you can change in the beginning, as you will already know within a few minutes when the girl starts to touch you if this is going to work or not.
Nevertheless, we take all feedback seriously to improve our performance. If you had particular bad match with a certain girl, please feel free to tell us in a private message. Thank you.

My masseur was called Alice. She is a slim, beautiful girl with very nice cheek bones!  Very lovely!  Anyway, Alice gave me a very good massage. She worked out all my kinks and knots and left me feeling great!!   I highly recommend Alice, very beautiful and a very good masseuse!!  ♥️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Sir, thank you very much for your compliments to Alice, it means a lot to her. We hope to see you again.

reviews.name: Peter
reviews.text: I just had a wonderful touch massage with Sonya. She’s so cute and really knows what she’s doing. I feel completely relieved and I’m sure I’ll come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Sir, thank you for your compliments about Sonia. We hope to welcome you soon again.

reviews.name: K 85
reviews.text: The massage is absolutely heavenly, top notch service, super clean and discreet! Thanks a lot to Bella❤️❤️❤️ for being such an amazing masseuse, I will come back! :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Sir, thank you for your compliment to Bella. We hope to welcome you again.

reviews.name: YuKin Khoo
reviews.text:
Ning is a counter staff, she is very careful to introduce each massage technique and process in detail, her smile is very friendly and very beautiful.  My masseuse No. 3, Yuyie, patiently explained the benefits of the massage, and was very talkative and beautiful.  Both of them were able to converse in English which gave me an unparalleled massage experience in Chiang Mai.

Highly recommend!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sir, thank you for your compliments to us!
You are so kind to think about our receptionist too! Khun Ning is our very valued staff, without her many customers would be lost in choosing the best option on the menu.
Khun Yuyie (no. 3) is one of our best massage therapists, she is very skilled, patient and puts your interests first.
We look forward to seeing you soon again!

reviews.name: Yogi
reviews.text: If you want a genuine, mind blowing, slow, sensual tantric experience then choose Sandy. She really knows what she's doing. If you can meditate using breath work, the kundalini energy will awaken.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sir, thank you for phrasing what we could not explain. The magic of Sandy is that she is a 'natural', she doesn't know about all these books but she intuitively does wonder.
Hope to see you again.

address: Sunrise beach, Ko Tarutao, Ko Lipe, Satun 91110, Thailand
plusCode: F8Q5+JW Ko Tarutao, Mueang Satun District, Satun, Thailand

reviews.name: Molly W
reviews.text: Could not recommend more! Keira is a brilliant teacher and really worked hard to ensure everyone in the class was catered for – from total beginner to total pro. We did the sunrise class and it was such a beautiful experience. We loved it so much, we went back the next day too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Molly,
Thank you so much for your lovely review,  I’m so glad you enjoyed the sunrise class; it’s such a special time of day to practice. It was a pleasure having you both, and I’m so happy to hear that you felt supported and catered for throughout the class.
It means a lot to me when people decide to return again and again! You’re always very welcome, and I hope our paths cross again on the mat sometime soon 😊

reviews.name: Linh Vuong
reviews.text: I did two lovely sessions with Keira during my stay in Koh Lipe. The first session was the 9:30am physioyoga and the second session was the 6:00am sunrise level 1/2 mixed. Keira is a great teacher, very attentive and supportive. I felt great after and not to mention the perfect location for class. She was really good with providing different options for moves and helped with adjustments. Check her out for yoga if you’re in the area!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Linh, 
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience in my classes. I'm so glad to hear that you "felt great after the class" and that you appreciated the modified variations of the postures that I offered. I hope you can make it back to Lipe again someday. Thank you again🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: CB
reviews.text: I’m a regular at Keirita’s yoga :) The beachfront setting is magical and you can really connect with yourself there with the sound of the ocean and the fresh sea air. Keira is a great teacher - creating a safe, warm space. I love that the classes are mixed levels and there are variations in each asana, allowing everyone - from beginners to more advanced - to practise in a way that feels right. Each asana builds on strong Hatha foundations with touches of Ashtanga and Vinyasa, helping you connect with your breath. Always available for advice, Keira encourages you to be kind to your body and stay present. Thank you, Keira, for the beautiful practice - it always feels like coming home🩵
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you CB for your feedback on my classes. It's a pleasure to have you join me year after year. Looking forward to welcoming you back next year. I'm glad to hear that you feel like my classes are like "coming home" Thank you so much!💜🙏

reviews.name: Theatricalisation Yep
reviews.text: Due to scheduling reasons, we chose the most difficult course for our first class, but neither my friends nor I have studied yoga. Keirita takes great care of us, adjusting and correcting our movements to ensure our safety. After the first class ended, we chose a package of three classes in total, which was even more favorable. The 9:30am class on the second day and the 6am class on the third day were both very comfortable. Personally, I recommend the 6am class. Practicing yoga while watching the sunrise is very healing, and it's a good start to the day.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi guys, thank you so much for sharing your thoughts on you time spent with me over the course of your yoga package. I'm delighted to hear that you appreciated the adjustments and that you feel the physical and mental benefits of your classes with me. I hope you can make it back again to Lipe someday. Thanks again! ☺️🙏

reviews.name: Kaltra Bani
reviews.text: Keira is such a wonderful yoga teacher, her voice is so soothing and she is so accommodating. I took 2 classes with her- sunset and sunrise. It was raining during the sunset so we had our class under a covered area and it was SO NICE with the sound of the rain. Feel well rested and relaxed after her class! Highly recommend for a sunrise or sunset class
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review! It was such a pleasure to have you in my class and for you to return with your mother for a second. I'm really delighted that you both enjoyed the class so much. Really hope that you can make it back again someday. Thanks again for taking the time to share your opinion with others. It is much appreciated! 🙏🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Hich Vee
reviews.text: I really enjoyed Keira’s class. I joined the 9:30 physio yoga and it was great! The yoga sequence was clear especially as I am a beginner and the physio exercises were especially helpful and I noticed a real difference in my lower back. It felt thoughtful and well-paced, not rushed and felt I was in really good hands with Keira!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello H, 
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience in my physioyoga class. I'm delighted to hear that you found the instructions clear and the class well paced and that you feel the benefit in your back. I hope to welcome you back to class again someday soon. Thanks again! 🙏

reviews.name: Alice Allsop
reviews.text: 100% recommend doing yoga with Keirita for anyone staying in Koh Lipe! Me and my partner are beginners and really appreciated how Keirita adapted the stretches for our abilities. Keirita was calming, soothing, professional and super friendly! We did the sunset yoga and loved it so much we came back for a morning yoga too, location is stunning on the beach   😍 thank you so much, we’ll be back! 💛
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Alice, Thank you so much for taking the time to write about your yoga experience in my classes. I'm absolutely delighted to read your thoughtful feedback on both my myself personally and also professionally on my classes. It was an absolute pleasure to have your positive energy in my classes these last couple of days. I really hope to welcome you back someday. Thank you again! 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Tessa Spiers
reviews.text:
I was only able to join this class once on my visit due to scheduling issues, but it was well worth it.
I contacted Keira on fb/ whatsapp before my trip, she was friendly and informative about the island.
The evening class wasn't too difficult for my friend and I. For more advanced yogis, Keira added extra poses to stretch their abilities. There were easier suggestions for mid level yogis and newbies throughout the class. After a day of snorkelling, which Keira helped arrange, this was a great way to stretch and relax my body.  Keira has some offers for those wishing to take multiple classes. I really appreciated her help whilst on the island.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Tessa, for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review of my 5pm class. I’m really happy to hear that you both enjoyed it and found the higher level with the modified options manageable despite your long day of snorkeling beforehand. 
It was my pleasure to give you all the local island information and the arrange your snorkeling trip for you. Thank you again for your lovely feedback. I hope you guys can join again the next time you’re on the island!
Thanks again! 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Kata P.
reviews.text: I can’t express enough how thankful  I am for Keira. She is an amazing yoga teacher with a fantastic personality. Her voice during the class helps to relax and make us feel comfortable. You can try the class if you are a beginner or not she will help you in any case 🥰 I hope I can see you again and maybe next time also can participate in a diving too. Yea, she is also a diving instructor . Isn’t she amazing?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to share your opinion on google. It was a pleasure having you in my classes and yes I hope to welcome you back again next year for more yoga and definitely some scuba diving too. Thanks! 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Emmy Jamet
reviews.text: I absolutely recommend the sunrise class, I went 3 days in a row. Favorite part of the day. The teacher Keirita is amazing and always makes sure to adapt her class to the level and body of each participant that day, whatever your level is you will love it. Can’t recommend enough🫶🏻🌅
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Emmy for your lovely review of my classes! It was a pleasure having you join me these last few days. I hope you will keep up your practice on your return home and I hope to see you back in my classes next year. Safe travels! 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Paula Monchietti
reviews.text: Keira’s yoga class was a beautiful way to start the day. She’s an excellent teacher and the place facing the sea is magnificent. The class is adapted to different levels so that everyone can enjoy it. I highly recommend this experience. Thanks Keira for this special way to start the year!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to share your thoughts on my classes. It was so lovely to meet you and to have you join me in the new year. I'm so happy to hear that you benefitted from my class and appreciated the beautiful view of the sea and beach. Wishing you all the best for the coming year. 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Zaya Lkha
reviews.text:
Absolutely wonderful experience with Kiera.
Her soothing voice alone made me feel relaxed. Couldn’t attend the sunrise yoga session. But the afternoon sessions were equally good. Highlight of the Lipe.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Zaya,
 Thank you so much for taking the time to share your thoughts on my yoga classes. I'm so happy to hear that they made you feel "relaxed" I hope that you can make it back again someday for more yoga and relaxation. Thanks again! 😊

reviews.name: Pirawan Bua-ngam
reviews.text:
So glad I booked the sunrise Yoga sessions with Keira. Her voice, her teaching way and modified version of Yoga poses are superb!

The view is gorgeous and vibes are reall nice. Keira also provides the class at her studio and also the online version ;)

Will defeinitely join her classes again if going back to Lipe ♥️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review.  It was a pleasure having you in my classes and I look forward very much to having you back again soon. Krob Khun Kaaa!!! 🙏🙏🙏😊

reviews.name: Susana Rengifo
reviews.text: Amazing place! I took 3 classes and I loved it! The views and the good vibes that you can feel there are stunning! The level will suit you as she has 3 different times available every day depending on your yoga level so don’t worry about that. You will love it for sure!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Susana,
 thank you so much for sharing your experience in my yoga classes. I'm really delighted to hear that you felt the good vibes and appreciated our gorgeous views of Sunrise beach. It was a pleasure having you attend all my classes. Really hope to welcome you back to class again someday. 🧘‍♀️🙏☺️

reviews.name: Sam Rae
reviews.text: The Yoga sessions are amazing and Keira is very nice and helpful. I would recommend them for people of all ages and ability levels. I took my daughter (16) this morning and she absolutely loved it 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Sam for your recommendation of my yoga classes. It was lovely having you and your family join me these last few days and to hear that they enjoyed  classes too. I'm looking forward to welcoming you all back to class. 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Grace Mackness
reviews.text: If you’re holidaying in Lipe and yoga is your thing, Keira’s yoga classes are an absolute must-try! I really needed some me time, and this was just the thing. If only I’d have tried out her classes earlier on in my stay. Thank you so much, I’ll be back😊🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this lovely review Grace.  It was a pleasure having you join me. 🌿
I’m so happy the classes gave you the me time you were looking for during your stay on Lipe. I only wish we’d found each other earlier in your trip too!

You’re always very welcome back on the mat whenever you return. Until then, keep taking that time for yourself 🙏🏻😊

reviews.name: Dalia Dragota
reviews.text:
Beautiful classes with a lovely view.
Keira is clearly an experienced yoga teacher and the classes are beautiful and adjusted to the student’s needs.
She’s calm and friendly and you’ll absolutely feel welcomed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Dalia, 
Thank you so much for your lovely review of my classes. It's was a pleasure having you join me this last week. I'm so glad that you enjoyed all the classes that you tried and that you appreciated the adjustments.
I really home to welcome you back to my classes again someday. 🙏

reviews.name: Renee Dillon
reviews.text: A wonderful way to start or end your everyday while in Koh Lipe.  A good range of classes from beginner to experienced, in a gorgeous setting, run by the beautiful soul, Keirita 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Renee for your lovely review of my classes and the beautiful pictures that you posted! I'm so happy that you got to try alll my classes also that you enjoyed them all. Looking forward to having you back in class!

reviews.name: Noa Cohen
reviews.text: The yoga classes are amazing! We went to 2 classes of mixed levels, Keirita built them perfectly and made each one different to keep it interesting ✨ highly recommend!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Noa, 
thank you so much for your kind review of my classes. I'm so happy to hear you enjoyed both of them so much. It was so lovely to meet you and I hope to welcome you back to my class again someday. 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Peter Butler
reviews.text:
Keira is a fantastic yoga teacher. Her directions are clear and easy to follow, and she has a very warm and caring presence. The yoga platform is right on the beach, with a nice breeze.

I did the 9:30am class, and as an older man who has not practiced yoga for over 20 years, I found it moderately challenging. However, Keira always provides alternative poses for people who are not regular practitioners.

Thanks Keira!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Peter for sharing your experience in my 9:30am class. I'm please to hear you found my instructions clear and the class moderately challenging and that you appreciated the modified variations too. 
I hope that I can welcome you back again to class again someday. ☺️🙏

title: SALA Spa Choengmon
ownerDescription:
SALA Spa Choengmon is a peaceful sanctuary within SALA Samui Choengmon Beach Resort, devoted to traditional Thai healing in a setting of understated luxury. The spa features four air-conditioned treatment rooms accented with warm teak wood, alongside a signature massage pavilion designed to “float” above a tranquil lotus pond.
At the heart of the experience is the SALA Signature Massage, a distinctive blend of Hawaiian Lomi Lomi, Swedish and Balinese techniques. Whether you are seeking a comprehensive SALA Samui spa package or a focused wellness retreat, our therapists create a refined, minimalist environment designed for complete rejuvenation. Located on the quiet sands of Choeng Mon Beach our luxury spa is open daily from 10.00am - 8.00am
address: Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320, Thailand
plusCode: H3FH+3X Koh Samui, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand

reviews.name: nikita fong
reviews.text:
A Truly Transformative Spa Experience ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

If you are staying at Choengmon Beach and are looking for a world-class spa experience, look no further than Sala Spa— and make sure you ask for Lalah.She is simply exceptional.

On my first visit, I opted for the foot massage with healing bowl package, and it was so deeply relaxing and precisely on point that I drifted off to sleep halfway through — which honestly says it all. I woke up feeling so refreshed that I immediately knew I had to come back for more. 😌

The very next day, I booked a full 3-hour treatment combining an aroma body massage, foot massage and Indian oil head massage. By the time Lalah was done, every last trace of tension in my body had simply melted away. I returned to my room, sank into a deep nap and woke up feeling completely renewed — something I hadn't felt in a long time.

Yes, the pricing sits slightly above what you would find at a local spa in town, but in my view it is absolutely worth every baht. The skill, the ambiance, the attentiveness — everything about the experience justifies it. Sala Spa is not just a treat, it is genuinely therapeutic. Highly, highly recommended! 🌿✨

reviews.name: Kelli Velasco
reviews.text:
​My husband and I are currently on our first trip to Thailand, and out of all the places we have visited, this resort is hands down the winner. It is a beautiful, relaxing, and quiet paradise that perfectly balances a family-friendly atmosphere with adult-focused tranquility.

​The Spa Experience
If you stay here, the spa is a total must! We had a couples massage that was incredible, easily the best we've ever had. A huge thank you to our therapists, Lalah and Green, who were both wonderful. Also, a shoutout to Angie at the spa for being such a welcoming and helpful host!

​Management & Service
The service here is top-notch. The Resort Manager, Oom, is absolutely fantastic and ensures everything runs perfectly. The entire staff at the restaurant and across the resort are just as lovely.

​Dining & Amenities
​The Food: The restaurant on-site is so good you could stay there from morning until night. They just updated the menu for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and every meal was delicious. Fluke our waitress was cheerful, poliet, and friendly. The bar also mixes amazing cocktails! ​The Beach: The views are stunning and the beach is right at your doorstep. They have plenty of activities like paddleboarding, kayaking, and other rentals available. ​The Layout: I love that they have a "fun" pool for kids and families while keeping a separate pool for adults to maintain that quiet, relaxing vibe.

​Verdict: We loved it so much that we’ve already decided that when we return, we are skipping the rental and staying in one of the resort villas. We can't wait to come back!

We would highly recommend Kat & Mew to anyone looking for a high-quality massage experience in Koh Samui and would happily come back again.

title: The Bear Fight Club Muay Thai Chiangmai
ownerDescription:
Old school Original Muay Thai Training Style 💯💪🐻
Beginners Muay Thai Training to Advanced

Muay Thai or Thai Boxing is a combat sport that uses stand-up striking along with various clinching techniques. It has its origins in the ancient battlefields of Thailand, where warriors used to fight with their bare hands and feet against armed opponents.

In modern times, Muay Thai has come to be known as the "Art of Eight Limbs" because it uses punches, kicks, elbows and knee strikes.

​

​

Chiang Mai is a beautiful city in Northern Thailand. Formerly known as the "Rose of the North" it was once a major stop along the legendary Silk Road. Today it's a favorite destination for tourits, digital nomads, retirees and expats who are looking to stay

reviews.name: Sophia Falck-Ytter
reviews.text:
Top-tier Muay Thai Gym in a stunning new location!

The Bear Fight Club is an absolute gem and highly recommended! They moved to this new location at the end of 2025 and it shows. The facilities are brand new, spotless and very spacious.

My boyfriend and I have been training Muay Thai for 2.5 years and have lived in Thailand for 6 months now. Having tested many gyms across the country (as well as in Chiang Mai) we can confidently say this is where we feel most at home.

What makes this place special:

1. The Atmosphere: The open-air training area is a lifesaver on hot days, allowing for a great breeze. Plus, training with a view of the surroundings is just beautiful.

2. The Trainers: You are training with living legends here. The Head Coach is a highly successful former fighter who now focuses entirely on coaching, while the other trainers are still active in the ring. They are all incredibly humble and welcoming. Their English is good and one trainer even speaks fluent Chinese!

3. For Women: As a woman, I really appreciate that there are other high-level female practitioners to train with. Training always feels safe and inclusive.

4. The System: A unique feature is that you can choose your own pad holder during group sessions. Since every trainer has a different specialty (e.g. Clinching, Boxing or Technical Footwork), you can really tailor the training to your needs.

5. Facilities & Location: Besides the Muay Thai area, there is a dedicated weight room for strength training. The location is close to the airport and city center, yet the neighborhood is perfect and quiet for a pre-training run.

6. Community Highlight: A huge plus is the community spirit. They even invite you to join the Doi Suthep run together. Conquering the mountain as a team was an absolute highlight for us!

If you’re looking for high-quality training in a modern, breezy environment, this is the place to be!

Khop khun kha for trainieren us and making us feel welcome every day 💜

reviews.name: Rob Bergin
reviews.text: Great Muay Thai gym in a perfect location. My son had several 1-on-1 coaching sessions and he absolutely loved it. A very welcoming place and great value. Highly recommend and we will definitely come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊

reviews.name: Jade Scarfe
reviews.text:
Easily the best and most authentic Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai. I’ve been training at Bear Muay Thai for 8 months, starting out as a beginner and recently having my first fight.

I first dropped in for a class while traveling in Thailand and loved the vibe. As a solo female traveler, I was nervous at first but the coaches super friendly and funny. During my fight camp I felt very safe and supported by both the coaches and the wider club community.

The trainers are all high-level fighters who know how to teach, spending a lot of time to correcting technique and help develop solid technical skills.

Would strongly recommend for both beginners looking to learn authentic Muay Thai or experienced fighters!

reviews.name: Elisabeth Cropper
reviews.text: Training at the Bear Fight club is a next level experience- whether you are a beginner, or a trained fighter looking to enhance your skill. The trainers are considerate of where you are at and will make you feel welcome no matter your experience - but they will PUSH you to the next level. The trainers are highly talented. Watching them will remind you of the true artistry behind Muay Thai. I have been to this gym twice for training vacations or extended stays. Once for 3 weeks of training, another for 1week. If you want to learn, get better, and get into excellent shape - this is the right place for you! Not to mention that the longer you train, the more you see that the culture and tribe of this gym is like a family.

reviews.name: Anne-Marie metzer
reviews.text: Training at The Bear Fight Club has truly been one of the best experiences. For me, it’s without a doubt the best Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai! I recommend it to everyone — the atmosphere feels like family, it’s professional, and there’s always room for fun. I’m going to miss every single one of them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊

reviews.name: Shiv Naranji
reviews.text: I'm wrapping up my time here and heading back home in a few days. I've had a really good experience with everyone. I made some great friends through training. The trainers are experienced. I, as a first time trainee in fighting, was able to learn a lot. Most of my training was with Somyat, especially my pad work. God bless him because he is a great man. I know we shouldn't pick favorites but Somyat was my favorite. He was understanding, patient, focused on technical skills, as well as conditioned me till I couldn't breathe. Expectations fulfilled.

reviews.name: Paul Kim
reviews.text: Amazing gym. Definitely one of the better Muay Thai gyms I’ve been to, classes are 2 hours so they really go over everything. Make sure to come ready to train! 5/5

reviews.name: Alfie Watson
reviews.text:
This Muay Thai gym is truly amazing. As a complete beginner, I immediately felt welcome and was guided through the techniques. The team is exceptionally friendly and dedicated to ensuring you learn the correct form, no matter how much time it takes; they genuinely treat you as one of their own. I opted for the 7-day, two-sessions-a-day package, which I found to be very reasonably priced. While it was challenging, I couldn't find any fault with it. I am now planning to return for a month at the same gym.

My sincere thanks to the entire team for an unforgettable experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🫶🏼🥊💯 Thank you Alfie

reviews.name: Limon
reviews.text:
Hands down the best Muay Thai gym we've trained at in all of Thailand, and we've trained at many over the past 5-6 months. My girlfriend and I have stayed a total of 2-3 months, already returned for a second time, and are planning a third trip specifically to prepare for a fight here. That says everything.

The gym recently moved to a beautiful new location near the airport: open air, green, always breezy, with brand new mats, bags and equipment. There's also onsite accommodation, a lovely café, and the neighborhood is perfect for morning runs. The training follows a classic, authentic Muay Thai structure: proper warmup, shadowboxing and technique building, pad rounds, bag work, daily technical sparring that is always clean and controlled, and solid conditioning. Even as non fighters, we were always invited to join the fighter sessions, that level of inclusion is rare.

What makes this place truly special is the combination of world class coaching and genuine community spirit. Head coach and owner Kru Bank cares deeply about every single student, whether it's your first session or you're preparing for a fight at Rajadamnern. The whole team is exceptional, and manager Fern keeps everything running perfectly. She also films sessions regularly, so you'll often get great shots of your own training.

Hard work, zero ego, constant laughs, and a real family vibe, that makes this place feel like home. We've seen complete beginners transform within weeks. If you are in Chiang Mai, you must check this place out. 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Big Thanks for always support us

reviews.name: Emily Lin
reviews.text: I highly recommend coming to the bear to train if you’re looking for an authentic muay thai experience. Come ready to WORK! Classes are two hours long and challenged my endurance, and refined my technique. All the coaches are friendly and helpful, though they speak limited English. They are beginner friendly but it’s better if you have some basics down first. Shout out to coach Richard and Mor Mor for working with me while I was there!

reviews.name: Peter Solomon
reviews.text: My experience of cooking with Khun Poo today was nothing short of AMAZING! I was certainly fortunate enough to be the only customer today. (Sad for Poo and her team) but the market tour was an eye opener, even for an Asian veteran of 40 years like myself. Poo cares so much about her family, friends and community it’s certainly admirable. She showed so much attention to me and I was so grateful for that. Her expertise and knowledge of how to cook high quality Thai foods is amazing and I’m so honoured to have been able to experience it.

reviews.name: Clay Newman
reviews.text: Great experience with a really sweet crew. The market tour was definitely authentic (not for the squeamish) and everything we made was absolutely delicious. The class wasn't too crowded, and there's AC, tea, and cold water inside. Ends with a bunch of tasty local fruits and desserts. You can see how money from the classes is directly impacting the neighborhood around Poo which is very cool. Bring small bills in case you want to buy snacks at the market, and big bills in case you want to buy souvenirs from Poo.

reviews.name: Josh Andallo
reviews.text: An absolute must! Not only do you get to explore how local Bangkok residents get their fresh food and get to prepare authentic Thai dishes, you help support the local neighbourhood by doing so! A win win for everyone! Khun Poo is a wonderful host and really knows what she is doing!

reviews.name: Dan Quine
reviews.text:
A must do if you are at all interested in Thai cooking. Poo and staff were so welcoming. They gave us a guided tour of the wet market where we purchased ingredients, then we were whisked by their bus to the kitchen where we were given a masterclass in preparing delicious Thai dishes.

The class is in Poo's family home deep in one of Bangkok's poorer neighborhoods. It is a wonderful space which is both intimate and well equipped. Everyone there  was friendly and knowledgeable. We came away having cooked and eaten a world class, four course meal.

Inspiring, fascinating and motivating. I can't recommend this enough.

reviews.name: Tracey Drinkwater
reviews.text:
We had a great experience Cooking with Poo. Loved the trip to the local markets.
Poo and her team were great.
We had a group of 4 booked.
Great recipes of authentic Thai food and the lesson was really easy to follow. Even for those we dont cook much.
A great program and Poo's passion and energy is wonderful.
Best to book direct through their website.
A great experience we can highly recommend. And a bonus is you are supporting local businesses.

reviews.name: Sibongi
reviews.text: A lovely cooking experience in a reasonably sized group. They picked us up at Emporium. We went to the market before heading to the township for the cooking class. Poo and her assistant were hospitable and had good customer care. The food portions were good and offered us desserts at the end.

reviews.name: Claudia aisa sanz
reviews.text: This experience allows you to visit the best market in Bangkok. Full of exotic products you wouldn’t get to see if it wasn’t for Poo. Poo is a great host full of energy and really focused on you enjoying and learning about Thai culture. I highly recommend this activity to improve your cooking skills and have a great time! Will come back!

reviews.name: Val
reviews.text: That’s was the highlight of our trip. Poo is the sweetest, giving and food knowledgable human. She is a true Thai soul representing the hospitality and kindness of her culture. Just book the course and dive into her world!  Poo is an incredible human, that will touch your soul and make you want to be a better human. By doing her cooking course, you’re also support the local community.

reviews.name: Malcolm Gray
reviews.text:
I was invited to join several friends who signed up for this class and I wasn't sure what to expect. However the whole experience was amazing and I highly recommend it.

We met Poo at the designated stop, which was easy to get to. There was a dozen in the group, and from there we went in their van for 10 minute ride to the food market. There we split up into 2 groups to go through the market, one with Poo and one with her helpers.

Poo took us through the market explaining and buying various fruits and vegetables that would be used later in the class. It's a fast paced experience and you definitely want to have on good shoes as it's a "wet" market. After loading up the van we took another 5 minute ride close to their cooking classroom. It's a short walk through a traditional set of Thai homes and the classroom is basically a converted home.

While the classroom is not large it was comfortable for the whole group to site while Poo and her staff quickly prepared things to start the class. The room has AC and a clean toilet and drinks are available.

Poo then started the class. She would show us how to prepare a dish and then divide up into groups to take turns repeating the steps at the front on a large long kitchen table, after which we would eat our dish and repeat the steps. Everything was very well explained and organized with almost military precision and efficiency.

The dishes we did today was Som Tum Green Papaya Salad, Tom Yum Soup with Prawns, and Phad Thai Noodle. All were delicious.

As a bonus at the end she had a large selection of fruits for us to sample, with descriptions of each, plus Mango sticky rice, my favorite.

Overall it was a most enjoyable experience and I highly recommend it.

Only very minor complaint was going through the market, Poo would start explaining about each food before everyone caught up, making it hard to get all the good information. Please try to wait a couple seconds for everyone in the group to catch up. Thank you!

reviews.name: Warren Hsiao
reviews.text: Hands down the most satisfying cooking experience in bangkok. Poo, an internationally renowned thai chef walks you through a hands-on cooking adventure (3-4 courses). Her delightful nature and mastery of thai dishes makes for a wonderful, fun and humbling experience. You will walk away with not only some authentic recipes, but a deeper understanding and appreciation of the thai people.

reviews.name: Rob Blyth
reviews.text:
The highlight of our stay in Thailand! The wet market was a unique experience that I would never have seen without a local guide. I'm happy to avoid cooking with the frogs and bugs we saw there! Highly recommend booking the morning menu for that experience alone. Do make sure you wear shoes that can take a puddle or the occasional escaped catfish flopping over them.
The three dishes we cooked used some of the fresh vegetables bought from the market. They were easy to follow and delicious. Poo and her team are very warm, and it was great to hear the backstory and see the cooking studio next to Poo's childhood home supporting her local community.
Don't eat before you go! You eat each dish as you make it, and it would be a shame to waste such amazing food.

reviews.name: kim dreisenstock
reviews.text: Today myself and my daughters did a cooking class with Poo. We all really enjoyed the experience. It was authentic and delicious. Poo explained recipes and techniques very well. We got to eat the delicious food we made. Highly recommended for a real authentic Thai cooking experience.

reviews.name: Brian Fuerst
reviews.text:
The wet market tour was the highlight for me.  All I wanted to do was buy unfamiliar ingredients and start experimenting.

Poo was a great instructor but any of her staff would have been great.

The best part is she gives back to her community.  That’s why I picked her tour.  She provides scholarships for the local kids.

reviews.name: Belen Gumiel
reviews.text:
Booked a morning cooking class with market visit. We were picked up in a van with air con and taken to a local market, where we walked around while the team bought some ingredients. Market is quite brutal but really interesting to see and the variety on food is incredible.
After a walk around we got back in the van and taken the the cooking school. Poo demonstrated 3 dishes, one at a time, and we each had a chance to cook all 3 and eat what we cooked! They provide containers in case you want to take anything away as it’s so much food.
At the end we were given different fruits bought at the market to try and sticky mango rice. You get given the recipes to take home and can buy the recipe book and some other bits if you like.
An amazing experience, very well organised and super educational. The school isn’t in a touristy area and it’s a good way to see the other side of Bangkok. Poo and her team really support their neighbourhood and other local businesses with the school, such amazing work!

reviews.name: Tiia Vihavainen
reviews.text: Amazing experience at the heart of Bangkok! Food is delicious and there is a lot of it, and Poo and her team are such kind and generous hosts, who not only cook and teach well but also help their neighbors and community but providing jobs and offering food. Warm recommendation.

reviews.name: Maya W
reviews.text:
I had a lovely experience during cooking with Poo and friends :) I enjoyed the market tour which included picking ingredients required for the meal. During the cooking class we made three meals (pad Thai, green curry and beef salad) and we were served mango sticky rice. We also had a chance to try different fruits of Thailand. I would strongly recommend this class - my friends and I greatly enjoyed it. Bonus: tasty food in Air conditioned kitchen 😄🙏🏼
Part of the earnings also goes to supporting other local businesses 👌
Thank you Poo! :)

reviews.name: Simon Turner
reviews.text: Booking through Poo's website was easy. The meet-up at the rendezvous point was punctual and seamless. The market tour was colourful, aromatic and very educational. The cookery demonstration and class was professionally delivered as well as being fun. Poo's helpers in the background ensured everything worked like clockwork. This is must-do experience for anyone visiting Bangkok. In addition, I recommend you buy the beautifully produced book AND definitely do not have breakfast before the class - you will sat handsomely during the class

I recommend this to everyone!!

reviews.name: Saher Khalil
reviews.text:
An Absolute Highlight of Our Phuket Journey!

Our visit to Chef Judy’s Farm and Cooking School was far more than a cooking class—it was an experience that nourished the soul, awakened the senses, and left us with memories we will cherish for years to come.

There were four of us in attendance, and from the moment we arrived, we knew we had discovered something truly special. Chef Judy’s property is nothing short of breathtaking—a thriving oasis of life, abundance, and passion. The farm is beautifully woven together with flourishing organic gardens, fruit trees, fragrant herbs, wandering farm animals, natural spring water flowing through the estate, traditional wicker-making workshop, outdoor cooking stations, a charming restaurant, and boutique hotel accommodation. Every corner reflects a deep respect for nature, sustainability, and the simple beauty of living in harmony with the land. For anyone who loves permaculture, botany, farming, cooking, raw farm culture with a touch of whimsical creativity or simply being immersed in nature, this would be your place to visit.

Yet as remarkable as the surroundings are, the true heart of this experience is Chef Judy herself.

She is the embodiment of what it means to pursue one’s craft with authenticity, dedication, and love. Her passion for Thai cuisine is not merely taught—it radiates through every story she shares, every ingredient she introduces, and every lesson she carefully imparts. She generously guided us through the foundations of traditional Thai cooking, explaining the history, purpose, and balance behind each herb, spice, and flavour profile with extraordinary depth and patience.

Throughout the day, we prepared seven incredible dishes together, each one more delicious than the last. The experience was hands-on, engaging, educational, and endlessly enjoyable. But what made it truly unforgettable was witnessing someone who has dedicated herself wholeheartedly to sharing her knowledge, culture, and gifts with others.

Chef Judy is the kind of person who pours her heart into everything she does. You can feel that every guest who walks through her gates is welcomed not as a customer, but as a friend. Her warmth, kindness, and genuine desire to give the very best of herself shine through in every interaction. She is a beautiful reminder that when someone follows their passion with sincerity and purpose, they create experiences that leave a lasting imprint on the lives of others.

If you find yourself in Phuket, do not miss this extraordinary experience. It is so much more than a cooking class—it is an opportunity to learn from a truly gifted teacher, to connect with nature, and to experience the generosity of a woman who gives so much of herself, her knowledge, and her love to those fortunate enough to visit.

Thank you, Chef Judy, for sharing your world with us. Your passion, generosity, and beautiful spirit made this one of the most memorable experiences of our entire trip.

reviews.name: Murray Johnson
reviews.text:
This is everything you could want from a dream Thai cooking class. A real Thai teacher in a real Thai indoor/outdoor setting. Judy's beautiful kitchen looks out over her organic herb garden where we learnt lots and picked our own ingredients on a pre-cooking stroll of her beautiful rural property in the heart of old Phuket Town. We met her ducks who provided eggs for our pad Thai and her pet water buffalo called Diva! We even picked beautiful fresh homegrown mushrooms from Judy's mushroom shed.
We learned how to crack a coconut in two with a single blow from the back of a hatchet. We drank naturally sweet juice straight from the coconut and learned the difference between these and the regular watery coconuts we all know.
Everything is so aromatic and fresh. Guests have some input in designing each day's unique menu from Judy's extensive repertoire. I chose to make a prawn stirfry with basil and noodles... but the Penang curry, which I had never tried before, turned out to be my favourite. We also made chicken pad Thai and a luscious show-stopping purple sticky rice dessert with fresh mango. The rice is dyed purple by soaking it overnight in water with orchid-like purple "butterfly" pea flowers from Judy's garden. Apparently you can buy the dried purple powder in supermarkets if you know where to look. Another new ingredient, for me, was the luscious coconut flower sugar... which you buy as a paste. It looks a bit like peanut butter, but adds a lovely sweetness to Thai dishes.
Although in Thailand locals can buy freshly-ground curry pastes and coconut milk in plastic bags cheaply at wonderful local markets, we had a go at grinding our own with a mortar and pestle... and making our own coconut milk by hand. It's a lot of work. I think I'll be going back to the cans and blender when I get home... but it was wonderful to see how this amazing cuisine evolved, to understand the raw ingredients, and to give it a go.
After our garden ingredient walk, and a couple of hours of cooking (which flew by) it was time to sit down together and enjoy what we had cooked.
This is as friendly, fun and hands-on educational as it gets.
It's great value too... worth the fee for the amazing meal at the end, so the lessons and fun in the lead-up were all free!
Judy is a national treasure... a wife and Mum of three, restaurateur, chef, teacher, artist, weaver and hotelier! Yes you can stay very affordably on-site in her Nonnita Boutique Resort which would be a super laid-back and relaxing way to plan a few days of live-in Thai cooking classes next time you're in Phuket.
Five Stars. Thanks Judy. See you next time!

 Laid-back, colorful rooms feature flat-screen TVs and minifridges, along with Wi-Fi and en suite wet rooms. Some have balconies with city views.
 There's a spa area offering various types of massage and body scrubs.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member

This means that you are in a short ride to everywhere you need to get to. The staff are very pleasant. My only complete this time was that I was at a room at the back of the hotel on floor seven which meant that I picked up the noise from the nightclubs behind the building next time I will ask for a room over the road.

reviews.name: Eric Gaiti

reviews.name: Alexa Riva Ravina
reviews.text: Third day in a row that I came for a  Massage here as it’s close to my hotel. First night was very good, second a little less so and tonight I had an old lady who basically stabbed me repeatedly with her sharp fingers and after 10 minutes I had to get up and leave because she just wasn’t listening and was actually making my entire body cramp up. When I left, she had told the gentleman at the door something else I assume and when I tried to explain what happened, he just looked at me blankly and I’m not sure he understood me as I was trying to be diplomatic... I wasn’t gonna argue over 1000 baht so I just left but frankly that was the worst massage I have ever had, a very sour end to an otherwise lovely holiday. Would not recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: My apologies that our massager did not understand what you tried to say and made you feel uncomfortable during the massage. 😔  Would it be possible to serve you again with free of charge and change the massager for you? 🥹  We will practice more for our employees who are not good enough in English. reviews.name: Ardi Borova

Totaly recommended , a bit pricy for Thailand but the massage was rly professional!

We picked the one with marijuana oil for 90 minutes and was very well done!
They also made us a tea , and there was a shower when we got out of massage
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for taking the time to review my work. Hopefully we will have the opportunity to serve you again in the future. Bangkok is a great place to visit, I hope you enjoy it and have a great day  😎

reviews.name: Sadhika Nanda
reviews.text:
The first time I went, it was great. A skilled masseuse named Ai. Unfortunately not representative of the establishment.

Went back 2 more times. Second experience - mediocre. Still decided to go a 3rd and last time. This time I wasn’t the only person in the room - really terrible experience. The staff were talking to each other very loudly the whole time, no attention to your comfort. One has been to communal style massage places before - staff and customers both always lower their volume to respect the atmosphere. Didn’t close up the windows/curtains so it was extremely noisy even on the 3rd floor. It’s just a bad experience - and prices are a premium compared to most options. There is no tea, no making you comfortable in your chair and really, they ignore you. Not at ALL worth the premium. You are left feeling less relaxed than before the massage. You’re not missing much if you skip this one.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are sorry that we cannot satisfy you as before. Our massager will be trained to improve their skills. Hopefully we'll be able to serve you again next time if you'll forgive us. We appreciate your feedback. We'll make it better. Thank you very much 🙏🏻🙏🏻

reviews.name: Andrey Kozlov
reviews.text: How wrong I was to check into this hotel after reading good reviews. Do you want the engine-compressor to turn on-off 50 times an hour behind the wall?! And that's true. The administration just throws up their hands and laughs in your face, doesn't want to help! I categorically do not recommend this hotel. I will duplicate the review on Agoda.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We apologize for making you feel not so good about air conditioning that annoys you. On that day, we cancelled your Agoda booking. You received 100% of the money from Agoda. The Front Reception team did their best to accommodate your many requests. I'm so sorry it's not enough for your standard in our small hotel. 🙏🏻🙏🏻

reviews.name: Mjellma Production
reviews.text: Amazing massage, the lady Mona was a professional therapist . I felt really great during the massage . The reception guys not so good, they don’t know to sell the package, but the massage itself was good ! RECOMMEND IT TO EVERYONE !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are very grateful for your review. For the receptionist, I will train him to explain things to customers in a better way. 🙏🏻😊

reviews.name: Tham Y
reviews.text: The only positive to say about this place is the location, the masseuse was not professional, I felt she basically just put oil all over my legs, forget about the techniques because I don’t think they even have procedure of the massage session, because she massaged my left calf but not the right one and massaged my left mid back area but not the right side. Besides of the massage session, this one hour session charged 690baht (I chose cannabis oil so it costed me 790 baht), they didn’t even wash our feet before the session, no hot tea or what so ever given after the session (they finally gave us tea after my boyfriend asked about it). In short, I chose here initially because of the interest of trying cannabis oil but turns out such a bad experience, wasted my time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Our sincerest apologies for making you feel bad and dissatisfied. Next time, we will do it better, and we will also train our massagers to do a better job for every Customer.

reviews.name: Beverley Hurren
reviews.text:
Ideally located for Nana Plaza nightlife if that’s what you are after -which means it can be noisy into the night but I didn’t find it too bad for the few nights I stayed.
The lift is very snug (fits 1 person and a suitcase) and there are stairs up to lobby - please consider those elements if they would be an issue for you.
The room itself was fine for the price and location. I did find the mattress quite firm for my personal preference but besides that, the room was overall clean and comfortable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate your kind words about our rooms. 😊😊 The best part of our hotel is the location, which makes it easy for our guests to go anywhere 24 hours a day. Suitable for foreigners who want to shop, eat, and party in Bangkok's center ♥️♥️

reviews.name: Shahid Muhammad
reviews.text:
In my massage life experience, this is one of the worst massage experiences I had in this place. Believe me, they just rub the oils without any massage treatment.

Waste of money, not recommended at all.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Shahid Muhammad,

Thank you for sharing your feedback regarding your recent visit. We are truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We understand that you were dissatisfied with the oil massage treatment and felt that it did not meet the expected standards. We want to assure you that we take such concerns very seriously.

To address your dissatisfaction, we provided a full refund for the 60-minute massage, despite the service being almost completed (45/60 mins). Our aim was to ensure that you were not financially impacted by the experience. We regret that this gesture did not fully resolve your concerns and that you still felt the service was inadequate.

Your feedback is valuable, and we are currently reviewing our service procedures and staff training to prevent such issues in the future. We strive to deliver high-quality treatments and are committed to improving based on your input.

If there are any additional details you’d like to share or if you have further concerns, please feel free to contact us directly. We appreciate your understanding and hope to have the opportunity to better serve you in the future.

Thank you once again for bringing this to our attention.
128 Room and massage

title: Stayments Massage
ownerDescription:
Discover tranquility and relaxation at Stayments Massage in Nimman, Chiang Mai. Located at 7/2 Suk Kasame Road Soi 6, in the bustling Nimman area, we offer traditional Thai massages, oil massages, foot massages, and head and shoulder massages, all rooted in timeless Thai wellness practices.

After unwinding with our expert massage therapists, enjoy complimentary tea, coffee, or water—a perfect end to your relaxation journey. Prices begin at 300 baht. Experience the essence of Thai relaxation at Stayments Massage, where peace and rejuvenation await you. Join us for a journey back to balance and well-being.
