reviews.name: jilawan metarasit
reviews.text: P’Kae is truly amazing! She’s the only one who helped me recover from not being able to lift my arm properly after years of heavy muscle work. She always finds exactly which muscles are tight or sore, and her treatment is super detailed and effective. I come back to her every year whenever I’m on holiday in Thailand — no one else compares! 💆‍♀️✨

reviews.name: JY. H
reviews.text:
I had a great sport massage here! Ms. Kaekae is a cute and friendly lady :)

I enjoyed the time during massage although it hurts sometimes. ( my problem 😂)

Highly recommend and it would be better if you booking in advance.

Hope to visit soon when I have a chance to visit Chiang Mai again!
Or Kaekae should open a branch in Taiwan ! 😆

reviews.name: Bryan Yeo
reviews.text:
Exceptional massage session by Kae Kae. Highly recommended to book a sports massage/deep tissue here. So good that I had two more 2-hours sessions across the next few days during my stay in Chiang Mai.

Amazing service and targeted massage based on your issues and tightness. Will be back to try out the Office Syndrome massage when I'm here in future. One of the more unique massage techniques by Kae Kae in the area. She truly loves her craft and explains to you your problems and helps relief them during the session.

reviews.name: Jaimie Parzinski
reviews.text:
Today I went for a massage after a week of freediving. My neck muscles were feeling really tight and uncomfortable from all the diving, and I am very glad I visited this place.

Kaekae gave me the massage and she is very, very professional. I have lived here for three years and have tried quite a few massage shops, but she really knows exactly where to work and what muscles need attention.

If you like a strong massage that actually helps, I highly recommend visiting this place. It is not like the other massage shops at all. This is a real gem in Nimman.

They also serve great tea and cookies. Thank you very much. When I find good service, I always come back, so I will definitely see you again soon for my next visit.

Kaekae also gives excellent aftercare advice for your body and muscles, which I really appreciated.

reviews.name: 知味
reviews.text: Taking the overnight bus from Bangkok was exhausting—I didn't sleep a wink all night. But after getting a massage here, I felt instantly rejuvenated. The service was very attentive and the staff were incredibly friendly!

reviews.name: wu sunson
reviews.text: nice people，nice massage，nice tea（with ginger and blue color），nice cookie，I recommend this place strongly！

reviews.name: Yevhenii Bespoiasko
reviews.text: The best massage I’ve ever had! I visited this place during the Chiang Mai by UTMB trail race and the deep tissue massage helped me recover much faster. The massage is strong and intense but extremely effective, you can really feel the difference afterward. Perfect for athletes or anyone needing muscle recovery. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Brandon Fields
reviews.text: I finally got to experience the master Kaekae! have a body that is blessed with aches and constant tension. With hundreds of shops to contend with in Chiang Mae it can be hard to narrow down a choice all the while hoping for a good experience. My intuition when I observed Kaekae in her demeanor and practice told me I should try. The first attempt she was busy and placed me with a male practitioner who was skilled and had good technique; I knew I had found a great, very skillful and hardworking person because her shop was so busy that day and her roster of masseuse was high level. Even every other time I Peeked in for a month she had a full plate. Well Today the 28th of February the last day I will live next to this shop I finally got my chance. With persisting lower back pain and some stiff shoulders I went to see her. At 1pm she was booked. She told me to come back at 4pm. A final lesson to make an appointment. At 4pm my intuition was finally put to the test and was undoubtedly proven right. Kaekae exceeded even what I thought. She has the strength to get in deep and the skill to match. She really is Someone who seems to care about the craft and who is very professional. On top of all that, she maintains a genuinely lovely attitude throughout her demanding day of taking care of so many people while running a busy Shop. My Respect goes to her and her staff!

reviews.name: Kirk Haver
reviews.text: Very good 90 minutes Thai balm/oil from An.  Perfect pressure so it is effective but only a little bit painful.  Nice clean shop and friendly, welcoming owner.  I will definitely be returning for more massages and I highly recommend visiting.  Update:  Visited a total of 7 times and the rest were with the owner KaeKae.  She is amazing and I highly recommend her massage.  Her massage abilities actually put her in the same league as a physical therapist.  She helped multiple issues I was having in the visits I made with her.  She is very kind and cute.  So fun to chat with that 3 hour massages went by quickly.  You won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: M e G a N
reviews.text: The owner is lovely, kaekae gave us lots of ideas for places to explore. The massage was a reasonable price and beautiful, not to firm not to soft. Water on arrival and ginger tea after with cookies. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: robin pirard
reviews.text:
Really good and professional massage in a good and relax atmosphere, the sports massage was really great and I do recommend it with no hesitation
The owner will ask you what you practice and she will adapt the massage for you
She is very good at communicating
Highly recommended place 😇🚀

reviews.name: Cole Storley
reviews.text: If you're looking for an amazing massage in Chiang Mai, Kaekae is the one to go to! She's truly a professional and experienced massage pro. She skillfully found and fixed all the problem areas, leaving me feeling so much better. Highly recommend her!

reviews.name: Michal Pešek
reviews.text:
The massage therapist (and owner) was fantastic. She spoke very good English, was really cheerful/energetic and highly skilled.

The oil massage I received was incredibly relaxing, and she checked several times during the session to make sure I was comfortable, which I really liked since I can sometimes be a bit shy to speak up mid-session.

The place itself was also very nice, clean, and relaxing. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Damian Węglarski
reviews.text:
Kae Kae is the best masseuse in the world. I recommend that place from the bottom of my heart.
She has helped my aching spine like no one else could. Whenever I am in Thailand, I make a special trip to come and see her.

reviews.name: Jay Liu
reviews.text: This is by far the best Thai massage I’ve experienced! The front desk staff and my masseuse KaeKae were incredibly warm and professional, communicating clearly in English throughout my visit. What really sets this place apart is their genuine focus on addressing the root causes of your physical issues, rather than just providing temporary relief like many other massage places. They truly care about helping you heal. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Mika
reviews.text: I visited this place because there weren’t many negative reviews. I got a one-hour Thai massage for 250 Baht, the happy hour price (before 18:00, during the low tourist season in Chiang Mai). The male masseur gave me a great massage. If you're a female traveller and prefer a female masseuse only, that might not always be available. Personally, I didn’t mind the gender of the masseur.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your kind review and looking forward to see you again in the future

reviews.name: James Morrison
reviews.text: Fantastic massage by Kaekae. Very attentive, asking if the pressure was correct, making sure it wasn’t too much. The oils were hand made made for her and the blue tea was delicious. Great experience ☺️

reviews.name: rizzlwizzl
reviews.text: Best massage i have had in thailand. The massage therapist Kaekae is fantastic at sport massage and the price was great, she was able to relive alot of tightness from a previous sporting injury. I will defiantly be back !

reviews.name: Tyler myers
reviews.text:
Last week I got a hot oil massage!

I arrived with a very sore shoulder and Keke fixed it!
Her English is brilliant and she was very good at checking if the pressure was ok for me

I left feeling reset!
I would 100% recommend

reviews.name: Nitin Elavarasu
reviews.text: Kaekae (KK) was an amazing masseuse. Very well informed and was able to answer any questions I had as a first time massage "user" in Thailand. Helped work out some kinks in my hip/leg area that had gotten sore from walking as well as an incredibly in-depth foot and back massage. She also told me after that she didn't even go that strong and I was already at my limit LOL, so any concerns about tight knots/not being able to go as in depth as you may want should be okay. 10/10 and will definitely come back when I am in Chiang Mai again.

title: Santai Muay Thai Gym
ownerDescription:
Muay Thai Training - Muay Thai Camp Chiang Mai

We mean Real Authentic Muay Thai.
Santai Muay Thai Gym in Chiang Mai has a strong team of experienced trainers that teach all levels of students, from beginners to professional fighters. Santai accepts students of all levels, and works them to get them to the next level. Whether you have only been training for a few months, or are out of shape and wanting to start learning Muay Thai, or are already at a fighter level and have been fighting in your home country, you are welcome to improve your Muay Thai at Santai Muay Thai Gym in Chiang Mai.
address: 79, San Kamphaeng, San Kamphaeng District, Chiang Mai 50130, Thailand
plusCode: P4V7+P5 San Kamphaeng, San Kamphaeng District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: anpack20
reviews.text: Stayed here for two weeks! Trained twice a day, and absolutely loved it. Training was awesome, the trainers were very good at their jobs and the pad holding and instruction was excellent. If you want to really experience Muay Thai, and really just forget about everything and train I highly recommend it. Definitely stay at the gym as well…perfect for the train, eat, sleep, train experience…the pool is a nice plus, you’ll need it…as you’ll be sore for sure!

reviews.name: Donny Wittenberg
reviews.text:
Amazing experience at Santai Muay Thai Gym. The training was excellent, and trainer Chai taught me a lot about traditional Muay Thai during my 3-month stay.

My stay at the villa was just as great. John and Noy are such lovely people and really make you feel at home. Noy even taught me how to cook several Thai dishes, which was an unforgettable bonus. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: dumont antoine
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Santai Gym. I originally planned to stay for 4 weeks, but I enjoyed the atmosphere, training, and people so much that I decided to extend my stay by another 3 weeks.

A huge thank you to all the staff and coaches for making me feel welcome from day one. Everyone is professional, friendly, and always ready to help you improve, no matter your level.

Special thanks to Kru Chai for his patience, motivation, and high-quality coaching. Training with him was a great experience and helped me improve a lot during my stay.

The gym has a great vibe, strong team spirit, and excellent training sessions every day. I highly recommend Santai Gym to anyone looking for authentic Muay Thai training in Thailand. I will definitely come back in the future!

reviews.name: Jack Chernauskaa
reviews.text: Great gym and great time! I spent one month here and it was the best month of my life. Made very good connections with all the cool people there and connections with some of the great and very experienced trainers.

reviews.name: Tee Morrissey
reviews.text:
Third time I’ve been here in three years, easiest five stars ever.

Santai is a phenomenal gym.
They have some of the best trainers you’ll have the pleasure of working with. Convenient accomodation options, bike hiring service and much more.

If you’re an absolute beginner or have been training and fighting for years, this place is perfect. Prices are competitive and the value for money is outstanding. I won’t be fighting under any other gym because Santai has it all.

reviews.name: Nico Petrea
reviews.text: It was a great experience I am definitely coming back thank you to all the staff and all the coaches they were all welcoming and kind. The Muay Thai training was amazing and  the coaches were very knowledgeable and skilled. Special shout out to Wut he's a GOAT. Much love Santai Muay Thai ❤️.

reviews.name: Ivanina Atanasova
reviews.text: Amazing gym, very pleasant atmosphere! All the trainers are amazing, very good at what they do. And all of them are seasoned pros with multiple titles underneath their belts. In my opinion, they pay attention to everyone, always willing to help, or show a new technique. I am grateful I have found them, and would recommend Santai gym to anyone, whether beginner or seasoned fighter.

reviews.name: zahir carlie
reviews.text: 100% an Authentic Muay Thai Fight Gym. I say this because when I decided to come Thailand which have thousands of gyms so I did research of the top list of “Authentic Muay Thai Gyms” and in the north Santai was rated 1st. At the time I booked the prices were even discounted so for me I was like I’m all in. I booked a 6-month training package with accommodation and I can tell you that from day one from being picked up at the airport until the end of my 6-months I not only learnt proper Authentic Muay Thai from the original Muay Boran fundamentals, but I also became part of a beautiful Muay Thai Family. Santai is the only gym that brings nationalities with so many historic differences from all around the world and brings them together under the Thailand Flag and connect them through the Beautiful Art of Muay Thai. The trainers are super legit ranging from Rajadamnern champions to current OmNoi Stadium 5-round Muay Thai Fighters to One Championship Fighters which makes this an insane pedigree of trainers who can take you from basic “No Experience” straight into the ring for your first proper 5-round Muay Thai fight! If your willing to put in the work and respect the culture you can achieve great results in the “Art of 8 Limbs”. They are well managed and organized, AupAip is amazing and the gym is clean and hygienic. I rate them the number 1 Muay Thai Gym in Chiang Mai and that’s based on experience from making life long friend to having the honor to fight under the Santai Muay Thai banner! With this review I thank SANTAI MUAY THAI and wish for them extended blessings for their future and may they always remain the humble and beautiful gym that they truly are!!! Khob Khun Krup 🙏🏼💯💪🏼👊🏼🔥❤️

reviews.name: hans kalusche
reviews.text:
We spend an amazing time in Santai Muay Thai Gym in Chiang Mai.
The conditions for our Trainings Camp were perfect.
I can highly recommend it to everyone who loves Muay Thai, to test it.
Greetings from Gradang Gym Springe

reviews.name: Big Bike Culture BBC
reviews.text:
Never experienced Muay Thai and I am not the fans either but I heard this is one of the best Muay Thai training in Chiangmai as the trainer was a champion before and his training skills is amazing so I just come here and check it out , who knows I might join the class one day 😂

Muay Thai Training
At Santai Gym, we have Muay Thai training 2 times per day (morning & afternoon), 6 days per week from Monday to Saturday, with Sunday as a rest day. We focus on teaching Traditional Muay Thai fighting techniques, or as our trainers call it, “Stadium Muay Thai”. Santai accepts all levels of students and fighters to learn Muay Thai here. Every student and fighter has their own weaknesses and strengths, which is why at Santai, we adjust your training in order to help you with your personal needs and goals. Training in Muay Thai consists of technical training, endurance training, and strength training, and we focus on these main principals, with a style! And this gym is close to Boon Homestay San Kamphaeng

reviews.name: Denis Varga
reviews.text:
Perspective: As a beginner (2 months) and a drop in since I'm here for vacation only.

I booked a private session via WhatsApp. When I came in for the training earlier, the trainer was already there waiting for me.

He gave me some time to warm up by myself before the lesson started. After explaining I was a beginner he quickly went through the basics with me. After that we did padwork for the entire lesson which was what I wanted.

It was calmer and more focused on the technique rather than an intensive beasting which is very good!

I enjoyed the experience here and recommend this gym for anyone just wanting to drop in for a training or two.

They even have their own shop with gear or will lend you some if you don't have it. (I brought my gloves and bought the handwraps as a souvenir)

Great training! Thank you! I will visit sometime again.😊

reviews.name: Monifah Kiani
reviews.text:
I learned a lot from the krus here who are all skilled and experienced, especially in regards to clinching. You are corrected on proper technique and have lots of time to practise on the bags. I enjoy how each class begins with a warm up and stretch to properly prepare you. Definitely would love to return!!!

San Kamphaeng is a great area with amazing food places nearby. There is a massage place right next door to the gym as well as the lovely Muay cafe. I stayed in both Baan Nak Muay and Baan Mai - I recommend Baan Mai as it’s close to the gym but quieter. Worthwhile to go to watch fighters from the gym fight if possible!

reviews.name: Camilla Vicente
reviews.text: santai muay thai is an amazing gym with highly trained and professional trainers. I stayed here for five months in total starting as a complete beginner to now having 3 fights undefeated. i came here as a young 19 year old girl and have cried to them, laughed with them and of course hit them ahahah. everyone here from the trainers, management and trainees are so genuine and kind. they really do push you to be your best and genuinely care especially if you show interest in fighting. Peter is the absolute best trainer and dancer you’ll ever meet with so much fun and playful high energy. almost everyone i’ve met at this gym has come back because it’s just that good. i could say so many things about chuy, poye, chai, mee, mek and everyone else, but this review would just be too long. you should come here and meet them for yourself!!! lots of love to everyone here <3

reviews.name: Alex Giang
reviews.text: I had to best experience training at Santai. Coaches are top notch and super friendly. The accommodation arrangements are incredibly homey. It is both convenient and great for community living next to the gym.

reviews.name: Ryan Tumbridge
reviews.text: I first visited santai Muay Thai at the age of 18, on my own and with no experience in any combat sports whatsoever and not knowing a single word of Thai. I stayed for 4 months the first year and 3 months the following year. It was the best thing I’d ever done. From the coaches, to the gym, to the village (San kamphaeng), to the cheap food around ($1 a meal in a restaurant) from the routine and the overall vibe of the place, not forgetting the other travellers you’re also training with, it’s a real community at santai, everyone is welcome. It’s amazing. All levels are welcomed whether you’ve never put a pair of boxing gloves on in your life or you’ve been training for 10+ years, they’re accommodating to everyone. It was so good that I actually decided to start making videos online on TikTok documenting my day to day life living and training at the gym so you can see it for yourself (@ryantumbridge). Shoutouts to poye, chuye, phon, lop, Eib, chai and Ten. Santai for life. I’m coming back.

reviews.name: Rebecca Rooney
reviews.text: I had a fantastic time training at Santai Muay Thai. I trained each day for three months. As a female, I felt safe amongst the students and with the trainers. I would absolutely come back if I am in San Kamphaeng again. Thank you!

reviews.name: Evie Uriarte
reviews.text: Authentic Muay Thai Gym for all levels. I stumbled upon this gym while traveling and it ended in me quitting my job and moving to Thailand to pursue Muay Thai. The coaches are extremely knowledgeable and helpful. They will make sure your technique is getting better every pad session. If you show up to the morning sessions, you will get individual technique adjustments every morning. The community is awesome and I progressed here more in 4 months than it would have taken a year back home. I would highly recommend this gym to anyone who wants to learn authentic Muay Thai.

reviews.name: Tyler D
reviews.text: This gym is incredible I started with little to no experience and after a month stay with only 3 private sessions I feel I have improved so much. 100% I will be back. Thankyou to everyone at team Santai

reviews.name: Julia Bondor
reviews.text: I booked 2 weeks here spontaneously - I was in Thailand and I’ve always wanted to try some sort of martial arts. The schedule with one morning and one afternoon training was pretty intense for me, even in 2 weeks I learned a lot and I feel much more in shape. And mainly, the trainings are fun, the time flies by - I can’t imagine spending 4 hours in a regular gym every day, but with boxing I didn’t even notice how it went by. The trainers are professional and the other foreigners were of many different skill levels. All in all, a really friendly place, and I didn’t expect I would enjoy it this much with no prior experience. I would like to come back in the future.

reviews.name: Jos Weir
reviews.text: Santai will forever be a special place for me! My first fight and camp in Thailand with the most amazing coaches and fellow fighters! The culture at the gym is unmatched. I will for sure be back one day ❤️

title: Rawai Muay Thai

reviews.name: Leon
reviews.text:
Came here as a complete beginner. Not with fear, but with respect. Respect to fail.
Luckily, the trainers taught me the foundations of Muay Thai in such a smooth and guided way that from day one it was fun but challenging right away and I wanted to learn more.
After four weeks I am just grateful that I went here and I'll definitely continue with Muay Thai.
Thanks to the team. Ya'll are absolutely amazing and inspiring people!

Accommodation: Good
Service: Very good
Muay Thai gym: Very good
Little gym attached to it: Good enough for some strength, cardio or mobility on the side
The surrounding area: Perfect. Not much distraction in terms of partying or tourists. Good to relax and be in nature.

I'll definitely come back!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your extensive review, much appreciated. Keep training and hope to see you again.

reviews.name: kozanike
reviews.text:
Top level gym! Can’t recommend enough. Everyone is friendly and you can feel the right atmosphere as soon as you step in on the matt. Looking forward to go back already.
👊💪
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the nice review. Hope to see you again.

reviews.name: Knut Lindekleiv
reviews.text: The trainers at Rawai Muay Thai are very knowledgeable and friendly, making it easy for first-timers like us to follow along. The gym is spacious, clean, and well-organized — a great place to train. We tried our first Muay Thai session and were guided through a light but engaging class that still gave a real sense of achievement. It was a fun workout, especially in the heat, and definitely worth visiting if you want to throw some punches and work up a sweat!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So happy you enjoyed your lesson with us. Thank you for the nice review.

reviews.name: Christian McBride
reviews.text: Fitness and Technique! What a place to come for some amazing workouts and incredible teacher. Everyone’s so passionate and knowledge and the surroundings are great too. I’ve been coming here for 10 years now and wouldn’t go anywhere else!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the nice review and for being such a loyal guest at our camp. We really appreciate it.

reviews.name: Reynaldo Paulinho Arriola
reviews.text:
Stayed a full week over at Rawai Muay Thai in Khao Lak, which was also my very first overseas training camp in Thailand.

Had an excellent experience. From the arrival to the moment of departure, both Diana and Jek arranged everything that was necessary from the airport transfers, the rooms for my lodging, rental of motor bike, taxi for sight-seeing and a shoutout to Siri for sharing with us on where to go about and what to visit also.

People in the village and staff working over at this camp are so warm and cheerful. Some may not be fluent in English but they never fail to greet you with a smile on their faces along with a warm greeting in Thai.

FOOD:
For food there is a short walk of 3-5 minutes from the campsite at a wonderful restaurant called Tik’s restaurant which apparently is the owners name.

They have an extensive menu from western to great Thai food which is undoubtedly the best tasting food so far while being in Rawai itself.

PROVISIONS:
It’s situated directly opposite Tik’s restaurant. You can find all you need for ingredients for cooking, water, beer, desserts and basic necessities.

TRAINING:
The trainers over at the gym are very professional and well natured. They are tough when comes to training. Their classes are never boring, might be similar in certain routine / pad work but at the end of the day,   all of the trainers take pride in their coaching and making sure you leave with improvement.

Although, this camp has many students but every trainer is watching everyone and never fails to spot your weakness and helps to correct you making you do the right thing.

A special shout out to these trainers:
Ajan Boon, Fin, Dawood, Tai, Dom, Wah, Tepwarit, Game, Don and Kob.

I must say that Rawai Muay Thai Khao Lak are blessed to have such dedicated trainers as they are blessed to be in this camp as well.

ROOMS:
Rooms are clean and proper, big comfortable bed, amenities are all in proper working condition, and they have a nice pool for you to cool off after training or to just relax your body when you’re not training.

They have a small in house massage parlar called Aree Massage. Although she is small in built but don’t and never underestimate her hands. I had a few massage sessions with her and it’s all great!

In ending, I didn’t want to leave the camp although I know life must go on. But I cannot recommend one more to go visit this camp while being in Phuket. Authentic Muay Thai training camp, dedicated trainers, comfortable rooms, warm and friendly staff which makes you feel at home, what could one ask for more.

I will definitely return to this camp with my family as it’s perfect for individual and a family retreat.

Thank you so much Rawai Muay Thai @ Khao Lak for giving me such a memorable time training with you! Kap Kun Kap!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a beautiful review and lovely photos. Hope to see you again!

reviews.name: Adi
reviews.text:
Brilliant muay thai gym with a fun and family orientated way towards training.

Diana, Tuk and the trainers have done an amazing job with establishing a friendly environment regardless of fitness level or previous muay thai experience.

I trained here for a month as a total beginner, and really picked up the sport thanks to the team.

The gym is great for:
- Learning muay thai with a respect towards its traditional roots and origins
- Family approach. Local kids and pets sometimes come in to train and say hello. The team celebrate successes and invite trainees for BBQs and events
- Low ego training from both trainers and trainees. Everyone is just here to learn, improve and have a laugh
- Challenging and sweaty sessions that are well capped to your capabilities
- Being in a quieter part of Thailand (away from Phuket partying)

Ps: For post training massages, try Didi Massages. She's a serious expert in her craft, and was a life saver for me.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Adi,
thanks for your kind and beautiful review. We are happy that you enjoyed your stay with us. Good luck on your future endeavors.

reviews.name: Robert Similea
reviews.text: A great experience and a fantastic community. I've been for a training with two boys 15 yo and 16 yo. They loved the training and I was impressed by the school and the people, students, trainers and staff. This is a genuine and pure thai experience that could help you to get a better understanding of local culture. Man, women and kids trained hard and with lot of passion and even a spectator like me found that as a great experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So happy your family enjoyed the trraining. Thank you for the nice review.

reviews.name: Chief Ushup
reviews.text:
Superb Muay Thai Gym In Khao Lak!

One of the first gyms in Phuket, especially for women! The owners were here during our visit, and we loved the story of how they opened this gym to cater to female Muay Thai enthusiasts back in the day when it was more common for only men to learn Muay Thai! We had a blast training here, and my kids were completely safe playing around as we trained! The open-air gym is very spacious and equipped with top-notch equipment. There were large groups during our session, but we received individual attention as we trained- without anyone losing out. The trainers are phenomenal! I would totally recommend this gym to anyone looking to learn Muay Thai in Khao Lak!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the amazing review. Much appreciated. See you again.

reviews.name: Jason Ormesher
reviews.text: Everything about this place is brilliant, the staff, accommodation and training. A real family feel, will definitely be back 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your nice review of the camp. Happy to hear you liked it. 🙏🏼

reviews.name: assaf sternfeld
reviews.text:
I trained at Rawai Muay Thai in Khao Lak and had an outstanding experience. I did a private session with Don, and it was excellent from start to finish. Don is highly professional and very precise in how he teaches. He helped me improve my technique across the board, stance, balance, kicks, punches, and overall movement. We focused on refining details that actually make a difference, and I could genuinely feel the improvement during the session.

The training was so good that I came back for a second session, which says a lot on its own. This is a serious gym with high level coaching, and I will absolutely be back next time I’m in Khao Lak. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the nice review. Glad you enjoyed training with us. Hope to see you again!

reviews.name: מתן סער
reviews.text: Highly recommend this Muay Thai gym! I took a private session with Coach Kop — he’s super professional, motivating, and really knows how to push you while keeping it fun. Amazing experience! 🥊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for training with us and for your nice review.

reviews.name: Jonathan Bertschi
reviews.text: Best training camp I've done in Thailand so far ! Had a great time, all the trainers are hard workers and push you to your limits if that is your wish. They are extremely respectful and fun to train with as well. Hope to come back in the future :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the kind review. I am happy to hear that you enjoyed training with us. Welcome back anytime.

reviews.name: Tolga Canli
reviews.text: The best Muay Thai gym. The atmosphere and the way they treat you is simply fantastic. After the first day, I felt like I was part of the family. They take very good care of you. The training is very interesting and at the same time very intensive. You can learn a lot and you get very good training. 5 stars are definitely not enough. I can only recommend it to everyone. Take the experience with you, and your visit won't be your last. ☺️ See you next time, Rawai Muay Thai Team
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your nice review. Happy you enjoyed training with us 😊

reviews.name: Tuomas Wäinölä
reviews.text: I have been a regular here for 15 years. I come to train, build myself up after a year of work and better my technique. The place is legendary, family run business with a friendly beating heart. I have had so many good teachers here, seen fights, even stayed in the camp for a few weeks. It is always good to come back. There have been spin-offs in the recent years, but this is where you want to go. The original, the best and the nicest location by a longshot. The gym resides smack in the middle of Khao Lak in a peaceful place without outside hassle. Remote enough but easily reached. If you want to train Muay Thai in the level from 0-100, look no further.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for such a wonderful review. Much appreciated. We are grateful for your regular visits. Our camp exists because of people like you who spread the word about us. THANK YOU!

reviews.name: P. T.
reviews.text: Sweet and personal Muay Thai gym with easy going coaches. If you want to get started and get fit - it’s the right gym for you. Less foreigners with combat experience and Many Thais from the local village train also there which makes the experience even better
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the nice review and happy you enjoyed training with us.

reviews.name: Yoni Bason
reviews.text: I booked a week of training and had a wonderful time. Intense training (2 hours in the morning and 2 in the afternoon). I felt like the atmosphere was excellent, especially as the gym is family run. Many of the students fight as well as the trainers. The staff is very experienced and well equipped to teach you from a beginner to advanced level. Highly recommend it
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the nice review. Good luck with your future plans and hope to see you again.

reviews.name: Heather Tran
reviews.text:
Rawai Muay Thai truly feels like our family here in Thailand. This is our second time staying, and each visit just gets better. The accommodations are amazing—clean, comfortable, and perfect for relaxing after training. The trainers are the absolute best, offering world-class instruction with genuine care and encouragement.

One of the biggest highlights is how great it is for families. Our son not only has kids to train with but also a safe, welcoming environment where he can run around and play freely. The entire community here is so warm and inviting—it really feels like home.

The location couldn’t be better, either. It’s close to Memories Beach, which is perfect for surfing and enjoying the ocean when you’re not in the gym.

We honestly can’t say enough good things about this camp. If you’re coming to Thailand to train, relax, or just immerse yourself in Muay Thai culture, this is the place to stay.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your nice review. It makes us happy that you enjoy your stay with us. We look forward to your third visit next year. Hopefully Tyko can have a fight here as well.

reviews.name: louise rocheteau
reviews.text: I spent two weeks in the camp, it was really good. We learned Muay Thai and were able to progress. All the staff are pleasant, the coaches are super nice and caring. I recommend this camp and I would come back. Thanks a lot
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Louise for the nice review. We are happy that you enjoyed training with us.

reviews.name: Florian Richter
reviews.text:
We spent a total of four weeks training at the Rawei Muay Thai Gym and stayed in their accommodation. The trainers were always in a great mood, open to questions, and ready for some fun. The management was also very friendly, helping with any concerns and trying to make everything possible. The training was very diverse and suitable for all levels, so every visitor could take something valuable from it. We had an amazing time and are already looking forward to the next visit!

Thank you so much to all the trainers and staff at the gym!

Best regards,
Jerome, Robin, and Flo
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the great review. Glad you enjoyed training with us. Looking forward to the next visit. Take care.

reviews.name: Christian
reviews.text: Often been in Thailand for Muay Thai Training but this place is unique. We came as a group of ten persons from Germany and lived in the camp. There is nothing to say than amazing !! Thank you Diana and Tuk for building up this wonderful place. All trainers did a great job and we will come back for sure.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your nice review. I'm so happy that the group enjoyed the training and staying in the camp. Hope to see you again!

reviews.text: I’ve had such a great experience at this gym! The facilities are clean and well-maintained, the equipment is great, and the atmosphere is really welcoming. The staff are friendly and helpful, which makes working out feel so much easier and more enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable place to start or continue their fitness journey!

reviews.name: Hadi Hartono
reviews.text:
Chance upon lyft gym from tiktok. Located conveniently from Surasak BTS. Was greeted by the friendly staff including Angelo who helped with the registration for 3 day pass (1400baht) & brief tour of the gym.
What i loved about Lyft is how clean the gym is. The weights area & toilet are incredibly well-maintained.
Equipments are from matrix and there are sufficient equipment for your workouts.
3 power racks including jammer arms & dumbbells up to 40kg. Theres a dedicated glute builder machine for hassle free setup.
Overall,would highly recommend to check this gym out :)

reviews.name: Mica Tuason
reviews.text: Stepped into this gym and instantly felt so motivated to exercise. Staff are kind and the gym provides everything you need from yoga mats to shower essentials. Gym equipment are also placed strategically to have the most comfortable workout.

reviews.name: natnnsh ark
reviews.text: This place is my favorite so far. Newly opened private fitness with professional personal trainer(Yoyo). Clean and not crowded place - such a good environment to workout. Definitely recommended.

reviews.name: Kornrawee Kitnarong
reviews.text: Best gym around Sathorn area. Parking available and is easily accessible via BTS sky train (Exit 2). It’s at Surasak station (only about 5 stations away from Siam). Very friendly staff and trainers. All the machines are very new, clean and well maintained. Most of the time not crowded so I really recommend people who don’t like busy gyms to come visit. All the staff speak English.

reviews.name: jj.701
reviews.text:
New gym just opened right next to BTS Surasak! Open 24 hours, so its super convenient whenever you feel like gotta exercise.

Machines are fully equipped here along with good music playlist, powerful air conditioning. Also the gym provides clean restrooms, shower rooms, and towels.

Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.name: Roy Weber
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at LYFT Gym for a while now and I couldn’t be happier with my choice! The gym is open 24/7 and is super conveniently located just a few steps from BTS Surasak, which makes it very easy to fit workouts into a busy schedule.

The equipment is brand new and there's a great variety of machines. They have plenty of cardio equipment and an excellent dumbbell section. The gym also offers classes with lovely trainers, and the staff are always friendly and welcoming.

Another big advantage is that the gym is always clean and never feels overly crowded, unlike some other gyms I’ve tried in Bangkok.

For me, the biggest plus is the professional and personal atmosphere, especially my personal trainer Mr. Yoyo.
From the very first moment, he was kind, friendly, and professional. He has a lot of experience, speaks great English, and is always willing to explain, demonstrate, and support me throughout my training.

As a foreigner living in Thailand, I explored several gyms around Sathorn and tried different trainers before deciding, and I couldn’t have made a better choice than training with Mr. Yoyo.

I highly recommend LYFT Gym and especially PT Mr. Yoyo.

reviews.name: Asha Ong
reviews.text: Amazing facilities and staff are all super friendly. We got the 3-day pass for THB1400. Equipment is very new and the gym is kept very clean. Bring your own towels!

reviews.name: Aphiwat Wannasuti
reviews.text: This gym has such a good vibe and friendly staff. Everything is brand new and they have all the machines you could need. Having 24/7 access makes it so easy to fit in a workout

reviews.name: Cindy Srinark-on
reviews.text:
Lyft Gym is top-tier! The equipment is modern, diverse, and very clean! very new!
The staff are incredibly friendly and always make you me feel welcome from day one ❤️❤️❤️. Highly recommend Trainer Yoyo and Angelo.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a high-energy gym with a personal touch!

reviews.name: christina matthes
reviews.text: Best gym in Bangkok. Directly across from Surasak BTS. A modern, immaculately clean gym with a wide range of equipment and friendly staff. Very chilled vibe. Highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Sofi
reviews.text: Stumbled upon this GEM of a gym on maps and got a day pass @ 700 thb Jan2026, they also do 3 day 1400thb or 7 day 2100thb. Incredibly clean, broad gym floor, separate studio for stretching, calming vibe and lighting, water machine, sanitiser wipes available, plenty of mats and mirrors, even a Dyson hairdryer. Super polite and lovely staff. Anyone in the area, check it out. They are super new, but they know what they’re doing. I came around 9am and it was very quiet. More people came over the next couple of hours, WHAT A TREAT! Thank you!

reviews.name: Jorge Luis Santovenia II
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at LYFT Gym and honestly, it’s impressive. It’s brand new, super clean and the equipment is top quality. Everything feels fresh and well maintained.

They have a great variety of machines and free weights. The layout is spacious, not crowded, and the atmosphere is motivating.

Definitely one of the best new gyms around. Highly recommend checking it out.

reviews.name: Sbai Boonyarud
reviews.text:
Absolutely a stunning gym. You could really tell the founders put all their heart into making the best gym experience. Facilities and equipment are top notch. Bathroom comes with shampoo, conditioner, even makeup cleanser!

Very convenient being right next to BTS Surasak. Free parking. Great coworking space as well.

Definitely recommend coming to this place at least just for a try.

reviews.name: Skeeter Gaban
reviews.text: Day passes are only during staffed hours FYI. Dumbells go up to 40kg. More a fitness gym then a weight lifting gym tbh.  You can come before 9pm and stay but if you need a 24hr gym or you lift heavy you should go to another gym. Its 21 USD for a day pass.

reviews.name: Justin Haefele
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at LYFT for the past two weeks and have had a very positive experience.

It’s a new gym with all the essential cardio equipment, including treadmills, rowing machines, and a StairMaster. The strength training area is excellent, with three proper power racks suitable for squats, deadlifts, presses, and other compound lifts. There is also a Smith machine, leg press, and a well-equipped dumbbell section that goes up to 40kg.

One standout feature is the dedicated space for sled pushes, bench work, and plyometric training, which makes it ideal for both strength and athletic-style workouts.

The gym is extremely clean, including the bathrooms, and the staff and trainers are welcoming and professional. It has a more focused, niche atmosphere rather than a typical commercial gym feel.

Highly recommended for anyone in the Sathorn area looking for a well-equipped and well-maintained gym.

reviews.name: Auttapon Nuntanawanich
reviews.text: Newly opened gym has a great atmosphere and privacy. It's open 24 hours, the trainers are friendly and polite, the equipment is complete, and the restrooms are clean with high-quality amenities. Recommended 👍👍

reviews.name: Kratib Ch
reviews.text:
Great gym with excellent facilities and a very clean environment.
Trainer Yoyo is highly professional, attentive, and really understands how to tailor each session to your goals.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for qualified trainers!

reviews.name: Nanthiya T.
reviews.text:
Premium quality equipment.

title: Elite Fight Club
ownerDescription:
Welcome to the official fan page of the Elite Fight Club Gym. Combining a convenient location with an extensive array of state-of-the-art facilities and professional trainers, our luxury gym is the ideal facility in downtown Bangkok for professional martial arts training or just for keeping yourself fighting fit.

Elite Fight Club is a well-equipped, modern gym located on the 10th floor of an upscale condominium complex overlooking the affluent Thonglor and Phrom Pong areas of Sukhumvit Road in central Bangkok. With its central location, the gym is easily accessible, both by road and skytrain.
address: 758/22 วอเตอร์ไดมอนด์ ทาวเวอร์ Sukhumvit 30/1 Alley, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: DJ Fuzz
reviews.text:
Elite Fight Club Bangkok is an outstanding Muay Thai gym that offers authentic training with a unique twist. The Muay Thai sessions here follow the traditional 2-hour format with all the essential elements - skipping, running, padwork, sparring, and stretching. You get the complete, authentic Thai training experience.

The gym is conveniently located just 700 meters from BTS Phrom Phong station, making it easily accessible for anyone staying in or visiting Bangkok.

What truly sets Elite Fight Club apart from other gyms is the spectacular view. Located on the 10th floor of a building, you can enjoy stunning views of the Bangkok cityscape while training. It's an incredible experience to work out with the city spread out before you - it adds a whole new dimension to your training sessions.

The gym is suitable for all levels, from complete beginners to experienced fighters. A lot of foreigners train here, creating an international, welcoming atmosphere where everyone feels comfortable.

The facilities are excellent with a big locker room and many toilets and shower rooms - no waiting around or cramped spaces. Everything is clean and well-maintained, which makes a huge difference when you're training regularly.

If you want traditional Muay Thai training with world-class facilities and an unforgettable view, Elite Fight Club is the place.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the awesome review, Corey! We're thrilled you enjoyed the Muay Thai and MMA sessions. It’s great to hear you got valuable one-on-one time with our coaches. Hope to see you back in Bangkok for more training! 🥊

reviews.name: Dag Hägglöf
reviews.text: Elite Fight Club in Bangkok is a fantastic Muay Thai gym with an amazing atmosphere. The training is solid and professional, making it a great place for both beginners and experienced fighters. One of the standout features is the incredible view — training here feels special thanks to the scenery around the gym. The pool is also beautiful and perfect for cooling down after a tough session. A special mention to the boxing coach, Joe Varden, who was excellent: knowledgeable, motivating, and very attentive to technique. Overall, a great place to train if you’re in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Glad you enjoyed, see you soon!

reviews.name: Nasser Al-Naama
reviews.text:
Elite Fight Club is clearly a well-established gym, and I can understand why it has strong reviews. I did my due diligence before going, especially because they also offer DTV visa-related training packages, which naturally comes with a bigger financial commitment. I wanted to try it properly before making any decision, and I’m glad I did.
The staff were gracious, patient, and honest with me. I spoke with someone from their management side who was very forthcoming about what they could and couldn’t offer, and I appreciated that. There was no hard sell, which I respect.
That said, the gym itself wasn’t quite what I needed. The building and interior felt older than expected, and the atmosphere didn’t feel particularly bright or inviting to me. It has a functional, established feel, but not necessarily the kind of environment that makes you feel immediately held or guided.
I joined a drop-in Muay Thai class and quickly realized it wasn’t the right fit for me as a beginner. This may not be an issue for more experienced students, but I found myself quite lost at points. The language barrier made it harder to understand the instructions, and the class didn’t really slow down enough for someone who needs more explanation, repetition, and hands-on guidance. One trainer did notice I was struggling and tried to help, which I genuinely appreciated, but overall the structure still felt more suited to people who can already follow the rhythm.
For someone neurodivergent, or anyone who needs clearer instruction, more patience, and a more personalized approach, I’d be cautious. This is not really a place that functions like a mentorship or wellness-oriented training environment. It’s a fight gym, and there’s a difference.
I don’t think Elite is bad. In fact, it’s probably very good for the right person. But after trying it, I realized I need something smaller, more attentive, and more emotionally intelligent in how it introduces beginners to Muay Thai. I’m glad I didn’t commit impulsively. For me, it was a useful visit, but not the right place to continue.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Nasser, thanks for your detailed feedback! We're glad you found the staff helpful, but we’re sorry to hear the gym atmosphere and class structure didn’t meet your expectations. If you'd like to discuss this further, please reach out via email. We appreciate your input!

reviews.name: Ras U-Ahk
reviews.text:
The facilities at EFC gym are clean, spacious, and well-equipped. The mats are in excellent condition, making it a safe and comfortable place to train. The gym also offers a variety of equipment for strength training and conditioning, allowing me to supplement my martial arts classes with a well-rounded fitness routine.

The atmosphere at EFC gym is welcoming and inclusive. The staff and fellow members are friendly and supportive, creating a sense of community that makes me excited to come to the gym every day. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced athlete, you will feel at home at EFC gym.

The experience I had in my kickboxing classes at EFC gym was truly exceptional. Each trainer brought their own unique style and expertise to the table, creating a well-rounded and challenging training environment.

"Big Ice" Aunupak's classes were tough but technical. He was always on me about blocking and putting more power into my punches and kicks. His attention to detail and dedication to helping me improve my technique made a significant impact on my progress.

Cubang had a way of making the class fly by with his jokes, but his training left me completely exhausted. I always ended up on the floor after his sessions, mastering new sweep and trip techniques that added depth to my skillset.

The brother duo of Thi and Phi provided a dynamic experience on the pads. Phi pushed me to my limits with intense cardio sessions, while Thi offered in-depth knowledge on strategy and technique that greatly benefited me during sparring sessions.

Overall, the trainers at EFC gym are truly invested in their students' success. They push you to exceed your limits and provide the guidance and support needed to achieve your goals. My experience in their kickboxing classes was truly transformative, and I am grateful for the opportunity to train with such skilled and dedicated professionals. I highly recommend the EFC gym to anyone looking to improve their skills and fitness levels in a supportive and challenging environment. Five stars, without a doubt.

In my BJJ classes, the instructors are top-notch. Coach Miro is a master on the mat, always providing detailed explanations and demonstrations of techniques. He is patient and understanding, making sure to give individual attention to each student. Coach Egor is fierce and pushes us to our limits, never allowing us to settle for mediocrity. Together, they create a dynamic and challenging learning environment that motivates me to improve every session.

One of the standout features of the EFC gym is the welcoming atmosphere created by the other guests. Regardless of your skill level, you will find a supportive community of individuals who are genuinely invested in helping you succeed. This positive and encouraging environment is contagious, and as a new member, you can't help but feel inspired to pay it forward and assist others in their journey towards improvement. The camaraderie and sense of unity among the guests at EFC gym truly set it apart as a place where everyone is valued and supported on their fitness and martial arts journey.

Overall, I can not recommend the EFC gym enough. The quality of instruction, state-of-the-art facilities, and supportive community make it a truly exceptional training center. If you are looking to improve your skills, get in shape, and have fun while doing it, EFC gym is the place to be. Five stars all the way.

Special shout out to boot camp classes they will get you in shape quickly.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re genuinely sorry to hear that your experience didn’t fully meet your expectations.

Regarding the equipment: for hygiene and safety reasons, we strongly encourage all clients to use their own gloves and wraps. As you mentioned, training sessions can get very sweaty, especially in our open-air environment, so shared equipment naturally wears out quickly and may not always feel pleasant to use. This is why most combat sports gyms worldwide recommend personal gear. Affordable options are available on-site and nearby for no more than 300-400 THB, allowing clients to train more comfortably without having the need to borrow other's gears.

We also appreciate your comments about the workout intensity and navigation within the property. Your feedback helps us identify areas where we can improve.

That said, we’re glad you enjoyed the setting and the atmosphere, and we truly appreciate your honest input. We hope you’ll give us another chance in the future, as we’re continuously working to improve both our facilities and overall training experience.

reviews.text:
I started training Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) at Elite Fight Club Bangkok about 4 months ago, and it has been an incredible journey! The gym itself is top-notch—high-quality facilities, very hygienic, and equipped with everything you could possibly need.

All the coaches here are extremely high-level, bringing a wealth of expertise and experience. While I’ve had the chance to learn from several of them, I’ve spent most of my time training BJJ under Danila in the 7am class. His dedication and energy are unmatched. From day one, he put so much effort into helping me improve. He tailored his coaching to my needs and constantly pushed me to get better.

After just one month of training, I competed for the first time and won 2× gold. Since then, I’ve competed every month and consistently taken gold medals. This would never have been possible without Danila’s incredible support, technical knowledge, and motivational coaching.

If you’re looking for a place to start training or take your skills to the next level, Elite Fight Club Bangkok is the place to be. And if you want a coach who will truly invest in your progress, Danila is the one. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: I had an apartment in Phra Khanong that didn't have a comfortable work area so I decided to utilise a co-working space. The very comfortable designer looking office chairs were a huge drawcard  and the internal cafe enabled me to start my morning coffee ritual without leaving the space. title: INNOV8 MMA - Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, & MMA
ownerDescription:
INNOV8 MMA is Bangkok's premier Muay Thai, MMA, and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gym, located on Sukhumvit 93 in Phra Khanong, just minutes from BTS Bang Chak and On Nut.

We offer Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ), Mixed Martial Arts (MMA), and Krav Maga for all levels, from complete beginners to competitive fighters. Our BJJ programme is led by Professor Oswaldo Neto, a 4th-degree black belt and world champion. We are also the only licensed KMG (Krav Maga Global) gym in Thailand.

Train in our 300 sqm facility in Phra Khanong with structured classes, private coaching, and measurable progression. Weights, gym, sauna, and showers included. Drop-ins welcome.

Located in the Peak365 Building with its own entrance.

reviews.name: Rob McCarter
reviews.text:
Fantastic Similan Island liveaboard trip! I was on the Krishna 2 for their six day/five night Similan Islands trip, and it could not have been any better. The boat was super clean, the cabin comfortable, the food delicious, and the diving was amazing.

Aside from world class dives sites, the real standout on the trip was the boat staff. Everyone was friendly, polite, service minded, and safety conscious. Dive guides were phenomenal divers with great awareness who tailored dives to the groups ability and made sure the dives were as safe as they were fun.

Lastly, as a result of the crew the vibe on board was always relaxed. We had a mixed group of passengers: the majority were Thai with a group from Hong Kong and a couple of Americans. Dive briefings were all in English, but many different languages were spoken around the dinner table. A truly special, international dive experience. I strongly recommend DiveMate, and I hope to be booking with them again soon!

If I had one complaint, it would be the trip was so good it has ruined me for any shore based diving in the future. There really is nothing like getting out of the water, handed a hot drink, then stepping immediately into a hot shower followed by either a meal or a delicious, post -dive snack!

reviews.name: Rattanachot Siriwanit
reviews.text:
The boat was clean, spacious, and very well-maintained.
The crew and instructors were incredibly professional, attentive, and made safety their top priority.
We were taken to beautiful dive sites with stunning underwater views.
I highly recommend them for a great and safe diving experience!

reviews.name: Tim Sharood
reviews.text: A fantastic liveaboard  experience! The diving was incredible, we did 15 dives including three night dives we hit some of the best dive spots in the Andaman sea. This was our first time doing a liveabord and I fear we may be spoiled for others. The guides and crew were outstanding! They took care of everything for us including all of our gear between dives. The food was my favorite part besides the diving, but the side trips were a very close second. We had the VIP room which was very spacious and comfy with a queen bed AC and our own bathroom with shower. Coming in and showering between each dive felt great no more being salty between dives! We had a great time and will book again. We already had all our certs but if you don’t you can do open water, advance or nitrox for SSI cert for free, I wish we had known about that we would have been able to do a liveaboard each time for the same cost we spent getting our certs in the US.

reviews.name: Passanan Supat-akanit
reviews.text: This is my first livaboard and it’s been awesome! They provided great service like an actual hotel service and also a great support for diving. The food is delicious and very authentic. The room is actually very comfy with the ensuite toilet/ shower. My dive lead absolutely reliable and he always ensure everyone’s safety. The boat staffs were really nice and took a really good care of us for the diving setup too. I would highly recommend Divemate/ Krishna 3.

reviews.name: Nutthakamon Ngamplung
reviews.text: I had such a great time, everything was so much fun! The dive lead took amazing care of us and made the whole experience feel safe and enjoyable. I also completed my Advanced Open Water certification here, and it was a really smooth and rewarding experience. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking to dive!

reviews.name: Nattika Supboonkerd
reviews.text: Such a great experience on Divemate liveaboard trip. Excellent food , helpful staff , professional dive lead and clean nice boat. Highly recommend to come . It s my first time coming dive on board , we stay in board for 5 days on 4 nights , never disappointed. Don’t forget to eat a lot of Roti !!! It s the best .

reviews.name: Jorge Lázaro Molina
reviews.text:
I just returned from an incredible liveaboard trip to the Similan Islands and Richelieu Rock, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Everything was top-notch from start to finish!
A huge shout-out to our guides—Ta, Itt, and Mint. They were absolutely fantastic! Their knowledge of the dive sites, their ability to spot even the smallest creatures, and their focus on safety made every dive a breeze. They really went above and beyond to make sure we had the best time underwater.
The itinerary was perfect. Diving at Richelieu Rock was a dream come true, and the beauty of the Similans is hard to beat. We also had the chance to visit the Moken village in the Surin Islands, which was a beautiful and eye-opening cultural experience.
Aside from the diving, the life on board was great. The food was excellent—plenty of variety, fresh, and delicious, keeping us fueled for all our dives.
If you are looking for a well-organized trip with a stellar crew and breathtaking dive sites, I highly recommend this liveaboard. Thanks again to Ta, Itt, and Mint for making this trip so special!

reviews.name: Na-Bhattara “Song” Ongwaranon
reviews.text: My first time diving with DiveMate Scuba Diving Club is brilliant! I booked a North Andaman trip with my friend and had a wonderful time on Krishna 3 liveaboard. We were looking for a trip from many diving shops and decided to come with DiveMate. I would say the food is delicious and the cleanliness is good, so my friend and I will definitely book more trips with DiveMate.

reviews.name: Duangchai Songeun
reviews.text: My first liveaboard! The best experience ever. P’ Due is the best instructor! All the staffs are super nice and helpful. The room is clean and comfortable, the food is also delicious. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Gigi Soontornnont
reviews.text:

The boat is well-maintained, spacious, and has lots of communal areas. The crew is friendly and very attentive. Overall, they made my holiday trip something to be forever cherished. Big thanks to the team. Will definitely join the other trips!🩶

reviews.text: Had an amazing trip in Thailand aboard the Krishna 2. Outstanding service, the crew always went above and beyond, and dive sites that truly take your breath away. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: At Divemate Scuba Diving School, I had an incredible experience! The service was outstanding, with friendly and professional staff always ready to assist. reviews.name: Supawit Suksanguan

reviews.name: François DELABIE
reviews.text:
Ask for MINT **** the best and radiant instructor, who sunshined this 3D/4N 11 dives Similan trip onboard Krishna3: great briefings, security check & procedures managed for real, to enjoy great fun dives.
+ We loved Tachai Pinnacle and the 3 dives on Richelieu 10h/14h//17h in great visibility with speed hunters, hundreds of barracudas, big fish, beautiful sorts of moray eels, corals, and lots more.
- We didn’t liked captain’s choice of last 3 dives too close to the arrival Pier (2 dives on a same wreck…that 2/3 of divers didn’t wanted to go again) to facilitate the new group going away the same day 😩 Trip price is for onboard dives, not for too easy costal dives… feeling we missed other better dives.
To improve: average Thaï food all days, cabins a bit overpriced.
Congrats for the Great friendly service of « madam ;) for food, and water/tea just before/after dives 👍🏼
Thanks so much again Mint! 🙏
You were the best by far and we have been lucky to dive with you 🥳

reviews.text: Amazing experience! The dive sites were stunning, with colorful coral and abundant marine life. The instructors were friendly, professional, and made me feel safe at all times!!!!!!!!!!!!!! The boat was comfortable and well organized, and the overall vibe was relaxed and fun.

reviews.text:
Such a lovely dining experience at SCUBA BKK! The food was delicious, especially the seafood!! everything tasted fresh and beautifully prepared. Everything g came very quickly as well!

Loved the atmosphere and interior too, super stylish but still relaxed and comfortable.

Service was attentive and friendly throughout. Definitely a great spot for a nice dinner in Bangkok.

Great location walkable from BTS Ekkamai! Would happily come back! ❤️❤️

reviews.name: Nuchanart Saichompoo
reviews.text:
I went to Scuba BKK in Ekkamai for dinner with a group of friends, and the food was really good, especially the seafood. We ordered several dishes to share, and both the fish and the meat were very well prepared. The ingredients tasted fresh, and everything we ordered was delicious.

I also loved the white wine we had that evening. It was light, fresh and went very well with the seafood. Very easy to drink and perfect for a relaxed dinner with friends.

The night we went happened to have a drag show, so the atmosphere was especially lively. There was also a DJ playing between the shows, which made the evening feel more fun and energetic than a normal dinner.

The restaurant is modern and nicely decorated, but not overly luxurious. It feels relaxed and comfortable, and I think it suits a younger crowd quite well. You can still sit, eat, talk and enjoy the evening without feeling that the place is too formal.

The food is definitely not cheap, but the quality is good. If you order several dishes and wine, the bill can easily be around THB 2,000 or more per person.

I would like to come back and try lunch one day because I imagine the atmosphere would be quite different during the daytime. Dinner was very enjoyable, though, especially with good friends, good seafood, nice wine and a fun show.

Menu is a tad expensive but ingredients are fresh and worth it. Plenty of parking and very pet friendly. Great addition to the must visit places.

A couple of dishes leaned a little salty for my taste, but overall it’s a genuinely enjoyable spot with a good wine selection to complement the meal.

reviews.text:
Think of SCUBA BKK as iODE's trendier sibling — and if you've dined at iODE, you'll know that's a very high bar to clear. This seafood neo-brasserie landed in Ekkamai not far from the BTS, and it's already making serious waves.

The concept is bold: Western-style seafood crafted by a French chef, with ingredients so fresh they arrive still alive — lobsters and king crab imported directly from overseas, swimming in a live tank on-site. It's theatrical, it's impressive, and it absolutely sets the tone for what follows.

The **Horse Mackerel** (฿1,490) was a standout — clean, precise, and beautifully plated. The **Duck Magret** (฿1,690) showed that this kitchen isn't just a one-trick seafood pony. The **Crab Wonton** (฿590) struck the perfect balance between indulgent and refined, while the **Hake & Chips** (฿590) was a clever, elevated nod to the classic. For dessert, the **Île Flottante** (฿350) — a classic French confection, feather-light and melt-in-the-mouth, topped with granola and puffed rice for texture, and gently sweet without being cloying was a wonderful way to close the meal.

**Verdict:**
The atmosphere, the flavours, and the service all hit the mark — nearly every dish impressed. Whether you come for the seafood or you're lured in by the Prime Rib (฿5,250 and worth every baht), SCUBA BKK earns a firm place on the Bangkok dining circuit.

reviews.name: nattawat apisakulchat
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️Food: The food tasted very good overall. The sashimi had a nice balance of sour and salty flavors. The pasta had a distinct clam aroma—fragrant and smooth. As for the appetizer, I’m not exactly sure what it was, but it was delicious.

However, there were still fish bones in the sashimi. For Thai people, finding bones in fish can be considered normal, but personally I expected more careful preparation.

⭐️⭐️Service: I wasn’t very satisfied with the service.

The staff didn’t pay much attention to our table. It took calling them 3–4 times before we could place an order, which might have been because our table was in a corner.

The food service was inconsistent. The appetizer and pasta were served at the same time (which was great), but we had to wait about 30 minutes for the sashimi. Compared to another table that arrived around the same time and ordered similar dishes—but received their food continuously—it made me wonder why our food took so long while others didn’t have to wait as much.

At one point, a staff member was taking an order from the next table and leaned back so far that they bumped into our table while we were eating sashimi (kind of funny, though).

Personally, I expected more attentive and faster service.

reviews.name: Ivor Hunger
reviews.text:
Modern, fun, interesting and quirky restaurant giving providing an enjoyable dining experience.

Cool decor including a huge seafood tank, open kitchen and mezzanine accessed by a spiral staircase.

Full of brushed stainless steel and white tiles, the place is funky, clean and inviting.

Food is very high quality with great taste and presentation served by extremely attentive, professional yet engaging staff.

Chef invited us to try his new addition to the menu that, honestly I was reluctant to try not usually being a fan is gnocchi. However, it was phenomenal and worth going back for. Not hard to fault any dish when made by a very talented culinary team in an amazing open kitchen giving diners a great show.

Very minor negative that is purely subjective and not a deterrent is the music. Although the upbeat modern music is not my style it does, however, fit the style correctly.

(Unfortunately so many photos lost. )

reviews.name: ARTYOS
reviews.text:
First visit at SCUBA BKK – and definitely not the last!

I had my first dinner at SCUBA BKK, a trendy new seafood-focused restaurant that just opened about a month ago. The space is stunning—high ceilings, open kitchen, and a modern industrial vibe with a playful edge. From the moment we walked in, the energy and design really impressed us.

The concept here is all about Mediterranean-inspired seafood, served with a fresh and modern twist. Since it was just the two of us dining, we couldn’t try everything on the menu, but what we had was absolutely delicious.

Looking forward to returning with a group of friends so we can explore more of the menu. SCUBA is a fresh new player in Bangkok’s dining scene and worth keeping an eye on!

reviews.text:
This very unassuming place which I usually wouldn't even have went in, looked so basic...
Where are the comfy massage chairs I asked in my mind?
It does helped that I saw I think 1 or 2 of them were visually impaired, and still decided to give them a try.
And omg... Just had the best ever foot massage in my life!
So the foot massage was done on the bed with me lying down. The techniques used were different... I guess the really traditional style?
Half way thru, I was thinking, can this never end! It's so comfy and somehow hit all the right spots at the same time.
Like most others, there's a 5min being allocated to back and shoulder, which the masseur auntie "cracked" me easily.
No talks, minimum laughters, and just pure good old school Thai massage.
When it ended, I asked how much was it and it's 200baht only. I gave her an additional 50baht as tip, only to realise she might be visually not so good as well. So perhaps this is all done by visually impaired individuals. If so, the more I would think we shd support them!
Not just for the above, but also for how good they actually are!
This is a 10/10! Pls come and support them.

A Truly Authentic Experience – Worth More Than 5 Stars

I cannot express enough how authentic and exceptional this massage was. In a place like Phuket, where so many massages feel commercialized, this was a rare gem—pure skill, heart, and tradition.

Let’s be real: this isn’t the type of place where people usually tip. But if you would leave a generous tip at a high-end spa, ask yourself—shouldn’t true skill and dedication be valued just as much, if not more?

I walked out feeling 5 kilos lighter, deeply refreshed, and beyond grateful for the expertise and care of such a talented masseuse. If you’re searching for a real massage, not just a tourist trap, this is the place.

reviews.text:
Recommended by a friend because it was cheap (150 baht/hour) and near our condo. But it turned out to be one of the best massages I've had since I've been to Thailand. It wasn't a basic Thai massage; they were thorough and careful. I'd just fell down the stairs a few days ago and am badly bruised on the left side and sprained my right wrist so I was afraid they'd hurt me more. I didn't know how to tell them bc I don't speak Thai let alone show them because they were all blind masseuses. I'm not sure if they felt the bumps from my bruises or if they're always careful but it was less painful than I expected. I especially loved the focused head massage in the beginning and the end bc I'd just gotten off a 3.5 hour bus ride with a migraine while trying to get over motion sickness.
Long story short, I HIGHLYYYY recommend this massage if you're okay with a nonfancy facility and limited english speaking blind Thai's massaging you.

I decided to stop learning at this place and here is my review:

1) It’s more like a fun activity not a real cooking class.
2) Studio is a bit dated now, lockers are starting to be broken. Stations have started peeling off.
3) Staff have not changed much since 2019 and some taught the same way which they should have been more improved.
4) People start to film and being a “CONTENT CREATOR” esp in 2023. This disturb me a lot cuz they will put phone/small camera on the shared cooking desk. Filming it, keep adjusting it, also touch up their faces/hairs all the time.
5) No one wears any toque/hat and it’s not provided.   So, my last two classes I have got hairs in my food which were certainly not mine (different color, length, thickness).
6)Menus have not changed much since 2019-2023 while other countries menu look a lot more appealing.

4-6 are my real reasons to stop taking class here. I actually want a fun activity class with higher hygiene and safety standard. Less content creator environment cuz I didn’t want to be one and be in theirs vids/pics too.

reviews.name: Vincent Cloarec
reviews.text:
Boring cooking class.
First of all, if you're a foreigner, just know that the cooking lesson is not in English. They may advertise it as so but the lesson was only in thai. The only advice I got was "stir" "again" "yes" and "no". Don't get me wrong, I'm not blaming the chef at all. She did what she could and was really nice. I'm blaming ABC cooking studio for not planning to get a chef that speaks English when they advertise it as English lessons and know foreigners will be attending.

Then the class in of itself was just plain boring. We get to do the chocolate cake that we prepared for 45 mins. They couldn't really explain me what to do (cause no English) so they just did it for me when it was wrong. So much for a cooking lesson, huh.
Then we had an hour or so of absolutely NOTHING. Just seating at our table firstly while the cake baked (understandable but still you could arrange to get us something to do in the meantime) then  cooling the cake with a fan then they put in the fridge. What do you do then? Again nothing. Then once it's cooled down you get another 10 mins of decorating the cake.

To sum up, 45 mins of "cooking lesson" without any advice whatsoever then 1h of nothing. Worst cooking class I've ever attended. Cake was nice tho.

reviews.text:
If you are thinking about doing a cooking class definitely book a session with We Cook Thai HomeGarden Cooking School! You will get to experience a wonderful time where you experience how to cook authentic Thai cuisine!

My instructor Mam is such a sweet and patient person and answered all my questions (which were many) with a smile on her face! Our tour started with pickup from my hotel, a tour of a local market where I was shown and learned about the ingredients we were going to be using as pointing out local cuisine from the food stands. We then went to her home where I cooked a 5 course meal, got to eat it and then had enough to take home for the next day! After finishing eating she took me back to my hotel, making it one of my favorite experiences in Chiang Mai!

I would recommend for any solo travelers who want to learn how to cook authentic Thai food, have a fun time with a sweet instructor and get your pictures taken while enjoying some delicious food!

There’s also a sauna, steam room, ice bath, and pool — everything was perfectly clean and well maintained.
