reviews.name: Brian Patterson
reviews.text: When I arrived I liked the set up generally. Booked an exfoliating massage and an oil massage together, was okay, not sure my woman had much experience though. Sauna  was roomy and hot and plunge-pool was beautifully cold. But while was in it a guy (the owner I recon) hooked a hose onto the side to top up the plunge-pool!  He left the hose running and aimed straight at me! Surely you top up when no clients are in it?!  Also no toilet paper in gents and most worrying, no wash hand basin! How long has that been the case? That’s a sure way to spread parasites and bacteria. I’d say probably worth a visit if local but there’s a lot of competition and a lot of decent inexpensive saunas in Phuket to choose from.

reviews.name: cheeno chin
reviews.text: It wasn't very relaxing during our visit because it was too noisy. I think they need to implement an age limit, as it tends to feel like a playground. Additionally, adults can't seem to stop chatting in the sauna and steam room at loud volumes, making it easy for everyone to overhear their conversations. The steam room is small, and one corner is too hot to sit in. I even noticed someone shaving in the steam room (lol). Yikes! They could definitely improve the experience by establishing rules on how to behave so clients can enjoy a peaceful and relaxing time. While I understand that THB 200 is a reasonable price, I would be willing to spend more at their restaurant and spa if the establishment were better supervised. I believe their goal is to focus on more than just the THB 200 business. I may consider revisiting if things improve.

reviews.name: Ian Hewitt
reviews.text: Peaceful little escape from the Soi. Cheap entry, fairly good food and friendly service. Couldn't fault it really.

reviews.name: I A
reviews.text:
Mixed experience.
This place can be nice when it’s calm, especially early in the morning. The infrastructure is actually great: a large pool, an ice bath (cold pool), proper changing rooms and showers.

Unfortunately, once it gets busy, the hygiene becomes a real issue. Cleanliness is clearly not well managed. There is no staff around the pool to explain or enforce basic rules. I saw several people entering the water without showering first, and even washing themselves directly next to the pool while proper showers and locker rooms are available.

As a result, after a few hours the water becomes really dirty and unpleasant, both in the main pool and the ice bath.

It’s a shame because the place has a lot of potential, but the maintenance and hygiene standards don’t match the quality of the facilities. The very low entrance price unfortunately attracts people who don’t respect basic cleanliness rules.

Conclusion: only worth visiting early in the morning, when it’s still clean and quiet.

They have everything you could want—a sauna, steam room, ice bath, pool, restaurant, and massage services. While the massages are decent, the overall experience is enhanced by the variety of amenities available.

The atmosphere is very family-friendly, with plenty of seating areas where you can unwind and enjoy the surroundings. The service is fair and efficient, and the reception staff are always welcoming, setting a positive tone for your visit.

If you’re looking for a spa with diverse options and a laid-back vibe, Phuket Spa is a solid choice. Great for families or anyone in need of some relaxation time!

100/10 – highly recommended.

reviews.name: Akachai Kliangklao

I highly recommend Real Thai Massage to anyone seeking an authentic and revitalizing massage experience.

reviews.name: Martin Hastie
reviews.text: My wife and I just had a massage at Being Massage, a real pleasure to be warmly greeted with no pressure sales. I have had a lot of massages and this would be one of the best, we have booked to go again tomorrow. The manager Bee was excellent, helpful and friendly, the therapists Boonmee and Su were great, highly recommended. reviews.name: Karl Wood
reviews.text: I was hesitant to get a massage in Phuket because everywhere I looked the people in massages were on display in the windows. We all loved the massages and returned the next day as well for one more.  I’ve had a few massages before in Mexico and Laos and Vietnam, but this was our favorite so far.  Our group of 3 all definitely recommends this place.

reviews.name: Bruno Papišta
reviews.text: I had the most incredible massage experience here! I wholeheartedly recommend this place. Bee, the owner, was not only exceptionally skilled but also fantastic at communicating in English. She took the time to thoroughly explain the intricacies of Thai massages and expertly guided me in selecting the perfect massage type. After my first visit, I couldn't resist returning three more times because the transformation I felt was truly remarkable. This place is a gem, and Bee's expertise is beyond compare. ✌🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you so much Bruno for spending your precious time to leave us a lovely review, i am truly happy to serve you and your group. Looking forward to serve you again in the future. thank you

reviews.name: Mr X
reviews.text: Very clean and modern massage place, tastefully decorated. The masseurs are polite and well experienced. I've had the best massage here (and I've had plenty through the years), I highly recommend it. If you're in patong, it's a must to visit.

reviews.name: Sujitha Vinothbabu
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience at Being Massage in Patong, Phuket. The facility is new, spacious, and impeccably clean, creating a relaxing atmosphere. The owner, Bee, is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, ensuring you receive the perfect massage. The professional and skilled masseuses delivered one of the best massages I’ve had in Phuket. The added touches of herbal tea was a nice bonus. I recommended Being Massage to my friends, and they all had a fantastic experience as well. Highly recommend for a top-notch, soothing experience.

reviews.name: Shamik Chatterjee
reviews.text:
My partner and I recently treated ourselves to a couples massage at Being Massage Parlor, located near Patong Beach. We were both feeling stressed and in need of some relaxation, and Being Massage did not disappoint!

The parlor itself is clean, inviting, and has a peaceful atmosphere. The staff were friendly and professional, and made us feel comfortable and welcome from the moment we arrived.

The massage itself was fantastic. Both therapists were attentive and knowledgeable, quickly identifying knots and tension in our muscles that we didn't even realize we had! They used a variety of techniques, including stretching, kneading, and acupressure, to release the tension and leave us feeling relaxed and rejuvenated. We particularly appreciated that the therapists used a firm but gentle pressure, avoiding any pain while still effectively working out the knots.

What really stood out to us was the overall experience. From the initial consultation to the final goodbye, everything was seamless and enjoyable. The massage room was quiet and calming, with soothing music and aromatherapy adding to the relaxation. We truly felt pampered and cared for throughout the entire session.

If you're looking for a relaxing and therapeutic massage experience in Phuket, I highly recommend Being Massage Parlor near Patong Beach. Their skilled therapists, peaceful atmosphere, and excellent service make it a truly worthwhile experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Shamik for your review, you truly made us very happy with your very detailed input. As a part of the team, i would like to thank to you and your partner for visting our massage parlor. I'm genuine grateful and appreciated your valueable feedback.
 Be safe and be blessed, 
Bee

reviews.text: If you want to experience a real Thai massage this is the place you should choose in Patong. The masseuses are kind and professional. reviews.name: S. H.
reviews.text: If you are looking for a cooking class and learn about local ingredients, I highly recommend this place. I learned a lot of things while visiting the market and also cooking. reviews.name: KG
reviews.text:
Must try!!! Our fam of 4 came on a Sat morning. Pimmy brought us to the local market and taught us how to choose some ingredients. We then prepared and cooked Panang Curry Chicken, Tom Yum Goong, Tamarind Prawn and Mango Sticky Rice. Value for money experience with own cooked lunch. Pimmy is friendly, speaks good english and very wiling to share knowledge.

We will definitely come again to learn other dishes. There are different dishes on different days.

reviews.name: Aidan Turley
reviews.text: Our family of four went for the morning class, just us there. Pimmy was informative and friendly. The market was interesting and she gave great advice. Pimmy and her assistant were efficient and helped us prepare ‘edible’ food. Recommended

reviews.name: Ahardy brit
reviews.text: Very well organized between Pimmy and her assistant. When I first saw the handout of what we were going to cook and eat, I was overwhelmed. In reality you and your partner share the chopping, crushing of fresh ingredients, then later wok cook each course. Learnt a lot about the fresh and some unknown ingredients. Great experience with knowledgeable, smiling teachers! 😊

reviews.name: Jennifer Neal (Nakedjen)
reviews.text:
I had the joy (and sweat) of joining a cooking class at Pink Chili Cooking School, led by the incomparable Pimmy, who is equal parts kitchen goddess, warm host, and spice sorceress. She welcomed us with a smile and a sparkle in her eye that said, you’re about to cook something that will blow your mind.

And she wasn’t wrong.

We kicked off with a visit to a traditional market that was very much alive—literally. Frogs leapt. Fish flopped. The herbs sang in their baskets. I was wide-eyed and grinning like a lemongrass-scented lunatic. This was not a sanitized, tourist-safe experience. This was the real deal.

Back at the school, we rolled up our sleeves and got to work: red curry paste from scratch, a silky, fragrant Tom Kha Gai, the best damn Pad Thai I’ve ever tasted (possibly because I made it), and a glorious finale of Mango Sticky Rice that made me want to cry from joy. I’m not kidding—every dish was a celebration for the senses.

And Pimmy? She was gracious, intuitive, and went out of her way to accommodate my dietary needs, adjusting recipes with zero fuss and total love.

Honestly, every single hot, sticky, aromatic moment was a gift. If you’re looking for an experience that fills your belly, opens your heart, and connects you deeply to Thai culture—this is it.

5/5 stars.

reviews.name: Anurag Dey
reviews.text: Pimmy is a great teacher. Cooking classes are a great way of learning about local culture. We were a group of 6 ppl from all around the world and we had fun cooking the Thai dishes. The ingredients provided are really fresh and an introduction to each ingredient is the best part. The cooking stations are really cool, the group sizes are kept small to ensure better understanding of the cooking styles. This is a must go to experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your great review !

reviews.name: Luise Janning
reviews.text:
We booked a cooking class with Pimmy in March 2016 and enjoyed it very much. When we got a message from Pimmy, she got cancelation for the afternoon class, we were afraid, she would cancel on us to, but instead we had a cooking class for only us TWO! How great. We went to the market, bought some stuff for the class and also for taking home and then started chopping, cooking, frying.... Pimmy and her help explained everything and were very patient with us. The food was awesome and because my friend couldn't eat it due to some stomach flue, Pimmy packed her food for us, so we could eat it the next day. Recipes are easy to understand. We are only worried, that we might not get all ingredients back at home...
Thanks again Pimmy for teaching us some lovely dishes!

reviews.name: Shai Robison
reviews.text: We had a great time! All of the instructors were so sweet and helpful. The classroom was nice and cool, great air conditioner. We made 4 different dishes and they were all delicious. Thank you so much for sharing your talents and beautiful smiles with us. ❤️

reviews.name: V.Ruettimann
reviews.text: Our experience with pink chili was great. After booking online we received a confirmation with a very good description of how to get to the meeting point. Pimmy was already waiting for us and we went straight to the market. She showed us around and explained what the different ingredients were. We went back to the school and started cooking. The instructions were very clear and easy and Pimmy is very funny. The food was delicious and the afternoon great! We would recommend this highly.

TAKE THE CLASS!!! This was a highlight of my entire trip in Bangkok. I took the morning session which includes a visit to the local market. Everything was amazing, from the teachers to the food :)

You also get to take the recipes home with you to remake. I unfortunately lost the paper with the recipes and emailed the company. They quickly responded and sent me the recipes via PDF. They are a lovely company doing an awesome job with their cooking experience. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

reviews.name: snarkyguy
reviews.text: This was a lot of fun! We scheduled our visit in advance and Pink Chili did not disappoint. The instructors were friendly and just made it fun. First they walked us to a nearby market to show us the ingredients we'd be using for our meal. When we got back, we made 5 different dishes and sampled them all as we went along. They had a well laid-out kitchen and cooking area, eating and preparation area, and of course was super clean. After we left, they even gave us a printed out menu so we could make the same amazing Thai dishes when we got home. Amazing!!

reviews.name: Suzanne Ehlers
reviews.text: Perfect end to my business trip work week. I went alone on a Friday morning (9-1) and enjoyed my tablemates, the instructor, her helpers, and the entire experience. The food was very good and so fresh, the recipe booklet was a great take-away, and the market tour was actually more instructive than I expected. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: leon j
reviews.text:
This is possibly one of the best experiences I have had in Bangkok and one of the better ways to spend half a day at a very reasonable price.
We cooked phad Thai, green curry chicken, tom yum goong, and mango Sticky Rice and it began with a trip to the Onnut fresh market just around the corner.
Right up from food preparation, to cooking and finally, enjoying it. And to eat good food that you actually prepped yourself is just wonderful.
Pimmy, our leader was excellent, assisted ably by Tia and Lakh. Great experience, good laughs and just wonderful food.
At 1200B it is a real bargain.

reviews.text: Pimmy and he staff were very good about meeting the group needs. Exploring the market helps us understand her options. Interesting usage of supplies. Although fun, many of the items cannon be made at home because the supplies are not easily available. To get an understanding of the food choices you can see in Thailand, it’s a great way to know what’s in the food.

reviews.name: mathieu AH HONE
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time  with our great teacher and her friend who helped us understand about thaï ingredients by going through a market and thaï cuisine.
I recommend if you want to cook some traditional meal.

reviews.name: Kharissa Fernando Smith
reviews.text: My friend and I really enjoyed this class! I specifically chose it because of the competitive price point, afternoon start time, and market visit (most afternoon cooking classes in BKK don't offer a market visit, however after having gone, the market visit can be skipped -- I've lived in Asia long enough that it wasn't too interesting). The class itself was fun and everything was well-organized. Our teacher had two helpers that chopped *almost* everything, so all we had to do was cook! But even then, the helpers would jump in if you're not stirring correctly. It's good for people that want a fun experience, but not for people that seriously want to learn since they try to do everything for you (even the portioning).

reviews.name: Leanne Wilkinson
reviews.text: We chose to do Pimmy’s cooking class to end our 2 week holiday in Thailand. What a great decision! We first visited a local market and learnt how to source the best ingredients, and then returned to cook 4 dishes. It actually amazed me that I cooked those myself! Thank you so much! Take the class and take home some great cooking skills👩🏻‍🍳☺️

reviews.name: Kashfia T. Ahmed
reviews.text:
My first ever cooking class and Pimmy did a great job in making it worthwhile.
The market visit was very well explained in terms of identifying good ingredients and necessary ingredients for Thai cuisine.
They organized every ingredient in an orderly manner making the cooking experience pleasant.
They explained the use or traditional and available utensils for cooking and gave a recipe book as well.
Enjoyed every bit of it, definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Tom Bertrand
reviews.text: The Meal + Cooking Experience + Market Tour with Pimmy was such a cool experience during our trip to Bangkok! Pimmy was such a knowledgeable and friendly host. The experience started with her taking us on a tour of the local On Nut market near the cooking studio. She showed us some of the local Thai ingredients we would be cooking with, as well as telling us about similar alternatives we could use to recreate the dish back home. After the market tour we returned to the cooking studio to prepare our meal. Everything was individually portioned, so everyone got an opportunity to cook each dish. Then menu varies depending on the day of the week, but for our class we made hand-ground Green Curry Paste (Nam Prik Gaeng Kheao Wan), Coconut Soup with Chicken (Tom Kha Gai), Stir Fried Noodles Thai Shrimps (PadThai Khung), Green Curry Chicken (Kheang Kheao Wan), and Mango with Sticky Rice (Khao Niaow Manmuang). Pimmy provided excellent instructions for how to cook each dish, and her staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Everything was delicious and you definitely don't leave hungry! You also get to take home a recipe book with all of the dishes you cook plus the dishes that are made on the other days. The studio is easily accessible via the BTS. I highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Bangkok wanting to learn how to cook Thai food. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.text:
My wife & i booked 2hrs Thai Massage Package on 23/4/25(10am)for 2 pax through ThaiHand apps.
Both of us was well arranged in a couple room. Nice ambience and comfortable.
Thanks to my masseuse as she performed authentic Thai Massage techniques very well. However, we very dissatisfied and felt angry with the masseuse that serve my wife.
As my wife told me, the massage was performed very perfunctorily, with frequent sudden stops at odd points. It wasn't until my wife suddenly looked up at her, startling her awake and making her freeze, that we realized she had been dozing off the entire time. When applying the hot compress, her touch was fleeting and light, like a dragonfly landing briefly on water. She just dabbed randomly across my wife's body, and it wasn't proper application at all. She was unprofessional, her techniques were unorthodox, and we don't understand how she passed her training and assessment.
We used to be regular customer of Let's Relax Spa. We did enjoyed our massages at other outlet e.g. patong 3rd road, bangkok, pattaya.
We hope that management will take the selection and training of your massage therapists seriously and prevent individuals who do not meet your company's standards from slipping in unnoticed. This can damage your reputation.

Now in Chalong
Ban Sabai Massage & Spa
217 E Chaofah Rd, Chalong, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83000, Thailand

I recently had the pleasure of getting a massage here and I can honestly say that it was one of the best experiences I've ever had.
As soon as I entered the shop, I was greeted by a warm, inviting atmosphere. The soft music and the lovingly designed interior immediately put me in a relaxed mood. The staff were extremely friendly and professional, which only increased my anticipation of the treatment.
I opted for a traditional Thai massage and it was simply heavenly! The masseuse was very well trained and had a remarkable sense of what tensions I had. The masseuse's ability to specifically target my problem areas without losing sight of the relaxation factor was particularly impressive.
It felt like I was immersed in another world, far away from the hectic everyday life.
My visit was rounded off by the fruits that were offered to me after the treatment.
Overall, I can recommend Ban Sabai Massage & Spa to anyone looking for an authentic and serious (no sex) Thai massage in a relaxed environment.
I will definitely come back!
Thank you to the whole team for the wonderful experience! 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Nariokung
reviews.text:
I recently visited Luxsa Spa at Hansar Bangkok and the experience was generally pleasant. My therapists, Khun Chompoo and Khun Nue, demonstrated good technique and maintained steady, consistent strength throughout the entire session, which contributed to a comfortable and relaxing massage.

Upon arrival, I was served a small snack and a drink before the treatment, which was a thoughtful gesture. The spa also offered a selection of four aromatherapy oils, and I found the Earth and Air scents particularly appealing for their calming and well-balanced fragrance.

During the session, I noticed that the therapists did not ask about the music volume, the air conditioning temperature, or whether the pressure needed adjustment. While this was unexpected, it did not interfere with the overall experience. I was also slightly surprised that there was no foot soak at the beginning, although it is not an essential step and not all spas include it. After the massage, there was no warm pillow or heat compress provided, which is something I am more accustomed to at other establishments. Another small snack and drink were served after the treatment, and the taste was enjoyable.

Despite these minor omissions, the atmosphere was pleasant and the therapists performed well. The thoughtful touches such as the aromatherapy selection and pre and post treatment refreshments added to the overall experience, making the visit relaxing and worthwhile.

reviews.name: A.
reviews.text:
As part of my hotel stay, I received a complimentary 1-hour Thai massage, and it was truly memorable.

From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed warmly and offered a refreshing welcome drink along with a cold lemongrass-scented towel – a perfect touch to combat the Bangkok heat. The ambience of the wellness centre was serene, with well-lit and dimmed areas that set a calming mood for the massage.

The massage itself was outstanding, thanks to my two masseuses, Nan and June. Both were highly professional and demonstrated remarkable skill in targeting pressure points with precision. Their attention to detail and ability to provide just the right amount of pressure made the experience deeply relaxing and rejuvenating.

Before the session began, I appreciated that they asked for my preference regarding the massage area, ensuring a personalized experience. The change of clothes provided was impeccably clean, adding to the overall sense of luxury and comfort.

In summary, my visit to Hansar Thai Wellness was exceptional in every way. The professional service, soothing ambience, and outstanding massage left me thoroughly impressed. I will definitely be returning for another visit!

title: Daisy Dream Nuru Massage
subTitle: Daisy Dream Bangkok
ownerDescription: Located at 12/8 Sukhumvit 33, Bangkok, just a short walk from BTS Phrom Phong, Daisy Dream has specialized in Japanese-style Nuru massage and Soapy massage since 2019. With one of the largest massage teams in Sukhumvit, you'll always find a warm welcome and a wide choice of experienced therapists. We're open every day from 11am to 2am, with sessions starting from just 2,000 THB. Combining a convenient location, elegant private rooms, and years of experience, Daisy Dream has become one of Bangkok's leading destinations for Nuru massage and Soapy massage. Ready to visit? Contact us by phone or add us on LINE through the link on our website to reserve your preferred therapist and enjoy one of Bangkok's most memorable massage experiences.

reviews.name: Jimmy Tall on
reviews.text:
I wish I could write this review on my main account, but unfortunately, this is all I can do. I visited this extraordinary place last month. Since I was on a trip in Asia, I only recently found the time to review it.

I went there because it had so many good reviews. When I entered the place, I was amazed by the atmosphere. Mamasan explained the services to me in very good English and let me choose the therapist. She recommended one, but I decided to go with my own choice.

I had always been curious about the experience of having two therapists, so I chose the couple massage with two therapists in the VIP jacuzzi room. If I understood their names correctly, Cherry and Melly were my therapists.

They were very cheerful and talked to each other almost all the time, sometimes in Thai and sometimes in English. First, they helped me use the jacuzzi and then took a shower. After that, we went to the massage bed for the session. They gave me a great conventional massage between the two special massages, and I had an amazing time until the end of the second session. They did not seem to be in any hurry and looked like they were having a lot of fun. Cherry, especially, was very beautiful and funny. On the other hand, Melly was very professional.

I will never forget this experience in my life. Every man should experience this at least once in his life, if he can. Thanks to Cherry, Melly, and Mamasan!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review. Reading messages like yours honestly makes the whole team smile.

We are very happy to hear that your visit to Daisy Dream left such a strong impression. Creating a welcoming atmosphere from the moment guests walk in is something we take seriously, so it is great to know that the experience with Mamasan and the selection process made you feel comfortable right away.

It also sounds like Cherry and Melly gave you a memorable VIP jacuzzi session. They will definitely be happy to hear that you appreciated both Cherry’s cheerful personality and Melly’s professionalism. That combination of fun energy and skilled service is exactly what we aim for every day.

At Daisy Dream, our goal is simple: give every guest an unforgettable moment with what many visitors call the best nuru massage and soapy massage in Bangkok, in a relaxed atmosphere where nobody feels rushed.

Thank you again for your kind words and for sharing your experience even from a secondary account. We hope your travels bring you back to Bangkok soon. Cherry, Melly, Mamasan and the whole Daisy Dream team will be ready to welcome you again.

reviews.name: Iconic Concierge
reviews.text:
We came for the "Hangover 2" nostalgia, but it became one of the best culinary experiences ! Like many travellers, we were drawn to the Lebua at State Tower because we wanted to see that legendary rooftop bar from the movie. And be assured - starting the night at Sky Bar with a sunset cocktail experience was the perfect "Bangkok moment"—the views are just as dizzying and dramatic as they look on screen.

However, the real magic happened when we moved to the 61st floor for dinner at Chef’s Table. The panoramic views of the city skyline are breathtaking, but the atmosphere inside is surprisingly intimate and refined. Chef Vincent Thierry gave us such a warm welcome and actually joined us at the table several times throughout the night to explain the story behind his modern French tasting menu. It felt less like a stiff fine-dining meal and more like being hosted by a master in his own home - we were even invited into the open kitchen to see the magic happen firsthand.

Every course was a total delight. It started with Chef spooning the most incredible homemade butter (churned from local Khao Yai cream!) directly onto our plates, and just kept soaring from there. The King Crab Tiramisu was a revelation, and the Challans Duck Breast and scallops were cooked to absolute perfection. To top it all off, they rolled out an incredibly impressive cheese trolley that would make any turophile weep with joy.

If you’re looking for a world-class meal with a view to match, this is the place!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Iconic Concierge,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share such a nice review about the whole experience.

We're delighted that you enjoyed your visit, from Sky Bar to Chef's Table.

Your word's regarding the chefs and the whole journey are really rewarding for us. Sharing the storys of each dish, and inviting the guest into the kitchen are really essential parts of the journey at Chef's Table.

We sincerely look forward to welcome you again.

Kind regards,
The Chef's Table Team

All four of us had an unforgettable experience and cannot wait to return for our third visit! A truly memorable celebration. 😍😍

reviews.text:
had the chance to visit for a special Pétrus wine dinner last week, and honestly it’s still hard to process the experience.

We tasted six different vintages of Pétrus in one evening — something I never imagined I would do in a single dinner. It felt quite surreal.

The food was exactly what you would expect from a 2 Michelin star level — refined, precise, and very well executed. Each course paired beautifully and didn’t try to overpower the wines.

Service and overall atmosphere made the night even more special. Everything flowed smoothly, no pressure, just a really enjoyable pace throughout the dinner.

Thank you for sharing such a thoughtful reflection following your experience with us.

We are truly pleased to know that the Pétrus dinner left such a lasting impression. It is indeed a rare moment, and we are glad you could fully enjoy both the wines and the harmony with the dishes that the chef created.

Your comments on the balance of the pairings, as well as the flow of the evening, mean a great deal to us, as this is exactly the experience we were aiming to create.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you again for another memorable occasion.

Kind regards,
The Chef's Table Team

reviews.name: Eiko Narita
reviews.text:
It was a lovely meal. The service was really amazing (got caught in traffic and delayed by 60mins and they rearranged seating time!) and everyone was so friendly. I loved the wines but 4,000 baht for a glass of Latour as “addition”? Hm….I can get that or better in Tokyo for much less (Latour is nice but not that nice lol). And the food, of course, was great. So why not the 5 stars? I can only explain using my previous experience in Germany where I went to 1 star Oben in the middle of no where and where the restaurant offered its best using local produce and creativity beyond imagination. Then I went to 2 star Opus V in Mannheim and everything was great, as it should, but somehow not quite.

I think the food at Chefs Table uses amazing produce like truffles, caviar, etc but somehow I hoped for more creativity. And if I may be super detailed, I saw madeleine served with chocolate coat all over it! I mean, I fell in love with madeleines in Nancy/Lorraine because of the subtle crunch outside that initially touches the teeth which brings back all the memory of warm madeleine from Le Grand Est! But no, that didn’t happen when there is chocolate all over it.

I actually tried Le Normandie earlier and … it felt more imaginative. No caviar, no truffles but somehow creative. I don’t want to compare restaurants and I really appreciate the hard work that goes into every dish only to be critiqued by amateurs like me (who just likes food) but that’s my comment (btw is the open kitchen really necessary at a 2-star restaurant? I would feel so uptight as a cook there :)) I still had a wonderful time and loved the dessert - Pavlova (that was a beauty). It’s an experience to have once in their life if possible.

Btw, there was 1 female staff in kitchen, which was a relief in my view but I think the restaurant industry could do better :)

reviews.name: Rune Olsen
reviews.text:
A Memorable Experience at Chef’s Table

Our visit to Chef’s Table was nothing short of exceptional. The food was truly excellent – each dish reflected impressive technical precision and creativity, with beautifully balanced flavors. The wine pairing was exciting and well thought out, complementing the menu in a way that elevated the overall experience.

Service was impeccable – attentive, knowledgeable, and warm, striking just the right balance between professional and personal. It’s clear that the team takes great pride in every detail.

This dinner will remain one of the most memorable Michelin experiences we’ve had. Truffle and caviar were featured as optional enhancements to some courses. While already used thoughtfully within the menu, their addition could be better presented as a way to complete a dish rather than feeling like an upsell.

One minor point – the live piano music, while elegant and well played, was a little too loud at times for our taste, slightly interfering with conversation.

That said, it was a truly unforgettable evening that fully lived up to its reputation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mr Olsen, 

Thank you ever so much for your beautifully written review. it was an absolute pleasure to read. 
We are thrilled to know that every aspect of your evening, from the wine pairings to the service contributed to such a memorable experience. Your kind words about the warmth and professionalism of our team will be shared with great pride. 
We also appreciate your honest and constructive feedback regarding the optional enhancements and piano volume, Both areas we are continuously fine-tuning to best suit our guests' comfort and expectations. 
It was our honor to host you and we sincerely look forward to welcoming you again for another unforgettable experience. 

Warmest regards, 

The Chef’s Table Team

reviews.name: Pete White
reviews.text:
This was only our third Michelin restaurant experience, and we actually flew into Bangkok for the night as a break from our beach vacation in Phuket. Overall, the experience was good, but not great. The food was, as you'd expect, beautifully presented, and tasted good, although a few of the items were not to our taste (which is fair enough). We did the wine pairing, which again was good, but not great. Can't really say why, other than it leaned into whites (and a cider!), and we tend to prefer reds.

Our main issue was the upsells before dining. This is already a pretty expensive endeavor for most of us, so the upsells for more caviar, more truffle (and one other option I forget) got a little tedious, and it made the whole thing a bit tacky. Have it as an option on the table perhaps, but we don't need the song and dance.

We stayed in the hotel, which as others have said, is looking worn in places. I don't know how to describe it, the room was huge, and well appointed, but the overall vibe was a typical 1990's US Marriott, so not really becoming of the restaurants at the top.

The Chef’s Table Team

Ps. New hours for (walk in) group classes:
- 3:00-4:30 pm
- 4:30-6:00 pm

reviews.name: belu beltran
reviews.text:
It was a great class for two people. My husband is advanced and I’m a beginner, yet the coach managed to make the class interesting for both, letting us know what we can do better.
We learned some new techniques and had fun as well!
Would totally recommend for any level

reviews.name: Eva C
reviews.text: It was my first time trying Muay Thai boxing! The owner was very kind. I went at 3 pm; you don't need to book in advance, you can just show up! It costs 500 baht, which is good value for money.

reviews.name: Shawn Giudice
reviews.text:
Amazing experience. Small gym which give you the chance to learn without too many interruptions
Adjusts to your level very easily. Beginner or advanced.
Amazing techniques that I haven't learned after 10 years of training in Canada.

If you have prior training get ready to sleep well that night ;)
(He told me I will sleep well tonight. He is definitely not wrong!)
I would give 10 stars if I could!
Highly recommend!!!

reviews.name: Misha Markovits
reviews.text: An amazing gym for all levels of people who want to train. He once had the biggest gyms before covid and is an truly amazing teacher who shares his passion! You can drop by in the hours depicted on the image and has earned a lot of prizes for his achievements :) Definitely recommend to take a Muay Thai class here!!

reviews.name: Gal
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic experience. There is a group class at 3pm. Payed 500 baht for a 1.5 hour class and was exhausted by the end. Learned a ton and had a great time. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Blake Christensen
reviews.text: Great instructor! I loved his energy and his enthusiasm for the sport. My girlfriend and I did a class together and we had a great workout and learned a lot. So glad we picked this gym during our vacation.

reviews.name: Sylvie Clark
reviews.text:
Thanomsak is a great trainer and we fully enjoyed our lesson! We will definitely be returning later in the year.
I recommend everyone to try this out :-)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your review !!! Happy to hear you enjoyed the session. Hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Heather Siddoway
reviews.text: My friend and I went for the group lesson (no need to book ahead, we just showed up at 3pm with 500 baht each) but it ended up just being us 2 so we basically got a private class! We both have done kickboxing but this was our first time with Muay Thai, and it was a great first experience - Thanomsak was an awesome teacher, we would definitely recommend this place 🥊

reviews.name: Notorious O.R.A
reviews.text: I really wanted to go to a training session and had a Thai friend call beforehand. We were told the trainer has a serious health issue so that the gym will likely be closed for a long period of time, so just wanted to warn others of this, I recommend to call to check whether this is the case. A pity, I was really looking forward to this training session seeing the rave reviews. Wish the trainer a healthy recovery!

reviews.name: salaar tassadaq
reviews.text:
I had the absolute pleasure of training with at Thanomsak Gym for 7 days. I have a fighting background and prior Muay Thai experience, and came in looking for a high-quality, personalised and authentic experience – and my trainer, Jun, delivered beyond my expectations. I can genuinely say that it was one of the best training experiences I’ve ever had.
I trained with Jun on an individual basis, and I really appreciated the level of personalised attention I received. Jun’s expertise and passion for Muay Thai are truly unmatched. He took time to assess my existing strengths and areas for growth and tailored each session to improve my technique. His detailed approach to refining my technique, power and pushing my conditioning made every session both intense and very rewarding.
Lastly, I was moved by just how friendly and encouraging Jun was. His attitude made it easy to really push myself and genuinely enjoy my sessions.
If you are looking for a top-notch Muay Thai experience where you will receive very personalised and professional training, definitely visit Jun! I cannot recommend him enough and will definitely be returning to Thanomsak Gym on my next trip!
Khapun Krup Jun for your incredible coaching and for an unforgettable experience 🙏🥊

reviews.name: Sam Bartlett
reviews.text: Me (Australian, 22) and another traveller (Mexican, 21) came here spontaneously. The owner and his wife are super cool and gave us a great lesson. The place also has little food stall out the front if you’re hungry after - it’s very good.

reviews.name: budibam
reviews.text:
I only went there once unfortunately because I injured my big toe.

BUT: What can I say, he is such a great teacher, where you can really learn from. He focuses on the techniques so well, you normally don´t get that in many Gyms when you are a beginner. So thank you very much for that real Muay Thai experience. I can recommend going there for sure!

reviews.name: Dmitry Voronov
reviews.text: Very good trainer, even if you trained before he will surprise you,  Thanomsak showed me very good technical muay thai actions. Very good place for training.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your review 🙏🙏🙏😊😊😊

reviews.name: danny burridge
reviews.text:
Amazing gym with a passionate trainer. He has incredible knowledge, patience and a great personality.

This gym is great for people of all levels as the trainer goes through stretching, technique and then a hard pad session.

Really enjoyed the session and wish I had more time in Bangkok as I would have had many more sessions here.

reviews.name: Laurence-Olivier Tardif
reviews.text:
This place is definitely a hidden gem in Bangkok. I've trained there the 3 days I was there and I absolutely recommend it, no matter your level of experience in muay thai. The coach really focuses on technique while still making sure you get a good workout and is full of anecdotes about the sport.

I can't say enough good things about the place!

reviews.name: Milo van der Pas
reviews.text: Me and my friend really liked the training, it was our first time trying Muay Thai. And it felt a little bit like your brother/father was teaching you the sport, it was a lot of fun😁

title: Sky One Massage
ownerDescription: Discover authentic Thai massage in the heart of Bangkok. Our certified therapists offer traditional Thai massage, foot massage, oil massage, and aromatherapy in a clean, relaxing environment. Just 5 minutes from BTS Surasak. Walk-ins welcome! “English-speaking staff”
address: 737 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
plusCode: PGFF+Q9 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Follow Fauzia
reviews.text:
Been dying for a massage and I wanted to try a new place and I read about this place and since it was fairly close to my house I decided to walk here and get a massage!

There was no waiting time I had actually called them and told him that I was gonna come there right away and they were waiting for me so that was really nice ! 😊
She got to all my sore spots she did a really good job 👏🏽😎😘😘😘

I think I got a really good masseuse her name was Anh - oh my God was she good I was going in between my one hour I was gonna extend it for another hour but then I will come back next week!

I would highly recommend this place although this place is small and you have to go upstairs for the actual oil massage the prices were exceptional and very very good !

Follow Fauzia for more massage places  in the Si Lom and Sathorn area of Bangkok you can follow us on our social media platforms such as YouTube TikTok Facebook and Instagram!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบพระคุณสำหรับการใช้บริการและบอกเล่าประสบการณ์ดีๆ ทางร้านยินดีต้อนทุกการมาเยือนนะคะ

reviews.name: Thanthip Phatthanawiwat
reviews.text: Highly impressed with the Aroma massage here! The therapist was very thorough and professional, hitting all the right spots with the perfect pressure. It was a painless yet deeply relaxing experience. You can tell they really care about their craft. Definitely worth a visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review!
We’re truly delighted to hear that you had a relaxing and satisfying experience with our aroma massage.

Your kind words mean a lot to us, and it’s always our priority to make every guest feel valued and well taken care of.
We will be sure to share your feedback with our therapist — it will definitely make their day!

We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another relaxing experience. 💚

reviews.name: Cristobal Daniel Capó Smith
reviews.text: They get a 4 star instead of 1 for the little lady that gave me the massage, she was outstanding very very good massage and taken care of, shame my partner got a girl, younger that seemed grossed at touching her skin, this girl should have a different job. If you go, get the smaller older lady, she knew exactly what spot to touch at all times, and had a very fun interaction with us, even though we don’t speak each other’s language.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We appreciate your trust and understanding, and we hope you enjoy the rest of your time in Thailand.

reviews.name: Charley Wilson
reviews.text: Had a great experience at Sky One. The staff were so lovely and welcoming, and the massage itself was excellent. Really skilled therapists who know exactly what they’re doing. Prices are very affordable for the quality you get…amazing value. I’ll definitely be coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review.
We’re truly happy to hear that you had such a great experience with our team and massage service at Sky One. Your kind words mean a lot to all of our therapists.
We’re very grateful for your support and would be delighted to welcome you back again whenever you visit Thailand.

reviews.name: Shivam Limaye
reviews.text: Probably one of the best massage experiences I’ve ever had. Slept like a baby for 1 hr. Therapists are great, place is clean.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
🤩 Thank you so much for this incredibly impressive review!

Knowing that your experience at Sky One Massage was "one of the best massage experiences you've ever had" and that you "slept like a baby for 1 hour" is the highest compliment we could receive!

We are delighted that our great therapists and the cleanliness of the place met your expectations and brought you such deep relaxation.

We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another comfortable and restful session!

The Sky One Massage Team

reviews.name: Kelsie Cottingham
reviews.text: Young lady was on her phone majority of the time, meaning the massage was stop/start while she was texting. Not focusing on the correct areas so was painful at times. It was obvious this lady could not be bothered. I will not be returning.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We have already addressed this issue with our team to ensure that all therapists remain fully attentive and focused throughout each session. Your comfort, relaxation, and satisfaction are extremely important to us, and we are committed to improving our service to prevent this from happening again.

We genuinely regret that your visit left you disappointed, and we hope you might give us another opportunity in the future to provide you with a much better experience.

Sky One Massage

reviews.name: Eileen Neo (Sgsohotleh)
reviews.text: Happened to pass-by this massage place. Love the very smoothing to ears music that really put me to sleep!! Very clean environment and welcoming aesthetics.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much and hope you will come back to use our services again.

reviews.name: Makikiss
reviews.text: Best foot massage i have had in my life, it was so relaxing i will be back

reviews.name: Sofie Kristensen
reviews.text: The thai massage was amazing. Definitely worth the money!

reviews.name: Moe Sandar Tun

The best massage l have ever done .
She was Oo who served me and she is very professional,talented and clever to know which parts of the body has defects .it was so gentle and amazing that she massaged my entire body with softness .thank you Oo again and again .
