We look forward to seeing you again soon for another personalized and relaxing treatment!

The Sky One Massage Team

reviews.name: Cameron King
reviews.text: Great professional massage! Mature and  Friendly Staff!

reviews.name: Katarzyna Bochenek
reviews.text: an amazing place, you can relax and de-stress, I wholeheartedly recommend it, the lady is very nice
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. I feel very honored to have taken care of you.

reviews.name: Bernadette H.
reviews.text:
A slightly bit more expensive than the ultra cheap places, but the extra 1-2$ are so worth it!
had the head, shoulder & neck treatment and my therapist did not only find my knots but also actively worked on them (yes, that's what you usually would expect from a massage, but most massage places in Thailand I visited just did their 0815 program).
one of the best massages I had in Thailand!

+ they have real massage beds, the ones with the hole for your face, I personally very much appreciate having a straight spine while getting a massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
🌟 Thank you so much for this excellent and detailed review!

We are grateful that you acknowledged that the slightly higher price difference is "so worth it!" We are very proud to offer an experience that goes beyond the "0815 program," showing that our therapists are true professionals who can not only find your knots but actively work on them, as you expected.

We also truly appreciate your feedback regarding our facilities, especially the massage beds with the face hole. We carefully chose these to ensure maximum comfort and a straight spine for all our clients during the massage.

Your compliment that this was "one of the best massages I had in Thailand" is the biggest motivation for the Sky One Massage team.

We hope to have the opportunity to serve you again soon! 🙏

The Sky One Massage Team

reviews.name: Ethan Joss
reviews.text: Excellent foot massage and service!

reviews.name: Steffen Holst Jensen
reviews.text: Very good massage place. The best I've had here in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are very grateful and appreciative of your satisfaction with our service. Next time you experience aches and pains, please remember us. We are always happy to welcome you.

reviews.name: Danielle Ernstsen Schmidt
reviews.text: If you are looking for a good relaxing massage I definitely recommend! I was missing a bit of relaxing music to cover the sound of the road nearby. But the massage was fantastic!

reviews.name: Catalina Londoño Henao
reviews.text: Lovely place. The lady knows just what I need and it’s relaxing. Exactly what you need.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. It was an honor to serve you. We hope you will use our services again.

reviews.name: Wang Ziham
reviews.text: so goodd！！people is nice！！love it！！😄
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. I feel very honored to have taken care of you.

reviews.name: ms zulekha
reviews.text: Amazing service. Foot massage for 30 minutes outclass. Almost fell asleep. Will also try other services. Reasonable prices. 👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Many thanks for giving me this opportunity.

reviews.name: Cinry Lei
reviews.text: Solid foot massage, professional and well trained staff. Only complaint is that they up-sale a foot massage with lotion, which I haven’t seen much before.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. It was an honor to serve you.

title: Rambong Muay Thai Gym - Chiang Mai
subTitle: Rambong Muay Thai Gym
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Rambong Muay Thai Gym, owned and operated by ONE Championship veteran Rambong Sor Therapat.

Led by Rambong, we are an experienced group of traditional Nak Muay. Our training focusses on technique, strategy, and conditioning.

We welcome all levels for training, complete beginners and experienced fighters train with us every day.

Whatever your level, you are very welcome to come and train with us.

Please contact us if you have any questions. You can reach us on WhatsApp or Instagram.

We look forward to having you.
address: 79/2 Sri Ping Muang 3 Road Tambon Hai Ya, Amphoe Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXCP+52 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Zak Hull
reviews.text: Such an amazing gym! The staff treat you like family and are so welcoming. Me and my brother stayed at the gym for 2 weeks and was such a good experience. They keep classes smaller which works much better as you get better coaching. Would 100% recommend to anyone in Chiang Mai and I will be back.

reviews.name: Anna Pirhofer
reviews.text: We had such a great time at Rambong Muay Thai Gym and can’t wait to come back! We stayed for ten days to train Muay Thai, for the first time in Chiang Mai and for the first time with our young kid. Rambong gym really was the best place for this: Rambong and the whole team were super kind, very professional, and there was always someone to have an eye our little one while we were training - the trainers were even holding pads for her and playing with her. The training was great too: Rambong and team mixed very powerful sessions with more technical / IQ ones, and pad work and sparring with Rambong were obviously the highlights. And all along there was good mood and fun in the gym. We went for group classes and private sessions and both were great. Finally, the whole team became like family for us during the stay, even inviting us for food and taking us along to see them fight in the stadium. In short: we loved it and can’t wait to come back! Thank you Rambong, Deaw and the whole crew 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Mátyás Bagoly
reviews.text: Amazing Muay Thai gym with a great atmosphere and excellent trainers. Rambong is very experienced, patient, and really cares about helping you improve. I learned a lot in a short time and felt welcome from day one. Highly recommend this gym to anyone training in Chiang Mai! 🥊🙏🇹🇭

reviews.name: cali leow
reviews.text:
Honestly one of the most welcoming gyms. Rambong himself is an active fighter along side his fellow coach/ who also fight regularly. They are always looking on ways they can improve you and your fighting techniques.

They have made Rambong Muay Thai a place you look forward to train and look forward to build a friendship with them too

Bonus on the gym puppy who loves belly rubs.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for visiting us!

reviews.name: Jamie McDermid
reviews.text: Had the best experience today! Rambong is a living legend! The instructors are super supportive and as beginners learnt so much! A great work for people willing to push themselves! Would 100% come back and buy a big block of sessions if we were staying longer! Well worth it, feeling great and an epic reason to get out of bed!

reviews.name: Kevin Downs
reviews.text: This was my first time doing Muy Thai or any combat sport. I went to a 10:30 am class and since no one was there I got a private training session. These dudes kicked my butt and then fed me after. I definitely recommend this gym.

reviews.name: Dieter Roelants
reviews.text: I took 2 classes here during my stay in Chiang Mai as a beginner. The coaches are super friendly and great at what they do, taking their time to make sure your technique is correct. According to the site a class is 1h, but it’s more like 1,5h. You’ll be exhausted at the end but feel great at the same time. 10/10

reviews.name: vikesh500
reviews.text: Very good gym. Coaches are professional and they take time to help you understand the techniques. Good, technical sparring also with Rambong. Thank you.

reviews.name: Anon
reviews.text: As a newbie woman to Muay Thai, I found Rambong’s gym and all the trainers to be very friendly and helpful! Immediately made to feel welcome, comfortable and confident! I am totally hooked now! Would definitely recommend if you’re in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: nathan witt
reviews.text: Rambong was extremely friendly. Had a great experience at this gym, worked me hard, great pad work and was a fun session. Would definitely recommend to anyone either beginners or experienced fighter boxing or Muay Thai. Would definitely come back

reviews.name: Nimai Ray
reviews.text: Best Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai. Trainers take time to teach proper technique and push your limits while keeping sessions fun. Trained for 1 week and ended up going out for meals and celebrating Songkran with Rambong and all his friends, they treat us like family. 100% would recommend

reviews.name: Enzo Ruiz
reviews.text:
Rambong and the coaches are so so welcoming, it will literally feel like training with your gym mates, but not for this reason do they go any lighter. This is definitly a high level gym. If you need, they will lend you glove and shinguards, so there is no need to buy them if you dont have them with you. All in all its a super gym.

Its been a blast and two weeks full of new bruises.💪

reviews.name: Noam Chayun Castillo
reviews.text: One of the best places to train and learn Muay Thai from real fighters. Highly recommended for both beginners and advanced students — it’s a great place to gain experience and see real personal progress. Awesome place, awesome vibe!

reviews.name: Finn Carpenter
reviews.text: I trained with Rambong for two months and it was the best time of my life. Came as a solo traveller and made so many friends. It's like a big family.

reviews.name: Randall Fouts
reviews.text: I showed up at Rambong’s gym for a private session. They gladly accepted me as a walk in. The session was one hour and I learned a lot. He personally took the time to improve my technique and show me the right way. It was a pleasure to train here and he is very kind. I will be back for training soon. Thank you Rambong!

reviews.name: 61epoc
reviews.text:
This morning I had an amazing training session.

It was really great! After the session I felt amazing - tired but deeply satisfied.

I worked on the heavy bag, did padwork, and joined sparring. During every stage, the coach gave me technical advice and pointed out important details that really helped me improve.

Big thanks for that! The coaching team at this Muay Thai gym is incredibly strong and supportive.
I’ll definitely come back again.

reviews.name: ryan watson
reviews.text: Great session at this gym, all the coaches and staff are fantastic and the atmosphere is so good. Would highly recommend for anyone at any level of training. Best gym I’ve trained at yet in Thailand

reviews.name: mert şahin
reviews.text:
Rambong is a true warrior, and it’s an honour to train under him. He sometimes holds pads for you, gives instructions, and if you’re lucky, he even spars with you! I could only train for 3 weeks due to urgent matters in my private life, but those weeks were unforgettable. I can’t wait to come back and continue training.

The coaches at this gym are active fighters, and you can feel the real fight experience in every session. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Luke Child
reviews.text: I trained at Rambong Gym yesterday did too classes, was an awesome experience the team there are super welcoming and fun to train with, I got to spend time with Rambong himself who is super passionate and friendly highly recommend coming to train here if you’re in Chiang Mai and want a true Muay Thai experience

reviews.name: Freddie Maddock
reviews.text:
PLEASE do yourself a favour and come to this gym.
If you are here in Chiang Mai for a few weeks... this place will become your second home!
Very good people.
Rambong (the owner) is only 29 years old, actively fighting on OneLumpinee.
It is his family and friends running the gym.
Easy going classes... most of the time your 'group' class will end up more like a private session which is good...
You are not just a number here. You genuinely will improve your muay thai.
I am glad I found this place to train in Chiang Mai 👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Freddie!

title: FITFAC Muay Thai Sathon(สาทร)
ownerDescription: ค่ายมวยไทย สาทร ลดน้ำหนัก เวทส่วนตัว
address: ชั้น B1 Ascott Hotel เลขที่ 7 ถ.สาทร ยานนาวา, 7 S Sathon Rd, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand
street: ชั้น B1 Ascott Hotel เลขที่ 7 ถ.สาทร ยานนาวา, 7 S Sathon Rd
plusCode: PGCH+87 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Shamrah Ahmed
reviews.text:
Excellent Gym/Muay Thai academy with very good trainers and a great management. The location is perfect, too. Just a stones throw away from St Louis Station. And so, the area offers a lot more so you can combine your daily chores or meetings around your training schedule.

A special shoutout to Khun Nook who's doing a great job managing. He's helpful and eager to assist with every question and is very friendly.

The Sathon branch has many excellent trainers. A special shoutout to Khun Mark, who's been very patient and extremely encouraging. He's very well informed and knows his work really well.

Based on my observation, other trainers are very good too, and clients seem to enjoy being part of the academy.
As for Muay Thai, Khun Fluke deserves much credit for being very patient in showing the techniques as many times as needed without any hesitation. Despite the language barrier.
The atmosphere is very positive and the academy is very clean, well maintained and well equipped for its size.

And finally -for those who wish to get DTV, this is a very reliable and professional academy you can count on. They'll assist you throughout every step. Khun Nook is very well informed and always ready to assist you on this and has assisted many successful applications.

I'll gladly recommend it to anyone.

reviews.name: Bernice anna Toussaint
reviews.text:
I had an amazing 1‑hour Muay Thai beginner session with Instructor Bo, and it exceeded every expectation. As someone new to Muay Thai, I appreciated how Bo broke everything down into simple, clear steps without ever making me feel overwhelmed. The warm‑up was good not hard at all, and Bo kept the energy high the entire time.
He taught proper stance, footwork, and basic strikes  jabs, crosses, and roundhouse kicks all while giving real‑time corrections that actually made a difference. Bo has a great balance of patience and intensity; he pushes you, but in a way that feels motivating, not intimidating. By the end of the session, I felt more confident, stronger, and genuinely excited to come back. The gym environment was welcoming, clean, and beginner‑friendly. If you’re new to Muay Thai or just looking for a great workout with a knowledgeable instructor, Bo is the one you want. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Leo
reviews.text:
They helped me with my DTV visa, and I also received 9 months of training as part of the package!

About the DTV visa:
The visa process was very smooth and straightforward. They guided me through all the paperwork, helped me choose the best embassy for my application, and were always available to answer any questions I had about the visa process and immigration requirements.

About the gym:
The gym is excellent—modern, well-equipped, and staffed by highly knowledgeable trainers. It’s suitable for both beginners and experienced fighters. Every training session is tailored to your goals and skill level.

If you’re looking for intense training, you’ll get it. If you prefer a more relaxed approach focused on learning and technique, they can provide that as well.

Overall, I’m very happy with both the visa service and the training. I’m looking forward to coming back and training again! 🫡

reviews.name: Nicole
reviews.text:
I took my first Muay Thai class here and it was great. Everyone was friendly and my instructor, Got, was very encouraging. Even though we did not speak each other’s language he was patient when I didn’t understand and demonstrated what he wanted me to do.

He did not push me too hard and encouraged me to take my time and take as many breaks as I needed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your kind review. We’re so glad to hear that you had a great experience with your first Muay Thai class and that Got made you feel comfortable and supported throughout the session.

We truly appreciate your feedback and hope to welcome you back for another training session soon. Thank you for choosing FITFAC Muay Thai!

reviews.name: Steven Nelson
reviews.text: My Muay Thai experience today was nothing short of amazing. My trainer Gap was patient, he helped me to feel welcome, and he constantly gave me positive reinforcements during the training. I am now considering doing more Muay Thai and studying it more in depth even if only as a hobby. I can happily and honestly say that I will be back soon! I am very happy to have Gap as my trainer again if possible.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the great review. We will sure send your compliment to Gap. It will make his day

reviews.name: Bjorn
reviews.text:
Bo is an incredible coach! I took private sessions with him, and he significantly improved my skills in every aspect—technique, stamina, power, and sparring. What is special in Bo is his dedication: he pushes you to your absolute limit, squeezing out every last drop of effort to ensure real progress. His passion for teaching and commitment to his students’ growth is unmatched. I highly recommend this gym, especially personal training with Bo!

Thank you FITFAC team, thank you Bo! See you the next time 🙏

reviews.name: Tszkin Chow
reviews.text: Coach Get is super kind and fun! We planned to have 1 class to experience Muaythai and my son requested for another session with coach Get before we leave Bangkok! Definitely will comeback for another session next time!

reviews.name: Jordi Froidmont
reviews.text: I took a private Muay Thai class with Na today. I’m still a beginner and he really helped me to improve my technique, it was also a very good full body workout at the same time! Really recommend this gym! You also get a cool Muay Thai short for free if you book a private class.

reviews.name: Nate
reviews.text: This was my first Muay Thai class, but likely not my last. I really enjoyed the experience and Joe pushed me, while still being respectful of my limitations. 10/10 would recommend and I’m the shorts are cute too ;)

reviews.name: Julian Thomas
reviews.text:
Did a muay thai class here. Nice little gym tucked away under a hotel.
Class was well structured, with a separate section each for stretch, pad work, and some dumbbell work.
Different trainers for each, all were good.

The dumbbell work was taught well but the trainer combined shoulder and triceps together, which is generally not a good idea.
Triceps already work when you do shoulder press, so to stack them together just makes them both unnecessarily difficult, and makes your triceps overworked quickly.

Overall, good gym and good price for a class.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: World Traveler
reviews.text: As a paying guest at Ascott Sathorn Bangkok (Room 302), I am deeply disappointed by both the on-site services and the management's response to guest harassment.During my stay, I used the fitness vendor operating inside the property (Fitfac). Instead of a standard class, I was subjected to open mockery, athletic profiling, and deeply disrespectful behavior by their staff. Discrimination and harassment should never be tolerated under any hospitality standard.When I formally escalated this to management, they utterly failed to take accountability. Management hid behind the excuse that Fitfac is an "independent tenant" and refused to issue a refund for the toxic experience. They claim the "service was delivered," completely ignoring that the service involved targeted disrespect.Ascott Sathorn Bangkok is legally and operationally responsible for the vendors they allow onto their premises to serve guests. By protecting a rogue contractor over a paying guest, they have proven they do not care about guest safety or dignity. I am escalating this to CapitaLand Corporate Compliance in Singapore. Do not stay here if you value respectful service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We take all guest experiences seriously and have thoroughly reviewed this matter, including CCTV footage from the session.
Our records show that our instructor provided attentive, personalized guidance throughout your class, and that fellow participants were supportive and encouraging toward all guests. No concerns were raised with our team at the conclusion of the session.
We're sorry the experience did not meet your expectations. Our door remains open if you'd like to discuss this directly with our team.

reviews.name: Davide Del Ferro
reviews.text:
An amazing experience with so great teachers !!!
Every coach deserve a 5 stars.
I only did for one week and I felt so much stronger !!!!!
I trained with « BO » « JOE » and « JIMMY »
I will recommend Bo and Joe great coach !!!
Thanks to them I enjoyed so much to come everyday !! The warm up, the Muay Thai class the gym class !!
Really a big thanks, I know if I stay again around Sathorn I will come back there 100% !
I spoke with some French people, Japanese and Italian they have been training over 5 months at Fit fac and they love it !!!!
Kop kun khrap really !!!
Even my wife could kicked for 1’ and she was so happy see you again 🙏🏼❤️

reviews.name: JUNOR BURNS
reviews.text:
2 different days, 2 excellent Kru(s)! One corrected my tight form/stance, the other corrected my focus towards opponent when punching. I’m applying for the 5 Year Muay Thai Visa!!!!

Plus, I got awesome Thai boxing shorts!

reviews.name: J
reviews.text:
Had my first ever try on muay thai yesterday in Fitfac sathorn. In just an hour I was teached bunch of different punch, elbow, kick and knee techniques. learned trough some really nice warm up routines n stretches and even got to the ring to hit some pads at the end with everything i was teached to.

The 1on1 lesson got me right in to the action and was well worth for me. Also the shorts I got included seem very nice quality.

Will definitely try to get some more hours in here. Thank you for getting me a perfect first touch for my new hobby.

reviews.name: Hans-Gert Dahmen
reviews.text:
Did the 1 hour private sample training and it was so-so. They sell you small water bottles for the ridiculously high price of 20THB. For this price you can get a big bottle at 7-11. The private lesson includes a "handmade" shorts that they claim is 990THB worth. Yet the same shorts is sold for 299THB on Lazada and is made in China. You can not decline the shorts.
Overall the gym seems to want to make money off of you by selling you overpriced stuff.

The trainer did not speak english and he did not try to teach proper technique. Instead he played to be pushed back by my "strong" punches to make me feel good.

I've made better experiences with other gyms in the area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Sorry again for your unpleasant experience. Regarding the water price, we sell bottled water at 10 THB if paid by bank transfer and 20 THB if paid in cash. This policy helps us reduce the amount of cash handling.

We also provide free water refills, so you are welcome to bring your own bottle to refill anytime.

About the boxing shorts, some factories in China often copy our designs and sell them at very low prices on online platforms. If your priority is the cheapest price, you will usually find lower-cost options directly from Chinese factories than from any retail shop in Thailand.

As for the training, please understand that our instructors are real Muay Thai fighters. They have many years of training and fighting experience. Many of them come from humble backgrounds and may not have had the chance to attend school or learn perfect English — but they teach with heart, skill, and passion.

At our gym, we also make sure to take good care of our staff. We provide stable salaries, fair working conditions, and a supportive environment. Because of this, our prices may be higher compared to traditional local gyms that operate with very low costs.

We understand that you may be looking for a cheaper gym with perfect English-speaking trainers, and if the main priority is the lowest possible price, we might not be the best choice. Our prices reflect the quality of the environment (clean, air-conditioned, convenient location) and our commitment to supporting our staff.

reviews.name: Jennifer Elizabeth Pasang
reviews.text:
Located on the B1 floor of Ascott Hotel.

The trainers are friendly and the group classes are structured well- 30 min of warm up/basics, 30 min of pad work with a trainer (3 minute rounds), 30 min of workout with sports scientist.

It’s a fun way to exercise and try thai boxing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Takashi Kawabe
reviews.text:
I had 3 months contract for this gym.

Pretty hard to believe Kru Jimmy has still got great energy to teach.

Kru Joe was a funny person.

Kru Gap, Kru Na, Kru Fluke, Kru Bo, Kru Get, Kru Mos, Kru Shu, Kru Tom and all others were kind. They were seeing me that I am trying to do with everything I got. The training I have been through will never be forgotten. All scientists especially Kru Joe knew I was trying hard to meet their demands.

I hope for a visit next year or so.

reviews.name: Nik K
reviews.text:
Horrible experience and I think the only 1 star review I’ve ever given in my life, and definitely the worst experience I’ve had in Thailand.
Absolutely awful, unwelcoming instructor who said maybe 5 words during the entire 1 hr session, and who’s focus was somewhere else for 90% of it. Zero guidance or help provided with any of the “exercises” he showed. For a $60 1 on 1 session, you’d expect people to be helpful at the very least.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We understand your frustration and sincerely apologize for any lack of full attention from our instructors during your session.

While some of our Muay Thai trainers can communicate basic English for demonstrating techniques, they may not be able to engage in extended conversations. We appreciate your feedback and will use it to improve our service by carefully assigning trainers who best match our clients’ needs.

We will reach out to you via the email you used for booking to discuss this matter and find a resolution together.

reviews.name: megan
reviews.text: I brought myself the 5x 1on1 intro to muay thai lessons. I got free Wraps and boxing gloves with the package. All the instructors were very welcoming as soon as I entered the building. My trainer Gap was awesome very patient I had a lot of fun and learnt some new skills, even with the laguage barrier.  it's also a great workout while your visiting bangkok. Can definitely recommend

reviews.name: Martin Wilson
reviews.text: Nice gym and nice people but it’s disorganised and they are not used to people who only visit Bangkok occasionally. Started coming here recently when my regular gym closed down. I need a private lesson for an hour or 90 mins when I am in town. Wasn’t easy to organise. Booked with one instructor who I had before and arrived only to be told it’s his day off. Would have been nice to have had some continuity. The manager asked me to sign some paperwork then left me sitting until after my lesson had started. When I asked they found my instructor who was excellent.

title: Lanna Muay Thai
ownerDescription: Lanna Muay Thai is a Muay Thai boxing gym in Saraphi, Chiang Mai, Thailand, offering authentic training for all levels. The gym is the perfect place to learn the art and sport of Muay Thai from experienced trainers who live and breathe the sport. Lanna Muay Thai is dedicated to preserving the rich history and culture of Thailand, and offers a unique training experience that combines traditional Muay Thai techniques with modern training methods.
address: 177, Tha Wang Tan, Saraphi District, Chiang Mai 50140, Thailand
plusCode: PX7X+W5 Tha Wang Tan, Saraphi District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Taresa Lee
reviews.text:
If you’re not ready to train hard and have fighter mentality, don’t come.

My third year in Thailand with my students and been to many gyms.

Lanna Muay Thai gym trains their athletes HARD.

Private lessons - the coaches tailor the session to your fighting style and works on your weaknesses & builds up your strengths. Not just the basic standard combos and train you like a regular student. Our students learned lots of new techniques.

Group Class - INTENSE. Pushing the students past their limits plus more. Great fight camp. For one of the classes, they even taught all the students how to do the traditional Wai Kru dance. They end each class by bowing to the instructors and thanking your classmates.

They are great for beginners too - for all beginners, after warm up and stretching, they will pull you aside and teach separately.

reviews.name: K Sim
reviews.text:
An intense and amazing week. Thanks again to Lanna Muay Thai for this great experience.
Coming from a boxing background, I had no experience in Muay Thai.
Thanks to the professional, friendly, and supportive coaches, I’m leaving with solid technical basics and a strong motivation to keep training.
I can only recommend that you come and try it for yourself, like I did. The rooms are great, and on top of that, the food was amazing!
Thanks again!

reviews.name: Ethan Clark
reviews.text: Truly the greatest gym atmosphere I’ve ever experienced. Amazing coaches, incredible food, and many other likeminded people all working towards the same goal. I couldn’t recommend this gym enough if you’re looking to get pushed to limits and gain the skills to fight at any level. I spent a month here after a week training in the south and won my first fight. Boom and his team are extremely talented and will bring out the best in you. I will definitely be making a trip back and can’t wait to train here again. Thank you Lanna!

reviews.name: Tim Bearden
reviews.text: Lanna Muay Thai is amazing! I had an incredible three weeks there and would recommend it to anybody. The Krus are awesome and care a lot about your development, they'll push you past whatever limits you thought you had, you'll meet a bunch of great people from all over the world, and the food is delicious and exactly what your body needs. ขอบคุณ ครับ to everyone at Lanna!

reviews.name: Pierre Filotti
reviews.text:
Lanna muay thai is an amazing boxing camp !
The trainers are the best, very kind, understanding and friendly.
The rooms are great and clean.
I recommend and it's good for the price
However few details to know :

If you don't get the food with the place, you won't have anything to cook. There is a microwave only accessible at certain hours. You could order grab and store it in the fridge.

The location is quite far from the center by foot, get a scooter or be ready to spend good amount to get around with Grab.

The building we were in is the new building, it will be probably be very nice in the future which is why I still recommend but while we were staying they would work early in the morning, bring stuff over the days in our room that we needed etc

Overall the club is amazing !

reviews.name: Anthony Lai
reviews.text:
I’ve really enjoyed my time at Lanna.

I stayed here for a month and got their food package and met amazing people. Because of the location where the closest seven 11 was a 25 min walk away I managed to lock in with my diet and lose 7kg that month.

The only reason I can’t give it a 5 is that because of its popularity there’s just a bit too many people so sometimes the classes feel a little crowded. That said, it’s an extremely well run gym. And no mistake about it, a two hour class is properly two hours. The training is tough and you will definitely work hard.

reviews.name: olish xesh
reviews.text:
Amazing place.
Great atmosphere, good food, dedicated trainers, cool bunch of people training in the GYM, highly skilled Muay Thai sessions.
What do you want more.

reviews.name: Anthea Li
reviews.text: Initially hesitant because Muay thai is more my partner's idea of fun but coming to Lanna has been the best, sweatiest two weeks of my life - super accommodating for all levels of Muay Thai, friendly group class, AMAZING FOOD and super helpful private one-on-ones available too! My absolute goal is to be like Bruna, the most beautiful Muay Thai fighter around, one day ❤️ Big props to all the trainers, special shout out to Kru Ongsan, Kru Namsup, Kru Dtung and Master Boon!! Hopefully we'll see you again soon!!

reviews.name: Anna Pavlovich
reviews.text: Intense is an understatement. but everyone there is amazing. They are truly professionals and yet so friendly and welcoming. and as a sport it’s just so fun. The first few days will drain you but then you’re gonna feel good after each practice and you will get stronger. Wish I could stay longer

reviews.name: Tom McGowen
reviews.text: I’ve camped here twice. Most respected Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai. Come here if you want to fight OR if you just want to get in the best shape of your life. Particularly good camp for women too - Bruna the head female trainer takes good care of her girls.

reviews.name: Giacomo Morrone
reviews.text: Had a great time at lanna. Felt like a family very quickly. Training is intense and can be fitted to your skills. Beginnings all the way to pro fighters. Facilities are great. Slept there for 2 months and met great people. Thank you so much can't wait to return.

reviews.name: Houda
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time at Lanna Muay Thai!

I did both group classes and personal training, and it was by far the best Muay Thai experience I’ve had in my three years in Thailand.

The gym is always clean, and all the trainers and people there are super nice too, which makes a big difference. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.name: Dylan Rosales
reviews.text:
My stay at Lanna was incredible.
Right from the first class, I knew this was the gym I wanted to stay at in Chiang Mai.

Immediately greeted with smiles upon entering. Great vibes from the start. The classes are well structured. But incredibly challenging. 2h30m of training.

I have been training Muay Thai for 9 years, and have trained at a few gyms in Thailand, but this as by far been the toughest one so far.

The gym is pretty busy, so you have a decent amount of training partners to work with. Despite this, I never felt like I was lacking attention because there are plenty of trainers around always looking out for you.

Good mix of farang and Thais training. The Thais are extremely skilled, and working with them is such a pleasure as I was always being challenged. Certainly learned a lot from sparring and clinching them.

If you are looking to fight, Lanna is definitely the place to go. I was constantly being encouraged to fight, and was able to get my first fight in Thailand after 3 weeks of training with them.

Bruna is very lovely! She really takes the time to ensure you have a great time training at Lanna, and makes sure you’re taken care of. She always brings a great energy about her. Made me feel very at ease when I was going into my fight. Thank you Bruna!

After training at Lanna, I can comfortably say that my level of fitness rose substantially, and the experience I gained here was invaluable.
I cannot wait to come back to Chiang Mai and train and fight with Lanna again!

reviews.name: Joey Walker
reviews.text: Amazing gym with the best trainers! Feels like a family 😁 I spent a month training and living here, the best food, intense but great training, learnt so much, had a good laugh every day, met some great people.. could go on for ages 😂 so so glad I chose to do it and will 100% be coming back 😊

reviews.name: bonnie evans
reviews.text:
Lanna Muay Thai was everything and more
Me and my two friends (3girls) visited for a week we absolutely loved it.
The trainers were firm but friendly, we were a bit anxious for our first session but our nerves quickly faded as everyone was lovely.
We were invited on to watch everyone fight and great spirit very social.
Food is also amazing overall best Muay Thai camp ever !

reviews.name: Chemène Braad
reviews.text: I had 7 trainings here while being on a trip for 11 days. I absolutely loved it here and i was sad i had to go. The trainers are amazing and professional. I learned a lot from the trainings and i can’t wait to go back for a longer period of time. I absolutely recommend Boon Lanna muay thai. It’s the best and the vibes here are amazing.

reviews.name: Morgaine
reviews.text:
I visited Lanna Muay Thai last summer for a week and liked it so much, I had to come back. So I booked a month this year and extended for another 3 weeks.
The training itself is very hard but the jokes and achivements in between make it a lot easier and enjoyable. It feels very authentic, community-like and I really do recommend it!
Thank you LMT for the good time x

reviews.name: Mollie Bolton (MollieBolton42)
reviews.text: Started training here a few months ago and my friends and I really love this Muay Thai gym. The trainers (especially Kru Boom) are extremely experienced, knowledgeable and helpful in helping you to improve. We attend the group sessions twice a week and always thoroughly enjoy them - highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jacob Pickering
reviews.text: Incredibly good gym, kind people and great coaching, especially from the radiant beauty that is Bruna, her smile lights up the gym and all of our lives, my only complaint is that there’s only one Bruna there

reviews.name: Chris W
reviews.text: Stayed here for a month and can say this is one of my favorite Muay Thai gyms I’ve ever trained at in Thailand. The accommodations and training is excellent. The trainers are very skilled  and I feel anyone can grow as a fighter at Lanna with the guidance of these trainers. I can highly recommend private training with Kru namsap. Thank you Lanna Muay Thai. I wish I could’ve stayed longer.

reviews.name: Anthony Lizares
reviews.text: I'm a complete beginner. I felt welcome and not intimidated. The instructors are very knowledgeable and had a sense of humor. Like anything else, you get what you put into it. The same goes here. Class starts with calisthenics and stretching, next comes technique, hitting bags and pads follows, some light sparring, and lastly stretching and a respectful thanks by the whole group. I recommend bringing your own gloves if you're going for multiple days.

reviews.name: Wendy Wong
reviews.text: Fantastic Muay Thai gym — love the rooftop beautiful views, great energy, great training. Friendly staff & coaches. Will definitely be back when I next visit Bangkok !

reviews.name: Justin Vaughan
reviews.text:
I was staying on Soi 24 for a week, trained twice a day every day here.
Overall the classes, instructors and the setup is very good. Gym is well located and clean, rates are good especially if you pay for 1 week or longer term pass. Gym has a friendly vibe.
The 1.5hr classes are structured but can sometimes drift a bit, depending on the instructor. It feels like the instructors are wanting you to book private 1:1 sessions with them so they hold back a little bit in the group classes.

reviews.name: Amy Vong
reviews.text: The view itself should be a separate entrance fee lol. Last minute booking and was perfect! I thought it would be too hot but you get a nice rooftop breeze. Instructor was great, polite, and professional. Had nice skills, techniques, easy instructions. Facility super clean equipped with showers, locker rooms, snack bar etc. If you’re visiting for a week or 2 I suggest purchasing a monthly pass.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much!
We really appreciate that.🧡

reviews.name: Danny Razore
reviews.text:
Great rooftop Muaythai / Boxing gym! Covered roof but open air. Very good coaches and equipment. Price for open gym only 250thb! Good training for all levels

After boxing you can shower then workout at Unreal gym in the same building for just 500thb day pass. World class gym equipment and delicious protein shakes.

Thank you to all of the very kind coaches and staff krub 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much 
We’re really glad you enjoyed training at our rooftop gym and had a great experience with both iMUAYTHAI and Unreal.

Our coaches and staff truly appreciate your kind words.
Hope to see you back on the rooftop soon krub 🙏🔥🥊

reviews.name: Simon Voelkl
reviews.text:
The Kru at the gym are really good.  They make the training session very well-rounded. They have a fun personality and good eye on improving your technique regardless your skill level.  I think it was my favorite gym in Bangkok.

The receptionist is also welcoming and friendly.

reviews.name: Samuel Govinden
reviews.text: I stayed in Thailand for 5 months and this was the best Muay Thai/Gym I went to. The coaches are friendly and make you feel welcome, it's tough work but definitely the best place to learn muay thai if you're in Bangkok!

reviews.name: BangkokBoy2001
reviews.text: A Muay Thai gym that doesn’t smell. INSTANT FIVE STARS. Trainers spoke good English. Well-structured class. Would recommend.

reviews.name: Rahul Ganan
reviews.text: Amazing coaches and great group /private classes Definitely will come back again!

reviews.name: Tossaporn Kunlabut
reviews.text: This was my first time training in Muay Thai. It was a great experience and the trainer taught me very well. I really enjoyed training in Muay Thai.🥊🙇🏻🙏🏼 Thank you for giving me a good experience.🙏🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are glad to hear this and very grateful that you had a good experience with us.

Hope you come join us again.🙏😁

reviews.name: Quoc-Bao Ma
reviews.text:
So I did the week long group classes, which was pretty fun. The coaches are very patient with you. I met some people from around the world. The other students were all very patient with my noobie self. especially when we’re sparring. 10/10 recommend!

Show effort in your techniques and drive. If not, you’re going to be doing a lot of pushups and get roasted.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Glad to have you with us at iMUAYTHAI! 🔥🙏

reviews.name: Xabier MU
reviews.text: The attention to detail is unlike any gym I have ever been too. From the coaches to the lighting there is nothing like it. If you are ever in Bangkok this Muay Thai gym is a must. No matter what coach you get, the training will be a memory you treasure.

reviews.name: Kimberley Toh
reviews.text: Honestly chose this gym at first because it was pretty lol 🖤 Tastefully-designed rooftop space was lovely and breezy at night and recently expanded and renovated! Spent 2 months training here and it was the highlight of my trip:-) Friendly and experienced trainers who were able to spot even tiny errors and helped improve my skills!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We truly appreciate your support. 🙏🏻🤙🏻🥊❤️

reviews.name: Ryan Chan
reviews.text:
My wife and I wanted to try Muay Thai and found this spot close to our hotel. They got back to me very fast and booked us in for a class.

Amazing facility, top equipment and great environment.

Good service with friendly staff and super clean and comfortable gym for everyone!

I will definitely be returning whenever I am in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for you guys. We are glad that you enjoyed our classes. Hope to see you soon!!😉

reviews.name: Ano
reviews.text: I booked a personal Muay Thai Session (my First Muay Training ever). Great experience with a great Professional teacher. Really nice place for training, i can highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We truly appreciate your support.Hope you enjoy our place 🙏🏻🥊

reviews.name: Amos Aow
reviews.text:
I had the privilege of having three sessions with Kru Jack and I could not have asked for a better teacher. He is not only patient but skilled both technically and as a coach - this means that he knows how to teach you bodily cues to execute different moves better. He also pays attention to areas where you’re lacking in as well as constantly gives you tips on how to improve you movement, footwork, stance, balance, and technique.

Also, not to mention Kru Boat who took my brother for a private session and taught him many things which other coaches never pointed out.

In summary, apart from nice and friendly coaches, this gym is worth your time for the attention to detail these coaches give you - which in my view is so important to instil good habits and make this sport sustainable!

Thanks Imuaythai, I’ll definitely be back 👍

reviews.name: Ava
reviews.text: I booked a group class. It was my first ever time doing Muay Thai and 10/10 could not recommend more. The instructors are very friendly and speak great English. They started from the very beginning and focused on technique. I will definitely be back! Also the rooftop itself it amazing. Thanks so much to Jockey ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
That's so great; we are so happy that you love our program, and our place.

Hope to see you again in the class. Thank you.😁🙏🩷

reviews.name: Adwin Yee
reviews.text: Was searching for a Muay Thai gym and found this place near my hotel. Really love the view and environment. Responds from them was quick and detailed. The owners and all staff are very friendly and helpful. Learned many new techniques, from stretching, mobility to Muay Thai. Thank you all and hope to train with y’all soon；）

reviews.name: Tiffy Diary
reviews.text: I love training here because the trainers pay great attention to technique and never let me do anything wrong.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your support means a lot to our team! 💥

reviews.name: Anton Ackermann
reviews.text: Absolutely loved it! Great team from the receptionists to the coaches, everyone was friendly, welcoming and competent 😊

title: Suksabai Massage
address: 357 80 Buakhaow 15, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
plusCode: WVHJ+FQ Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: Martin Moser
reviews.text:
About a year ago, I had a massage here and unfortunately forgot my expensive designer sunglasses at the salon. When I came back this year for vacation, I visited again. After the massage, the lady actually remembered me and returned my sunglasses. I was truly touched and deeply impressed. You rarely experience this level of honesty and integrity nowadays.

The massages are excellent – very professional and deeply relaxing. The ladys
is incredibly friendly, helpful, and absolutely trustworthy. You don’t just feel physically relaxed here, but also genuinely cared for as a person. Thank you so much for this special experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Adam Ouellet
reviews.text: I went for a massage every day and im not talking about some "special" massage. Im talking about the best thai massage ever. These lady folded me like a pretzel and every day i felt bether.

reviews.name: Kristinn Leví
reviews.text:
Great massage parlor and this was the best massage I had in Pattaya. Went often and tried many variations and absolutely great massage, especially strong Thai massage. Excellent professional service and the girls with skills 10 out of 10.
Will definitely go there next time. Top massage parlor ✌️

reviews.name: Torque Hero
reviews.text:
A great place for a relaxing massage. Thai, oil, foot massage all of them are good. All the therapists are very friendly and talented ladies. The place is very clean. You’ll also enjoy a deeply satisfying massage, all for the same standard price.

Special mention: Patty. She is a great therapist. I was so impressed by her skills that I did not go to any other massage shop after that. Suksabai became my 'go to' massage place. If you're in Pattaya, I strongly recommend visiting this shop.

reviews.name: pympim
reviews.text:
Very Disappointing Experience at KIM Massage Phuket Old Town Branch 86

I usually go to KIM Massage, especially the old Robinson branch, with my family, and I’ve always had a good experience there. So when I saw that this new branch had opened, I decided to give it a try. Unfortunately, this was by far the most disappointing massage experience I’ve had.

I booked online for 1 hour of neck, shoulder & back massage + 1 hour of body massage, and was told that the online booking price was THB 950.

Here’s what happened:

1. When I arrived, I gave my name at reception and was shown the menu. I confirmed that I wanted the treatments I had already booked online. However, the staff couldn’t find my booking and asked me to show the booking details. At that point, I wasn’t even sure whether I had come to the correct branch.
2. The massage room was very small, and the massage bed was extremely narrow. There was barely enough space for the therapist to stand properly.
3. The therapist couldn’t remember which massage oil I had selected and confused my oil with my boyfriend’s.
4. The massage itself was very disappointing. The therapist mainly used her elbows, applying very strong pressure. However, whenever she switched to using her hands, the pressure became extremely light.
5. I specifically booked a neck, shoulder and back massage, but this area was barely focused on. The therapist spent less than a minute actually working on my neck and shoulders and mostly continued with a general oil massage.
6. Because the bed was so narrow, the therapist struggled to position herself properly. At one point, while moving my arm around, my hand hit the edge of the bed, and there were also several moments when my hand accidentally came into contact with the therapist’s foot.
7. Another uncomfortable moment was when the therapist started massaging my stomach without informing me beforehand. She suddenly removed the entire towel covering me. I personally feel that this should always be communicated to the guest first.
8. Interestingly, my boyfriend had a much better experience with his therapist. In my case, however, it honestly felt like the therapist was just trying to get through the two hours rather than providing a proper massage.
9. What disappointed me even more was the lack of follow-up from the reception staff. After the massage, nobody asked whether everything was okay or how my experience had been.

I eventually contacted the person I had made the booking with online. She told me that she was the manager and would look into the situation. The staff later spoke with my boyfriend, apologized to me, and arranged a refund, which I appreciated.

However, even with the refund and apology, the experience was still very disappointing.

As a Thai customer who has had many massages before, I know that this did not feel like a proper massage experience. Perhaps an international guest might simply assume that this is what massage is like, but for someone who has experienced many good massage places, the difference is quite obvious.

I also want to emphasize that the price itself was not the issue. The price is actually reasonable and within what local Thai customers would normally be willing to pay. The problem was the quality of service and the overall experience.

I still appreciate KIM Massage as a brand because my previous experiences, especially at the old Robinson branch, have been very good. That is actually why this experience at the new Old Town branch was such a disappointment.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously, especially regarding therapist training, treatment accuracy, guest communication, privacy, and the overall service standard.

reviews.name: L
reviews.text:
The ladies here were so lovely and friendly but I am leaving this review in the hopes that the staff see this and ensure their masseuses are correctly trained:
The woman I had massaged *directly* on my spine, especially on my lower back, for a very long time. You are always taught never to massage directly on the spine. I asked her to stop several times explaining I did not want her to massage directly there, and she would stop for a few minutes and then start doing it again. She used her elbow and forearm too, meaning it was even higher pressure. This messed up my back for at least a week and a half after, and not in a good way. If I had not stretched a lot daily to undo the impact, it would have been longer.

If somebody has existing back problems or a problem with their spine, something like this could definitely lead to a slipped disc or trapped nerve. It is dangerous and incorrect massaging technique, please educate your staff on this.

reviews.textTranslated:
Yoga teaches us how to reconnect with ourselves, and this studio is a place we want to return to… again and again.

This is a small studio filled with heart. Each teacher has their own unique style and teaching methods, all sharing their knowledge and experience with genuine care, making every class valuable in its own way.

The atmosphere in class is warm; teachers remember their students, offering attentive and detailed guidance. Fellow classmates are always ready to offer smiles and encouragement.

We believe that a good space isn't measured by its size, but by the feelings of those within it, and this place allows us to experience that clearly.

reviews.name: Natalie Tan
reviews.text: A bit expensive but definitely a good massage. I did the digestive system massage for my stomach bloatedness and cramps. Although the lady therapist did not speak English she was very solid with her work. Not distracted and focused on her job. I appreciate it when the staff do not get on their phones when massaging me and concentrate well. It is a short 5 minute walk from the BTS station. The receptionist was also kind to  let me borrow then shop’s telephone to make a call to my thai friend when I was running late for dinner at my hostel as she does not have whatsapp.

reviews.name: C R
reviews.text:
First of all, the price is very reasonable and the space is clean. Not a tipical fancy massage but who cares ?

Strong massage is their specialty, whoever handles you here. All therapists are well-seasoned. So if you like deep tissue massage specially if you do sport, you come to the right place.

I always get 90 mins oil massage and request either Khun Pa / Khun Sa.

reviews.name: adenah
reviews.text: Because it was almost time to leave work, the staff were in a bad mood and gave the massage very forcefully. This massage parlor almost broke my finger. It hurt so much. Nobody apologized, and nobody cared about me.

reviews.name: Dave Tan
reviews.text:
Review (POV of preference for stronger massage to solve neck and shoulder pain)

1. Cat [Massage: 5/10] Massage is mostly presses and squeezes in repeated motions. Doesn't customise to your pain points. Doesn't seem to really know where to press also.

2. Rin [Massage: 8/10] Puts in effort to resolve your pain. Somewhat knows where to press. Generally a good massage.

3. P'Taew [Massage: 9/10] Strong massage from start to end, strength is unlimited. Generally knows where to press especially where you tell her your aches. However, may be too strong for people starting massage. Neck pain almost resolved after the massage.

Still looking for the masseur who helped me pressed two years ago but can't seem to find. That was a 10/10 and pulled all the aches along my whole back up to the neck.

reviews.name: Peter T
reviews.text:
After reading all the good reviews, booked by line went for 1 hour foot massage and 2 hours Thai massage.

Foot massage is nothing to shout about, just very very normal, not worth to try (my own opinion). But the Thai massage is very very good. I told the lady my shoulder pain, she try her very best to massage my shoulder.

After finished the 2 hour massage I feel like I reborn with new body.
Totally worth to try. Will be back again.

Remember to do booking. Saw a few walk in customer being rejected due to already full house.

reviews.name: Luca Horak
reviews.text:

Thanks again, we‘ll come back tomorrow! :)

title: Thai cooking studio Phuket
ownerDescription:
Hello everyone :)

We will start the day with a local fresh market tour to shop for ingredients, try some Thai fruit, dessert and snack.
After a market tour, we will go back to the cooking studio.
When you arrive, we will serve a welcome drink (lemongrass tea with honey) as refreshment.
After that, I will introduce the main ingredients including vegetables, spices, and herbs.
Then we will start preparing and cooking 4 different authentic Thai dishes.
Afterwards, you will enjoy your own Thai cooking dishes. We also have a souvenir for you. It is a Thai cooking set (including herbal curry paste and seasoning) for you to cook your Thai food at home.

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Robert Pauls
reviews.text: This was a wonderful class. She explained things thoroughly and enthusiastically.  Started at the market to get fresh ingredients.  She was very knowledgeable of all ingredients.  Next we went to her studio and gathered ingredients and proceeded to prepare and cook four dishes. The instructor was very patient.

reviews.name: Sa Au
reviews.text:
Absolutely Recommended – A Highlight of Our Trip!

Our experience at Care’s cooking class was a true highlight of our time in Thailand. It started with a wonderful visit to the local market, where Care took her time to show us many different ingredients, explain their use in Thai cuisine, and even let us taste some of them. This introduction was not only informative, but also a warm and welcoming way to start the day.

Back at her clean and spacious cooking studio, Care continued to impress us with her knowledge, patience, and passion for teaching. She remained fully engaged throughout, always open to questions and explanations.

We cooked four delicious dishes, each one introduced step-by-step with clear demonstrations. Care explained the ingredients, spices, and preparation methods in detail, and then carefully supported us while we cooked ourselves. Her attentiveness made us feel confident and relaxed.

This class is a must for anyone visiting Thailand who wants to learn more about Thai food and culture. It’s especially valuable for first-time visitors, as Care shares so much helpful context that makes the whole country and its cuisine more approachable and understandable. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Nicola Forani
reviews.text: Looking for a Thai cooking class I found this in google, and I got really lucky! Chef Care is an amazing person so full of energy and positivity! On the way to the market during our conversation she underlined her passion for teaching cooking classes, and this passions in truly visible during the whole time you spend with her! The selection of ingredients at the market was amazing all those flavors and colors and she carefully explain you details that help a lot to understand what you will cook and what to expect! After moving into the kitchen the experience of cooking under her guidance shape the day in the most wonderful experience I have been inside a kitchen (beside the one with my grandmas)! the dishes were fantastic (kudos also to myself) and I want again thank Care for the amazing afternoon! Ka!

reviews.name: Paul Gifford
reviews.text:

The morning was very well planned out, with the visit to local market, where we learned very much about local Thai produce..
Care's new studio is open and spacious, very modern and clean (spotless).
Having spent time with Care and learning about her extensive cooking career, we knew we were in very good hands.
Dishes cooked on the day were delicious and authentic, which we sat and at after each course, rather than at the end, which we really enjoyed.
We will definitely visit Care again on our return travels to Phuket learning the fine art of some different dishes and recommend this class to family and friends.
Thanks Care for a wonderful day..

reviews.name: miemarc
reviews.text:
Today we had the pleasure of attending a private cooking class in Phuket with the wonderful Care, and it was an unforgettable experience!

From the moment we met and drove to the local market, Care’s professionalism and warm personality made us feel right at home.

We started by selecting the freshest ingredients, learning about local produce, which set the stage for our culinary adventure.

Throughout the class, Care guided us through the preparation of traditional dishes, including Tom Yum Goong Soup, Massaman Curry, Pad Thai, and the delightful Mango Sticky Rice.

Care's organized approach made the cooking process enjoyable and accessible, ensuring we felt confident every step of the way.

The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and Care's passion for cooking was infectious.

Not only did we leave with fantastic recipes, but we also gained a deeper appreciation for Thai culinary traditions.

We highly recommend this cooking class to anyone looking to immerse themselves in the flavors of Thailand. Thank you, Care, for a wonderful experience!

reviews.name: Ainsley Fuller
reviews.text:
Care’s class was exceptional. I booked the class with her via Whatsapp, her number listed on her website. On the day, she picked us up from our hotel, and took us to the local market to start the day. She talked us through all the ingredients we’d be using for the day, and answered all questions about fruits and vegetables we hadn’t seen before. She also got some things for us to try! The cooking class was amazing - the studio itself is so lovely, clean, open and inviting. It was great being able to book a small class with only 4 of us, compared to other classes that are usually large. The food we made was so delicious. Care’s instructions were so helpful and easy to follow. I particularly liked getting to eat each meal after we cooked it, compared to other classes i’ve done where you eat all the food at once at the end and it’s too much.
A particularly special highlight of the day was getting to meet Care’s cat, Oreo, who was so cute and funny! We would definitely come back to Care’s class if we visit again and couldn’t recommend it more. Thank you, Care!

reviews.name: 董悦
reviews.text:
Extreme Safety Negligence & Irresponsible Management - Avoid for Beginners
I am deeply disappointed with Pure Grappling Chiang Mai. My partner and I specifically chose this gym because the owner, Ryan, promised a safe, structured introduction to BJJ for absolute beginners. He explicitly assured us that safety would be the priority.
The Reality: In the very first session, after a minimal demonstration, the instructor immediately pushed my partner (a total white belt) into live practice with an experienced student. The partner used excessive force, illegally stripping my partner’s grip, which severely dislocated and injured multiple fingers on both hands.
The Management’s Response: Instead of providing first aid or taking responsibility, the owner (Ryan) and his wife simply left the gym immediately after class while my partner was in extreme pain. There was zero follow-up and zero accountability.
This injury resulted in three weeks of ruined travel in Thailand and months of medical treatment (splints and physical therapy) back home. Our fitness routine has been severely impacted.
Warning: This gym is NOT beginner-friendly. They prioritize ego and intensity over the safety of their students. If you value your physical health, do not trust their verbal promises of safety.

Update (Response to the owner):
Let’s look at the hard facts provided by the medical report (attached):
1. Medical Reality vs. Your Claim: The official diagnosis is "multiple interphalangeal joint soft tissue injuries" and "poor joint stability." This is structural damage, NOT "muscle sensitivity" as you attempted to downplay.
2. Failure of Supervision: The doctor ordered "3 weeks of rest and immobilization." For a professional coach to allow—or even encourage—a student with this level of structural injury to "continue training" is a severe breach of safety protocols and professional ethics.
3. Accountability: Stop gaslighting and blaming the student’s "physical condition" or "personal choice." The role of a coach is to prioritize safety over "atmosphere."
The splints and the medical report don’t lie. Your safety promises are merely marketing. Newbies, stay away for your own physical integrity.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re sorry to hear about your partner’s injury and wish him a smooth recovery.

From our records, this account appears to be based on second-hand information and does not fully reflect what occurred during the session. 

Our classes are structured and supervised, with controlled partner drills rather than unsupervised live sparring. Safety and proper pacing are always emphasized, especially for new students.

Our instructors were present throughout the session, and assistance was provided at the time the injury happened, including offering ice pads and advising him to rest and to suspend training if needed. We take student welfare seriously and do not leave injuries unattended.

As with any physical activity, injuries can occasionally occur, particularly where individual physical conditions may increase sensitivity to strain. 

Following a short rest after the injury, the participant with injured fingers chose to continue the session, which is always at the individual’s discretion. We encourage all students to communicate limits and train progressively.

We remain committed to providing a safe, respectful, and beginner-friendly environment. If you would like to discuss this matter further, we are open to direct communication.
_______________
Our second reply to your update:

In your review you said “The partner used excessive force, illegally stripping my partner’s grip, which severely dislocated and injured multiple fingers on both hands.”

But in the Chinese medical report it suggested soft tissue injury instead of “severely dislocated”.

I’m not sure what you mean by “live practice”, your partner didn’t get injured  during sparring, it’s a grip drill exercise at the beginning of the class. And it’s usually safer to practice with more experienced student. 

You said “Instead of providing first aid or taking responsibility, the owner and his wife simply left the gym immediately after class while my partner was in extreme pain” and 
“For a professional coach to allow—or even encourage—a student with this level of structural injury to "continue training" is a severe breach of safety protocols and professional ethics.”

This is self contradictory. If we “left the gym immediately”, how could we “encourage him to continue training”???

In fact, we gave him ice pads and asked him what happened, he said he didn’t recall that his partner did anything particular but out of somewhere his fingers got snapped. We asked him to rest and told him we can tape the fingers to avoid injury. This is the standard practice in a Gi class. He said he was fine and went back upstairs. We chatted with him for quite a while again later and before we left the gym we checked on him again. There were other people there who could prove this. he told us his fingers were fine after icing and he didn’t feel anything strange.

You said “This is structural damage, NOT "muscle sensitivity" as you attempted to downplay.” We never said "muscle sensitivity" in our reply. We said “as with any physical activity, injury can occasionally occur, particularly where individuals physical conditions may increase sensitivity to strain.” Probably there was some mistake in your translation APP/AI which led to this misunderstanding. 

Again We are sorry about the injury. But you were not there when things happened and what you said was not in line with the truth. This will just become a Roshomon event, as each side stands by its own stance. There are many factors contributing to injuries in a close body contact combat sport. There is no jiujitsu coach in this world who could Promise you that you would never get injured in the training. 

Wish your partner speed recovery.

reviews.name: Benjamin Chua
reviews.text:
I had the rare opportunity to have a private session with Instructor Bobby whom gave me so much guidance for my upcoming competition.

It was only a 1 hour private session but we managed to iron out a solid game plan to execute upon.

Great gym! Clean and near the airport. Will definitely return :)

reviews.name: John Mark Junio
reviews.text: Trained there for 2 days when i visited Chiang Mai on a long weekend. Cozy place that doubles up as a yoga studio and BJJ facility. It is very accessible from the old town and next to restaurants and coffee shops. The people here are warm and welcoming, especially Ryan, the head instructor. They teach great techniques and because it’s not a big facility, you will easily see and hear the instructions. I’ll definitely come back the next time i head back up to Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Sasha
reviews.text: Great gym for anyone who is just passing through Chiang Mai or for anyone who is planning to stay a while. - Ryan is a very technical instructor and explains the technique with great detail. Membership isn’t expensive and everybody is very friendly. Gym is clean and well taken care off. Yoga is free with a monthly membership and I would highly recommend trying the class.

reviews.name: Enrique Caballero Gonzalo
reviews.text: Wonderful place to train BJJ, either as a beginner, an experienced coloured belt, or for kids classes. Coach Ryan is an excellent instructor and him and coach Neroli have built a friendly, welcoming community. Classes are engaging and I always take something away from it. The instruction is excellent and patient, and everyone there helps one another. I will definitely recommend it to everyone who lives or visits Chiang Mai!

title: Sting Club Muay Thai Gym
address: 123, 1 Chang Lor Rd, Haiya Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXJJ+F9 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Gianluca
reviews.text:
Summary: This gym is for you if you are a slim beginner because one of the coaches will use your weight to motivate you.

I am a self defense instructor with 10 years experience in martial arts. The first out of the two sessions with this club was positive. However, the second was a disaster.

The session starts with very very fast stretching, followed by rope skipping. Then students are called by the coaches for pad work sequentially. First timers are separated from the rest for basic instructions on how to punch, knee, or kick. the rest is waiting for their turn and is doing nothing. Good for some break for beginners. Personally, I went for the bag and did some technical work in between the pad work. One time I was called for light sparring with one of the coaches which was fun, playful and technical. The session terminates with a bit of conditioning and quick stretching. A big letdown for me was that Muay Thai drills and techniques are not taught.

⚠️‼️‼️‼️⚠️
Now to the second disastrous session. I brought my girlfriend with me because it is very beginner friendly. However, after the session she told me that when hitting the bag during conditioning one of the coaches told her: "Are you hungry? KFC? burger? Coffee? Pizza?"
As a coach myself this is super disrespectful and you can motivate your students differently. After the class l told the trainers about this in front of the other students. I will not go again.

Now, we are super hungry after the intense session and will go to BBQ! 😉

reviews.name: Kai Bin Ho
reviews.text: Had an amazing time here, coaches are patient and detailed, they are passionate and supportive. The boxing gloves are sanitised very very well, totally no smell, really uplift the learning experience. Love the vibe here, strongly recommend coach Super ball and the lady coach. Other coaches are friendly too, everything here is awesome . Group class and private class , both high quality.

reviews.name: lewis bailey
reviews.text:
What a great experience.

I booked the 2 month 30 day class package. I'm a complete beginner

The trainers are friendly and spend a decent amount of time on techniques.

The pad sessions are intense but you can ask them to slow down of you wish.

I did a sparring session with another fighter and this was closely monitored by the trainer's.

There's always stretching and group cardio sessions during each class and this helps to build relationships with the other class mates.

I highly recommend this gym and wouldn't hesitate going back

reviews.name: Wing Lo
reviews.text:
All the trainers in Sting Club are super friendly and patient. Learning Muay Thai in this gym feels really encouraging which is suitable for beginners. I’ve been able to improve at my own pace without any pressure.

Special thanks to Kru Kit for his patience and guidance. I really appreciate the way he teaches.🙏🏻

reviews.name: Jarad Yeow
reviews.text: The trainers are super friendly and helpful. Was my first time doing Muay Thai. Learn the basics and did some circuit / pad work. Enjoyed it a lot. Worth the price and definitely would visit again if I have the chance ! a good workout indeed.

reviews.name: Noella Vang
reviews.text:
Let’s go!
My son wanted to change things up, and train in a group/class setting today.  STING trainer balanced the entire group perfectly…adjusting to various levels.

Trainer really held pads well, with experience and attention.  We will have to get a private session in while we are here.

👍🙏

reviews.name: Richard
reviews.text: This was my first time ever doing Muay Thai. I got in a great workout and was soaked w/ sweat by the end of 1 1/2 hours. Meou (?) taught me the basic footwork, punches, elbows strikes, knee strikes, and kicks. He was working with other people, so I had about 2 x 5 min sessions with him in the ring and 1 x 5 min outside of the ring. It seems like a short time, but the intensity made it perfect for a beginner. Because I’ve played sports before, I was able to grasp some of the skills and exercises. However, a person without a sport/gym/workout background might need more direction. It would also help if the gym gave an overview at the beginning since there were times in which I was unsure of what to do. But, I was proactive and made the most of my time. Great experience. I think I might go back 1-2 more times.

reviews.name: Zayyan Takieddine
reviews.text: My favorite gym in Chiang Mai out of the 3 that I tried. My trainer Ball was very friendly and taught me many new techniques without pressure. It was a great training experience and I will come back in the future

reviews.name: Thomas
reviews.text:
I used to train here often when I was living in Chiang Mai.
Out of the 5-6 Muay Thai gyms I tried in the city, Sting Club is one of my favorites.

It's a relatively small gym and can get quite crowded, but it has a great vibe and the place is clean and new.
Coaches are top notch and very friendly.

And membership is super cheap.
30 group classes for 4500 Baht, so 150 Baht/training.

reviews.name: Nicolas Rivia (Nico)
reviews.text:
So i've personally trained with all of the instructors in this gym for a couple of months now,

I'm pretty sure of my comments here on google before posting them.

Coaches

Maew
Phat
Cha
Chiang

These are the most active coaches in the gym and there are a couple of trainee coaches as well.

Different coaches have different teaching styles which students can benefit a lot from.

The basics are pretty standard but quite ingrained to their curriculum.

The combinations aren't the same as your typical muay thai gym, the combinations have multiple scenarios where you can apply them and pretty much repeated by the coaches for mastery.

I won't spoil their craft here! That's up to you to enroll and find out, but pretty much different coaches have the same standard for basics just different approaches for muay thai fighting.

5/5 in terms of equipment and cleanliness of the facility

5/5 in terms of coach competence and knowledge

5/5 in terms of timeliness

I'll put 4.5 for the beverages just because they don't have pocari sweat! 555

Will recommend for tourists and expats to train here.

If you're into western boxing, definitely a good place to train.

reviews.name: Yi Quan
reviews.text: Good for all levels! I had issues finding their account on LINE to make a reservation ahead of time, so I just dropped in for a group class like I did at the other gyms and they weren’t too happy about it.

reviews.name: Jessie Zhu
reviews.text: Favorite Muay Thai Gym in Chiang Mai! Very friendly coaches and great environment! Will definitely come back again in the future🥰

reviews.name: Jeff Lee
reviews.text: Super friendly instructors. Intensive and effective program. Highly recommended for all levels! Make sure that you make a reservation as the place seems very popular but only limited slots are accepted for the quality of the training.

reviews.name: Marie
reviews.text:
Great sessions suitable for all levels, with friendly instructors that make the experience enjoyable.

The workouts are really effective and guaranteed to make you sweat.

A big plus is the availability of showers, adding convenience to an already fantastic gym!

reviews.name: Anthony Han
reviews.text: Super clean and great coaches to work with!  Note: this gym has showers available if you need to bounce elsewhere after training!

reviews.name: Marcin Kaczorek
reviews.text: Great place, did 2 group trainings, one with sparring as well. 1,5h of well rounded Muai Thai experience. I highly recommend!

reviews.name: Paul Kluckner
reviews.text: I've been training for two weeks in sting club and I really enjoyed it; the trainers went to great lengths to teach me Muay Thai. The gym and the equipment was clean . I can most highly recommend private training with yuth. I would come again every time.💪

reviews.name: AyeChan Phyu
reviews.text: I’ve trained at a few places, but this Muay Thai gym is truly on another level! The trainers are highly skilled, patient, and genuinely care about helping you improve—whether you’re a beginner or experienced. What I love most is the supportive community—it feels like a family that pushes you to be your best. Whether you’re looking to get fit, sharpen your techniques, or just enjoy an authentic Muay Thai experience, this is the place to be. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ellis Head
reviews.text: Best gym I've trained at in Chang mai, the trainers will help you in every way no matter what your skill level is! Great prices, highly recommend.. 🥊

reviews.name: Sam
reviews.text: We had a beginner class and it was lots of fun! We would definitely recommend 😊

reviews.name: Jodie Hitchcock
reviews.text: If you're looking for a unique activity in Bangkok, I highly recommend the FitFac Muay Thai 1 hour 1:1 class. Nat was an excellent trainer who made the session fun, encouraging, and perfect for beginners. At 61 and only moderately fit, I surprised myself by completing the class and even discovering I still had some agility! A fantastic experience and a great way to try something new, plus you get a free pair of shorts to take home.
