reviews.name: Ricky Hamilton
reviews.text:
Training at FITFAC Muay Thai Phloen Chit was the best thing I did during my time in Bangkok. The first thing that hits you when you step into reception is how professional, clean and well-equipped the space is. Don’t worry about the language barrier if you’re an English speaker wither - they are totally fluent and well versed in introducing foreigners to the facilities.

I booked a five-pack, and then added another day at the end because I loved my experience so much!

I trained predominantly with Tao and he was absolutely incredible (HIGHLY RECOMMEND)!! My form and technique evolved so much in those six sessions. I also got the opportunity to train with Heng on one session who was also amazing and really challenged my skills and gave a great workout.

I’m leaving Bangkok with a new level of fitness and muay thai techniques. Such an awesome way to stay fit while travelling or even adopt it if you’re living locally.

I spoke to a few foreigners who I’d see come and go and everyone commented on how great the coaches are. They really make the place and experience - thank you!

… I can’t wait to come back!

reviews.name: Sreejita Deb
reviews.text: I did a 3 day intensive Muay Thai course here. Was impressed by how easy it was to sign up and schedule. I learnt a lot during the course on correct form and posture and technique - took time to undo a lot of bad technique from group kickboxing classes. What i didn't entirely love is that my instructor wasn't fluent in English so communicating was a challenge. It looks like a place that encourages tourists and expats so hopefully this can be solved.

reviews.name: Xin Hui Yeo
reviews.text:
I initially joined FitFac for Muay Thai, but what kept me coming back was the incredible weight training program and the amazing coaching! As someone who started with zero interest in lifting, my trainer Bank has completely changed my perspective. His patience, expertise, and emphasis on technique turned me into someone who actually looked forward to every session.

The strength gains I made in a short time didn’t just help me in the gym, they directly improved my pilates, climbing and martial arts performance too. Even though I still have a long way to go, the progress I felt was encouraging. Now, I can’t even train without hearing my trainer’s cues in my head!

If you’re looking for a gym that blends functional strength with skill (and coaches who truly care about your growth), this is the place. I’ll miss my sessions here, but I’m walking away stronger, more confident, and deeply grateful. Highly recommend!

Bonus: the gym is about 5 mins walk to a BTS station and you get Muay Thai group sessions included in the weight training package too so you can train cardio on top of strength!

reviews.name: Tanarin T
reviews.text:
From the moment I arrived, I asked the woman sitting at the front desk I’m not sure whether she was a coach or receptionist if I could go inside already. However, her tone and facial expression were quite unfriendly, which immediately made me feel uncomfortable.

After going inside, I waited several minutes past the scheduled class time without anyone checking on me or calling me, even though I was sitting in the usual waiting area. Eventually, someone came and said they did not know I was there for class.

The class itself consisted of around 30 minutes of stretching and another 30 minutes of boxing. The boxing coach was good patient, helpful in correcting my form, and clear with instructions. However, there were quite a few breaks during the session, so I did not really feel like I got to train fully.

After the boxing session, the coach told me I could go upstairs to the weight training area. However, when I went upstairs, there were no staff or trainers around for quite some time. I then walked into the weight room, and a woman who seemed to be a trainer approached me with an unfriendly tone and expression, telling me to wait outside.

I asked whether I should start training on my own or wait for further instructions, but the response was still quite dismissive.

Overall, I had no issue with the boxing coach. However, I feel that the customer service and communication process need improvement. There was no guidance upon arrival, I had to wait past the scheduled time without assistance, and there was also no clear instruction when moving to the weight training area.

Compared to the Ekkamai branch, the atmosphere and overall service at this branch felt much less welcoming.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your honest feedback. 
We sincerely apologize for the experience and will take your comments into consideration to improve our service. 🙏

reviews.name: Ae Kanjana
reviews.text:
I’d like to share a review for my son’s boxing class.
My son is 8 years old and started boxing to learn self-defense, stay active, and improve his focus and concentration.

He really enjoys the training and always has fun during each session. The coach is patient, supportive, and explains everything clearly, which helps my son stay focused and motivated.

He has completed 12 classes already and will be continuing with another 12 classes, as he truly enjoys the training.

Thank you so much to Coach Tui for making every session fun, engaging, and helping my son build discipline and concentration.
Highly recommended for parents looking for a safe and beneficial activity for their children. 🥊💪

reviews.text: Great MuayThai Gym! Easy to book online, with or without transport from your hotel; very stylish shorts are included. The 1:1 session with Trainer K.Phet was well organized and structured. As a beginner, I have learned the basics and was able to practice in the ring. Had so much fun! Definitely recommended! Thank you for this experience!

reviews.text: I booked a 1:1 Muay Thai session at FITFAC Muay Thai Phloen Chit and it was such a great experience. The gym had AC so the temperature was nice. The training area was very clean and so were the restroom and showers. My package included a free Muay Thai short which is such a nice souvenir to have from Thailand. My trainer that day was Khun Jade and he is such a nice and funny guy. He explained and taught me all the basics very patiently. We regularly made some short breaks to have some rest and water. I can definitely recommend this Muay Thai gym for newbies but also people having some experience. Thank you so much :)

reviews.name: Jamie W
reviews.text: I booked a private 1-1 class at FITFAC and thoroughly enjoyed my time, although I must disclaim that I’ve not tried any Muay Thai classes before. I think the trainings done were pretty basic and expected for a first timer. Khun Tui was my trainer and despite our language barrier, he made it really fun and was very encouraging. Some tips though - try not to book it on Trip Advisor as I severely overpaid. I would advise to get in touch with them directly. Also, their free shorts have limited designs and sizes. I ended up with a really unappealing pair of shorts that I probably would not ever wear again. Still fun though!

reviews.name: Otávio guastamacchia Valentim
reviews.text: I had very good experience and good insights with Pong! He made me pay good attention to foot work, stay focused while I do the exercises (good opportunity for me to practice my focus skills since I have adhd ), the important punches , kicks and elbow + made corrections to how I kick - it was really nice and made me want to get back to learning Muay Thai again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thanks for great review!

reviews.name: Brandt Bacha
reviews.text: FITFAC was great !! Very welcoming and were able to handle 4 kids with little to no experience. Each kid had a couch and had them engaged for the entire hour lesson. If you are visiting and are looking to stretch your travel legs just head on over and book a lesson.

title: Bodhi Tree Yoga Pai

reviews.name: Amy Horikoshi
reviews.text:
For bamboo studio
Mats & water provided so that’s nice.
But the studio is very noisy. You can hear the family in the back and all the roads. There is also no music or waterfall noise to create a better audience which I feel like is important for me in vinyasa Instructor is nice but unfortunately couldn’t get into the flow

reviews.name: Peter James
reviews.text:
Vanfa just started teaching here in Bodhi.  I've been coming for regular classes with Vanfa for over a month in Pai.
The most unique class I have ever experienced, her technique is about active awareness for the body, posture and opening fascia.
She is vibrant and makes the class fun and teaches from the heart, powerful and soft, God given ability.

reviews.name: Jay M.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the vinyasa classes here, it was strong and very beautiful flow. I've coming here for the last 3 years and never get enough. High recommend to take a vinyasa or power yoga with Prie, he is experienced and very good teacher.

reviews.name: C J
reviews.text:
I love coming to Pai and staying with Aisha and Holly at Bodhi Tree! The homestay is in a gorgeous teakwood house right in the heart of Pai - with great food and convinces just across the road.
They offer amazing Yoga and Meditation classes at all levels (included when you stay here) AND the doggies Mr. Fang and Kimchi are the sweetest (especially good for cuddles).
I loved feeling like family here and cooking meals for everyone in their beautiful kitchen, healing my body and mind with their extensive class offerings, and being able to walk anywhere within 5 mins.

reviews.name: Kushal Nichani
reviews.text:
Attendee the sound healing and the aerial yoga session , absolutely enjoyed both.

They also have another branch that has a cute cafe attached

Prea - the owner is a great teacher and the studio is super cute too. Well lit , well ventilated , clean mats as well(that’s difficult to find while often)

reviews.name: SUNNY K
reviews.text:
It was really nice greatful experience.
The studio is kind of inside with the roof.
Studio has few fans.
I had 10am and 5pm classes.
I din't feel hot.
It was perfect temperature.
I didn't see any mosquito both of my classes.
Also there is mosquito spray everyone can use.
Studio is clean.
Yoga instructor Elisha was super nice.
It was pretty much first time for me to try yoga.
She was kind and I had no problem to be a beginner.

reviews.name: Amy Creaser
reviews.text:
Tried the evening sound bath, expecting this to be peaceful and relaxing. Unfortunately this is based in the Home Studio which is different to the Bamboo studio where most of the reviews have focused.

Although the instructor and sound experience itself was great, the Home Studio is based on a busy road and the studio itself has 0 soundproofing. In the hour, we constantly heard bikes, cars, groups of people socialising loudly, music from nearby bars and dogs barking. It ruined the experience and was completely pointless to try relax and truly experience the session. No matter how much you try to ignore it the outside noise was a lot louder than the sound session itself and constant (a few bikes would be OK but it was all the time). The place really needs soundproofing.

I'm not quite sure why an evening relaxing session is based here. I wouldn't bother spending any money on this session. Try somewhere else!

reviews.name: Rich Love
reviews.text:
We stayed 10 days at bodhi tree. We needed some rest and yoga. A perfect experience with perfect timing.  🙏
We had the magical breathwork experience with Holly and kiki. Crazy! A true rebirth. Yoga technique to do with a good guide. Holly is perfect and there to welcome you.
Pai!!! Yoga, smoothies, art, difference, tourism, travelers.
We needed to get out of the madness of Chiang Mai and after the 762 curves we had the pleasure to discover Pai and its authenticity. Another madness. I invite you to visit this unique studio in its difference and professionalism. 🙏 Go to the coffee Paihigh next door with the rooftop terrace

reviews.name: Marco Novara
reviews.text:
There are two studios at this location, HOME and Loft, and they are both very nice, but Loft studio is a bit noisy cause it is right on the side of the road and has open windows.

Regardless, in the last months i participated to both acroyoga and yoga at Loft studio and i had good time without being bothered much by the noise.

HOME studio is more silent, with very different vibes, and i enjoyed the candlelight Yin Yoga and the sound healing events

reviews.name: Siti
reviews.text: Had an excellent beginner level yoga with a combination of meditation, breathing, vinyasa, hatha and yin by Elisha. Elisha made time to correct some of our poses and suggest variations. Small cafe at entrance. Highly recommended.

The instructor was very much agressive and rude to me and my friend, the location is terrible and i couldn't concentrate because of all the noise from the road, even tho it's says "aerial yoga" he started with saying we're mostly doing yoga and that aerial will be a small part of it, we stayed for 10 mintues because of how uncomfortable he made us feel in the situation and he still made us pay the full price and was also very rude about it.
Overall won't reccomend to my enemies to set foot in this studios, i came to relax and came out having a terrible time.

reviews.name: Yin TTC

One of the best yoga studio I’ve ever visited!
I have been visiting Bodhi Tree on and off for the last few years and I couldn’t say enough about how wonderful it is. The teachers are highly experiences and knowledgeable, the atmosphere is amazing for yoga practice. I am highly recommended to everyone to visit Bodhi Tree at least once when you’re in Pai.

reviews.name: Siobhán Gavin
reviews.text: I joined Monday mornings Vinyasa flow and absolutely loved it! I’m a beginner and found the approach brilliant as we were given different options of each exercise/pose. Really enjoyed it and would definitely recommend if you’re coming to Pai to chill ☺️

reviews.name: Tal Uziel
reviews.text:
Me and my friend went to a few classes while we were staying in Pai and we loved all of them, but there was one that was especially amazing
We took part in an ariel yoga class where Kushal was our instructor.
Kush was absolutely great - his explanations, awareness to the body and the feeling of security he gave us made the class a great experience!

reviews.name: הגר בריק
reviews.text:
I attended a yoga class here that was advertised as Vinyasa, but after I had already paid the high fee of 300 baht, the teacher announced it would actually be Hatha yoga with sun salutations and long static holds. I felt completely misled and very disappointed.

The teacher didn’t give any adjustments or guidance during the class, which made the whole experience dull, uninspiring, and not worth the money.

At the end, I just wanted to take five minutes to practice headstand and pincha on my own, but the teacher told me to leave. That was extremely frustrating.

Overall, I left angry, disappointed, and feeling like I wasted both my time and money. I would not recommend this studio

title: The Nest Pai Love
ownerDescription:
Welcome to The Nest Pai Love a heart-led wellness resort and retreat centre in Pai, Northern Thailand.

Nestled in nature and designed for deep rest, we offer 20 unique accommodations—including private bungalows, riverside rooms, and beautiful gardens—ideal for solo travellers, couples, and long-stay guests seeking peace, healing, and connection.

Our serene property features a beautiful riverside restaurant, natural swimming spots, and relaxing huts for lounging and unwinding. Guests are invited to explore daily yoga, meditation, breathwork, massage therapy, and personal growth workshops—guided by experienced facilitators in a calm, supportive space.

We’re more than just a place to stay in Pai. We’re a conscious community space rooted
address: The Nest Pai Love, Mae Hi, Pai District, Mae Hong Son 58130, Thailand
plusCode: 8F75+XQ Mae Hi, Pai District, Mae Hong Son, Thailand

reviews.name: Sophie Rose K
reviews.text: This was the most fun and freeing experience I had on my solo travel trip to Pai. Kailey immediately sets the mood with a playful mood filled with laughter and lightheartedness. This class feels extremely freeing with zero judgement involved. You get to swing around and learn new poses and act like the child you’ve always had inside of you. I am so grateful to have had such an amazing experience. The amazing view of the mountains and the sunset make the experience even more rich. There is also a delicious fruit smoothie at the end! Great environment, great people, and great energy. I couldn’t have asked for a better time! Thank you Kailey!

reviews.name: Nancy .S
reviews.text: I attended a sunset trapeze yoga session and it was phenomenal!! The whole session was super small and personal, and we were all encouraged to move with our bodies and play around which made everything really fun. We got to do loads of stretches and try some fun tricks which were were shown, and after we’re got to have a delicious smoothie by the lake. The overall atmosphere was so peaceful and joyful and a great experience to try out a new activity! Also a special thank you for helping me with my transport back to Pai town, after a miscommunication with my grab driver- it meant a lot to go above and beyond beyond to help me get it sorted in the best way for everyone :)

reviews.name: August
reviews.text: We saw something about a free yoga session on Instagram and when we arrived there were only one person except from us. He said he thought the yoga session was at 17:30, but then we talked to a lady who lived here, and she just started an incredible yoga session right then an there! We really enjoyed! 10/10! The location is splendid and we had an amazing experience. Thank you

reviews.name: J K
reviews.text:
Stumbled across The Nest whilst riding around Pai. Dropped in for a coconut water, and ended up staying for the rest of my time in Pai.

As someone who likes their quiet space (can't do hostel dorms anymore), I appreciated how the accommodation is split into little villas, with your own bedroom and bathroom.

The Nest is about a 5-10 minute drive from Pai town, so it's in a chill area, but the flip side is you do need a scooter or car to get around (but to make the most of Pai you need that anyway IMO)

I say it's quiet, there is a party spot up the road from The Nest, so two nights per week there's music. Fortunately they turn the volume down at 11pm, so it doesn't get in the way of sleep.

I tried out Kayleigh's trapeze class whilst there, and that was great. Less technical and more fun I had expected.

Would have tried the yoga too, but always had something else going on.

So yeah, thumbs up from me if you're looking a chill place to enjoy Pai. I'd happily visit again in the future.

reviews.name: Natasha Baker
reviews.text: Me and my partner booked a trapeze yoga class as it sounded like something different and fun. It was exactly that! Kayleigh was a great instructor, no pressure, the goal is just to have fun and let go. We really enjoyed the class start to finish and had so much fun. I would highly recommend trying it out, we had never done it before and now I want a trapeze of my own! Thank you guys ❤️

reviews.name: Chloe million
reviews.text:
Myself and my friends came to do the trapeze yoga class with Kayleigh, what an experience!
Kayleigh is an amazing instructor who doesn’t take herself too seriously, and really empowers this attitude into the class. It helped us have way more fun and enjoy the class so much more.
The view you get to experience while partaking is like no other, and it’s so peaceful and quiet - the only thing you could hear was how much of a good time we were having!
And the smoothie we were treated to at the end was a lovely touch.
Kayleigh and her partner have such a brilliant story on how they came to build such a haven, and it was such a pleasure to be a part of it.
Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Loïs Herkemij
reviews.text: We had a sling yoga lesson with Kayleigh and it was amazing! Shes very skillfull and will help you when you're stuck. Definitely reccomend if you want to try something new in a safe environment!

reviews.name: Daisy-may Carter
reviews.text: If you plan to visit Pai, this is a must stay! Located a very short trip away from the centre, this is a beautiful resort with a traditional feel. The staff are friendly and attentive. The view at dusk is breathtaking as this property is located in a gorgeous area. Your stay would be supporting a small business- and a very good one at that. The yoga classes are really good too! We had such a wonderful time. Thank you :)

reviews.name: Lutz Grimm
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 10 out of 5 stars – a true paradise from the heart

The Nest Pai Love is so much more than a resort – it truly feels like home.
Kayleigh and Shawn radiate an incredibly positive, open, and inclusive energy. Their constant good mood, laughter, and genuine care for their guests make you feel like you’re staying with very good friends from the very first moment.

Kayleigh’s yoga classes are professional, heartfelt, and filled with humor and deep empathy – a beautiful balance of presence, joy, and connection. Her love for dogs is especially touching: during my stay, there were nine puppies living at the resort for several months, creating a uniquely loving, warm, and inclusive atmosphere.

The resort is located about 12 minutes by scooter outside of Pai, right by the Pai River, surrounded by a stunning, park-like, and extremely well-maintained landscape. It’s the kind of place you don’t want to leave – you just want to lie in a hammock, relax, enjoy the peace, and cuddle puppies.

I was lucky enough to spend almost three months in this paradise and enjoyed every single day.
Highly recommended – 10 out of 5 stars! 🌿🐶💛

reviews.text: we got a booking confirmation yesterday for our yoga booking today saying, “get ready to come”. when we paid for our taxi there, AND paid for our yoga session we rocked up and were told it had been cancelled for months. we booked it one month ago and got a booking confirmation, yet by the time we got there, the workers were confused. bad communication on their part. do not recommend. super unhappy with the service and still yet to get a refund

reviews.text: The sunset Yoga class was amazing! Very friendly instructor:) Had a great time unwinding with friends and strangers. Would definitely recommend. Smoothie was great also! Beautiful place.

We recommend renting scooters, for which the hostess helped us alot! Easy 5/5, we are sad to leave

reviews.name: Sandra Scherer
reviews.text: I was here for the first time last year and met the charming couple who took over the resort the following summer. It's a very special place; it's absolutely beautiful, and the atmosphere is lovingly, relaxed and joyful. Both owners take care of everything, Kayleigh offer fantastic yoga, she is wonderful in everything she does! You can see that the staff are truly happy and contribute to this wonderful atmosphere. I could write so much more; it would fill a novel. The best thing to do is simply come and experience it for yourselves.

reviews.text: Our trapeze yoga class was amazing and so much fun! It was so lovely doing it at sunset followed with by a free smoothie next to the river. Deffo recommend

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience at The Nest Pai love. The location is absolutely beautiful, right by the river, with a peaceful and natural atmosphere. We joined a Yoga Nidra class, which was a very special and relaxing experience.

The whole place feels calm, authentic and thoughtfully designed. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a quiet retreat in nature.

reviews.name: Natasha Williamson
reviews.text: We did the Arial yoga which was amazing!!!! Was super fun to try and thoroughly enjoyed it, also got a delicious smoothie to finish off😊😊

reviews.name: Diane Mc hale
reviews.text: Amazing expierence doing trapezius yoga, which is 100% beginner friendly as I have never done anything like this before. Kayleigh our instructor was so friendly/calm and explained everything so clearly. Will definitely be back again!

reviews.name: Lisa Bristow
reviews.text: Amazing place where you can stay in nature and have quiet relaxation and rest. Met many people there who had come for a few days and stayed months!!I did the same, planned 4 nights and stayed 10. It’s out of town but easy by bike or the resort will order you a taxi into town.at a good price. The yoga was exceptional , the teacher Kayleigh is dedicated to the practice and sensitive to your needs, very encouraging especially in trapeze yoga. The food is amazing too! Highly recommend staying here .

reviews.name: Rasha Mediene
reviews.text:
You want to be secluded but not too far away from society? Want to stay somewhere peaceful with the river right in front of you and animals like cows and dogs roaming around? Like yoga, wellness and meditation?? Then this is the place for you!

Each bungalow has its own bathroom and baloney along with basic kitchen appliances.

The couple that run the place are so lovely! They’ll make you want to stay longer than you intended, don’t say I didn’t warn you…

Kayleigh offers free spirited yoga classes with a view! And there’s a restaurant on site.

They are located in between the hot springs and two huts. Not a bad place to be. But if you plan to be out and about more I’d suggest getting a scooter.

I loved how peaceful this place was. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.name: Sophie Wilcox
reviews.text:
We did the Trapeze sunset yoga and it was so much fun! Very lighthearted and welcoming. The location is beautiful.

Very nice activity to do in Pai at sunset!

reviews.name: Mieispalmmie
reviews.text:
After a long holiday,
the body may not feel quite right yet —
tired, heavy, or a little tight.
So I chose to learn Pilates to gently restore my body at Soulfit Pilates 🤍

Here, classes are one-on-one.
The instructor starts by checking posture,
observing how your body actually moves,
along with assessing muscle mass and body fat percentage,
then designs a program that truly suits each individual.

One session lasts 50 minutes.
The instructor stays with you throughout the entire class,
adjusting movements, guiding breathing,
and helping you understand your own body better.
(They even help take photos for you 📸)

After the session, there’s guided stretching —
leaving the body relaxed, comfortable, never forced or overworked.
You also learn how to prevent injuries,
which is essential for anyone looking to care for their body long term.

The studio is fully equipped,
and you can train on any machine.
Whether you’re a beginner or already familiar with Pilates,
the program can always be adjusted to match your goals.

Soulfit Pilates
is suitable for everyone — all genders, all ages.
For those who want to build strength, increase flexibility,
burn fat, tone the body,
and boost confidence through better posture.

There are shower and changing facilities available,
and you can choose your own class days and times.
It’s a kind of self-care that truly feels
intentional and just for yourself 🤍

reviews.name: Oh.Mommy2N
reviews.text:
A new Pilates studio has opened in the Ram Inthra area. It’s a franchise located inside Panya Market with convenient parking available. The place is clean and well-maintained, equipped with brand-new machines. There are restrooms and showers provided, along with shampoo, conditioner, and body wash — just remember to bring your own towel.

Drinking water is available for purchase, and the front desk staff are friendly and helpful in giving information. The studio offers private classes that can be scheduled directly with the instructor. There’s a special promotion for first-time visitors and discounts when purchasing multiple sessions. The instructor (Mine is Ms.Fern) is patient and gives clear, detailed guidance.
**The water heater is currently in the process of being connected to the electrical system.
** Studio is opened in October 2025

reviews.text:
ส่วนตัวไม่เคยเล่นพิลาทีสอย่างจริงจังมาก่อน จนได้มาเรียนกับครูเบนซ์ ครูสอนสนุกมากและใส่ใจผู้เรียนสุดๆ คอยโฟกัสและปรับท่าให้ตลอด รวมถึงแนะนำการหายใจที่ถูกต้องอยู่เสมอ ที่สำคัญคือครูเบนซ์คอยให้กำลังใจและช่วย push energy ทำให้มีแรงและความมั่นใจในการเล่นต่อ พร้อมทั้งคอยเซฟและดูแลเรื่องความปลอดภัยตลอดเวลา ทำให้รู้สึกไว้ใจและกล้าลองทำท่าใหม่ๆ ที่ท้าทายตัวเองมากขึ้น

อีกอย่างที่ประทับใจมากคือ ด้วยลักษณะงานที่ทำอยู่ทำให้มีอาการปวดเมื่อยคอ บ่า ไหล่ และหลังอยู่ตลอด ต้องไปนวดบ่อยมากๆ แต่ตั้งแต่ได้มาเล่นพิลาทีสมากขึ้น มีการยืดเหยียดอย่างสม่ำเสมอ แทบไม่ต้องพึ่งการนวดอีกเลย แถมหลังคลาสครูเบนซ์ยังช่วยนวดให้ด้วย รู้สึกสบายมากๆค่ะ

สตูดิโอพิลาทีสอยู่ใกล้บ้าน เดินทางสะดวก อุปกรณ์ครบและหลากหลาย ทำให้การมาเล่นในแต่ละครั้งไม่น่าเบื่อ ครูเบนซ์พาใช้เครื่องครบทุกแบบ และได้ออกกำลังกายครบทุกส่วนของร่างกาย จนทำให้แม้แต่คนที่เคยคิดว่าตัวเองไม่เก่งพิลาทีสแน่ๆ ยังเปลี่ยนความคิด และอยากกลับมาเรียนเพื่อพัฒนาตัวเองอย่างสม่ำเสมอ ชอบมากค่ะ แนะนำครูเบนซ์สุดๆค่ะ 🫶🏻✨
reviews.textTranslated:
Personally, I had never seriously pursued Pilates before until I started learning with Teacher Benz. She's incredibly fun and attentive to her students, constantly focusing on and adjusting postures, and always providing guidance on proper breathing. Most importantly, Teacher Benz is incredibly supportive and motivates me, giving me the energy and confidence to continue. She also ensures my safety at all times, making me feel secure and willing to try new, challenging poses.

Another thing that impressed me a lot is that my job constantly causes neck, shoulder, and back pain, requiring frequent massages. Since starting Pilates more often and stretching regularly, I hardly need massages anymore. Plus, Teacher Benz even gives me a massage after class – it's so relaxing!

The Pilates studio is close to my home, making it easy to get to. They have complete and varied equipment, making each class enjoyable. Teacher Benz lets me use all the equipment, and I get a full-body workout. Even someone who thought they weren't good at Pilates has changed their mind and wants to keep coming back for more classes to improve. I love it! I highly recommend Teacher Benz! 🫶🏻✨

reviews.textTranslated: The atmosphere is great. Teacher Fern is fun and very attentive. I came from not liking exercise and had tried many places, but I finally opened my mind to this place and it's fun and not boring at all. The teacher understands my needs and meets my needs perfectly.

reviews.name: Porntippa Sornchan
reviews.text: แฮปปี้บรรยากาศสถานที่ การสอนของครูทอฝัน ชอบมากค่ะ สอนเข้าใจ ละเอียด ใหีกำลังใจในคลาสได้ดีเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I'm very happy with the atmosphere, the location, and the teaching style of Teacher Torfan. I really like it. She teaches in an easy-to-understand and detailed way, and gives great encouragement in class.

reviews.name: MEW W.G.
reviews.text: หาที่เรียนพิลาทิสใกล้บ้าน พอมาลองที่นี่ก็ติดใจเลยตั้งแต่ครั้งแรก ครูเฟิร์นใส่ใจสภาพร่างกายที่มีการบาดเจ็บ คอยระวังและสอบถามตลอดว่าเอฟเฟคกับจุดที่เจ็บไหม สถานที่สะอาด อุปกรณ์เยอะ ที่สำคัญมีห้องอาบน้ำและเปลี่ยนชุด สะดวกมากเวลาต้องไปธุระต่อ
reviews.textTranslated: I was looking for a Pilates class near my home and tried this place, and I was hooked from the first time. Instructor Fern is very attentive to any injuries I might have, always careful and asking if I'm experiencing any side effects or discomfort. The place is clean, has plenty of equipment, and most importantly, there are showers and changing rooms, which is very convenient when I have other things to do afterward.

reviews.name: pakjira st
reviews.text:
สาขานี้บรรยากาศผ่อนคลาย เงียบสงบ มีที่จอดรถเพียงพอ เดินทางสะดวก

เรียนกับครูเบ๊น ครูเป็นกันเอง เฮฮ่า ทำให้ผ่อนคลายมากขึ้นค่ะ ทดลองครั้งแรกก็รู้สึกชอบเลยย 👏🏻
reviews.textTranslated:
This branch has a relaxed and peaceful atmosphere, ample parking, and is conveniently located.

I enjoyed learning with Teacher Ben; she's friendly and fun, which made the learning experience more relaxing. I loved it from my first try! 👏🏻

reviews.name: ดวงใจ เนตระคเวสนะ
reviews.text: เรียนพิลาทิสที่นี่ ประทับใจในบรรยากาศการเรียนกับครูภู่กันค่ะ ครูน่ารัก ใส่ใจในการสอน ละเอียดอ่อนกับการสอนในทุกท่วงท่า เรียนแล้วมีความสุข รู้สึกผ่อนคลาย สนุกทุกครั้งที่มาเรียนเลยค่ะ ผู้สนใจมาเรียนที่นี่แนะนำครูภู่กันค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I'm taking Pilates classes here and I'm very impressed with the learning atmosphere and Teacher Phu. She's lovely, attentive, and meticulous in teaching every movement. I feel happy, relaxed, and enjoy every class I attend. I highly recommend Teacher Phu to anyone interested in learning Pilates here.

reviews.name: Wanwii
reviews.text:
ส่วสตัวชอบเล่นพิลาทิสอยู่แล้ว แต่หาสตูดิโอใกล้ๆมีคลาสเรียนเยอะ อุปกรณ์ครบ และราคาเป็นกันเองไม่ค่อยได้เลย แต่ที่นี่ตอบโจทย์ทุกอย่าง ครูเฟิร์นใส่ใจรายละเอียดมาก ทุกท่ามีการปรับให้เหมาะกับระดับร่างกายของเรา ทำให้รู้สึกปลอดภัยและมั่นใจขึ้นเยอะ หลังเรียนเสร็จรู้สึกว่ากล้ามเนื้อแกนกลางแข็งแรงขึ้นจริง ๆ แถมยังช่วยให้ท่าทางการนั่งทำงานดีขึ้น ไม่ปวดหลังเหมือนก่อน

สิ่งที่ชอบที่สุดคือความสงบในคลาส เหมือนได้ใช้เวลาโฟกัสกับร่างกายและการหายใจของตัวเอง เป็นการพักผ่อนที่มีคุณภาพมาก ๆ ใครที่อยากเริ่มต้นดูแลสุขภาพแบบไม่หนักเกินไป เริ่มเรียนกับที่นี่คือเริ่ดเลยหล่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
I've always enjoyed Pilates, but it was hard to find a studio nearby with many classes, complete equipment, and a reasonable price. This place ticked all the boxes! Instructor Fern is very attentive to detail. Every pose is adapted to my fitness level, making me feel safe and confident. After the class, I really felt my core muscles were stronger, and it even improved my posture while working – I don't have back pain like before.

What I loved most was the peaceful atmosphere in the class. It felt like I was able to focus on my body and breathing – a very quality way to relax. If you want to start taking care of your health without overexerting yourself, starting here is a great option!

reviews.name: Snow Inargon (Snow)
reviews.text:
ตัดสินใจมาฝึกพีลาทิสที่สาขานี้ ซึ่งถือว่าโชคดีที่ตัดสินใจมาที่นี่ค่ะเพราะได้เจอ คุณครู Benz ที่ช่วยฝึกสอนท่าเล่นต่างๆ ได้อย่างดีและสามารถฝึกเล่นได้อย่างดีด้วยค่ะทุกๆครั้งที่มาที่นี่เหมือนมาเจอลูกสาวที่น่ารักที่คอยช่วยสอนคุณแม่ให้มีร่างกายที่แข็งแรงยิ่งขึ้น รู้สึกอบอุ่นใจและมั่นใจในการฝึกท่าต่างๆ
พนักงานที่นี่ก็มีความน่ารักมาก โดยยังคงมีความเคารพผู้ที่มาเรียนทุกๆคนด้วยการการยกมือไหว้สวัสดีทั้งเจ้ามาเรียรและหลังเรียน รู้สึกประทับใจมากๆค่ะ ซึ่งสิ่งเล็กๆน้อยๆ เหล่านี้เป็นคุณสมบัติที่ดีนะคะที่ทำให้ผู้เรียนรู้สึกอบอุ่นค่ะ 🙏❤️
สถานที่เรียนมีเครื่องมือครบครันและสะอาดทุกครั้งหลังจากฝึกเรียนเสร็จจะมีการเช็ดอุปกรณ์ที่ใช้ด้วยแอลกอฮอล์ทุกชั้นทุกครั้งค่ะรู้สึกมีความมั่นใจที่มาใช้บริการที่นี่ ❤️❤️❤️❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
I decided to train in Pilates at this branch, and I feel lucky to have made the right choice because I met Teacher Benz, who taught me various poses so well and helped me practice effectively. Every time I come here, it's like meeting my lovely daughter who helps me become stronger. I feel warm, secure, and confident in practicing the poses.
The staff here are also very lovely and respectful to everyone who comes to class, greeting them with a wai (traditional Thai greeting) both before and after class. I am very impressed by these little things, which are good qualities that make students feel welcome. 🙏❤️
The training space is fully equipped and clean. After every class, all the equipment is wiped down with alcohol. I feel confident using the services here. ❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: สิริรักษ์ สติมานนท์
reviews.text: เรียนกับครูไทน์ครั้งแรก สนุกมากค่ะ บรรยากาศเป็นกันเอง ครูตั้งใจสอนและเซฟดีมากๆๆๆ บรรยากาศดีสุดๆ ที่จอดรถเยอะ แนะนำเลยค่ะที่นี่
reviews.textTranslated: My first lesson with Teacher Thine was so much fun! The atmosphere was very friendly, the teacher was dedicated and very safe. The ambiance was great, and there was plenty of parking. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.text:
บริการดีจากเทรนเนอร์น้องภูกันน่ารักเป็นกันเอง
สอนเข้าใจง่าย สถานที่เรียนสะอาด Private มาก

Great service from trainer Nong Phu, she's lovely and friendly.
The lessons are easy to understand, the learning space is clean and very private.

reviews.text: เลือกมาฝึกครั้งแรกที่นี่ค่ะ ตั้งแต่มีนา ครูน้องเฟิน สอนสนุก เข้าใจง่ายค่ะ

Inside they have almost all equipments and music is not loud unlike some other gyms. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Frankie
reviews.text: I’ve been going to this gym for a little over 3 months now and I have to say this gym is well equipped for most needs whether you lift heavy or not. I really appreciate the row machine because I need low impact high cardio now if they got the ski machine that would be superb. Staff is friendly and even when it’s slightly busy you can still get your workouts in. The price is very comparable. Thanks for a great gym experience.

reviews.name: Mike Jaxcel
reviews.text: Price value and very good. But please careful with music choice. Some might not be for the gym . Need music that motivates ! Not loves songs…

Good range of equipment including two free weight sections, around three squat racks, and some punching bags.

Very well priced and the staff are very nice. Not busy at all in the mornings and seems to have a friendly culture

reviews.name: Syrristen
reviews.text:
It's a very nice gym. It has all the amenities you need. It also has a small corner to train muay thai which is really nice. The staff is friendly and polite, they sell some proteinpowder, creatine and pre workouts which is nice. It's airconditioned which is sweet.

reviews.text: Very well ventilated, ample Aircon unlike most other gyms I have been to in Chiangmai, big selection of machines, big space, little crowd in the morning, very clean. 100 baht day pass.

reviews.name: Thomas B
reviews.text: Good place with friendly owners. I’ve been going there for a year. Gym has AC and air purifiers.

reviews.text: Excellent well equipped gym.  Clean spacious facilities.  Good selection of weights, machines and cardio equipment. Muay Thai area as well. Only 80 baht for a day pass.

reviews.name: Andrew Hicks
reviews.text: Great spot, my new favorite Gym in the area. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Great range of equipment, everything you need and more. Affordably priced, AC gym. I'll be coming here as long as I'm in the area.

reviews.name: Jordan Park
reviews.text: Amazing gym outside of ton. Pro tip, get a place nearby. Has every piece of equipment you need for a great physique.

reviews.name: Jamie Lamer
reviews.text:
This gym is wonderful. It’s a small, family-owned business. The owners are incredibly kind & helpful. They listen to customer complaints to ensure a comfortable & safe environment for everyone.

The equipment is really clean, functions well, & they have a bit of everything for all your cardio, machine, & free weight needs.

reviews.name: Shamblesguru Smith
reviews.text:

When I was there, Sunday evening, only 5 others so COVID social distancing very easy.
Changing room with lockers (take your own lock) shower convenient.
Owner/ family .… really nice people.

I liked this gym!

reviews.name: Suwichak Finneran
reviews.text: Great gym, lots of machines, space, ac, and air filters. The owners are wonderful and lovely! One of the best gyms in Chiangmai!

reviews.name: Safi-Zar

reviews.text: This gym is great. The trainers are all very professional and treat everyone with respect. They make training physically demanding but also enjoyable. A 90 minute session costs 300 Bhat which converts to 12 dollars Canadian. I highly recommend giving this gym a try..
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you💕🙏

reviews.name: Pavlo Mykytenko
reviews.text:
I tried several Muay Thai gyms in Chiang Mai and had quite different experiences. Back home I already trained some kickboxing, so when trainers noticed that I had some basic skills, many gyms would often just let me do pad work without giving much feedback. In some places it also felt like they weren’t very interested because they knew I was only staying for a short time.

This gym was completely different. From the beginning the staff was very friendly and helpful, and communication on Facebook was quick and easy. The training itself was excellent. The trainer was very professional, pushed me hard, and made me sweat, but still kept the training fun and motivating.

What I appreciated the most was the attention to detail. The trainer showed me several new techniques, pointed out mistakes in my fundamentals, and clearly explained how I could improve them. That kind of feedback is something I really missed in many other gyms.

Another thing that stood out was the atmosphere. You really feel welcomed there and not just like another temporary customer. They take the time to work with you and make you feel valued, which makes you want to come back.

Overall it was a great experience and definitely one of the best gyms I trained at in Chiang Mai. A big thank you to the whole team and especially to trainer Kru Rit for the great sessions!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you 
Thank you for joining the fun at our gym🙏

reviews.name: gert
reviews.text:
Such a great fight gym!
For the beginners/tourist:
-they start easy/slow and focussed on fun, you really get to know muay thai here, in all its forms: cardio, fun, learn to use your body in a different way.

For the intermediate’s:
-they really care… the pas work is nit just pas work they give you some advice to work on, and they really want to learn you something.

The ambiance is not hardcore muay thai, but relexed and fun, if you want to go hard, the trainers will sense it and you wil get hard.

The cummunity arround the gym is great, we also eat together some times, and there the real thai culture is shown.

reviews.name: Michael Dyson
reviews.text: An amazing time spent training here. Came here for 10 days during my stay in chiang Mai. The trainers worked me so hard every session and corrected my errors. I had a mix of conditioning, pad work, sparring and recovery work. This is the place to come whether you want to learn as a beginner or fight as they help all abilities. My favourite part was how welcome they made me feel, a week here made me feel like I’d been here a year. I wish I wasn’t leaving but I will definitely be back to train. Thank you all for your guidance and pushing me. Respect🙏

reviews.name: Brittany Storniolo
reviews.text:
Great smaller gym with a nearly 2:1 student to teacher ratio, so you get lots of one on one instruction. Really chill vibe, and many class times throughout the day to choose from.

Excellent place to avoid the giant crowds of the more commercial gyms in town.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you

reviews.name: James Ding
reviews.text:
Went over with my bro-in-law and it was truly an amazing experience!

Trainers were technical and gave proper guidance in correcting my form, stances, footwork and strikes from knees, elbows, punches to kicks. Trainers will ensure your technique is solid before pushing you further every step of the way.

No limits! Had a blast and will definitely return again!

Thank you Jerome, Pong, Rit, Ton and Nott for my first Muay Thai in Chiang Mai before flying back to Australia!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you hope see you next time🙏

Group class is only for beginners. If you are intermediate level is not for you.

I tried the group classes in the morning and when I did pad work only 2 out of 4 trainers were really into their job.

Maybe a provate lesson is worth it

Thank you for organizing the fight and preparing me for it — you helped me level up. I’ll be back. Family.

reviews.text: Small size gym for Muaythai practitioner. The trainer will improve your game and give advice politely. The trainers know what they are doing. They are professional, calm and friendly. Great for family! Female friendly environment! Mr. Pong, the owner, is very kind and polite.

It’s small but good coaches.

Myself and my partner are beginners and We were both treated with lots of respect. Catch punches very well and would not get upset if we timed something wrong or misunderstood.

Very accommodating, it wasn’t busy so lots of time for questions and pad work with coaches.

Would recommend over a busier gym.

Wonder how it's gonna be on a smoky season. The gym is very clean, English speaking trainers with plenty of parking.

reviews.name: Martin Thomas

Without any doubt, the best place to learn and practice muay thai in Chiang mai.
Staff very kind, very focus to make you progress, and very professionel. I have a hips imbalance and the guys really took this in count to help me. Pong the owner choosed well his workers.
A really friendly place, good mood, good attitude, very clean and prices very affordable. It's twice cheaper as others gym if you chose one month training.
Thanks guys, it's really have been a great adventure here

reviews.name: Samuel Pilley

The trainers are great guys and really help focusing on your technique and have a laugh with you whilst doing so! I would recommend this gym to anyone no matter what you’re looking for this gym will welcome and accommodate you. Thank you guys!! Will be sure to return 🤙🏼🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you we will miss you and hope  see you again

reviews.name: Dantheminiman
reviews.text:

reviews.name: wan r
reviews.text:
​When I couldn't get a massage at the Let's Relax CentralWorld branch because they were fully booked, their staff was incredibly helpful. They called the Arnoma Hotel branch for me, which had an open slot.
​I went straight to the Arnoma branch, located on the 4th floor. It was so quiet and private. The staff was great, and they even suggested I shower before my massage. I was given a tablet to fill out a questionnaire about my pressure preferences and any areas to focus on or avoid. My masseuse was excellent and followed my requests perfectly. The massage ended with delicious mango sticky rice and herbal tea. It was the perfect, relaxing experience.

reviews.name: Amelia Yeo
reviews.text:
It was a bit hard to find the hotel, asked the BTS station staff but they gave us the wrong directions because they were not sure. On Saturday I went down to Let's Relax at Central World and they were fully booked. I called them again to book for Sunday but they were fully booked again. Read Google Reviews and saw that the next nearest alternative was this Arnoma Hotel branch. I called on Saturday night to make a booking for 2 people for the Dream Package on Sunday morning at 11am. The lady over the phone was helpful, I listed down the types of massages I wanted and she suggested the Dream Package. When we were lost and were going to be late for our appointment, i called and the lady kindly shifted our appointment time to 11:30am. When we reached Let's Relax at Arnoma Hotel, we waited for a very short while before a lady came up to us with 2 towels and 2 small glasses of pandan juice (which tasted nice and refreshing). We were then made to remove our footwear and change to their slippers. Payment for the package was to be made first, 850 baht per person, so 1700 baht in total. We then walked over to a small seating area for two people with 2 basins on the floor. Our masseuses washed our feet with soap and water. They put on the slippers for us and brought us into a room with recliner chairs. There, they did foot reflexology on us which involved wiping down the feet first, then using a balm to rub our feet and legs (all the way to the calves). They used some stone piece to poke pressure points at the bottom of the feet. Next, they did hand massage which didn't really help with the aches. The back and shoulder massage was done on a special sitting down chair where your face is placed on a circular pillow with a hole in the middle for you to breathe, it was honestly a bit uncomfortable and hard to breathe, especially since we wore our masks the whole time. The massage involved using elbows and it hurt and was sore afterwards. The "special" chair also kept creaking and I was better off getting the massage on the stool. The best part was after the massage they gave each of us mango sticky rice and tea. The massage was passable, the food was better 😅 the quality of massage is comparable with the Central World branch which I went to on Monday.

Getting to Let's Relax at Arnoma Hotel:
1) Take the BTS to E1 Chit Lom Station located on the Sukhumvit Line.
2) Follow signs for Exit 6 (Central World and Gaysorn Village)
3) While walking on the sky walk, take the exit on the right (somewhere before Central World) towards Gaysorn Village (R Walk North Walk).
4) Go up a small escalator which leads into a small mall (Gaysorn Village).
5) Follow signs for R Walk North Walk.
6) Take an escalator down (following the R Walk North Walk) that leads to Pratunam Intersection, Platinum Mall and Big C.
7) You will be walking on a covered bridge / skywalk. On the right, you will see Arnoma Hotel followed by Big C Supercentre. On the left below, you will see the main road and the Central World shopping mall across it.
8) Turn right into Big C Supercentre and take the escalator downstairs.
9) Follow signs for the Tourist Bus exit which leads you to the main road in which the hotel next to Big C Supercentre building is Arnoma Hotel.
10) Enter Arnoma Hotel and take the lift up to Level 4 where Let's Relax Spa is located.

Hope this helps anyone who wishes to go there.

reviews.text:
Too many things gone wrong.

TDLR: you are better off along the streets in regular massage places.

1) service : 1/5. would give zero if I could. We booked an appointment for four at 9pm and was told after collecting payment that they didn't have enough staff. That is already ridiculous. They said that earlier batches of customers ended later so there is a backlog. But that's not something that they should make other customers pay for. Customers should be treated independent of each other! How we responded was just accept it and wait the 15mins they asked for. Till this point, things were still salvageable. Then they dropped another update at 915 that they only had two masseurs that could start first. OK fine, I again accepted. The other two of us were there told at 930 we can begin. But nope, we started at 940 and the people washing our feet was the front desk staff, meaning that they had serious manpower shortage or a misstep in bookings.
2) massage : 2/5 maybe I am biased because I was already pissed. The massage felt rather weak and not done properly. This is the first time I didn't tip.

I think the worst thing is that this sits in the Arboma Grand Bangkok which is a 4 star hotel. This gives the hotel a bad name.

reviews.name: Daev Nygel
reviews.text:
I went here twice, the second time expecting better. Each time I was insulted and disappointed by the masseuses' behaviour, the boss's very noticeable prejudice and racism and the overall quality of service as a result.
(My last masseuse was "A" by the way. She is still on the website as of today. Total wreck!)
(I wouldn't choose "Orange" either. She's got a pissed, disgusted ugly look on her face for no reason and definitely ZERO quality!)

If you're WHITE or ASIAN and you look wealthy, the line-up is longer and girls and the boss are noticeably more enthusiastic and gushing and fussing all over you.

If you're dark-skinned or appear less wealthy, the line-up is just TWO or THREE bored and angry and dismayed looking masseuses most of whom will refuse anything you ask, leaving you with a disgusted girl who'll play with her phone the whole time and try to end the session within minutes.

This is so rampant all over Bangkok but to see it here, what should be a place of zero judgement, I was so revolted, incensed and disgusted by the establishment that I had to leave a review.

What a despicable stain on the beautiful city of Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We are concerned by the use of derogatory terms to describe our therapists. Such comments are hurtful and disrespectful, and we believe it is important to treat everyone with basic dignity.

Regarding your mention of our website, our shop presents an honest and genuine representation of our therapists and services. What customers see and choose is transparent, and we do not mislead or misrepresent our offerings.

We would also like to clarify that our team does not judge or provide different levels of service based on appearance, race, or background. We have been in this industry for many years and pride ourselves on serving all customers fairly and professionally.

We welcome constructive feedback about service quality, as it helps us improve. If the service did not meet your expectations, it is fair to state that the experience was not suitable for you. However, personal remarks about our staff’s appearance are unnecessary and unacceptable.

While we understand that not every experience will be perfect, we always do our best to ensure our customers have a pleasant and respectful experience. We kindly ask for mutual respect, as respect is a two-way .
 Thank you very much for choosing to visit us — although I am not entirely sure if you actually received our service, I am not sure if this is due to competition or other reasons. Nevertheless, we sincerely appreciate your support.

For your next visit, if there is anything you are not satisfied with, please feel free to inform to manager immediately so that we can make adjustments and provide a service that best meets your prefere

reviews.text: After two perfect experiences last year, I visited Boss Massage again today. In the early afternoon, there were many girls outside. Instead of letting me choose, the manager inside talked me into a recommendation without introducing me to the girls who where outside. Since the recommendation looked okay, I went along with it, which was a clear mistake. The girl exuded an unusual coldness for a Thai girl, didn't smile at me, and massaged me mechanically without any feeling. Apparently, the manager had paired up two people who were completely incompatible. After many massages, this was a completely new experience for me, and one that not everyone might want to have. The business model of pushing underperformers onto uncomplicated customers can earn a few baht in the short term. In the medium term, however, the company's reputation suffers, and overall revenue decreases, also for the manager and the other girls who do a great job.
