reviews.name: Eve Cockburn
reviews.text: Did the 11:30 beginner yoga with Kitty and it was amazing. Costed 300 baht the 1.5 hour class, with free taxi transport to and from the studio (though I ended up walking back on my own). Kitty was an amazing teacher, clear that she loves what she does and knows how to modify moves for different skill levels and flexibility. Overall, an amazing lesson in a beautiful studio and I would definitely it do again.

reviews.name: Melissa Prior
reviews.text: Incredible studio in a beautiful location! Holly runs Mystic Village with heart and kindness and brings a mindful trauma informed approach to the breathwork and yoga. The few sessions I did there had an incredible impact and i felt very safe and supported in the practice! Also there are beautiful dogos! Mr Fang is my fave 🐾

reviews.name: Gideon Hanse
reviews.text:
Incredible yoga flow and very good vibes!

Holly guided us through a super creative flow. Very well doable, but challenging enough, leaving space for deeper exploration or to take it easy where needed.

Perfect mix between activation and relaxation throughout the flow, with a deeply relaxing, beautiful soundbath with live singing during Savasana.

10/10 recommended!

reviews.name: Worldly Wander
reviews.text:
Mystic Village cultivates an atmosphere of calm. Whether you’re attending a workshop, a yoga class or retreat — you’re sure to embrace the healing energy of this beautiful place, experienced teachers and the magic 🪄 of pai.

Breathwork has been a transformative tool to understand past traumas and release old patterns/cycles.

Holly is a gifted yoga instructor. I was always leave her classes feeling a sense of ease, happiness and
bliss body state of being — Anandamaya Kosha ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Molly ⭐️🌸 We love and appreciate you so much x

reviews.name: Jamila Rota
reviews.text: Best yoga class of my life. Such a beautiful space with beautiful souls, including the dogs. Thank you!

reviews.name: Nir Shaharabani
reviews.text: I did many sessions with Denise, Omer, and Holly, and it was truly magical and amazing. Each session was meaningful, deep, and left a strong positive impact. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Eza Chowdhury
reviews.text: Holly’s breathwork healing sessions are profoundly deep and incredibly comforting. She holds space in such a trauma-informed and compassionate way that you feel completely safe to open up and release. Each session has led me to powerful realizations, deep introspection, and emotional release that have truly helped me move through heavy, negative feelings. I’m deeply grateful for her work. And Mystic Village—it’s pure magic.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Ah thank you my dear. You will always have a special place in Mystic's heart. Our doors are always open for you ❤️❤️❤️🌸🌸🌸

reviews.name: Olivia Campanella
reviews.text: Tried out yoga for the first time here and it was such a wonderful experience. The teacher made me feel so comfortable. The sound bath at the end was so relaxing. I’ll definitely be back ❤️

reviews.name: Sarah Ludwig
reviews.text: Stunning yoga studio! Loved that they pick you up in town and bring you out to the studio. Beautiful and serene setting - you can tell there was a lot of love that went into the design of this space. Holly's 1.5hr vinyasa flow and sound bath was exactly what I needed! Highly highly highly recomend.

reviews.name: Luna Pedreschi
reviews.text: Such a beautiful space and team!!! Its an absolutely beautiful shala and garden. I have loved offering workshops here and the whole team has high integrity and a lot of experience :)

title: Chan Thai Massage (จันทร์ไทย นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ)
ownerDescription:
Found in 1998.
Chan Massage is a long established traditional Thai massage provider located in the heart of the Pratunam shopping district (just a 30-second walk away from the Baiyoke Sky Hotel Viewing Deck). Though we may not be a 5-star massage and spa, we have forged a great reputation for high quality, high value and low cost massages. We specialise in Aroma Oil massage, Herbal Ball massage, Thai massage, foot massage and body scrub. Prices start as low as 250 baht for a 1hr foot massage. We guarantee that you will not be disappointed!

禅按摩是一个历史悠久的传统泰式按摩供应商，位于普拉塔南购物区的心脏地带（距离拜辽科天空酒店观景台只有30秒的距离）。虽然我们可能不是一家五星级的按摩和水疗中心，但我们已建立了一个伟大的声誉高品质，高价值和低成本的按摩。我们专门从事香薰油按摩，草药球按摩，泰式按摩，足底按摩和身体磨砂。1小时的脚底按摩的价格最低为250泰铢 我们保证您不会失望的！
address: 120/41 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
plusCode: QG3R+J7 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Z X
reviews.text:
Affordable massage with a standard experience. The place was quite busy during my visit, so it seems to be popular. Looks to me that every staff member has different techniques, so good luck.

Paid 250baht for 1 hour foot massage.

Overall, it is a decent option if you're looking for a basic massage at a budget-friendly price.

reviews.name: isabelle
reviews.text: super friendly staff and one of the best thai massages i have had. hitting the pressure points well. very affordable prices too. highly recommend

reviews.name: balaji rockz
reviews.text:
I have been in Thailand for 5 day... Gone for different shops...
Among those @chan thai massage was good 😊 for me...
I had foot massage.. by Sang (40 yrs of experience in massage)
absolutely they are professional.

reviews.name: Steve Low
reviews.text: Been here for many many years. Everytime back to BKK will come here for massage. It’s really good, no hard sell, no scam… just good old price worthy massage. The lady manning the counter has always been there even before pre-covid and have always been very friendly.

reviews.name: Mich Mara
reviews.text:
This is one place that I have been going back to regularly.
The staffs are friendly and place is clean.

Foot massage for an hour is only 250 baht.
Gave the masseur an additional of 250 baht for her dedication.
I was very happy to see her smile.

Total cost of 500 baht.
Happy customer, happy masseur.

Anyway, great place, great staff, great price!

reviews.name: JTB Hutt
reviews.text: Excellent foot and shoulder massage. These little old ladies really have excellent pressure without causing pain but still giving a proper firm massage. Would have love to come back. My best out of three massages on this trip.

reviews.name: peter liew
reviews.text: Massage was normal but service was good!  Price is reasonable.  1st floor massage area is not sound proof so you can heard traffic outside.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Peter for sharing. We will try our best to improve to be better. Regards, Goy

reviews.name: Zara Kettler
reviews.text: The masseuse just kept talking among themselves, even shouting across the room. The massage itself was sub par, used barely any strength. What made the experience worse were the customers next to me talking non-stop. Would not recommend.

reviews.name: Rabin Doolub
reviews.text: Me and my wife both had a foot massage. Place was excellent and they people were nice. Also had quiet signs, so peaceful and nice atmosphere. I had many massages, this place is worth a try. Thank you

reviews.name: Karolina Golembicka
reviews.text: Amazing foot massage, welcoming staff. We ware very pleased. Thank you

reviews.name: Duyen Nguyen
reviews.text:
We had this spot on the list by chance when watching a vlog from a renowned vlogger in my country, Vietnam. It was not too crowded when we stopped by. I definitely loved and felt so much pleasure with the smell and atmosphere there. The service staff were quite elderly and super friendly, which made us feel like we were at home when we were there.

The whole process was totally amazing and so much relieved. They also served hot tea after the massage to fulfill our experience.

It is worthwhile to pin this place in your next trip to Thailand.

reviews.name: Sherry Loke
reviews.text:
Another hidden gem right beside baiyoke sky hotel! Second time coming here when I'm come Thailand and last week I met a really quiet and strong masseur (ICE). Went for the 1hr foot massage the first day and ended up extending for another half an hour because dam shiok! ICE knows how to catch the sore areas perfectly! Foot massage comes with neck and head massage , strength was just right for me, whole body felt relaxed and loose after her service.
Went again the next day to try the balm massage, love it too but I prefer more of the foot! We had lots of talk the second time we went! She taught us many Thai words as well which was a really enjoyable experience! She had about 10-14years of experience in this line which you'll know after you try!  Definitely coming back next time!
Place was a little run down but still comfortable with good air-conditioning and experienced masseur. My friend got (JOY) as her masseur on the first day which was good as well! Second day that we went joy was unavailable and got another masseur which we forgot what's her name... Which she was very good and experienced as well according to her!
Also, please do tip your masseur whatever you can afford, it's not an easy job to be honest.

Overall would definitely recommend to try out at this humble shop! Front desk was friendly as well and speak/understands a few languages!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Kris
reviews.text:
Tried this place as the one I had planned to go had a long waiting time and this place had recent decent reviews.

Service to attend to walk in customer is good and the place was clean. However the massage done was too soft even though the masseur was informed to use more strength. I can tell that the masseur is just going through the motion with bare minimum effort and was likely tired due to long working hours.

Disappointed and will likely not return. Will recommend this place for anyone who likes a soft touch approach and does not like hard massage.

reviews.name: HAW-REN LEI
reviews.text: Friendly boss, clean place, not expensive price, good choice for taking massage

reviews.name: Melissa H.
reviews.text:
I had a Thai Balm massage - it was very good, she knew what she was doing. She straightened my cervical vertebrae and generally gave me a good massage. My friend actually had a foot massage but she also had her back and arms massaged.
Very good value for money!

reviews.name: hotaru no16
reviews.text: It's incredibly noisy. Why are they so inconsiderate of others?

reviews.name: Nirmal Agarwal
reviews.text:
I am a tourist and go in this place everytime whenever I visit Bangkok and till last time the spa was good and nice.

But this time the experience was not good. As therapist literally killed me with her elbow piercing to my back and my back is still aching since 2 days. She was doing as if, she is taking out her anger on me.

My bad Thai massage experience till date.

Instead of relaxing my body it is aching since last 2 days.

Looks like the therapist is either too old or not very professional.

I had told for good massage at starting not a massage with elbows piercing my bones and aching them.

Yes took 90 minutes therapy ended early.

Ambience , sleeping mattress are just not much comfortable.

I think next time will avoid this place if I get some good alternative.

reviews.name: Haris Dzulkarnain
reviews.text: Went there for my first ever foot massage, really enjoyed the experience! Good ambience, clean environment and the masseuse did a great job! My legs felt better afterwards. She even gave a bit of head & shoulders massage towards the end.

reviews.name: Martlet
reviews.text: Strong Thai massage. Ability to detect the stiffness of the muscles and worked on it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Appreciated very much for your kind 4 stars review.

reviews.name: Alesha Nazrin
reviews.text: Went on my first day in Bangkok and thoroughly enjoyed the massage. Felt so light and refreshed after. Came back on the 3rd day after trying out another massage place which I wasn’t as great as Chan’se. Will definitely keep this as a must go place when I’m back again in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Appreciated your time to review us. Thank you so much.

title: Crystal Spa (Line: @CrystalSpa)
subTitle: คริสตัล สปา
ownerDescription: Crystal Spa offers a luxurious and relaxing experience with professional spa treatments tailored to rejuvenate your body and mind. From soothing massages to revitalizing facials, we provide a serene escape to help you unwind and refresh. Our skilled therapists use premium products to ensure the highest quality service. Visit us to indulge in tranquility and wellness.
address: เหนือ, 1533/1 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PH8R+4J Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Steven Lujan
reviews.text: Excellent massage place. My therapist really knew what she was doing and worked hard to undo all the knots in my body. She was kind, patient and through. Definitely recommend and will be coming back. The girl in the picture was my therapist and she did a great job. It was so good I fell asleep on the spot.

reviews.name: Felix
reviews.text: I have been here twice recently and received very relaxing massage from two different therapists. I even falled asleep during the massage. Their technique and use of pressure is highly skillful. You felt like not wanting to leave yet after one hour. The atmosphere is fantastic too, neat and tidy. Go for it without any doubts.

reviews.name: shu shu
reviews.text: This place is a gem! I've been coming here a few times. Don't let the tiny doorway trick you! Once inside, it's a peaceful oasis, you cannot even hear the traffic or noise from outside, even though it's located right by the BTS! The massages have been 100% consistently good. The masseurs are strong and firm and hit all the right spots. I usually go for the Thai massage or stress relief (for back and shoulders) due to my tense muscles. And always come out feeling reborn.

reviews.name: Paulo Gaspar
reviews.text: Staff is great especially if you like serious hardcore massage. The facilities are clean and comfortable. Reception people are very friendly. It is very convenient as it is down the stairs of BTS Phra Khanong station. 90 min foot massage is my favorite.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It's really kind of you to say. 😊

reviews.name: Anthony Lam
reviews.text:
One of my favorites

Service is 11/10

The price is above standard prices and it’s worth it

Get a 90 min thai massage. You’ll thank yourself later

reviews.name: S R
reviews.text: Excellent and professional service. Had Swedish massage.. very clean, private room plus shower. Highly recommended!! Rice crispy and tea waiting after finished.

reviews.name: Besta
reviews.text: For my very first Thai massage in Thailand, they gave me a great experience. The place has a calming ambience, with professional staffs. ✨

reviews.name: Bảo Anh Vĩnh Thụy
reviews.text: The first time I tried Thai massage in Bangkok. It’s a beautiful place, and good services make me so comfortable

reviews.name: Mae T
reviews.text:
I'm so glad I stumbled upon this place and trusted the positive Google reviews. It was a wonderful experience, and I'm feeling completely stretched out and so relaxed now. The masseuse had a great attention to detail; she discovered my tight spots without me even mentioning them and went the extra mile to release the knots. I usually go for aromatherapy, but I decided to opt for the Thai massage this time, and I have no regrets – it was one of the best Thai massages I've had in Bangkok.

And yes, it's true that despite this place being right next to the BTS train station, it's absolutely quiet inside. All you could hear was the hum of the air conditioning. Give it a shot, you might even come back for the second time.

reviews.name: Timothy Dempsey
reviews.text:
Clean and professional massages, though I found the massages I had to be relatively light and on the easier side.
Maybe they were uncomfortable with a foreigner but I was hoping for a little bit more pressure and stretching which is something that I don’t ever request.
Well located though, and the facilities are very nice, especially the spa room.

reviews.name: Frida Staffansson
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place. Had the best massage and it was so relaxing. Would go back for sure!

reviews.name: Jayden
reviews.text: One of the best massage places I have been to in Bangkok

reviews.name: A S
reviews.text: The foot massage was so good it put me into a sleep trance where I was half lucid.

reviews.name: antonella bozoki
reviews.text:
Went as walk in today and it was the best choice ever.
The Price quality balance is insane, so worth it! A really big Thanks to Tip, the masseuse who Did an amazing foot scrub, foot massage in combination of a heated pad on shoulders.

She went beyond and massaged further my neck back area and stretched me too. Had a very long day/night travelling and she was basically an angel to my eyes.
I’m definitely coming back ✨

reviews.name: Connie Chow
reviews.text:
The experience was absolutely wonderful. I'd say it's the best in Bangkok!

I did thai relaxing massage, aroma massage and foot massage twice during my 6 days trip. The masseur are professional and the ambience was relaxing and comfy. Never enjoyed massage like this before. The tea and crackers are also tasty 😋

I'll definitely recommend to family and friends, and will definitely come again when I visit Bangkok again!

reviews.name: Elyce Behrsin
reviews.text: I go back everytime I'm in Bangkok! Perfect spot if you want something nice that isn't so posh it becomes not a Thai massage lol

reviews.name: kjnick suthipaet
reviews.text: One of the best spa in prakanong area. I’ve been using their services here again and again. I love their oil massage that has a real private room. The thai massage room and foot massage room are separated, they both quiet, clean and very relaxing. The after massage tea and rice cracker is cute and refreshing. No matter how many other places I tried, I found that this place is really the best. The service is consistently good to great. I pay more but worth it every time.

reviews.name: Anthony Carman
reviews.text: Had a fantastic experience for a one hour foot massage. It's lovely inside starting from having your feet cleaned, to the amazing foot massage that included head, neck and arms too. Then had a hot black tea and a snack waiting for me at the end. Would 100% recommend

reviews.name: arul
reviews.text: One of the better foot reflexology treatment I have been to in a while. Very nice and clean ambience

reviews.name: M NS
reviews.text: My girlfriends and I had an amazing time at Crystal Spa. Their traditional Thai foot massage is divine and a few of us doze off. The ambience is so relaxing and the staff are very friendly and honest! I forgot my necklace  and immediately they called me to say they found it. Thank you Crystal Spa for a wonderful experience with you!

title: World Thai Massage
address: 1/15 soi sukhumvit 39 sukhumvit Road. khlong Tan subdisyrict 14 ซ. พร้อมมิตร Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: 1/15 soi sukhumvit 39 sukhumvit Road. khlong Tan subdisyrict 14 ซ. พร้อมมิตร
plusCode: PHJC+F7 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: anonymous333
reviews.text: I was introduced to this massage parlor by an acquaintance and it was my first time. It's located near the Emporium Mall, so it's perfect for a massage after shopping. I chose a menu that included both foot and upper body massages. The staff spoke a little Japanese and were very friendly. The massage was literally amazing, and highly recommend!

reviews.name: Lyubomir Lyubenov
reviews.text: Great service and great Thai Massage went twice, and it was worth it. 350 THB for 1 hour is a very good price for the quality massage.

reviews.name: Ppl8y
reviews.text: Good service, All staff is professional Thai massage 👏🏻

reviews.name: Thomas A
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience. The foot massage was poorly done and it was obvious there was a lack of proper skills.

At one point, the masseuse even used a pen to massage my foot 🤨 which was honestly ridiculous and something I had never seen before. It didn’t feel professional at all and definitely not worth the money. I wouldn’t recommend this place 👎

reviews.name: Nattapong “Natalie” Nuamcham
reviews.text: Best Thai massage I have ever had. Hit all the spots and they know what they are doing. The review is coming from an actual Thai person and my partner aussie. ✨️🙏🏽

reviews.name: Howie
reviews.text:
If you've travelled to Bangkok looking for a good massage, it can be very hit and miss.

Luckily for me, I stumbled across a lady at the World Thai Massage parlour who knew exactly which muscle to manipulate to improve its mobility. She might be small in stature but never judge a Thai book by its cover. Ploy is her name and she packs a punch.

To set the scene, my back seized up after spending too much time in planes and cars. I am also recovering from a knee operation from 3 months ago to fix a torn meniscus. Although my knee has been repaired, the ligaments surrounding my knee needs a lot of work. After 2 sessions with Ploy, my knee feels incredible.

Warning: I wasn't sure if I was perspiring or crying during the massage. It could have been both but it was worth it.

reviews.name: Caroline Alexander
reviews.text: Went there with my husband on Sunday...at 7pm and we had been there earlier...we had different therapist last time... who was excellent... this time the experience was painful and horrible.  We had taken 2 therapies for 60 mins for foot and head shoulder massage and later extended for 90mins given that we were extremely tired.  The 2 young therapist assigned were talking and making fun throughout the massage and felt like they were takinh out their frustration on us. We are having pain 2 days later and have nerve pain as well.  Not going back ever and are warning to go there on your own risk. The old masseuse is very good... but the young ones don't know the therapies at all.

reviews.name: Justin Wong
reviews.text:
Overall, this was a solid massage with a strong massage therapist, but there are a few things that could be improved.

Today, I ordered the 1 hour shoulder + neck massage for 350.

Pros:
- therapist was strong as other reviews noted
- she did a very good job on the shoulders and a decent job on upper back and neck

Cons:
- I ordered a neck+shoulder massage but I received back and arms as well. Neck and shoulders were barely touched until last 15 minutes perhaps due to miscommunication
- the arm massage was ineffective, not a single trigger point was activated here despite roughly 10 minutes spent
- while strong, I would say deepness was lacking, the kind that makes you exhale involuntarily. Furthermore, trigger points could be more precise, especially for back and arms.

Again, a solid massage that has some room for improvement, 4/5.

reviews.name: Robert Crowther
reviews.text: I stopped in here by chance for a foot massage at a very affordable price. I wish I got masseuse’s name because it was the best I have ever received. Excellent (hard) pressure, with a lot of calf work. My feet and legs felt loose and nimble for 2+ days after. Nice, clean, relaxing place. Well worth a visit.

reviews.name: Sarah Lim
reviews.text: Fantastic service. They were experienced and strong but not painful. The 60 min foot massage is pretty much a full leg massage. It also included some leg and back stretching, shoulder massage and arm massage too. The place is really clean, quiet, and pleasant. There was space for all 6 people in my group.

reviews.name: Manisha Singh
reviews.text:
Service opted: Full body oil massage

The staff here is very polite, but, that doesn't compensate for the lack of skills. The massage quality is really sub-par. I had to ask the masseuse to stop after some time. I wanted to go get another one at a better place instead of wasting my time here as I was leaving Thailand the next day. But she insisted on using less pressure (There's also a huge communication gap).
The only difference after that point was, it was not painful, but it was very generic, no technique. My neck continued to hurt for a few days afterwards.

Some of the techniques used in the beginning were of Thai massage, my guess is they are trained in Thai massage and not oil massage.

I would not return or recommend this place for oil massage.

reviews.name: Stevie Tran
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a powerful massage, this is the place. The default starting pressure here is a 12/10. I’ve tried 3 other places that used a 7-8/10 pressure level, despite my requests for the “strongest.”

I tried the 2-hour foot massage and the 2-hour head, shoulders, back massage here. Different days and people, and I received 12/10 pressure each time without having to ask.

They took my brittle rice paper body and pulverized me into soft fluffy human mochi.

Edit: Went back for another 2-hour foot massage, had to ask for a little harder, and got pulverized with 13/10 pressure. Excellent.

reviews.name: DL
reviews.text: One of if not the best massages I’ve gotten in Bangkok. These ladies are strong and will make sure no knot goes unpunished. Make sure to come before 9/10 pm as they are always booked up.

reviews.name: Robert-Jan
reviews.text: I had a very nice massage at world Thai Massage. Friendly and quiet environment. Prices are good and they don’t push for anything. About how hard the massage must be, just tell them before or during the massage. I would definitely recommend World Thai Massage. 🙏 thank you

reviews.name: 保亨林
reviews.text:
If you tired come to world thai

If your body pain come to world tahi

I come from Taiwan,  travel lived near by world thai massage,  in 4 day i came 3 times

The master is pro ,they always know
Your “knot “  and handle it

When i finished the massage
I feel my governor and conception vessels  are smooth like the old Chinese film says.

I fell  i got a whole new body

Worthy to try !!!

reviews.name: Azmeer Idzagi
reviews.text: One of the best massage I've been to. Price is decently cheap and the masseuse really work on your selected area. And they crack ur joints too and that's a big plus.

reviews.name: Raphaël Drapeau
reviews.text: One of the best if not the best I had in Thaïland. Place is clean. Didn't even ask for strong thaï massage, more than I expected, also some technique I never saw before which were very good.

reviews.name: Mai Mai
reviews.text: Best place, clean and cheap price but high quality. I do food massage 30 mis (150 bath) and Thai massage 1 hours (300 bath). Staff can do strong so I really like. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Don D
reviews.text: Place is clean and people are nice. Affordable prices but the massage is very generic. Lots of oil and rubbing but little skill or relief. Won’t return.

reviews.name: R Henz
reviews.text: ordered the oil massage. it was the worst experience ever. the massage table was so small....the oil for the massage smelled like in wasnt used for years, and the masseur seeing me barely fit on the table didn't offer to change the table or something. just unprofessional. And the strangest thing they didn't even say sorry...

title: อนุรักษ์ นวดไทยเพื่อสุขภาพ Anurak Wellness Thai Massage

reviews.name: Анастасия Честных
reviews.text: This is where I received the best massage of my life. I booked a ninety-minute oil massage. It wasn't my first time visiting a massage parlor, and what impressed me most wasn't the preparation, the aesthetics of the place, the polite service, or the complimentary touches — though all of that was excellent too — but rather the therapist's actual skill. I wanted deep muscle work across my entire body, and that's exactly what I got. She beautifully released my hip joints, which had been locked up for years. It turned out the issue wasn't about stretching — it was about tension. A single session had an incredible effect on both my body and my mind. I can say with certainty that after the session, some fears, anxieties, and insecurities gently left me. I was lucky to end up with a highly professional and genuinely lovely woman. I had originally been heading to the salon next door, so I consider it a stroke of luck that I walked through the wrong entrance. In ninety minutes, she worked through literally everything, and in ways I couldn't have done myself — even though I'm quite good at releasing many areas through self-massage. The session was a couple of weeks ago, and since then a massive layer of accumulated emotional tension has lifted, freeing up an enormous amount of energy. The pressure was strong, but that's exactly what I wanted. I had no bruises afterward, even though I have fairly sensitive skin and blood vessels close to the surface. She also cracked my joints in a way no one ever has before, which made being in my own body noticeably more comfortable than before the visit. I will absolutely be coming back to this salon the next time I'm in Thailand

reviews.name: Theodore Washington
reviews.text:
I’ve been to hundreds of massage Spas across many countries. I’ve had 4 massages in Bangkok in the past 3 weeks. I’m staying at The Marriot Executive Apartments. I asked the front desk for a good massage spa. They recommended Chiang Mai.

I am sooooooo pleased with their services. Lew massaged me for three hours. I train a ton to maintain my health. I need a massage every week because of all the training pain and 20 plus years of stress on the body.

You never know what type of masseuse you will get when you’re traveling. It’s a roll of the dice. However, I am elated to have one of my best masseuse. She’s in the top 4 if not the top 3. Four of my top 5 are Thai massages.

One in Finland in 2022, Cebu Philippines in 2025, and two separate masseuse in Bangkok in 2026. Originally, I was to have a two hour massage. Typically, in the first 10 minutes I ask the masseuse for more time. I didn’t today. I haven’t had much rest in the past three days with traveling.

Lew offered and I didn’t hesitate. It was the best decision I made at a massage spa since living in Asia. Hands down she’s fabulous and deserves a second visit in a few days but maybe 90 minutes because I’ll be too sore.

Thanks Lew for one of the best massages I’ve ever had. I mentioned this to her. I don’t think she believed me. Now she can see how good she was for me and my body.

Theo

Tony’s approach is straightforward and focused. The setting is simple, but the quality of the massage is outstanding. The pressure was perfect, and I left feeling rejuvenated and ready for the next day.

What stands out is the value. For a very reasonable price, you receive a massage that rivals those of high-end spas. As others have noted, it’s an excellent value for money.

reviews.name: Markus Lichtenheldt
reviews.text:
Although I wouldn’t necessarily count myself as a fan of the Lancaster Hotel, I must admit that it houses an unexpected treasure. Nestled within its less impressive surroundings, the Viva Jiva Spa emerges like a hidden gem, offering a tranquil respite from the bustling Bangkok cityscape.

From the moment I stepped into this oasis of calm, I was treated to exceptional service. The serene atmosphere was as comforting as it was inviting, a stark contrast to the busyness outside. The spa rooms, each with their own shower and bathroom, are thoughtfully designed to prioritize your privacy and convenience.

My therapist, Khun Mayom, was a testament to the level of professionalism and skill at Viva Jiva. She consulted me on every detail—pressure, focus areas, and even the lighting—to ensure my experience was tailored to my liking. The gentle dimming of lights, the flicker of a candle, and an aromatherapy massage later, I found myself immersed in a profound relaxation I hadn’t thought possible.

The experience was beautifully rounded off with refreshing water, a hot cup of lemongrass tea, and traditional Thai cookies, a delightfully sweet finish to an overall extraordinary experience.

While the Viva Jiva Spa may come with a heftier price tag than the typical street shops, it’s an investment in high-quality treatment, unforgettable service, and true relaxation. Even within the unassuming Lancaster Hotel, the spa stands out as a shining beacon of tranquility and rejuvenation. A true hidden gem, the Viva Jiva Spa is not just a spa experience—it’s an indulgence that you will savor.

reviews.text: I went for 2 hours body scrub, Jacuzzi bath and oil massage. Super relaxing. The masseuse applied the right force during massage. The spa room was quite clean. But the towel I used had some red stains, maybe from scrubs, make me feel a little unhygienic.

reviews.name: Tom Anthony
reviews.text: Beautiful, tranquil spa. Spacious private room with shower. I had body scrub and 90 minute massage. A+.  Relaxing and reasonable!

reviews.name: Jesse B
reviews.text: I visited the spa and had a 90 minute Thai massage with Sao. It was pure bliss. 1100 baht well spent. Will visit again. I’ve been in Thailand for 8 years and this was a very good massage.

reviews.name: Bayana Iskandyrova
reviews.text: Oh my! What a great massage with a pre-scrub I had! The masseuse was very professional and knew exactly where I needed more attention. My neck and shoulders are forever grateful 😄 I liked their choice of oils and scrubs, the overall ambience is quite and calm. I will definitely going back once in BKK!

reviews.name: Carine Leung
reviews.text: Good massage therapy,  comfort zone and nice place.  Highly recommend to spa lover❤️

reviews.name: Jina Kim
reviews.text: Highly recommended!! Great service and spa. Quite ambience and great therapist, 7th floor of Landmark hotel.

reviews.name: liliths garden
reviews.text: The best massage I have had in Thailand. Ice gives a massage that relaxes all the aches I have had for years

title: Physique 57 Erawan
subTitle: ฟิซีค 57
address: 494 Phloen Chit Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
plusCode: PGVR+J8 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: C M
reviews.text: We attended a drop in class with Muay. I can only say that it was a highlight of our stay in Bangkok. The studio is upscale and the ladies change room is well stocked with everything you need. The class is challenging with our fabulous instructor doing the class in Thai and in English and giving personal attention to everyone. The classes are small and high energy. We absolutely loved this studio and especially Miss Muay. I have taken barre classes in North America and in Europe and this was the BEST. Next time we are in Bangkok we will be back!

reviews.name: Jessica Squibb
reviews.text: 10/10 Barre class!! I’ve done plenty of barre classes in my life and this was my first in Bangkok. Super challenging. Class was done in perfect English. Big appreciation to Paan the instructor who was amazing. Beautiful studio and changing rooms - can’t wait to go again 🌴🩷🫶🏼

reviews.name: Path PB
reviews.text: Choose carefully the instructor/class. One quite rude and even scold a newbie in the class. Remembe, good instructor = good class. Enjoy!

reviews.name: Lilly Winds
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the class at Physique Erawan
the energy, instruction, and atmosphere were all excellent. It’s definitely one of my favorite gyms in Bangkok so far. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a fun and effective workout experience!

reviews.name: Amanda Nio
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I recently had the pleasure of visiting a barre studio located within a luxury retail outlet in Bangkok during my trip. As a tourist looking to take a drop-in class, I was genuinely impressed by how efficiently and responsively their social media team managed the booking process.

For just 750 baht, I joined a morning class at 7 am hosted by instructor Nymph in English. Conducted in mixed language, the atmosphere was wonderfully quiet and private, allowing for an intimate focus on our practice with only a small group present. It was the perfect way to start my day, and I left feeling energized and accomplished.

Highly recommend trying this studio if you're in the area! You won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: Kanjanis Thumaprudti
reviews.text: I have been to this studio for almost 2 years now. Staffs are very helpful and caring. Classes here vary from basic, moderate to challenging. Instructors are very attentive to students as classes are limited to 12-15 people and they help customize poses according to each students’ level. Each month, there are activities which give prizes from skin care to snacks. Facilities are also clean and amenities are above average gyms in Bangkok. Parking is up to 4 hours and allow me to hang out in Ratchaprasong area after class. Overall, I’m very impressed and would continue coming to exercise at Physique 57.

reviews.name: Ravipha Selarak
reviews.text: Back here after released of the lockdown and curfew🥰 Classes are now restricted to 10/ per class. Alcohol sanitizers are provided. There is also more time gab in between classes for maid to clean.

reviews.name: Sammy Fish
reviews.text:
Very welcoming staff, professional and motivating instructors
Classes are amazing! My muscles turn to lava every time I join a signature class! You feel fully alive! Also, I love the post-class feeling of well-being & energy.
The studio is clean, luminous and has large and clean fully equipped changing rooms, with large showers. The service comes with towels, air dryer, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, rubber bands to tie your hair (in case you forget one) and lockers.
Great training centre. I love barre & Physique 57!

reviews.name: Tam T
reviews.text:
Great body weight workout. The staffs and instructors here are nice and friendly. Some instructors would tease you a lot to stop you from slacking 😅. They just want to keep you engaged in the class.
The workout looks simple but challenging. Instructors would give you tips for variations so workout can suit your needs. Slight change to workout can make it easier for beginner and harder for advanced members.

reviews.name: Nelly Rodriguez
reviews.text: Barre workout is amazing! I have tried this before  in US and this studio had even better work outs than the usual barre I was used to. The coaches are amazing and they are always personalizing the class, ensuring the posture and forms are perfect so you can reach your goals. Always pushing you! The front desk service is amazing and always very attentive since you enter the door!

reviews.name: wrny
reviews.text: Core class is just too much movement and less focus on the posture if we’re actually doing it right.. more like just matte cardio, haven’t tried Barre class yet tho

reviews.name: S S
reviews.text: Physique 57 made me get back to exercising again. The facilities are great, the location perfect. The teacher (in my case, Nooty) made the hour pass by swiftly as her class was fun, engaging and of course effective. This smart and creative method made me feel that every drop of sweat was worth it. My first Barre Workout experience couldn't have been better and I can't imagine anyone who would just be a first-timer here. Well done guys.

reviews.name: Taresa B
reviews.text: I’ve taken classes with 3 instructors so far and all of them are so full of energy and positive vibes. There’s something different from taking classes at other studios - while it burns like hell while doing it, you get that satisfactory feeling afterwards and you just feel great about yourself! I also love that the studios are very clean and well-managed!

reviews.name: Prim Uampornvanich
reviews.text: Amazing barre classes tailored to different levels from beginner to advanced. Staff and instructors are attentive and friendly. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: MD Chonni
reviews.text:
Don't underestimate the power of pretty girls (almost like no boys are allowed here.) If it's your first time here - get ready to be super exhausted! It's burrrrrrning inside.🔥

All the staffs and instructors are THE BEST! Soooooo friendly and attentive. Love it here, worth the pricey class.

reviews.name: Nanteera Witwutisak
reviews.text:
I never got bored of this place. Full of energy and fun always. This place makes me feel stronger and healthier than did any other place.

I had left this place for 2 years or so due to my job change, and when I came back, the energy level was even higher than before. Recommend!

reviews.name: Suthasinee Susiva
reviews.text: I have joined the beginner classes twice now, the instructors were very details on how I organized my body. The class was not too hard for me as I am not quite good on telling left and right. The beat is fun but i can’t follow though.

reviews.name: Ayu Andryani
reviews.text: Awesome workout while visiting Bangkok! Welcoming staff! Great instructor! Love it when they remember and called names to make sure you’re motivated and keep on going. Will comeback for sure when in bkk.

reviews.name: Yvonne Yan
reviews.text:
I have been to Barre in the US, Europe and Singapore. Physique 57 really stood out for me. Instructors are knowledgable, energetic, engaging and involved.

I may even honour them with the title of 'Best Barre studio in Asia!' Actually I feel it's the best Barre brand globally. Physique 57 have really raised and set the 'barre' high for this workout.

Keep it up!

reviews.name: Apiradee Maya Nicharat
reviews.text:
At P57 the most instructors allow you to reach your goals of building a beautiful, harmonious and strong body by providing challenging classes, expert advices on corrections and ultimately setting the ambience with a selection of music to set the tone of the sessions. Professional and impeccable classes that deliver.
Highly Recommend to all fitness levels

reviews.name: Tim Wong
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Ruenmai Massage School enough! It was such a pleasure meeting the teacher here—they are incredibly kind, patient, and passionate about teaching traditional Thai massage. My boyfriend took the 6-day intensive course, and by the end, he was able to confidently give me a full, relaxing Thai massage from head to toe.

The whole environment is so welcoming: the teacher is attentive, and the other students are friendly and supportive too. It’s clear they take pride in their students’ learning journey. If you’re looking to learn Thai massage in a genuine, hands-on setting with caring instructors, this is the place to go. We’re both so happy with how much he learned here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review—it truly means a lot to all of us at Ruenmai!

We’re so happy to hear that your boyfriend had such a positive experience with the 6-day intensive course, and even happier knowing he can now give you a full, relaxing Thai massage from head to toe—that’s the best result we could hope for 😊

Your kind words about our teacher, the learning environment, and the overall experience really touched us. We do our best to create a space that feels welcoming, supportive, and genuinely focused on each student’s progress, so it’s wonderful to know you both felt that.

We’d absolutely love to welcome you both back again. Please come visit us anytime for a refresher session—on us. It would be our pleasure to see you again and support your continued journey in Thai massage 🙏

reviews.name: Jeff Chang
reviews.text:
I had a great time at Ruenmai!
Ajarn Fon is incredibly patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about sharing the art of traditional Thai massage, which made the whole experience both enjoyable and rewarding.

The training is very hands-on, and by the end of the course I felt confident performing a full, structured Thai massage from head to toe. The teaching style is clear and supportive, with plenty of guidance and encouragement throughout.

The environment is also fantastic—welcoming, relaxed, and filled with friendly, like-minded students. It really feels like a place that cares about your progress and experience.

If you’re looking for an authentic, practical way to learn Thai massage with dedicated instructors, this school is an excellent choice. I’m very glad I chose to study here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind and thoughtful review!

We’re truly happy to hear that you had such a great experience at Ruenmai. Your words mean a lot to all of us, especially to Ajarn Fon—she will be so encouraged to know that her passion and dedication made a difference in your learning journey.

It’s wonderful to hear that you felt confident performing a full Thai massage by the end of the course. That’s exactly what we hope every student takes away—not just knowledge, but real confidence and hands-on skill.

We’re also glad you enjoyed the atmosphere at the school. Creating a warm, supportive, and friendly environment is very important to us, and it’s great to know you felt that during your time here.

Thank you again for choosing to study with us and for sharing your experience so beautifully. We truly appreciate it, and we hope to welcome you back to Ruenmai again in the future! 🙏

reviews.text:
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the massage school for the high level of education, the warm atmosphere, and the genuine passion for the profession. The training was well-structured and clear, with a strong focus on practice, attention to detail, and an individual approach to each student.

Special thanks go to Madame Fon. She is not just a teacher, but a true master and an inspiration. Her professionalism, sensitivity, patience, and ability to share knowledge deserve the highest respect. Thanks to her, the training became not only valuable but also a truly inspiring stage in my professional development.

I wish the massage school continued growth and prosperity, talented students, expanded programs, and new achievements. May your school continue to bring knowledge, confidence, and love for the massage profession!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We are truly touched and deeply grateful for your kind words. Your feedback means a great deal to us and is incredibly encouraging—not only for our team, but also for future students who are considering learning Thai massage.

Madame Fon will be especially moved by your message. She teaches with her heart, and knowing that her passion, patience, and dedication have inspired your professional journey is the greatest reward for her and for all of us.

We wish you continued success and fulfillment in your massage career, and we truly hope our paths cross again in the future. 🙏✨

reviews.name: Дмитрий Темерёв
reviews.text:
I recently completed a Thai massage course at Ruenmai Thai Massage School, and it was truly an incredible experience! The course lasts only 6 days, but it's very intensive and well-structured — perfect for anyone looking to gain solid skills in a short time.

Even though I don’t speak Thai, the language barrier was never an issue. The teacher is a true professional and master of his craft — he explains everything clearly, demonstrates each technique step-by-step, and makes sure every student understands and feels confident. He has a personal approach to everyone, creating a supportive and comfortable learning environment.

At the end of the course, you receive certificates in both Thai and English, which is a huge plus if you're planning to work internationally. The whole experience exceeded my expectations — great atmosphere, amazing teaching, and real practical skills that I can now confidently use. Highly recommend this school to anyone interested in learning authentic Thai massage!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for sharing your incredible experience at Ruenmai Thai Massage School! We truly appreciate you taking the time to highlight the intensive yet well-structured nature of the course, and we're delighted to hear that the language barrier was not an issue due to the teacher's expertise and personal approach. It's wonderful to know that you feel confident in the practical skills you've gained and that the dual-language certification is proving to be a valuable asset. Your feedback is invaluable, and we're thrilled that the school provided such a positive and impactful learning environment.

I called a lady called One and she arranged me a massage course for 7000 Thai Bhat. The course she said was 2 days 10 a.m. to 5.p.m. and 4 days 5 p.m. to 8.p.m. She said the course is with Teacher Fon.
I went there the first day and it was  not opened.  After a while a lady opened the door and didn't even look at me. I had to ask her who is teacher Fon. She said she is teacher Fon. Teacher Fon never welcomed me and had no smile on face. I paid the money.  Fon didn't give me a receipt.  But I asked for it .
I started the course and teacher Fon was more interested in watching her programs on mobile than teaching me.
Fifth day she stopped the course and said she doesn't have another student for the course.
I wasted my time, money and my holidays trusting the lady called One.

reviews.name: Steve Reilly
reviews.text:
Did the oil massage course here and found it so beneficial. Fon is very friendly and helpful. The management was also so helpful and compassionate with me too. They have such a generous business model where once your graduate one subject you can return for free as many times as you like to practice and get really good at the practice of massage.
I wish I had more time in Pattaya to come back.
Not really any point going anywhere else in Thailand, for quality, price, teaching standard and management this is the place you want to be.
Schools in BK and Chiang Mai I found seemed far more expensive.
Biggest blessings, May businesses like this be successful - honestly setting the standards for how all businesses should function.
Hope to be back to complete the Thai and foot course one day!

reviews.name: Павел Романов
reviews.text: Сегодня получил долгожданный сертификат по обучению Тайскому Традиционному массажу для здоровья. Обучение длилось 6 дней. Каждый день мы плавно погружались в процесс освоения техники, перенимали опыт, изучали навыки у прекрасных и мудрых учителей школы. Шаг за шагом - это очень просто и весело. Вам обязательно помогут и покажут лучший путь для достижения лучшего результата. За эти дни я совсем не устал, а скорее влюбился в это потрясающее место, научился лучше чувствовать свое тело и теперь готов двигаться дальше. Мое знакомство с этим местом не заканчивается, я буду возвращаться, чтобы улучшать свои навыки и практиковаться. Хочу выразить благодарность всем сотрудникам школы, учителям, моим однокурсникам, которые поддерживали меня и вместе со мной осваивали новую профессию. До скорой встречи!
reviews.textTranslated: Today I received my long-awaited certificate for training in Traditional Thai Massage for Health. The training lasted six days. Each day, we gradually immersed ourselves in mastering the technique, gaining experience, and learning from the school's wonderful and wise teachers. Step by step, it's very simple and fun. They will definitely help you and show you the best way to achieve the best results. Over these days, I haven't tired at all; rather, I've fallen in love with this amazing place, learned to feel my body better, and am now ready to move on. My acquaintance with this place is not over; I will return to improve my skills and practice. I want to express my gratitude to all the school staff, teachers, and my classmates who supported me and mastered this new profession with me. See you soon!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Congratulations on receiving your certificate in Thai Traditional Massage for Health! It sounds like your training experience was enriching and enjoyable. We're thrilled that you found the process simple and fun, and we're glad to hear about your passion for this practice.
We look forward to welcoming you back to further enhance your skills and practice. Thank you for your kind words about our school staff, teachers, and your classmates.
See you soon!

reviews.name: Николай Добров
reviews.text:
Ну что могу сказать, отучился в школе массажа хорошо. Учат замечательно, сами учителя приветливые, правда мало времени у меня было, для усвоения тайского массажа, а так по хорошему надо две недели где-то чтобы по максимуму все усвоить.

Вместо 5 дней учебы отучился 4 дня, потому что про меня забыли. Поэтому сразу берите телефон и за день два перед учебой напоминайте тайцам, что вы к ним идете на учебу. Ну так всё ок.
reviews.textTranslated:
Well, what can I say, I did well at the massage school. The teaching is excellent, and the teachers themselves are friendly. It's true I didn't have much time to master Thai massage, but ideally you need about two weeks to fully grasp everything.

Instead of five days of training, I only had four because they forgot about me. So, pick up your phone and remind the Thais two days before class that you're going to their place for training. So, everything's fine.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
It sounds like you had a really positive experience overall! It's great to hear you felt well-taught and appreciated the friendly atmosphere.

It's understandable that you'd be a little disappointed about the scheduling mix-up. It's definitely a good tip for future students to confirm their attendance beforehand.

Despite that, it's wonderful you still felt you learned a lot. And you're right, two weeks would probably allow for a much deeper dive into Thai massage.

Keep up the great work with your massage skills! I'm sure you'll be putting them to excellent use.

reviews.text:

#ถ้าใครอยากหาความอิสระให้ตัวเอง งานที่เป็นอิสระ เป็นเจ้าของกิจการได้ การมีวิชานวดติดตัว ไม่ว่าเศรฐกิจจะเป็นอย่างไร เราสามารถใช้วิชานี้เลี้ยงชีพเลี้ยงครอบครัวได้แน่นอนค่ะ
#ขอขอบพระคุณ คุณวรรณ ครูฝน และครูหมวย มากๆนะค'ะ ความรู้สึกมันเหนือคำบรรยายจริงๆค่ะ _/|\_ _/|\_ _/|\_
reviews.textTranslated:
I was impressed from the moment I first visited. The school owner is incredibly lovely. They gave us the opportunity to try a trial lesson before officially enrolling and offered many different possibilities. Once I started studying, I met some truly unique teachers! (lol) I gained more than just knowledge about massage. Teacher Fon and Teacher Muey are incredibly attentive to each student; they're like family.
#It unlocked certain things within myself that I was insecure about. It helped me get to know myself better, giving me positive energy and confidence that I can do massage. The teachers' teaching is easy to understand, and they made learning fun and enjoyable. I also made new friendships with lovely and friendly people here. I feel incredibly lucky to have studied here.
#If anyone wants independence, a career that allows them to be their own boss, having massage skills is essential. No matter the economic situation, you can use this skill to support yourself and your family.
#Thank you so much, Khun Wann, Teacher Fon, and Teacher Muey. My feelings are beyond words. _/|\_ _/|\_ _/|\_

reviews.text:
At first, I got a manicure, pedicure, and full body massage here, and everything was very good. I was really happy with the service. and I also had decided to be their loyal customer.

However, today I booked a hair shampoo with a 4-hand massage. The lady told me she couldn’t do it because she already had another customer, so she replaced me with another staff — which I was fine with. But during the shampoo, the new staff didn’t wash my hair properly. When I informed the lady about it, she asked, “I’m sorry, will you come back for my service again next day?” I said, “No, I will not.” After that, she handled my hair aggressively and rushed to finish, which completely ruined my hair.

I’m very disappointed with their attitude and service today. I will never come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your feedback and for being our returning customer in the past. We truly appreciate your support and are very sorry for your recent experience.

On that day, your appointment was scheduled earlier, but unfortunately you arrived almost 50 minutes late. At that time, our staff already needed to serve the next booked customer, so we could not provide the full service as planned. We sincerely apologize if this caused any inconvenience or disappointment.

Our team never intends to rush or make any guest feel uncomfortable. We will provide further training to ensure consistency in service and communication, especially in situations when timing becomes an issue.

We truly value every customer.
🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

Great explanation, good attitude, private, food included, with special uniform to use during the day spend there, book explaining the whole sequence of the massage. Had also the opportunity to listen the explanation of Sen Lines when I spend some time with the Thai massage course students and it was the best explanation I ever had, really easy to understand where the lines are.
This school exist since 20 years and if someone really wants to learn Thai and foot massage I think is the best place to start because they give a good base. Instead in the other schools either the classroom had too many students and just one teacher where the teacher would not correct you when doing the wrong moves. Or the teacher would not care to teach that much because he is tired of his job. So in Jera the teachers love what they do and take care of their business better than anywhere. 200% recommend this place and hope to come back and be able to learn more from them.

reviews.name: Joa
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about Jera Massage! My partner and I are in Chiang Mai for one month and knew we wanted to learn some Thai massage. I had researched a lot of places in the area and visited a couple, but I think it’s hard to beat Jera Massage school in terms of value for your money.

To begin with, we wanted to come visit the place before we committed to it. The day we were supposed to visit we had a really hectic day so we weren’t going to make it before they closed. I messaged them asking if they can stay open a bit longer for us and Wi was super kind and waited for us and told us to take our time. This alone already made a great first impression. When we arrived at the place, they were talking to a couple of other potential students but gave us a warm welcome and made us part of the group immediately. Ai and Wi were both so personable and made us feel comfortable and thoroughly went over what we will learn over the next five days. This interaction made us feel like we were making the right decision so we signed up and got started the next day.

The next five days were a lot of fun and we learned a lot! It was a small intimate setting (first 3 days were 4 individuals/2 pairs and the last two days was just me and my partner). The set up was more or less the following: Ai would go through a set of massages, giving us detailed explanation on how to perform it and who it/isn’t good for. She would select one of us for each set of massages so we could all get some exposure to what it should feel like when done properly. Afterwards we would practice with our partner while an instructor watched carefully how we did each move, and they were very much paying attention at all times 😂 one small wrong movement and Nancy was quick to say “uh uh!” and correct me which made me feel assured that I was learning things properly. If you (or your partner) felt like you were doing the move incorrectly, Ai would come over and give hands on tutorial so you could feel it again on your body. I think at a bigger school with more students this would have been difficult. After 5 days, I feel much more confident in my massage skills and could give a 1-1.5 hr massage. Also a big plus that is worth mentioning is that the room has AC! We had two fans and an AC running during our classes. It was still warm at times bc giving a massage is basically a full body work out 😂 but I can’t imagine what it would have been like without the AC.

Another thing I really appreciated was that we were provided with lunch everyday. This allowed us to eat and relax before the afternoon session rather feeling like we had to leave the premises to go find lunch in the heat and feel rushed back. They also took note of everyone’s dietary restrictions/preferences in the beginning and tailored the meals so that we could all enjoy it. They were simple Thai meals but everyday was different so you can feel the love and care they put into their business and their students.

Thank you Ai, Wi, and Nancy for the incredible experience and unforgettable memories :) you guys are amazing teachers, and now, also a good friend 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🏻😊

reviews.textTranslated:
The shop is located in the City Connect project. There's ample parking; it's spacious and easy to find using the map.

This shop specializes in body scrubs and masks. They have a wide variety of programs to choose from, as well as regular massages. It's perfect for those who want simple relaxation. I've attached pictures of the programs, but promotions change monthly, so check their Facebook page for updates.

I personally chose the Arabica body scrub program. It started with a sauna to open pores, then the scrub began – it was so much fun! They scrubbed until the water and scrub evaporated from my skin! LOL. Next was a mask, left on for a while, then a shower to rinse off. It finished with a full-body serum. The whole process took a little over two hours.

The staff were excellent. They were meticulous, knew exactly what to do, and the process was smooth. They didn't over-talk, making me feel comfortable. It was perfect for introverts! LOL. They didn't try to sell me any packages, just recommended other interesting programs.

Overall, I was very impressed. I'll bring my mother next time! 😀

title: Tum Massage
ownerDescription: Quality Traditional Thai Massages by professionally trained Massage Therapists. Come and enjoy a massage in peaceful and tranquil surroundings to help you relax and unwind.
address: Buakhaow 15, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
plusCode: WVHM+47 Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: Peter Williams
reviews.text:
Tum massage deserves every 5 star review that the venue has been awarded.
The staff are professional and friendly and the facilities are clean and welcoming.
I had a 1 hour pedicure (฿200) excellent value for money. Tip: visit early morning to get immediate attention…and enjoy the peaceful ambiance.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Peter. The staff work hard to keep the salon clean. We are happy you engjoyed the experience and hope you come back soon

reviews.name: Rich G
reviews.text:
Don't let the outside fool you.

This is a high quality, dependable oasis of authentic, professional massage in Pattaya just around the corner from the Holiday Inn Express.

All the same pricing as everywhere else despite the significantly better interior design and relaxing music and atmosphere. $6 for 1 hr foot and leg, $9 for full body oil massage.

Ask for Downy (pictured with her permission).

After a few halfhearted (and let's call them 'bait and switch') experiences at other places, Downy brought a clearly well-trained, thoughtful and focused approach to her work. And while it's true that it's more about the person than the place, I'm sure it's representative of all the other staff here.

The upstairs for the full body massages is clean, with more privacy than most.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review. We are happy to hear that you enjoyed your visit with us. We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Jörg Simon Hägele (Simon)
reviews.text:
What should I say, I have been there for three days in a row now and I am actually very satisfied with the service. I have to say, in this massage salon you only get serious massage without any accessories or EXTRA services. And I cannot emphasise on how much I love you this fact, as a client who really wants to have good, proper massage ONLY!
I simply can recommend this massage salon to everyone who wants to indulge an hour or two of really good, professional treatment and even though I looked into other salons around the Pattaya, I cannot say that I found something similar so far in this price class for this level of professionalism.

Go there and enjoy your time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jorg,

Many thanks for your kind review. We hope to see you again soon.

regards

Tum Massage

reviews.name: Pierre
reviews.text: Nice standard and professional massage. No funky business whatsoever. Only element that I disliked is when the masseuse started talking about how little they get paid and was living trough tips. Otherwise nice and clean.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Pierre,

many thanks for your review. Our ladies should always be professional and not talk when you are having a massage. The ladies typically get 50% of the cost of a massage and the tips get paid directly to the ladies. They typically earn more in a month than staff working in factories or 7/11's.

We hope to see you again soon and thank you for your review.

reviews.name: BudinCambodia G
reviews.text: Excellent facility at this price level. The staff are friendly and professional. I had a pain-free pedicure, something that is rare for me to find. The body scrub was okay. The Thai massage was very well suited for my needs, not very painful 😂 The 4 hand oil massage was excellent! A friend said that he was able to nap during his foot massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review.

reviews.name: Daniel
reviews.text: Jang gave a great foot massage. 200 baht. 1 hour. Very lovely ambience inside too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you for your kind review. We are happy that you enjoyed your experience and hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Ethan McQueer
reviews.text:
This place is magnificent. So many massage parlours to choose from but I'm so glad the first one I tried (Tum's) made me come back more and more.

Peaceful music, vintage lighting and chairs. Very comfortable temperature and ambience.

Great pricing and great ladies.

For Thai massage, I did suggest for their tables to consider a hole for head when laying on stomach (save me twisting my neck) but don't let this be a deterrent to you.

Easiest 5 I've given in Pattaya
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Ethan for your review and custom. We hope to see you again ❤️❤️❤️ Our oil nassage tables have head holes. Next time ask the therapist if you can use these tables instead for your massage. Alternatively have one of our range of oil massages to allow for the ultimate  relaxation.

reviews.name: MM176
reviews.text: Best massage in Pattaya by far. The ladies are friendly and nice to see them having a laugh. So cheap for the professional service they provide. Very clean and relaxing. Well worth coming here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you for your kind review. We are happy that you enjoyed your experience and hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Aarti Khurana
reviews.text: Very neat and clean place. Great for massages. Have well trained masseuses. The best part is this isn’t a loud place and they have good music.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review. We are happy to hear that you enjoyed your visit with us. We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Doctor Kutchapeckeroff
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Tum Massage in Pattaya is an absolute gem!

This massage shop stands out for its high-quality experience, offering comfortable chairs, excellent air conditioning, and additional fans to keep you cool.

The sanitation is top-notch, creating a clean and welcoming environment.

Unlike some other places in Pattaya, Tum Massage focuses purely on professional, quality massages without any “funny business,” which I truly appreciated.

The location is fantastic, conveniently situated on Soi 15, just a short walk from Soi Buakhow.

The atmosphere is serene and quiet, perfect for relaxing or even napping during your session.

The staff enforces silence, so there’s no disruptive chatter—just pure relaxation.

They also provide extra pillows for lumbar and head support, which made the experience even more comfortable.

I highly recommend Tum Massage to anyone seeking a professional, tranquil, and high-quality massage in Pattaya. It’s a fantastic spot that delivers every time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you for your kind review. We are happy that you enjoyed your experience and hope to see you again soon.

reviews.text: We happened to be walking past when my wife said let's go here for a massage & who am I to argue! We each enjoyed a 2 hour massage & then returned for another. Owner Nok is a lovely lady & runs a very clean well organized establishment. It is clear her staff is very happy. Highly recommended from both of us. Enjoy!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Gerry for your review and kind words. We work hard to ensure that the salon is run professionally. We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Luboš Ducháček
reviews.text: This massage was by far the worst experience I’ve had during my stay in Thailand. I get massages regularly, whether in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, or elsewhere, so I have a solid basis for comparison. Unfortunately, the quality of this massage was extremely amateurish and did not meet the standards I would expect from a professional salon. Instead of relaxation, it turned into an unpleasant experience that completely ruined my day. It seems that the quality of service here is purely a matter of luck, which damages the overall reputation of the establishment. The masseuse assigned to me clearly lacked sufficient experience, and her approach was unprofessional. The massage took place on February 13th at 1:00 PM (head, neck & shoulders). I will definitely not be returning to this salon.

reviews.name: Suparat Larsson
reviews.text:
Staying at Amethyst hotel, this massage parlor located right outside. All of them staff are really good with their job, depends on how you like it.

For me, not too hard, not too soft, a bit slow, no elbow, no stick, I know I’m so hard to please, but I have found the right lady, who do exactly how I like. Her name is “Noy”. She studied massage, with all type for many years, and works with massage for most of her life, she used to work in hotel’s spa as well.

While the treatment is so amazing, the price for whole body oil massage is 300 baht. Foot massage is 200 baht. That’s crazily cheap.
