title: PowerHaus Pilates (พิลาทิส เชียงใหม่)
ownerDescription: Step into a world of mindful movement and strength at PowerHaus Pilates Chiang Mai. Since opening in early 2023, this premier studio has been dedicated to transforming bodies and minds through the power of Pilates. Situated in the vibrant city of Chiang Mai, our expert instructors guide you through invigorating sessions designed to improve flexibility, build core strength, and enhance overall well-being. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned practitioner, discover a personalised fitness journey that empowers you to achieve your health and wellness goals. Join us and experience a unique approach to fitness.
address: 76/1 floor, 2 Moo.4, Fa Ham, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
plusCode: R24C+Q9 Fa Ham, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Hathairat J.
reviews.text:
Today I tried Gyrotonic for the first time.
Kru Chard guided me through the movements with great clarity, making them easy to understand and explore. The exercises encouraged length, space, and freedom throughout my spine, rib cage, and shoulders. There was effort, but without tension; challenge, but without force.
By the end of the session, I felt light, open, and energized.
Highly recommend Pilates Haus Studio and Kru Chard for anyone interested in exploring Gyrotonic in a supportive and professional environment.✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: "Thank you so much for such a thoughtful review! We're thrilled that your first Gyrotonic session felt both effortless and energizing — that sense of length and freedom is exactly what we hope every student experiences. We'll make sure Chard sees this, it will truly make his day. Thank you for the trust, and we can't wait to welcome you back for more!

reviews.name: Reyelleraye
reviews.text: Such a lovely Pilates studio in Chiang Mai! The instructors are professional, knowledgeable, and very supportive. The staff are super friendly and always make you feel welcome. The overall service is excellent — I always leave feeling refreshed and motivated. Definitely will come back every time when I visit Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the kind words! We're so glad you enjoyed your sessions and always leave feeling refreshed and motivated. We look forward to seeing you again next time you visit Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Mika M
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my class at Powerhaus Pilates🧘‍♀️ The staffs are very friendly and welcoming, and the studio is always clean and comfortable. Special thanks to Instructor Kong, who is very friendly, patient, and helpful. He explains everything clearly and makes sure everyone is doing the exercises correctly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this wonderful review! We're so glad you enjoyed your class and felt the warm welcome from our team. We'll be sure to pass along your kind words to Kong — he'll be so happy to hear it! Thank you for trusting us with your practice, and we can't wait to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Joan Kau
reviews.text:
I highly recommend PowerHaus Pilate studio! As a 60-year-old student, I place a high priority on safety and professionalism, and this place delivers perfectly. The environment is spotlessly clean and comfortable.
Best of all, the instructors are incredibly professional. Focus heavily on core stability, ensuring there is absolutely no strain on my knees and lower back. After consistently practicing 4 timers a week, I can clearly feel a significant boost in my overall strength and endurance. If you are looking for to build stamina and maintain your health through low-impact exercises just like me, this studio is absolutely the top choice!

reviews.name: Thanyaluk Akarasirikul
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my group classes at Pilates Studio! The studio is clean, the classes are fun and varied, and the instructors are very attentive and nice. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: T T
reviews.text: I love how challenging the mat classes are and the instructors are so supportive. They really make sure that you are getting the most out of the class. The staff is so friendly and helpful and they make it easy to book your classes.

reviews.name: Darcy Berkley
reviews.text: Tried my first ever Reformer Pilates class in a private session with Chard. It was amazing! Chard is such a great instructor, all instructions were clear and I felt safe and confident. Definitely recommend, it’s really fun, challenging but relaxing all at once. The staff are all lovely and the studios are clean and well equipped.

reviews.name: Kanpitcha Kasemsookpaisan
reviews.text: Professional instructors and super friendly staff. Super hygienic place even air quality. Almost 3 years with PowerHaus pilates studio, build better posture and confidence. I would highly recommend all of my friends to try if you’re seeking also healthy body and positive vibes. Do not believe in my review if you never try by yourself and wanna be better one.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this incredible review and for trusting us with your health for nearly 3 years! 🌟

Hearing that we’ve helped you build better posture and confidence means the world to our entire team. We take great pride in keeping our studio immaculate and our air quality pristine, so it's wonderful to know that stood out to you. Your challenge to readers to "come try it for themselves" is the best compliment we could ever ask for. Thank you for bringing your amazing energy to our studio day after day! 🤗🌿

reviews.name: Himadhida Villarroel
reviews.text: It was the best studio Pilates in Chiangmai. The studio is very neat and clean. Instructors are very kind, taking care of you as you were one of their family. Many fun classes for you to learn. Very very good! If you are looking for a place to play Pilates, I really recommend.👍🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Reading your review completely made our day! 🥰 Thank you so much for highlighting our clean space, our kind instructors, and our fun variety of classes.

Your recommendation is the greatest gift we could ask for, and it inspires us to keep delivering the best experience possible. Thank you for bringing your amazing energy to our studio family—we can’t wait to move with you again soon.

reviews.name: hannah mansell
reviews.text:
Excellent Pilates studio, the staff are so kind and friendly and very knowledgeable.
The 1-2-1 lessons are incredibly professional and caring.
Powerhaus pilates is a must even if it is your first time trying pilates they will accommodate every need and deal with any injuries you have.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the incredible review! We are so happy to hear that you enjoyed our 1-on-1 private lessons and felt well taken care of by our team. Making Pilates accessible, safe, and tailored to individual needs—especially when dealing with injuries—is exactly what we aim for. Your recommendation means the world to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for your next session!

reviews.name: Vivian Viv
reviews.text: Very professional and knowledgeable instructors. I have done a lot of Pilates classes all around studios from so many places / countries, I would say here is one of the best one.

reviews.name: Forever Soul
reviews.text: The studio is very clean and well-maintained. The instructor is professional, attentive, and really understands the body’s movement. Every class feels safe, effective, and enjoyable. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for such a wonderful review! 🥰 We are so happy that you are enjoying your time with us.

Creating a clean, welcoming environment and delivering professional, attentive instruction is what we strive for every single day. Knowing that every class leaves you feeling safe and effective means the world to our team. Thank you for your high recommendation—we can't wait to guide you through your next movement journey.

reviews.name: Young
reviews.text:
This place offers different classes in one location.

Tried the Power Barre for the first time and it was quite challenging.  Nui, the instructor was full of energy. However the space is a bit small in my opinion.

I also did the reformer class with Fun. She has excellent ques and easy to understand.

One time class is 800baht but for 3classes it is 990baht which is a better deal.

Located near convenience store, food stalls and restaurants which is a plus.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your experience with us! 🥰 We love that you got to experience both the high energy of Nui's Power Barre and the precise, easy-to-understand guidance of Fun's reformer class.

Thank you also for noting our cozy space; we always aim to keep our classes intimate so our instructors can give everyone personal attention. We're glad the 3-class deal and our handy location near local food stalls and shops added to your visit. Can't wait to see you back on the mat or the reformer for round two.

reviews.name: Jayden T
reviews.text:
PowerHaus Pilates is by far the best studio I’ve been to! I was lucky enough to attend group reformer classes for two months, and the experience was incredible. The staff are highly trained, always offering adjustments and guidance when needed. There’s so much variety between teachers and classes, so you never feel like you’re doing the same routine every time. The classes are small but I never had difficulty booking in times. There are a great number of classes throughout the day.

The facilities are beautiful and always kept clean, which made every visit a pleasure. But the best part, everyone is so welcoming and friendly. As a non-Thai speaker, I felt completely comfortable — the instructors do an amazing job delivering bilingual classes. This mustn’t be an easy task so they deserve a lot of praise. I highly recommend PowerHaus and I can’t wait to return one day. Thanks to everyone at PowerHaus :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautiful and incredibly thoughtful review! 🥹❤️ Hearing that PowerHaus is the best studio you’ve been to means the absolute world to our entire team.

Your praise for our bilingual classes is so incredibly special to us. Delivering smooth, engaging instructions in both English and Thai is something our instructors practice with a lot of heart, so knowing it made you feel completely comfortable and included is the ultimate reward! We are also thrilled that you loved the variety in our routines and found our booking system and class schedule convenient during your two months with us.

You will always be a part of the PowerHaus family, and we already can't wait for the day you return. Thank you for your high recommendation, and safe travels until we meet again.

reviews.name: Cathy Huang
reviews.text: Very nice Pilates studio, instructors all very professional.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to leave us a rating. We are so glad you had a positive experience with us!

reviews.name: J
reviews.text: The studio is super clean and aesthetic pleasing. They used standardized equipment for each classes. They have reformer class, springboard, power barr etc. They also have alot of experience instructors here too. Some of the instructors are physiotherapist so if you are looking pilates/rehab, this is the place for you. 10/10.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the perfect 10/10 review! We are so happy you love our clean, aesthetic space and our lineup of Reformer, Springboard, and Power Barre classes. Having experienced instructors—including our amazing physiotherapists—means we can give you the absolute best care, whether you're here for a killer workout or specialized rehab. Thank you for the wonderful recommendation, and see you next time.

reviews.name: Drishti Sanger
reviews.text:
I’ve been taking classes here for a week now and I couldn’t be happier to be here and to have found this studio.

The staff is so friendly and helpful!
The studio is clean and calm.
The instructors are insightful and encourage you during class to push well within your means. They assist you to help you achieve your goals and acknowledge your efforts and progress.

I highly recommend taking a private session before starting the group classes to receive tips on how to work with the natural grooves of your body.

reviews.name: พิมลทิพย์ ยศชูสกุล
reviews.text: I truly cannot say enough about this place. I had only less experienced Pilates class a few times. When I moved to Chiangmai, I was hoping to finally find a studio with reformers and other equipment. I go between both studios around Central Festival. The studio vibe is just so lovely, the teachers so welcoming and the pricing actually affordable.   All of the instructors have been incredible. Chard, Aom, Nozomi, Looknok, Phai and Kwang truly have the magic touch with these studios. I've been practicing for 1 months and have seen my body change in ways I've never seen by just going to the gym. My body is stronger, more flexible and overall having a bit of a glow-up.  If you have been debating giving this a try or are looking for a studio with kind, helpful and one-on-one attention, this is the place. The classes are small but this allows you to actually improve with the help of your teachers. There is no pretentiousness here, just an open, welcoming and kind community. Plus, it's fun! You must come here at Powerhaus Pilates.

reviews.name: Jonathan A.
reviews.text: I had my first Pilates session ever with Amp and I really enjoyed it. It was challenging but she was very good at explaining and adapting the exercises to my level. The studio is clean and well equipped. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the wonderful review! We're so glad you enjoyed your first-ever Pilates class with Khun Amp and found her adaptations helpful. Our team works hard to keep the studio clean and well-equipped for our community. Hope to see you back on the reformer again soon!

reviews.name: Danaya Yerzhanova
reviews.text:
I went to every Pilates studio in ChiangMai. This is THE best one. Group class here - was better than private sessions I took elsewhere.

Owner/instructor Chard is fab: from energy to seeing where you are with your ability and assisting. I could not have a better class. And I’m impossible to please.

Beautiful facilities too, smell of green tea makes you feel like at a SPA.

Wish I could give this place 7 stars ⭐️

reviews.name: EdT
reviews.text: Making an appointment was easy, even in English, and I booked mine through Facebook Messenger. The spa has a pleasant environment, and the front desk staff were friendly and welcoming. The massage itself was standard, although communication with the therapist was somewhat limited due to the language barrier. Overall, it was a decent experience, but personally, i will try other places next time.

reviews.name: Christopher Chin
reviews.text: Clean well presented premises, professional front staff, soothing relaxing background music and fit qualified masseurs. Had a very rejuvenating massage. They have an extensive massage menu and I’m totally tempted to go back for an aromatherapy deep tissue massage - the perfect compliment for a lot of trekking travelling and temple visits.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your thoughtful and wonderful review.
We are truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the atmosphere, cleanliness, relaxing music, and the care provided by our team.

It means a lot to us that your massage experience felt rejuvenating after your trekking, traveling, and temple visits around Chiang Mai. Helping our guests relax and recover is exactly what we strive for every day.

We are also very happy that you explored our massage menu, and we would be honored to welcome you back to try our aromatherapy deep tissue massage on your next visit.

Thank you once again for your kind support and recommendation. We look forward to seeing you again soon for another relaxing and restorative experience.

The gentle Massage and Spa
Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Danny K
reviews.text:
Pros:

Nice reception area to sit and wait while waiting

Masseuses do not chat with each other and remain quiet throughout.

Very clean and well furnished.

Tasty drinks and snacks served.

Cons:

You are paying much more (450) than the usual 300 per hour for a massage and so they surely the actual massage should last 60 mins?

What annoyed me lots was this joint started counting the 60 mins from the moment I paid for the massage.

So we waited 5-7 mins for the masseuses to get ready, waited another 3-5 mins for them to wash our feet, meaning that our actual massage lasted around 48 to 50 mins.

Also another huge factor is the skill of the massage. I’ve had much better foot massages at other places. The masseuses here don’t understand how to apply pressure on targeted points on the soles of the feet to get desired results.

Don’t be fooled by the fancy spa-like decor. At the end of the day, if the masseuse needs to know how to do give a good massage.

reviews.name: Goose without a hat
reviews.text:
My friend organized our massage, I didn't know where I was going and I didn't know what to expect. I left broken, and I came out regenerated from head to toe and I enjoyed every moment, even before the massage, during the massage and after. I have no doubt that you will feel differently than I do.
Make sure to visit this place and you will understand better how great this place is.

Many thanks to all the people who work at The Gentle Massage & Spa. They are very professional, polite, cultured, everyone is very attentive and well organized.

5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐and a huge plus!

The Gentle Massage & Spa
Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: jordon Lee
reviews.text:
I couldn’t find anything that wasn’t busy nearby… so I ended up coming here that was not busy and had some high ratings. So I might as well tried it. We did a two person foot massage with balm (300 without and 350 with). You pay before you go inside. The place looks quite old but they have lots of promotions going on. There’s no music playing and the masseurs were very chatty with each other.

As a person who’s been to many massage parlours before, I think the basis of a good parlour is having a quiet environment that is comforting and inviting.

Funny enough, the masseurs asked whether they could keep talking to each other… I think about half way the talking got less.

To end on a good note: the strength of the masseurs were on the good side.

Just some kind suggestions for next time:
- Have some calming music playing
- Less talking with each other as it’s supposed to be a place of relaxation
- Lots of things happening in the background- (dishes being put away, chatter, doors closing, etc)

Thank you for the massage though!

As a local who has received massages since as young as middle school, I highly recommend this place! I got the 2 hour oil massage with the masseuse lady named Toon. She was super sweet, friendly, attentive, and thorough with my entire body from head to toe, front and back! I can really tell they're knowledgeable and very well trained.

The highlight was her finding all the nooks and crannies of the smaller muscle groups I never paid attention to before...and the stomach and chest massage - which most masseuses don't go there because being top naked is embarrassing for Thai women, so culturally they just avoid touching&seeing those areas...but those muscles need TLC too!

The place set up for the oil massage was a 2-massage-bed private room w/ attached shower on the 5th floor, which took some calf muscle warm-up to get there but I didn't mind. There's an AC which you can control the temperature and you have complete privacy if you're there with your spouse or friend.

The other lady named Imm worked on my husband and he enjoyed her work as well. I got to chat w/ both of the masseuses calmly during the 2 hours and appreciated all the tips and life stories we shared w/ each other.

10/10 and definitely coming back here every time I visit Sukhumvit!

reviews.name: D. B.
reviews.text:
I actually came here because of the good reviews and I'm not someone who likes to give out Google reviews. But this was by far the worst oil massage in 3 years in Thailand. The oil massage cost 500 bht for an hour and you have to pay at the beginning before the massage.

The feet are not washed before the massage and you are not given slippers, which is why you can walk into the massage room with your own dirty slippers (very unhygienic). The massage room was not prepared. The beds were lined up and the air conditioning was off. I was asked to change when I was already soaked with sweat because the room was sticking and very hot. The air conditioning was then switched on, but of course it took 5-10 minutes until the room was cold.

The massage started exactly at 18:41 and ended exactly at 19:32, so in total only 51 minutes instead of an hour. Apparently the changing time was counted as massage time. But the massage was so bad, I'm glad it ended earlier.

It wasn't a massage. The woman's aim was to rub me with as much oil as possible. In my opinion, the oil smelled very cheap and you couldn't choose an oil like in other massage places. Either the masseuse wasn't really a masseuse or she just didn't want to work. There was 0 pressure applied, just rubbing the oil back and forth with a lot of speed, which felt very uncomfortable. If pressure was applied, it was applied in all the wrong places.

In the end, the face was also massaged after the unwashed feet were massaged.

That's why you should look for a more hygienic place and masseuse who value you as a customer. Worst experience so far!

reviews.text:
I would like to share my experience at this establishment.

I do not judge people based on their gender identity, and when I arrived for my massage, I was assigned to a transgender therapist. I had no issue with this and was simply expecting a professional massage service.

At the beginning, everything seemed normal. However, as the session progressed, the therapist repeatedly touched my intimate areas in a way that made me extremely uncomfortable. The situation escalated to the point where she placed her hand directly on my penis. I expressed that I did not want this and asked her to stop.

I came to this establishment expecting a professional and respectful massage experience. Instead, I felt violated, uncomfortable, and I was not respected.

This experience left me feeling upset and disappointed of the Thai massage, and I believe other customers should be aware of what happened.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention.

We would like to clarify that the actions described in your review are not authorized, approved, or tolerated by our establishment. The behavior of this employee does not reflect our standards or policies, and the business was not involved in this action.

We are deeply sorry that this happened to you and that your experience was uncomfortable and upsetting. Providing a professional, respectful, and safe environment for all customers is our highest priority.

Please accept our sincere apologies. We will immediately investigate this matter and take appropriate action action as quickly as possible to address the situation and prevent anything similar from happening again.

address: 17 Rama I Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
plusCode: PGXH+7X Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Horace Chan
reviews.text:
I have been to Bangkok for few times and this Christmas I am staying at Mecure Hotel, making me find this lovely massage shop right in the heart of Siam, and it turned out to be one of the best massage experiences I had in Bangkok.

The prices are very reasonable for such a central location, and you can tell it’s popular — it was full of customers both days I visited. I’d definitely recommend making an advance booking.

The lady owner is friendly, elegant, and speaks good English, which makes everything very easy for visitors. From the bed linens to the wallpaper, you can tell a lot of thought has gone into the details, reflecting the owner’s care and personal style.

Cleanliness is a priority for me, and the place is not only spotless but also beautifully designed — quiet, tasteful, and full of Thai character.

I tried their traditional Thai massage on my first day and a relaxing oil massage on the second, and both were excellent. My masseur was professional, serious, and very attentive throughout the full two-hour sessions. I mentioned some tightness in my right neck and waist, and she really listened — not just on the first day, but also remembered and focused on the same areas when I returned the next day.

Overall, this is a great choice for anyone looking for an authentic, down-to-earth Thai massage without the fancy atmosphere or overpriced packages.

Just to be clear — I paid for my massages myself and visited as a real traveler. This is a genuine review, not an advertisement!

reviews.name: Mr Law
reviews.text: Staffs are very polite and massage was not bad! However, the lady sitting at counter has some attitude problem. I was there and witness how she treating guests who still come in after hours with her long face and speaking in thai which I found it bit rude. However, I dont like the wat she doing the business. Will not visit anymore! Gonna try other massage shops since its alot in bangkok with same price and better service , perhaps!

reviews.name: N0mad Lawyer
reviews.text: Best massage I’ve ever had. Planning on heading back again during my stay in Bangkok. Experienced masseuse. I felt brand new afterwards. Highly highly recommend!

reviews.name: Iron Chef Shellie
reviews.text:
Conveniently opposite the LIT hotel & residences, I went to this place nearly every day I stayed in Bangkok.

Open till midnight I enjoyed a few late night massages to help me wind down.

The ladies are great, very friendly and friendly like a Thai massage should be.

As someone who has had her fair share of massages in Thailand, I can say this place is fat person friendly!
- stocking disposable undies, not the paper kind
- Thai massage they have up to XXL garments
- no one laughed or mocked me for my size

That weird smell someone said is just like a tiger balm smell. Totally fine and only smelt it on the floor where they did the Thai massages.

Excellent prices, will definitely frequent again when I come back to BKK.

Curtains, not fancy but good

reviews.name: Mo
reviews.text:
My wife and I were killing time waiting for a very early check in at Lit Hotel Bangkok. We found a foot massage shop right in front of our hotel and decided to give it a try. We were both very happy with the experience!

The staff was very friendly and welcoming. They offered us water after our massage was finished. We both opted for a traditional Thai foot massage, which uses a variety of pressing and stretching techniques to relax the feet and legs.

The massage cost 250 THB each, and we would definitely recommend this foot massage shop to anyone looking anything to do before checking in the the Lit Hotel

reviews.name: Renae Verboon
reviews.text:
My first ever Thai massage experience, it was amazing. I took 90 minute head, back, shoulder, feet traditional. I didn’t know what to expect but it was great! It’s a strong, intense massage but makes you feel light and airy at the end.

The shop is clean and smells like tiger balm, feels very traditional and authentic.

reviews.name: Clarence Tang
reviews.text: this no frills traditional massage hits all the right spots. The masseuse was very detailed, even to the smallest muscles in the toes and wrist. But most important of all is the right amount of strength and pressure on my neck, back and shoulders, reliving months of stiffness.

reviews.name: Udomkarn Boonyaprasert
reviews.text: Fantastic traditional massage with relatively cheap price. Staff are very welcoming and good with what they're doing. I didn't feel ticklish, nor did i leave with bruses on my body like any other massage parlour. The neck cracking got me a little off-guard, but I'm sure you can ask them not to do it if you're not into it. The massage areas are separated by a blind curtain, so you'll feel nice and private. Will definitely be returning whenever my office syndrome hits again

reviews.name: Romiio Oo
reviews.text: I tried a massage here this past Saturday, and it was fantastic—especially for anyone looking for a deep tissue Thai massage. I highly recommend it! I was massaged by Khun Aouyphorn, and she was amazing. She really helped fix my back and shoulders. I’ll definitely be coming back. The staff were also very friendly and provided excellent service.

reviews.name: Babak Eliyahou
reviews.text:
The massage was excellent. I feel like a new person. The only thing is that the masseuses talk too much between each other,
Makes it hard to relax.

reviews.name: KL Chen
reviews.text:
Stumbled upon this Thai massage place back in JUL . Went in and had a fantastic foot massage.
Came back to Bangkok in SEP and paid another visit to this place as it was less than 5mins walk from our hotel - Mecure Siam Bangkok.
Again, they did not disappoint. Very skillful masseurs and peaceful environment though its quite a small venue.
Definitely will come  back again and this time , will try the body massage!

reviews.name: Roxanne Chew
reviews.text:
Decided to give this a try after we stumbled onto a few overpriced massage places. Very pleasantly surprised by the relaxing experience. Fuss-free, clean and really good. We came back twice!

It may get busy after 8PM but do give this a try. They also accept future bookings if needed.

reviews.name: Vent_9
reviews.text: I went there after a full day walking around town and this foot massage (with a free head, neck and shoulder extension) was heaven. Everyone was very friendly. The place is simple and you’ll get a massage with no fuss. I left relaxed and relived.

reviews.name: David Ow
reviews.text:
I felt like a piece of pork gettng soaked in oil.

The massage was terrible, the masseuse didnt know what she was doing. The amount of oil she used on me could have filled up a deep fryer.

In fact, my masseuse was giving another customer a foot rub when i entered, and after i confirmed my body massage, she tagged out with another staff and came to attend to me instead. The only plus point was that she gives a decent leg massage towards the end of my full body massage.

The whole place is rather old and not maintained well.

reviews.name: J N
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for this massage parlor but unfortunately, the experience was quite poor.

We walked in but were asked to return after an hour due to “no availability.” We are grateful to be accommodated. When we came back — five minutes before our scheduled appointment — we still had to wait another 15 minutes. This was fine. However, the woman at the front desk, who seemed to be the owner, was cold and unwelcoming. Her demeanor set an uncomfortable tone from the start and lacked the warmth you'd expect in a service-oriented environment.

Prior to this, we were asked to remove our slippers in a cramped, cluttered entryway. While it’s understandable to follow this practice, the space was disorganized, there were too many slippers, and the way the staff insisted on it came across as pushy and awkward, making us feel uncomfortable instead of relaxed.

Next, we were led up to the fourth floor, even though the second and third floors appeared completely empty. The reason wasn’t explained, and the climb felt unnecessary and inconvenient.

Before the massage, I showed a translated note on my phone to my masseuse explaining that I had recent treatments on my upper arms, face, chin, and neck — and that these areas should be avoided. The note was read and acknowledged yet completely disregarded during the massage. Nevertheless, I kindly reminded her during my massage. She apologized for the pains caused. I accepted her apologies.

The masseuses themselves were polite and kind, but they chatted multiple times during the massage, which was somewhat distracting.

The quality of the massage was poor. Pressure was inconsistent — too strong in some places, too light in others. The strokes felt random and lacked technique. Having experienced hundreds of massages around the world, especially in Thailand, I can confidently say this was far from professional.

The biggest letdown was the lingering pain in my nape (the area at the back of the neck extending to the shoulders), which I believe was due to the masseuse’s lack of skill.

I also suspected that my partner's massage bed had not been changed from the previous customer. While we can’t confirm it for certain, I noticed a lack of visible hygiene protocol on his side/his massage bed. This raised some concerns, which we realized after our massage due to the rushed handling (as we had late start).

To top it off, we were given a small, room-temperature plastic bottle of water after the massage — a lackluster ending to a supposedly premier Thai massage experience.

At 900 baht per person for a 90-minute Thai and oil massage, the service, environment, and professionalism were well below standard. Sadly, I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a high-quality or truly relaxing massage.

reviews.name: YR Chen
reviews.text:
I went twice for foot massage on first day and body and foot massage on the second. Although both are nice pressure, the Senior staff is very good in body massage. While I did nit have a good experience on the first day due to baggage time shortage and environment, I still went back for body massage.
Instead of foot and Thai body combination, I would suggest to have a 2-hour Thai traditional body massage.
Price is very reasonable for a Thai traditional body massage in Siam area.

reviews.name: 楊岱軒
reviews.text: A classic Thai massage! I have to say it's totally not a easy money for them to earn! I stay in Bangkok 4 nights and I visit them for 3 times, recommend to do "Head, Back, Shoulder ,Foot" it's really worth the price!

title: Carve House | Lagree Fitness & Pilates Studio in Phuket, Thailand
ownerDescription: Carve House Lagree is a fitness studio specializing in the Lagree method offering high intensity, low-impact, full-body group fitness classes. Similar to Pilates except the Lagree Method is specifically engineered to strengthen, tighten, and tone the muscles effectively and efficiently without adding any excessive stress on the joints, connective tissues and the spine.
address: 4, Blue Tree, 2 Srisoonthorn Rd, Si Sunthon, Thalang District, Phuket 83110, Thailand
plusCode: X8P9+PH Si Sunthon, Thalang District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Frank Balikok
reviews.text: ​I accompanied my wife to her very first Lagree session. The equipment they use is on another level; you genuinely need serious core strength to survive 45 minutes of this workout. It's fascinating how this French founder managed to reinvent traditional Pilates into such an intense discipline. Throughout the class, my wife’s muscles were under constant tension; it’s crystal clear that mastering these machines is no walk in the park. Anastasiia, our instructor, was highly skilled and incredibly athletic, doing an amazing job leading the class. All in all, it was a fantastic experience; my wife ended up exhausted yet thrilled. She will definitely be back, and I'll be right there to tag along. Enjoy Phuket! Enjoy Thailand!

reviews.name: Maneewan Davenport
reviews.text:
I started Lagree at Carve House Phuket in April 2024, and it has been an incredible experience! The slow, controlled movements challenge every muscle, making each session intense my muscles shake, my core burns, but the results are worth it.

The instructors are professional and motivating, ensuring proper form for maximum effect. The workouts are tough but incredibly effective for strength, endurance, and toning. I feel stronger, more toned, and energized after every class.

I still go regularly, and I love it! If you want a workout that truly pushes your limits, I highly recommend Lagree at Carve House!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for being with us this whole time! We really appreciate your loyalty and so glad to hear you’re enjoying the benefits of the Lagree workout!

reviews.name: Sue Kansinee Phumipol
reviews.text: I always have good time and great sessions at Carve house. All the instructors are great and very friendly. If u are someone who wants to get a sweat sesh without running around or jumping. Low impact high intensity workout will be found here! U gotta try!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the 5 stars Sue! Yes! You’re right Lagree does leave you super sweaty without the jumping and running around! We’re glad you’re loving the workout as much as we are. Thanks again!

reviews.text: Very fun and effective workout session with nice studio ambiance. The instructors were very nice and helpful as well for my first time trying the lagree class looking forward for the second studio in Bangkok :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for working out with us! Hopefully see you back in the studio ! :)

reviews.name: Harriet Kilduff

reviews.name: anais ilvento

reviews.name: Jeng Chen
reviews.text: One of the BEST massages in Bangkok!!!! The therapist is called Lak (apologies if I spelled it wrong). Even though I was her last customer, her pressure was still perfect and she did an amazing job! So lucky to have met her! 😭🙏🏽

reviews.name: Javier Z
reviews.text: Ayothaya Massage & Laundry Sukhumvit 18 is a great place to relax. The staff were very professional and welcoming. They did an excellent job peeling my feet, leaving them smooth and refreshed, and the massage was very good—strong, relaxing, and exactly what I needed. Clean place, good service, and great value. Highly recommended if you’re in the Sukhumvit area.

reviews.name: Ying-Ting Chiu
reviews.text:
I hate to write bad reviews, but my sisters and I had a very bad experience with the staff at this laundry place. For this reason, I had to say something to make people (especially tourists staying in the area) aware of what they might encounter if they do go to this store.

Here's what happened to us:

We came to the store before noon on April 5 (Sun), 2026. We were staying at a hotel nearby. On Google Maps, the store had many good reviews, so we chose to bring our laundry to the store in person when we went out.

We interacted with the staff (specifically three women at the front door) in person. They were dismissive and mean to us. They did not answer our questions until they had to. It looked to me they did not want to work. However, we were tourists and did not know much about other laundry options, so we still chose to work things out with them in order to get our laundry done.

Based on the rules they made visible at the reception, we would be able to get our clean clothes back at 5 pm the following day and with free delievery to our hotel. However, they insisted on a later time and no delievery. In fact, they asked us to go back to the store in person for a self-pickup at 8 pm the next day.

I read how things work at the store before I went there, so I did not give in. It took a while for us to reason with them in order to remind them it was still before noon and the store's rules state free delievery to nearby hotel at 5 pm the following day.

Eventually, we did get our clean clothes back with free delievery to our hotel the next day. However, I will NEVER go to this store again.

Sidenote: Before this bad experience, my sisters were thinking of doing massages there. Needless to say, they decided not to and were glad they didn't.

reviews.name: Daniel Howard
reviews.text:
We have been traveling in Thailand for almost two weeks, and had quite a bit of dirty clothes we had accumulated. We decided to get some of the clothes laundered, and found this location. We communicated via WhatsApp, and afterwards dropped our clothes off with the front desk of our hotel around 8pm. Shortly after, we got a message of the total due - very reasonable! We dropped off the baht at the hotel lobby.

Next day, we come back to our hotel room to find freshly laundered clothes, nice and neatly folded in a plastic bag.

All said, we got our clothes back in excellent shape in roughly 20 hours!

We will definitely use this business when we inevitably return to Thailand!!!

reviews.name: Mike Young
reviews.text: Stayed at the Rembrandt hotel. I opted for the wash and dry and my laundry came out just fine. I did not do iron service (extra 50b per kg) because I was afraid they would melt my sportswear. Overall service and final product was 5 stars. Dropped off on a Friday morning and picked up on Saturday afternoon. 2.8kg of Laundry cost me 280b.

reviews.name: N
reviews.text:

It is located in the same lane as the Lexus Showroom and it is about 300m from Asoke BTS station.

reviews.name: Fam. Fricke
reviews.text:

I also had oil massage here - 600 THB/hour, the place was very clean and massage was very good.

reviews.name: Rattana Sakdikul
reviews.text: Highly recommend, very nice and friendly, staff, reasonable price and clean place. Coconut oil massage is very good can make my skin so soft and smell good. Will be back again for sure ❤️🙏🏻👍

reviews.name: Anna Roman

reviews.name: Steven Roman

reviews.name: colin neo
reviews.text:
I am torn between giving it a  4 stars or 3 stars but since i am an experienced Remedial Therapist that has been practising abt closed to 20 yrs in a physio clinic.  I will provide feedback based on my background and experiences.  Coming from having trained in various massage skills ( acupressure, thai massage, sports, swedish, aroma, remedial, lymphatic drainage gua sha and cupping).  I have been practising almost all techniques day to day except Thai massage.  This trip i was very interested in Karsai treatment and Thai massage is just  something i hoped to get revision since I am there.
Overall the training for Karsai is good.  The trainer is very experience although I hoped they could explain more on why we have to press those pressure points during treatment.  The material provided is very simplified.  If you don't take notes, most likely you will forget those steps.  In this expects, the school need to improve.  Also, maybe its Thailand, I noticed their timing is like "Rubber Time"  ie, supposed to start at 9am daily ended starting around 9.30am or even later.  Lunch time 1.5 hrs but supposed to start at 1pm ended maybe 1.30pm. Class stopped 4 pm.  For someone like me trained in Australia and Singapore, this is definitely wasting time.  I would say the Karsai course could have finished in 1.5 days inclusive of practical.  That could be the reason why courses can be draggin over 5 days.

After this training, I decided to forgo the Thai massage course as i was observing the students for a few days during their practicum. Basically they are mostly very new to this industry. My request for crash course was turned down.  The trainer told me Wat Po training is different from Ong"s training so much start overall which was not what I envisage before I travelled there and I dont buy the idea that Wat Po style defers from Ong's as all are Thai Massage.

Finally,  I would say this,  if you are totally new to this industry, this school is not a bad place to start but be prepared that the pace is very slow and can be messy but since you a new, you might not know what is  expected so should be fine and the fees are quite reasonable.  The school also seems to target Japanese clienteles and those in the yoga and alternate medicine related industry that want  broaden their business based.  However, as an experienced person, this school will not tailor made the courses for you.  You will ended paying more by following those new students  from basic, intermediate and advance.  I understand, from business stand point, the courses are being dissect  into level 1, 2, 3 ...etc more for  make money rather than giving you the full formal training.  In this case,  you are actually paying more for the whole package.  Smart marketing !!!!

Anyway, this is my two cents worth.  Hopefully some will find this useful.   Lastly for those who aspire to become a thai massage therapist, please do your homework by visiting all the schools and observe before signing up .  At least you will know their standard and pay for what you expected rather than flying in and be disappointed

title: Breeze Spa at Amari Phuket
ownerDescription:
“Rediscover soul and body rejuvenation at Breeze Spa!

Unwind exquisitely, indulge confidently.
In preparation to welcome you back, we've been working hard to ensure your health and safety with extra hygiene measures."

More on our safety measures 👉https://bit.ly/2ZVsCBe
address: Amari Phuket, Pa Tong, Amphoe Kathu, Phuket 83150, Thailand
plusCode: V7PM+J7 Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Dennis Low
reviews.text:
Breeze Spa lives up to its name in every way. Set right by the sea, the walk from the hotel lobby is a genuinely pleasant outdoor stroll — though do request the buggy service if you’d rather ride. As non-hotel guests, locating Breeze Spa was a touch challenging; our taxi driver wasn’t familiar with it, so come armed with directions and allow a little extra time.

Once we arrived, we were shown to our spa villa — a beautifully open-air space that lets the sea breeze do its work naturally. No air conditioning needed. The villa is well-equipped with showers, changing rooms, and clean toilets, and there’s a Jacuzzi on offer if you select a package that includes it.

We chose the Traditional Thai Massage “Signature – Energise” and were in excellent hands. Our therapist was mature and clearly seasoned — every stroke spoke of real experience and craft. My wife and I both stepped out feeling genuinely refreshed and energised, exactly as the name promises.

Is Breeze Spa pricey? Yes. Is it worth every baht? Absolutely. A memorable experience in a stunning setting — just make sure you know how to find it!

reviews.name: Hasham Omar
reviews.text:
Picture a massage table set surrounded by nature and greenery with the ocean stretching out in front of you…calm, expansive, and deeply grounding.
The therapists are highly professional and precise, delivering exactly what each treatment promises. I chose the “Serene Mood,” and it lived up to its name completely. From start to finish, there was a consistent sense of calm and balance that made it easy to fully switch off and relax.
The experience is thoughtfully curated down to the smallest details, starting with a refreshing welcome drink and ending with tea and cookies, giving you a gentle transition back to reality.
If you’re looking for a spa experience that combines skilled therapy with a truly tranquil setting, this one delivers on every level.

reviews.name: Noura M
reviews.text: One of the best massage experiences I’ve had in Phuket! The service was excellent, and the therapists were very professional. The room had a beautiful view, which made the experience even better. If you’re visiting Phuket, you definitely need to give this place a try. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Paelli Lu
reviews.text:
There are countless spas in Phuket, but Breeze Spa is truly a must try! My husband and I tried the Mood Massage with Nang and Rainy, and they were both amazing, skilled, and very attentive. We were genuinely impressed with the quality of their service.

Before the treatment, we filled out a detailed form to indicate which areas we wanted them to focus on and which parts to avoid or where we might feel sensitive. I really appreciated this step, as it showed how thoughtful they are in making the massage personalized and comfortable.

Special thanks as well to Beam, who assisted us beforehand. She explained the treatments clearly and helped us choose the massage best suited to our needs which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

The setting itself was calming! Overlooking the beach with the sound of the waves, surrounded by trees where you could also hear birds chirping. It was simply the perfect mix of nature and relaxation.

Overall, it was a wonderful and memorable experience. We’ll definitely be coming back next time we’re in Phuket. Thank you, Breeze Spa team, for making our visit so special!

reviews.name: Zaynab Muhammad
reviews.text:
I was treated to this spa by my friend, and hands down, it is the best spa I have ever been to.

The views at the top are absolutely incredible, overlooking the beach. You can feel the ocean breeze while having your treatment, which truly lives up to the spa’s name and makes the experience even more special.

We had a three-hour treatment that included a full body scrub and wash, a full body relaxing massage, and a facial. It was pure bliss. I felt so relaxed that I actually fell asleep during the massage. My skin felt amazing afterwards and continued to feel incredible for days.

Everything about the experience was calming, luxurious, and perfectly done. I couldn’t recommend this spa enough — a must-visit if you’re in the area and want to truly unwind.

reviews.name: Siddhartha Poudel
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at Breeze Spa, Amari Phuket. I went with my wife for a 90-minute spa and massage, and it was truly one of the best we’ve ever had. Lisa and Tew were absolutely fantastic — professional, attentive, and made us feel completely relaxed throughout the session.

A special mention to Taew at the reception, who welcomed us with such warmth and ensured everything went smoothly from start to finish. The atmosphere, service, and overall experience were exceptional. Highly recommend Breeze Spa for anyone visiting Phuket who wants a memorable and rejuvenating spa experience!

reviews.name: Youssef Nachid
reviews.text:
Amazing experience at Breeze Spa! The staff is very professional, kind, and welcoming. We had the best massage ever incredibly relaxing.

Special thanks to Beam and the two other girls for their kindness and great service. They truly made us feel cared for and gave us a wonderful spa experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: David
reviews.text:
This spa is world class, a 10 out of 10 experience.

From the moment you arrive at reception Beam and Taew make sure the whole experience is wonderful, these two ladies know how to host guests.

The location, atmosphere and massage are all perfect.

Ann and Rainy did the massages, both were fantastic. The complete experience from start to finish was perfect !

Thank you,

reviews.name: Hailey Clark
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing experience at Amari breeze spa. From the moment we arrived, Taew and Ann at reception made us feel so welcome and relaxed. Their kindness and professionalism set the tone for the whole visit.

Our therapists, Nang and Lisa, were incredible. The massages were easily some of the best we’ve ever had, so relaxing, skilled, and thoughtful from start to finish. The whole spa atmosphere was peaceful, beautiful, and exactly what you want when you’re trying to unwind in Phuket.

Highly recommend Amari Breeze Spa if you want a genuinely luxurious and calming experience. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Lisa Properjohn
reviews.text: I had an absolutely amazing treatment package at this spa set up in the hillside overlooking the beach. Each hut has its own treatment room and shower. The staff were friendly and very skilled. It was one of the best treatments I have ever had. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Bdr
reviews.text: Highly recommend this spa! Beam at the front desk was so professional, sweet, and welcoming right from the start. The massage therapists, Tew and Aew, were incredible. They have amazing technique and tailored the massage perfectly to what my body needed. Total relaxation from start to finish.

reviews.name: Tatiana Ash
reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic 👏🏼
My husband & did the Coco Mojito experience - and it was just so relaxing. We decided to check out the spa in our hotel on our last day to help us relax after a full 9 days in Thailand filled with adventure.
I highly recommend - trust me, you won’t regret it.
Nang was my therapist & really took good care of me. Her massage was spot on!
From the body scrub, to the massage all the way to the facial. With the sound of the waves crashing, and the relaxing spa music - you can’t help but want to stay up there forever. Everything was 10/10.

reviews.name: Karen Rogers
reviews.text: We have just had a 90 minute couples spa treatment.  It was out of this world.  The massage was so very very relaxing we are feeling very chilled.  The surroundings to have a massage is the best we were overlooking the sea with the sound of the waves in the background.  The smells of the oils and creams were delicious.  We purchased the "pick me up" cream to take home.  If you are visiting Amari Phuket please make an appointment with the Breeze Spa you will not be disappointed.  Thank you so much

reviews.name: Nick
reviews.text: Cliffside location with breathtaking view of Patong bay.  Unhurried service and a good, strong massage to the sound of the waves lapping the shore below put me in pure heaven.  I can’t recommend this place enough for a premium massage experience.

reviews.name: parya taheri
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Breeze. The location view, the message itself the staff everything made me left with a great mood and feeling! Thank you!

reviews.name: Jes T.
reviews.text: Booking for the massage and spa was relatively easy, via email with your room confirmation prior to arrival or 1 day before your preferred date. The receptionist on duty Pink, was all smiles and welcoming upon my arrival. While waiting for my therapist, I was served blue butterfly pea flower drink with a slice of lime to squeeze into it to make it more refreshing. My therapist Tar was briefed by Pink on the parts to focus. Tar’s use of force was up to expectations, I enjoyed the outdoor massage and am looking forward to returning

reviews.name: Meishin Tan
reviews.text:
Breeze Spa is an outdoor spa under Amari resort. It is really serene and sweet treat to ourselves, price is reasonable, service is great and you get to enjoy the outdoor ish massage.

You might not be able to fall asleep like typical indoor air conditioned massage but connecting body with the sound of forest and oceans and the heat (tho) made such good chance for mindfulness.

It is rejuvenating in another form.

reviews.name: Ali Alkowayes
reviews.text: We were attracted to book since the massage rooms were in the open! So were specifically excited for this alone. Then, the Thai massage itself was AMAZING! My wife and I were massaged by Bong & Mint for a 90-minute session. We've had many amazing massages before, and this one rates top 3 easily! (We've had ones in the Maldives, Zanzibar, and Europe!). Perfect pressure (we had no comments during), and amazing sound of nature - with a low-volume spa music. We're still in Phuket, so we might go again if the time allows because it's worth it! Thanks a lot!

reviews.name: Alexandra Dyumina
reviews.text: I had a serene mood massage with Tar, and she was amazing! Highly recommend having a massage with Breeze Spa, specifically Tar! ;)

reviews.name: Tia Hammoud
reviews.text: Such an amazing experience to do with your husband. The service and the staff are incredible. We got the package with a body scrub, massage and facial and it was perfect and so relaxing. The sound by nature and the view is also amazing.

title: SALA Spa Chaweng

SALA Spa Chaweng is truly heavenly – a haven of tranquility that will transport your senses into another world of serenity. Guests can enjoy a wide selection of treatments, including blissful body scrubs, wraps and massages, and separate steam rooms are also available. Our professional massage therapists use only natural products from two leading Thai brands, I Plus Q and Dermalogica, to leave your skin feeling smooth, your body refreshed and you mind revitalized

reviews.name: Tanya Collins
reviews.text: A fabulous spa experience. We were greeted with a drink, there was no rushing, however it’s good to be a bit early to relax. The attention to detail was evident when you walk into the treatment room and exceptionally clean. I had the head neck and shoulders for 90 minutes and my daughter had the signature massage. The massage was very relaxing in-fact one of the best I have ever had .
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Tanya Collins,

Thank you so much for your lovely feedback! We are delighted to hear that you and your daughter had such a fabulous spa experience with us. It’s wonderful to know that you enjoyed the welcoming atmosphere, unhurried pace, and attention to detail throughout your visit. We take great pride in maintaining a clean and relaxing environment, and we’re thrilled that your 90-minute Head, Neck & Shoulders massage was one of the best you’ve ever had. Your kind words mean a lot to our team, and we truly appreciate you taking the time to share them. We look forward to welcoming you both back for another relaxing and memorable experience soon.


Warm regards,

Prisana Duangmanee
Cluster Spa Manager

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text:
I went to SALA Spa in Chaweng, Koh Samui, and it was honestly the best massage I’ve ever had. I did their signature massage, which was around 90 minutes, and even though it’s a bit on the pricey side, it was absolutely worth it.

From the moment you walk in, the smell and atmosphere hit you in the best way. Everything is calm, warm, and luxurious without feeling intimidating. It really feels like they’re trying to engage all your senses, not just rush you through a treatment. The space is beautiful, quiet, and incredibly relaxing.

The therapist was amazing and clearly knew exactly what she was doing. You can tell the staff actually care about their work and take pride in it. It didn’t feel robotic or rushed at all,
it felt very intentional and well paced. The pressure, technique, and flow of the massage were perfect, and I left feeling genuinely relaxed instead of sore or overstimulated.

Yes, it’s more expensive than your average Thai massage place, but the quality, environment, and overall experience completely justify the price. This is the kind of spa you go to when you want something special, not just a quick massage.

If you’re in Koh Samui and want a high end, sensory, genuinely relaxing spa experience, I would 100 percent recommend SALA Spa Chaweng. I’d go back in a heartbeat.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Alex,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review of your experience at SALA Spa Chaweng. We are truly honored to hear that it was the best massage you’ve ever had and that our Signature Massage left you feeling genuinely relaxed and restored.

It means a great deal to us that you appreciated the atmosphere, sensory experience, and unhurried pace from the moment you arrived. Our team strives to create a space that feels calm, warm, and luxurious while remaining personal and sincere, and we are delighted that this was reflected throughout your visit.

Your kind words about our therapist and the care, skill, and intention behind the treatment will be proudly shared with the entire team. Knowing that you felt the quality and experience justified the value is the greatest compliment we could receive.

Thank you for your heartfelt recommendation. We would be absolutely delighted to welcome you back anytime for another special and relaxing journey at SALA Spa Chaweng.

Warm regards,

Prisana Duangmanee
Cluster Spa Manager

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again soon for another relaxing and memorable experience.

We chose the milk bath and signature massage experience and absolutely loved every part of the ritual, the oils, the peaceful atmosphere, and the meditation moments. Everything felt perfectly smooth and relaxing.

A special thank you to Rose and Milky for the amazing massages. The whole experience was flawless, we highly recommend!

Massage studio is right next to Icon Siam and the both Hilton Hotels.

They do not understand english. It is quite difficult to communicate.

Unrecommended.

reviews.text: Amazing massage is truly amazing. We did foot massage and it was wonderful, and relaxing. The staff is so kind and friendly. Supper recommended!!!

reviews.text: One of the best massages I had in Thailand. This is a very clean and well maintained massage place with very friendly and welcoming staff. I´ve been there three times during my stay in Bangkok. The massages I got were all very good and professional and I felt relaxed afterwards. I can highly recommend 'Fern', she has great techniques and she is very friendly and attentive.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review 😊❤️🙏

reviews.name: Gehan Ghofari
reviews.text:
I have tried many Thai Massages in my 5 years of living in Thailand. This one is the most satisfying one for me.

I came here with my 5 friends and all of them were extremely satisfied.

Price is cheaper compared to the competitors in the area, but of course not expensive at all and very worthy. I paid 450baht in July 2023 and I got 60mins of Thai massage + 30 mins of foot massages.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review you are very kind to us 🙏😊

reviews.name: Office in SEL NPL
reviews.text:
This place offers “extra services” specifically to male solo travelers. Please take note.

First of all, to the tourists who said this place was good—I’m truly sorry, but my experience was the worst massage I’ve ever had.

The massage technique was nonexistent, and I even considered stopping halfway. Unfortunately, due to the language barrier, I couldn’t communicate and had to endure it until the end—which led to serious consequences.

Currently, I’m experiencing muscle pain all over, with particularly severe pain in my back. If you receive a massage from someone unskilled who just uses their elbows without proper technique, your body can suffer—just like mine did.

Please, go to another local massage shop nearby.

reviews.name: Eric
reviews.text:
I had a great experience here to fix my neck and shoulders. The masseuse used the appropriate level of force and asked me if I was fine the entire time.

I’ve seen 0 evidence of anything shady going on here. like the one Korean reviewer here implies.

I’ve also found that just about every shop on this street can be very hit or miss just depending on the masseuse you get. Anyways, my experience here was good.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your review.Your review gives us more encouragement. Thank you very much. 🙏🙏

reviews.text: They were able to fit the two of us in right away. We had such a great experience we came back the next day! Pressure was on point!

Highly recommend for you guys trying this place and book Ms Tik/Tak do massage. Plus,  Ms Nan did well as well . Thankssss

reviews.name: Casey Feehan
reviews.text: Just had an amazing massage here, as promised! I had some leg pain after all the long flights from the US + traveling around Southeast Asia and got a 60 min foot+neck massage — the masseuse got all the good spots and it feels much better now. My boyfriend got a 60 min full body massage and was in heaven afterwards. He’s very tall and the masseuse recommended 120 min for the best experience —if we had time we would absolutely go back. The women who work there are incredibly kind as well. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Six weeks of travel in four Asian countries and I had the best massage of all here. From the front desk staff to the facilities it was a positive experience. I had a male therapist named Sun who definitely had a sense of where to apply pressure rather than just rubbing in oil. Looking forward to returning on my next trip.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review 🙏

I was there for a scrub and massage yesterday night. The reception staff can communicate very well in English. They are able to advise clearly on what types of services they offer. The scrub and massage was done in a room with door unlike most places only with curtains. That provides better privacy to the customers especially female customers. They use good scrub products similar to what I bought from Icon Siam. The scrub and massage were excellent especially the scrub because the masseuse are very experience and did a good job.
I highly recommend this shop.

title: Mood Massage House
ownerDescription:
The Mood Massage House
A small house that serves you like a our family member with a cozy warm atmosphere
"Reflexology is a type of massage
with a traditional Thai, originating from Lanna Chiang Mai
address: 78 3 Samlarn Rd Old City Tambon Phra Sing, เมือง Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXMJ+3J Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Kai Sweet
reviews.text:
A fabulous massage with incredible hospitality, well worth a visit if you're in the area!

The Setup: Went to mood massage parlour for an hour's session. We got the back and shoulders massage each for 350 Baht (~£8). As soon as we got there, we were greeted by the lovely ladies, got slippers, and headed inside to get changed and start.

What stood out:

✅ The Hospitality: Super hospitable and friendly from start to finish. After the hour was over and we got changed back, they even gave us some tea for afters, which was such a lovely gesture.

🔥 The Experience: Fabulous. The women really know what they're doing. It felt really good after—she dug deep and removed all the knots from my back which was heavily needed.

🙌 The Value: 9.7/10 - Exceptional value for money. Getting a targeted, high-quality massage that genuinely clears your knots followed by complimentary tea for 350 Baht is an absolute win.

The Verdict: Overall, if you're nearby, please pay this place a visit. Super hospitable and friendly.

reviews.name: nuevo
reviews.text:
I found out about this massage parlor near my hotel through the GoWabi app, and they were having a big discount! 😍😍

So I didn't have high expectations. But the masseuse who massaged me was so professional! 👍👍👍 She really relaxed my tense muscles, completely exceeding my expectations! 🙂🙂

I was so lucky to have such a professional masseuse! 🙏🙏🙏

The post-massage snacks were also amazing—the cookies were delicious! The hot drinks were also very comforting. 👍👍👍

reviews.name: Lena
reviews.text: We happened to stop by this place for a Thai massage while checking out the Saturday Market, and we both were extremely satisfied. In fact, we loved it so much that we came back a second time without a reservation. It doesn't have a luxurious ambiance, the place is very clean and the quality of the massage was absolutely amazing.

reviews.name: Freddy Wm
reviews.text:
I just got my first Thai massage in Thailand, and wow—it was exactly what I needed! Woke up this morning feeling super sore from yesterday’s full-day tour, so I searched around my area and stumbled upon Mood Massage House.
The staff were so welcoming and friendly, and the massage itself was incredible. Felt like I was sparring in a Muay Thai ring with them, but totally worth every second! Plus, the price is way more affordable than other spas in the neighborhood.
I feel like a whole new person! Huge thanks to the team—I’ll definitely be back. If you’re craving a massage, you gotta check this place out. They’re amazing!

reviews.name: Lu Coq
reviews.text: Incredible Oil massage ! We will come back for a 90min. The best massage of our stay in Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Sherry Liang
reviews.text: Wonderful massage and great staff. Came here twice in a roll and would definitely visit again next time in Chiang Mai! Super comfortable experience with a decent price!

reviews.name: Beate
reviews.text:
Best massage ever - and I had a few in my past life😊
Highly recommended for excellent technique and friendly service. Will be back 😇

reviews.name: Hayley Lanigan
reviews.text: Legal battery at its finest ;-)The service here is first class. The massage stretches you to your limits and you feel like you've been reborn! The strength and skill of these ladies is like nothing else. I'll be returning for more de-stressing and their bael tea. Thank you!

reviews.name: spx
reviews.text:
Had one of the best massage experiences here. The masseuse was very skilled and immediately knew where my knots were, focusing on them with just the right pressure. I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed.

Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ray Koivunen
reviews.text: The massage here was my first in Thailand and what a great experience. I feel so loose and could float away if not careful. These gals have just the right touch!

reviews.name: Milan Shah
reviews.text: Great massage. Accommodating when our 5 month old started crying 30 mins in. Professional and clean! Just what we needed!

reviews.name: Lada Rodionova

Long time I didn’t get such a complex massage

Thanks Nam , she’s amazing
I was get signature package for 90 minutes, each minutes such a pleasure

Recommendation 💯

Very relaxing.  Very good.
Good foot scrub and face massage! Recommended.

reviews.name: WS YM
reviews.text: Visited this facility while staying at Pingviman hotel. Very kind staff with extremely high quality massage treatments!

reviews.name: Choi Heymin
reviews.text: I had a massage from a lady with glasses, and it was truly the best Thai massage I’ve ever had—and I’ve had many. She treated each of my feet differently, as if she instinctively knew exactly where the pain was and customized the massage accordingly. I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: María Victoria Núñez Fernández
reviews.text: Friendly staff. The massage was nice and easy. It was next door to our hotel so good location for us. We asked for a lower price but it wasn't possible.

reviews.name: Przemyslaw Szyling
reviews.text:
Amazing Massage Experience in Chiang Mai

During our 3-day stay in Chiang Mai, we visited this massage salon three times — and for good reason! I was dealing with pain and tightness in my back and neck, and I finally found something that truly helped. The therapists really know what they're doing when it comes to pain relief.

My wife, on the other hand, was looking for something more relaxing, and she absolutely loved her experience too. The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, and each session left us feeling better than the last.

If you're in Chiang Mai and need real pain relief or just want to unwind and relax, this is definitely the place to go. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: susan Allison Taylor
reviews.text: The prices were competitive and each massage that we received  was fantastic. Each person provided a slightly different experience, and they were all very good. I highly recommend it.

reviews.name: Roy Naftaly
reviews.text: Loved it! They're so kind and caring about the massage. Felt very professional, was relaxing and enjoyable. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Chad Harris
reviews.text: Professional,  Therapeutic, True pain relief. I can't recommend this place enough.  Su is an amazing therapist, I'm grateful for time and level of attention.
