reviews.name: Timothy Stewart
reviews.text: My wife and I came in for a 90 minute massage. The Office Syndrome massage for me and the Aromatherapy Oil Massage for the Mrs. My massage was spectacular, and perhaps the best I’ve had. My massage therapist was Pu, and she paid attention to the areas of my neck, shoulders and lower back that tends to give me issues. I was amazed by her technique and highly recommend Masumi Spa and specifically Pu if you have neck or back pain. On the sheet when it asked how much pressure to apply I elected to have the massage therapist recommendation and it started off soft, but the rest of the massage was perfect with no need for intervention on my part. I definitely would consider coming back.

reviews.name: Vincent Hoe
reviews.text: It's one of the best spa in Chiangmai and they do have Monthly promotions that have great value for money. Nice environment, friendly reception and very good and professional therapists.

reviews.name: Sheri Lucas
reviews.text:
Spent an afternoon here for my husbands birthday and got the touch of paradise package.

The ladies were wonderful and it was nice to have a couple’s room, which is the right amount of talking, pretty much quiet, the whole time, and less we started the conversation.

The massages were wonderful, the perfect amount of strength which you can have them due to your liking.

The facilities were very clean, the tea at the beginning, and at the end were wonderful and appreciated, as well as the treat:-)

The only thing that could be better is it was hard to understand the order of the massage. We were supposed to get a 30 minute foot massage which we think was added to one of the massages but it was definitely not 30 minutes.

They didn’t understand English very well so the communication was a little hard but we managed.

I would recommend this place, a little bit more expensive than other, but it is worth it to be in a nice clean place.

reviews.name: Nathan
reviews.text: Masumi spa is an amazing place. We wanted to go to a spa and found this place. On arriving they give you a form to fill asking for all your details and allergies. Once that has been filled you get a cold towel and a welcome drink to begin with. Once this is done they take you to a place to clean your feet with bath salts. After this you are taken to your room where the massage starts. They ask you whether you would prefer soft, normal or hard massage. We initially said hard and then realized hard here is actually hard. We shifted to normal. The massage is so relaxing and you might fall asleep. The music was soothing and perfect. Once you are done with the massage you feel fresh and good. Definitely a must do when you are in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Panisara
reviews.text: I visited here in Jan and they had a promotion for hot oil aroma. The decor is comfortable and relaxing. But I think the massage room could be better decorated as well. As for the massage, it was quite relaxing.

reviews.name: Xin Ying
reviews.text: Bought the klook voucher for a 120min thai massage. It was super worth the value, masseuse had a strong enough touch but was thoughtful enough to check in every once in a while during the massage. Interior was clean, staff were so welcoming. I highly recommend this place. Would definitely do it again.

reviews.name: Fond S
reviews.text: Impressive body massage! Totally recommended this place with the masseuse who knows which area to focus on heavy massage and where to be gentle. I had the body scrub and aroma oil massage was so fantastic. The scrub part was totally different from other place I’d been to. They scrubbed all the scurf on my body til the salt melt on my skin and they made sure to rub all out completely, I can feel my smooth and soft skin when showered it off. Plus one with aroma scent on my first step in and clean with Muji style decor. The price is more than acceptable comparing to the good quality massage I received, this place is going to be my favorite massage place in Chiang Mai. Make sure to call in for booking in advance at least a day. They will have the promotion from time to tjme as well.

reviews.name: Justin Yap
reviews.text: Booked the traditional thai massage through Klook and called them ahead of time to book my slot. Service was impeccable and they served us with cold towels and some cold herbal tea before whisking us away to have our feet washed and dried. Afterwards they bring you to a room for your massage. The masseuse adjusts the pressure to your liking and constantly asks you if you are comfortable. It ended up being so relaxing that I slept for a good bit. Once the massage had ended, we were given some rice crackers and hot tea which was a great way to end the experience. The staff were all very kind and helpful. I’d happily come again if given the chance.

reviews.name: Gine “Gine The Mae Nai's Winery” MaeNaiWinery
reviews.text: Excellent massage place to relieve all your stress and body pain from traditional Thai massages to spas with highly professional therapists with affordable price!

reviews.name: Ernst J
reviews.text: (Looking) new and clean place. Decent price. Good service.

reviews.name: Ajirapa Pradit
reviews.text:
Good service, I requested for strong massage and the lady did not fail to do her job, friendly atmosphere and relatively clean and has many services available.

I recommend as a Thai person who has been to many massage sessions.

reviews.name: Shannon Ryan
reviews.text:
This place is great! My husband and I went here 5 years ago in 2018 and again twice this week! I love to get the foot massage or full Thai massage. Everyone is thorough and well educated on technique.

They provide a cold drink before and warm tea after. Prices are very stable and it’s easy to book. We will definitely go again!

reviews.name: Marwah
reviews.text: Cute little spa! Were able to fit us in last minute, staff was great! Limited English so it made communication during the treatment a bit hard.  Simple tidy rooms treatment rooms. Got an oil massage and their signature facial and my skin felt amazing afterwards! Would definitely recommend!!

reviews.name: up urbum
reviews.text: They called a masseur from outside and my foot massage was bad. I almost left half way as the masseur had no idea where the pressure points were. Worst massage in Thailand I have had so far. 600 baht was an absolute joke. Told reception and they said they will send feedback to their manager.

reviews.name: Cindy Song
reviews.text: Worst experience I ever had in Thailand. Change my booking three times, then made me wait 30minutes without an explanation (until I asked- which turned out to be because the previous person was late). Used ice cold water to wash my feet. (hopefully it was not left over from previous client). Facial was below average, half of the session I was left by myself with a super dried mask. 100% not worth the price they charge. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.name: Joshua J
reviews.text: My masseuse would not turn off the air conditioning despite me telling her 4 times I was freezing cold. I told her in both Thai and English so there was no doubt she understood but rather than make me feel comfortable she selfishly chose herself. Presumably she was warm. 100% avoid this place

reviews.name: Ruby Mok
reviews.text: My masseuse is really bad! She keep coughing during the whole massage. I told her several times I need stronger massage, she only last for few mins and return the soft massage. Very unprofessional and unpleasant experience!

reviews.name: Lisa Chong
reviews.text: Hands down the best massage I’ve had in Chiang Mai! Everyone was very kind and the place had many amenities. They give you a sheet to fill out and you can choose the intensity of the massage. I chose “strong” and they did not disappoint. I highly recommend the Feet, Head and Shoulders massage. I would definitely comeback!

reviews.name: Diamond David
reviews.text: I have to wait for 40 minutes without explanation.  If you value your time,  it would be better to avoid this place. The therapist declined to massage my knees, saying it is not included as a foot massage course.  Hahaha.

reviews.name: D&M
reviews.text: Wonderful massage and service. Welcome drink and after massage snack provided.

title: Let's Relax Spa - Phuket (The Sis Kata)
ownerDescription: A stylish Modern Spa hidden in the newly designed The Sis Hotel, Let's Relax The Sis Kata Phuket offers a perfectly relaxing ambiance with glam and spacious private treatment rooms located in beautifully-designed Woven Domes that make you feel like being pampered in the Oasis. Just a few steps from Kata City Center.
address: 255 Kata Rd, Karon District, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R872+32 Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Brianna Stephens
reviews.text: A beautiful massage had here. They really added all the little touches along the way. The massage had good pressure the whole way through. The atmosphere was calm and quiet throughout the massage and the therapist continued to check in throughout to make sure we were good. Would 100% come back again. We weren’t staying at the resort and walked up from Katathani (had massages at our resort and would recommend this place over ours). Around $55 AUD per person for the hour. We headed upstairs for sunsets drinks post which was lovely- fantastic sunset view

reviews.name: Naema DI MICHELE
reviews.text:
I booked a foot massage yesterday and immediately booked another treatment because it was so wonderful. Today I had a facial treatment (Dr. Spiller).
For both appointments, I was warmly welcomed with a refreshing drink and towel. A short questionnaire on a tablet allowed me to indicate which areas of my body I wanted focused on or to avoid, as well as the pressure level (light/medium/firm).
Junchine, the massage therapist, was punctual and took excellent care of me; I simply let myself be guided. It was a true moment of well-being. Junchine provides treatments with precise, delicate movements with pressure adjusted to vary in intensity depending on the location and need. You can really feel her experience and professionalism.
A big thank you for these relaxing moments in such a pleasant setting. I highly recommend this spa.

reviews.name: BLS
reviews.text: We love Let’s Relax! The spa is immaculately clean and the massage areas are dark, comfortable and quiet. It’s a pleasant atmosphere with formally trained professional masseuses. I like the two hour Thai massage because it gives time to relax and give each area lasting attention. I’ve been here many times and had different massage therapist. ALL of them have been incredible.

reviews.name: Giovanni s
reviews.text:
I think it is the best spa I tried for traditional curative massage (Thai massage).
The service it’s amazing and you could try a lot of beautiful products also for smell during the massage or for your body (like scrub or similar to wrap body).
Thai massage is at top level and you stay 2 hours only for 30/35 euro. If you need a cure base on old yoga or old ancient Buddha medicine come here please !

reviews.name: Jo Greenwood
reviews.text: It’s very private and comfortable. Even thought the price might be twice higher than the massage place on the street. But it’s clean, smell nice, and private and the massage lady super nice and professional. At beginning of massage they got me a delicious tea and end of the massage they provide me a cute and delicious mango sticky rice. It was a lovely visit. I highly recommend. Total 1200B for a two hour massage. Not bad at all.

reviews.name: Linda Chua
reviews.text:
I’m a regular at Let’s Relax whenever I visit Thailand and usually go daily throughout my trip. Unfortunately, this outlet was very disappointing. The design and atmosphere felt unlike the usual Let’s Relax theme, and standard procedures were skipped — no foot wash.

The Thai massage area is a communal space with curtains that don’t fully close, offering very little privacy. The worst part was when my partner was having a 2-hour aromatherapy massage and a maintenance staff suddenly entered the room, making loud noises.

We were both shocked and disappointed. This is our first time returning to a Phuket outlet since Covid (the Bangkok ones in 2022 were fine), and we’re now wondering if the standards have dropped so much that we should consider other spas in future.

reviews.name: Chongun XX
reviews.text: This spa has to be reached via a very steep road, there is no survey before the massage to understand customers need, and the choice of essential oils is very common. I would say Spas in Bangkok will have a little more surprise and ritual. The environment is hygienic, the massage lady technique is acceptable

reviews.name: Taghreed Felemban
reviews.text:
What a 5 STARS EXPERIENCE! 😍😍
First, you smell lemongrass the moment you step into place; which immediately gives SPA Vibes! They welcomed us with a drink and cold face towel, asked us to change into their sandals, then we headed to the room. My husband and I booked couples Aroma/Warm oil Message. The room was very clean and tidy, and there was a shower & a bathroom. They provided (disposable underwear, hair cap, and robes). The message was amazing! The ladies were very skilled and they applied good pressure. We relaxed so hard we slept & snored too lol 😂!

Overall an experience I definitely RECOMMEND! And I loved it so much I wanted to book another appointment for the day after 🤭❤️

I should mention that our appointment was at 9:50pm and they close at 11pm. We took a one hour session which means we were their last clients of the day, yet they provided the best experience! Thank you so so much xx

reviews.name: Brian Greenbourne (Brian)
reviews.text:
Beautiful setting
Amazing atmosphere
Reception staff good

We had a family of four taken aromatherapy massage on a less busy day

Firstly they bring the aromatic oils to you to chose from but here you need to go and chose yourself which isn’t a big thing but I’m used to it in other lets relax spas across Thailand  which ain’t followed here

Masseurs was good but not firm enough
Though she was reasonably good

Big thing for me NO Mango sticky rice at the end 😄
Just a pre packed little snack which was really disappointing  🥲
Again not a huge thing but when you this as a norm in other let’s relax spas across Thailand why not here ?

Overall ok ish compared  to the other lets relax spas in Thailand
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Let's Relax Spa, Sawasdee Ka.

We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. Your observations regarding the overall experience have been carefully noted. Please be assured that we continuously strive to enhance the quality of our services. Regarding the mango sticky rice, we would like to inform you that it is served only to customers whose service total is 1,000 Baht or more, and only at branches in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Pattaya, and Hua Hin. Unfortunately, the branches in Phuket, Krabi, and Trang do not provide mango sticky rice after treatments. Nevertheless, we sincerely appreciate your comments once again. We will use the feedback you have provided to improve our communications, ensuring clearer and more accurate information for our customers in the future.

reviews.name: Anne XU
reviews.text:
A bit disappointing experience at Let’s Relax Karon.

The room was too cold, and even after we told the therapist, no extra blanket was provided.

After the massage, several of us had neck pain, and one friend had visible bruises on her legs the next day. The pressure and technique did not feel properly controlled.

Overall, not recommended.

reviews.name: Nkululeko Dhlomo
reviews.text: Beautiful relaxing spa. The ladies were very professional and kind. My body feels renewed after the treatment . I’m going to come back for sure

reviews.name: Matilda Ong
reviews.text:
Hidden within The SIS Kata Hotel Resort, I’ve booked for a Body and Soul package for 60mins scrub and 60mins aromatherapy massage.

Room is big and spacious, massage was fantastic. You get to choose the type of massage oil and scrubs

Price at 2300baht is of cos pricier than those by Kata beach but it’s a more serene spa relaxation. You are given a welcome cool down drink, tea in between and ginger tea after. Refreshments, hot towel and cookie after..

Hotel guests gets 20% off and I only paid $1840baht for it. It’s a great deal considering it’s only $70+SGD. for 120mins SPA experience

reviews.name: Оксана Тусина
reviews.text: The massage itself was not bad, I even liked it. but the front desk girls DO NOT SMILE AT ALL. they had the most dissatisfied faces, as if they were suffering working there and doing everyone a favor. I earnestly ask you to work with them, as it is precisely because of their sad faces that I don’t want to come anymore. this is bad. What about ladies doing massage - thank you very much, they are good

reviews.name: Atistarn Winemiller
reviews.text: Great experience with aroma oil massage and body wrap service. The therapist has positive energy, pays attention to details and cares for my request. Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Salma Soummade
reviews.text: Best spa in Phuket staff service all was 10/10 special thanks to the receptionist Nadia for arranging the booking and her warm welcome and of course Thanks to the therapist Supannee for her professionalism

reviews.name: Nyda Homes
reviews.text: The best Spa in Thailand.  I made the Blooming Life package and it was absolutely amazing.  The therapist, the environment, the massage and treatments were wonderful. Worth every penny.

reviews.name: E B
reviews.text: Spa is beautiful and my back neck and shoulder massage was amazing, so relaxing and definitely got a lot of the knots out my back. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: HA TRAN
reviews.text: Beautiful space and friendly service. Service price is quite high but should experience once when coming to Phuket.

reviews.name: Anastasia Ryaboshapka
reviews.text: Our family are frequent guests of Let’s Relax in Bangkok and we used Christmas vouchers while staying in Phuket. Unfortunately, the visits were disappointing. The service felt very average, and the reception manager over two days avoided eye contact and offered minimal communication, focusing on the screen instead. Our massages for four people started 45 minutes late, with no explanation or apology - The salon is clean and nicely presented, but if you’re looking for a premium massage experience, I wouldn’t recommend this location.

reviews.name: Paula Hibbard
reviews.text:
The best spa experience I have ever had! From the arrival, massage, scrub, facial it was all amazing! A great way to spend a rainy afternoon in Kata!
Thank you so much to Nathamon for making me feel amazing!
Highly recommend Let’s Relax Spa @ The I
Sis Kata

This pressure can be adjusted during the massage in discussion with your therapist if the intensity is not bringing the desired result.

reviews.name: 김주현
reviews.text:
The price was incredibly affordable, but the massage was absolutely amazing and very relaxing. I received my massage from Ferry, and she did an excellent job. I had back pain before, but after the massage, I felt much better and it really helped.

If you book a 2-hour massage for 2 or more people, they provide free pick-up and drop-off service. After the massage, we visited a large and clean shopping mall nearby and then returned to our hotel.

Highly recommend this place! 😊

reviews.name: Samuel Bennett
reviews.text:
My partner and I have been coming here recently and the massages have been consistently 10/10 not rushed, they actually listen to what you want, and the techniques are spot on.
Only hiccup was one session a couple of weeks ago where my "temple, head" massage turned into what felt like an attempt to reset my brain... 😂 Left with a pretty sore head days after not going to lie, and she definitely knew I was struggling… so maybe just an off day.
Still, we keep coming back overall these guys are great and definitely worth it.

reviews.name: LilyTheExplorer
reviews.text:
I’ve been twice and I’m very picky with massages after long time living in Thailand. One of the best I’ve had by two different ladies, they actually did the parts of the bodies that I asked and not a full body as the rest do without listening.
Lucky me never had to wait and always could have massage right at arrival. Easy to find too, next to everything and in front of Burger King.

reviews.name: Uday Shankar Dwivedi
reviews.text:
PJ massage situated at Boat avenue, Phuket provides good relaxing massage to there customers.

Variety of massage types available from there menu card and they have trained professional therapists, who knows their client's need.

Clean and pure massage center, I would definitely recommend the place if you are looking for a good massage

Weather you are too tired of sports activity, walking , sea activities or from work , they have massage treatment to choose from and get yourself relax and going for next day

Foot massage, deep tissue,Thai massage, pain reliever , etc to make a few. You can choose the oil or balm as per your convenience.

Neat ,clean and hygienic environment.

Moreover they have free shuttle service to pick you and drop back to the location with minimum 2 hours of therapy booking or 2 person together...

I'll surely recommend. Also the prices are competitive and best in the area.

Don't forget to visit in your trip and try.

reviews.name: gekky sugumar
reviews.text: Me and my family had massage on this place everyday.  They provide shuttle service to and from hotel too. Thoroughly enjoyed.  Highly recommend this place for Thai massage.

reviews.name: Ichrak Harbaoui
reviews.text: Amazing place. My go to and my favourite massage place in Phuket. You can even ask them to focus on an area and you get a strong massage. The place is quiet, big and most importantly very clean. The staff are friendly.

Number 1 massage in Bangtao.

Love it 😍❤️

reviews.name: Ray Ray
reviews.text:
Don’t underestimate this unassuming shop
Never thought I’d say this but this massage changed my life. I came in tired and weary and in pain, they put me through more pain but by the end of it, it was basically new year new me new body.
And based on the moans and groans I was hearing from the other beds, they were also getting their lives changed
I’m going to see if I can squeeze in 1-2 more visits here before I leave

reviews.text: PJ Massage salon has truly exceeded my expectations, and I am particularly delighted with Ms. Ja's skills. Her expertise is exceptional, and I always look forward to returning to her.

reviews.name: Mehdi Elaichouni
reviews.text: We have been coming here for years and also send all our friends to this place, but I have no idea what happened this year. All the masseuses have a bad attitude, when you book someone you like, they still force you to take the masseuse they want you to take based on their roster. Avoid taking Nani, she has a horrible attitude and is leading a mafia-like group inside PJ. The managers and owners needs to fix things fast.

reviews.text: The massage was great! However, I was a bit disappointed that they no longer offer transportation for smaller groups—before, they provided it for any number of people, but now it’s unavailable if there are only 1–2 guests. The salon is clean and well-maintained, and the restrooms are always spotless. The therapists are polite and professional.

reviews.name: kim kayla
reviews.text: Me and my 2 friends were satisfied with their service. Pick up/drop off service is amazing. We did 1hr foot + 1hr shoulder /neck. Generally we liked it. Thank you.

reviews.name: Lesley Chan
reviews.text: I just went today. I don't think I've ever had a Thai massage. I walked into a couple of massage places this morning, they all open at 11am but I needed to kill time before a zoom call for work at 12.30pm sharp. PJ MASSAGE was THE ONLY ONE open at 10am. In fact, they let me in at 9.57am. The place is very basic but spotless, tidy and the floor is very very clean. My masseuse was Pear who spoke minimal English but was great at the massage. She did not do any sudden whiplashy movements but moved her hands and applied even pressure which really loosened me up after, the release and serious feeling of amazing relaxation after this was un-be-lievable. The full-body massage with Tiger Balm and some oil was one hour and cost 400 baht. Thats SGD15.74 / USD 12.13 / AUD18.92, y'all. I read that it's nice to tip at least 50% of that so I did. It was worth it. Then I got a small bottle of iced water. Nice.

reviews.name: Viktoria Ispravnikova
reviews.text: It was perfect massage! Thank you!

reviews.text: Not sure why this place has good reviews. Maybe I was just unlucky with who I got. It was terrible. Wasted my time and money. Left with more pain in my body. I don't think the person I got knew what she was doing. She aggravated my old injury despite me warning her. She didn't get the knots in my back and the worst feeling ever is getting your spine elbowed in all the wrong spots. Towards the end I repeated not to touch my hair like 3 times (I already bun my hair, it wasn't even in the way) but I still had my hair touched and left with oil in my hair. Wouldn't risk coming back here again.

reviews.name: Jane Mon
reviews.text:
This place is a hidden gem tucked away from the more touristy massage parlors. One thing I really like is that you actually get the full amount of time you pay for, unlike some other places where the sessions always ends early. Nutty and Ning were amazing!!!

The atmosphere is peaceful, quiet, and relaxing. We booked the foot massage, which started with a warm welcome and a thorough foot wash. They then eased into the treatment with gentle warm-up techniques before moving on to foot acupressure, focusing on key pressure points. The massage built up perfectly to the main treatment, leaving our feet feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated.

Come to this place if you want an actual massage, not a random massage where the therapist dont know what they're doing.

Note: Take a look at their wall of fame certs!!! Shows credibility to their work.

reviews.name: Omer Burshtein
reviews.text: Best massage I had in Pattaya! Really professional, clean and welcoming, terrific Thai massage

reviews.name: Andriana HJ
reviews.text:
This was truly the best massage experience of my life — and I have had many professional treatments around the world.
I have a significant back issue with disc problems, so I am always very careful about where I go. The treatment here was completely tailored to my condition and personal needs. The therapist took the time to understand my problem and adjusted everything accordingly.
After the session, I could stand up and walk without pain — something that doesn’t happen easily for me. The relief I felt was incredible.
If I lived in Pattaya, I would honestly come every single day.
Thank you, Ticha and the team, for a unique experience and a treatment that truly made a difference. I am deeply grateful.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautiful and detailed review. It truly means a lot to us.

We are especially grateful for your trust, knowing that you have a serious back condition and are very careful in choosing where to receive treatment. Your comfort and safety are always our highest priority.

We’re so happy to hear that you felt real relief and could stand and walk without pain after the session — that is the greatest reward for us.

If you are ever back in Pattaya, we would be honored to welcome you again.

With sincere gratitude,
Ticha & Team 🤍

reviews.text:
I had an amazing massage at this salon and I can truly say it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed with such warmth and kindness. The entire team is incredibly friendly, professional and attentive.

The atmosphere is beautifully calm and relaxing – you immediately feel at ease and can fully let go of stress and tension. The massage itself was absolutely perfect: very professional, deeply relaxing and exactly what my body needed.

You can really feel that they work with heart, care and true expertise. I left feeling refreshed, balanced and deeply grateful.

Highly recommended – I will definitely come back again and again!

I asked her to lower her voice, and I think she realized I was upse. They are also currently running an offer where you get 10% off before 1pm so do come soon.

reviews.text: did the 1h foot massage here. fairly priced and refreshing, masseuse applied just enough pressure to release fatigue, but not too hard to cause pain and discomfort. highly recommended.

reviews.name: Paula B
reviews.text: very good massage, I took a 1h Thai massage and it was very relaxing + great prices. I will definitely visit again on my next visit to Phuket!!!!❤️

reviews.name: Robert Andrésen
reviews.text:
Visited this place twice during my short visit in old town. It was the closest place to my hotel and reviews seemed good.
It did meet my expectations, both massages was good even if there always are some difference between therapists. The place was clean and relaxing. I had 90 min Thai massage both times. The cold tea before the massage and the hot tea with a biscuit afterwards was a nice extra touch that I haven't had on other massages places I visited in Phuket. This seems to be a little bit more upscale place, but prices are still not much higher than other simpler parlors. There supposed to be a 10% discount if you go before 13:00. I didn't get it for my massage that started 12:45, but as it was not a primary factor for me and I was satisfied with the massage I didn't bother to raise the question.

I recommend this place if you are nearby.

reviews.name: J H
reviews.text: Amazing customer service, went the extra mile. Excellent and thorough massage. We both loved it.

reviews.name: karen jeong

When we left, we even got a gift of cookies just because we mentioned we liked the thank-you cookies & tea they gave when one finished the treatment

We were 6 in our group and each one of us recommended every massage we had. Even my 18 year old son said it was the best Thai massage he had ever had. Please don't go to Kata without visiting this friendly place 💛🙏

reviews.text: I ordered 1h Thai massage. It was really like it should feel. A war very satisfied. My boyfriend hast feet massage he said it was good.

reviews.name: Bard Spb
reviews.text: Have a nice day everyone! This is the best massage parlor in Thailand! The best masters and very attentive and pleasant administrators! We recommend everyone to try a massage here!

reviews.name: Alli Sheline
reviews.text: I went here on my way home from a day full of sightseeing. I picked an hour foot massage and got the amazing Moon as my masseuse. Just the right pressure and got all the spots my tired feet and legs needed. Moon did such an amazing job I made sure to go back the next night after a day full of boating just to have Moon give me another amazing massage. The place is very clean, smells great and so relaxing. The front door staff are amazing as well. Over all 10/10 experience, highly recommend if in the Kata Beach area. I know there are a ton of spas to choose from but this one is superb, especially if you are lucky enough to get Moon as your masseuse.

reviews.name: Eugene Tasker
reviews.text: Best massage I’ve had in Kata Beach. After having a rib cracked early in week I was hesitant but the lady was so careful in that area allowing me to relax fully. Possibly best I e had anywhere in the world.

reviews.name: Caitlyn Kelly
reviews.text:
The best 1 hour thai massage ive had!
Highly recommended 👌

reviews.name: Lewis Allen
reviews.text: Excellent services and the best massage parlour you can find anywhere here. The staff and super friendly and know their stuff and the boss has a great personality is so fun to talk to!

reviews.name: Julia Dolgikh
reviews.text: I’ve had a body scrub with cream massage and I absolutely loved it! The lady’s strong but gentle movements made me feel like a goddess afterwards, clean, nourished and shiny, it was beautiful, thank you for the experience!

reviews.name: Ashish Thadani
reviews.text: Massage was very good . Not the best I've received in Thailand but pretty close.

reviews.name: Ben
reviews.text: One of the best massages of my life! Ben was excellent— she provided the most quality massage I have ever had. The facility was also surprisingly beautiful upstairs and nice— extremely clean. I recommend Ben for your massage!!

reviews.name: zouhaina Auger
reviews.text: Terrible experience, the lady at the cashier stole 500 Saudi ryal from me , which is 5000 baht. It happened while I was paying , i had a bunch of bills and from different currency, mixed up. I should have been more careful than spreading my bills like that to find the right ones ! I realised only next day as I had a missing 500 ryal and I only went to benjamas the day before. I ask to check the camera, they said okay then became very aggressive screaming at me, trying to intimidate me. I just left, not worth to fight for it but I’m just  sharing my experience. Be careful

reviews.name: John Dundee
reviews.text: We had a one hour head, shoulder and back massage. My massage was painful most of the time and I left the place with a weird feeling in my shoulder, but don't worry it was ok again later on that evening. The second lady either didn't have enough muscle power or just has been scared to hurt someone, I wish my massage would be more careful instead. I wouldn't come here again as there are other places which are less expensive compared to this one. From my point of view, that is not good value for money.

reviews.name: Sebastian Heinzmann
reviews.text: I had a back and neck massage, which was absolutely fantastic. Rather than just going through the standard protocol, the therapist identified all the knots and sore spots I had and took her time massaging those. Very friendly and polite, clean, and an overall pleasant experience with an excellent massage.

reviews.name: Katy Hilditch
reviews.text:
Excellent massage and pedicures. A group of us went a couple of times, it’s brilliant, very friendly and spotlessly clean.
All our massages were great and so were the pedicures - they even painted my brother in laws toe to celebrate the “green army!”

reviews.name: Charlie Noonan
reviews.text: Best massage of my life. I feel like I have a new body after being on a plane for many hours. They are so thorough and so good at their jobs. I will be back tomorrow!

reviews.name: Evangeline Tan
reviews.text: Price is transparent as listed in the price list in front of the shop. The reception is good in advising me not to go for the Traditional Thai Massage as I may not be able to take it and recommend that I take the traditional oil massage which cost 500 baht. The masseur is very good. It was very relaxing and I could feel the blood flow when hands are lifted off certain parts of the legs. This is definitely not a shady shop but a proper massage shop. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Extremely rude receptionist to begin with, not accommodating to request, makes you feel unwelcome, wouldn’t be going back again for sure.

reviews.name: Priscilla Pereira
reviews.text: Love this place so much because they are so professional and so respectful, 4 of us did the massage and will definitely come back because of the hospitality and they are super experienced. Thank you for having a safe space.

reviews.name: Aurora Reviglio

reviews.name: M SD

Money was demanded even before providing services. Quite disappointing for tourists!

reviews.name: Michelle Easter
reviews.text: My husband and I are currently 2/2 on absolutely incredible massages here. We started with a one hour Thai massage, then went back the next day for the two hour Thai massage. My masseuse, Su, was by far the best that I have ever had in my life. I’m extremely flexible, which can make it hard to effectively stretch me- and she did an unbelievable job stretching me. Only very large, male personal trainers have ever been able to stretch me like that (and I regularly get Thai massages). We will hopefully be coming back every day while we are in town. Highly recommend this spa for the value and quality of service. It may not be the fanciest spa we have ever been to, but the masseuses are absolutely incredible.

reviews.name: Yen Yeyen
reviews.text: I had a great massage at this place, the therapist is professional and friendly, however, I’d probably will think twice to be back when the receptionist lady made me not welcome (not friendly)

reviews.name: Adib Ahmed
reviews.text: Great massage. A little expensive than the otger but it's cleaner and more professional. I surely will visit ut again.

reviews.name: siew lee
reviews.text: Paid 999bht for a gold facial massage and had to stop halfway through as skill was so poor. And the gold is a scam. Extremely Rude reception lady also. Changed to a foot massage which was average. Masseus was polite at least.

reviews.name: Rhiannon Jones
reviews.text: Had a wash and blow dry and considering my mum is a hairdresser it has to be the best blow dry I have ever had. Head massage while shampooing and the softest hair. It isn’t a ‘British’ technique but please trust the process. The lady was fabulous!

reviews.name: Stephanie Morrison
reviews.text:
My partner and I came here for a Thai massage. My Thai massage was excellent, my partner said he’d had better, but it was a good massage.

I’d read here that the price was good value for service, so I was not expecting a Thai massage to cost 400 baht. The atmosphere was lovely and the service excellent, but this is a higher end place with higher prices.

reviews.name: Vipul Tewari
reviews.text: No.... something wrong. Mixed thoughts...out of 5 ppl 2 were good...no technique, no pressure. Very disappointed after reading such glowing reviews...very very average... Foot reflexology usually is at another level...highly disappointed. Why don't managers simply ask for a rating while leaving? Whats the problem? What exactly is the manager there for ? Just to collect money ? .....

reviews.name: Kon Kalogeropoulos
reviews.text:
One of the better more classy massage joints around. Air-conditioned, clean and classy. Prices are about the same as less reputable dirtier places. All the staff are friendly and professional, so don't think this is the place for a happy ending. They also wash your feet beforehand give you plenty of water and a biscuit with Thai tea at the end. Perfect👌
Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Holly Morwenna
reviews.text: They were so professional. Listened to my needs of a soft massage with no clicks and respected my boundaries :) lovely massage, very relaxing! Thank you!

reviews.text: Very lousy customer service . Want to do 1 hour body oil massage (400B) with one of my female friend and the male manager brought us into a couple room massage. I refused as requested to have individual room instead and he want to charge me 200B extra . I declined and go for foot massage (300B) instead which they need to refund me back 100B and the manager not happy to refund

reviews.name: Viknesh Ilangovan
reviews.text: Nothing to rave about. They charge 100 baht higher than surrounding shops so you’d expect somewhat better service, but not the case. The 1hr Thai massage felt abit rushed like every massage point was quick. Didn’t feel very relaxed nor were my knots removed.

reviews.name: Saj M
reviews.text:
Amazing place!!!
I was in Phuket for 2 weeks and tried massages at different places and with over 15 different masseuses. F (Sakunta)’s massages I had here were by far the best!!!
She is kind, attentive, professional and truly gifted. She speaks very good English which is a huge plus.
I will truly miss the experience I had there.
If you are staying in Patong, look no further for a massage… just go here and ask for F (Sakunta). ☺️

Also the shop has a notice saying “NO SEX”, which made me walk in the first instance as some of the places in Patong can be very sketchy.

reviews.name: Henry Rahardja
reviews.text: Just had a Thai Massage (THB 400 for 1 hour) on 2 Jan 2022.  The shop was not busy at all, according to the receptionist most of the masseurs are called to other locations (I did not confirm but seems you can book them to your villa or hotel) and so my friend and I had to wait for about 5 minutes for a masseur to come back.  Due to the lack of masseur, Ef, the receptionist doubles as a masseur as well for us.  I had originally thought this is not going to be good, a receptionist giving massage?  But I was completely wrong... Ef was a really really great masseur, very strong and good technique honed from her many years massage experience.  Her English is also above average and she make jokes during the massage that made us cracking up.  We will definitely come back again and look for Ef to give massage!

reviews.name: Joanne Leong
reviews.text:
Came here TWICE in a span of 6 days hahaha. Here, we had the best massage from head to toe. Massauers are skillful and professional, place is clean and comfortable, definitely not a shady place and price is reasonable. Excellent relaxation and felt so much lighter every time after the session. Will definitely be back again! Keep it up!

Useful landmark: The shop is opposite Holiday Inn Resort Patong, Phuket.

reviews.name: Britt Kings
reviews.text: One star for each girl. One of them insulted my boyfriend and ignored his request for more shoulder she said to him “I’m the doctor” and then they both laughed and kept talking about us. If someone says they want something, don’t ignore them and be rude. We both have pain in our shoulders, asked for the head, shoulder and neck. Why did they start doing our legs, feet, arms? At a certain point we almost left. My neck and shoulders are still sore.

reviews.name: Rachel .T
reviews.text:
🌿 Massage Review 🌿

I recently visited this massage place and had an amazing experience! The shop has a clean and relaxing atmosphere — modern yet cozy. It’s also very easy to find, located just across from the “Took Kab Khao” restaurant, which makes it super convenient to get to.

The staff here are wonderful. They are polite, friendly, and professional. My therapist was excellent — her pressure was perfect and she really knew how to hit all the right points. I had sore feet before coming in, but after the massage, all the pain was completely gone.

The price is also very reasonable compared to other places nearby. I actually checked a few massage shops around the area, and this one definitely offers the best value for money.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great massage with professional service and a clean, comfortable environment. I’ll definitely come back again!

This Spa is designed very comfortable with wide reception areas where You can wait with some drinks until the massage will begin.

reviews.text: This was my second time here. The massage are quite affordable, I didn’t get to use their other services such as sauna, pool etc yet but it looks decent. Mostly Chinese groups are coming here and they have a lot of spaces for their massage rooms. Somehow, I was waiting for 15 minutes inside the room before my massage begin and had to ask 2 times as it seems like they either forget that I’m inside or there were no therapist available. The massage as well was quite okay for these 2 times I went there. It could be an alternative for affordable massage.

reviews.name: Rizwana Alli
reviews.text: A wonderful spa offering a wide range of services from massages to scrubs along with other holistic treatments. It is definitely affordable and professional. The facilities were clean and pleasant. The staff were friendly and welcoming. The experience was wonderfully tranquil and unforgettable. I recommend the 2 hour hot stone massage. It is invigorating and rejuvenating.

I walked out and will not ever return.

reviews.name: Lisa Eijdems
reviews.text:
This was honestly the best foot massage I had in Thailand, and at a very good price. The therapists here truly know what a proper foot massage is, even using special tools (wooden sticks) to work on the pressure points in your feet. The balance between feet, lower legs, and upper legs was just perfect. I would recommend this place to everyone; the owner is extremely kind, and the whole atmosphere is welcoming.

At first, I felt a bit nervous about being massaged by a man, but they are genuinely professional and respectful, which quickly put me at ease. If you’re looking for a high-quality foot massage, this salon is a must-visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly delighted that you used our services and had a positive experience. Thank you for your patronage. We hope you will return again in the future.♥️🙏

reviews.name: Karl Lustig
reviews.text: Excellent massage, one of the best I got so far! I have serious neck and shoulder stiffness but Ui Chan took great care of me, addressing all spots perfectly and using the right amount of pressure to make me feel relaxed. It takes a lot for my stiff neck and shoulder to feel better, so I highly recommend this place, great service and excellent massage skills!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Ui Chan She is the best masseuse in this shop. You are so lucky to have her as your masseuse. She can tell just by touching you how you feel. Thank you for using our services. We sincerely hope you will come back again. 🙏♥️

reviews.name: VM
reviews.text: After seeing the reviews I was excited to go here. I asked for a 90min foot and shoulder massage. The woman then very badly massaged only one foot for a full hour before I noticed just how long she had taken. The massage was mainly super soft or kind of painful with her nails being dug into he soul of my foot. After I realised a full hour had passed I just asked to stop the massage. They still charged me full price after getting only half a massage. I didn't argue, it's only 300baht at the end on the day but that has to be the worst massage I have ever experienced
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely apologize for what happened to you today. We acknowledge that it was the masseuse's mistake and we have reprimanded her to prevent this from happening again. Regarding your service fee, we would like to ask if you would be willing to return and receive a refund as a token of our apology. Therefore, we will not charge you for the service.

reviews.name: Pat Claire
reviews.text: Great service at such an affordable price. Very attentive. I got a foot massage and requested a brief shoulder massage. He also fixed my stiff knee. Feeling so relaxed after. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for using our services. We are happy to see you feeling relaxed. We hope you will use our services again next time.🙏♥️

reviews.name: James
reviews.text: Had such wonderful one hour body massage with balm (oil). The female massage therapist seemed professionally trained. I felt amazing afterward. And the price was very affordable. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your patronage. We are delighted that you had a pleasant massage experience at our shop. We hope to see you again next time.♥️🙏

reviews.name: Wendy Kim
reviews.text:
마사지 실력이 정말 좋아요. 타이 마사지는 단연 최고
I had massages every day during my 5-day stay in Chiang Mai, and this place was by far the best. I honestly regret spending time at fancy luxury spas—this one exceeded all expectations. My only regret is not coming here sooner!

The therapists here are true healers. They are incredibly kind and professional, and the quality of the massage is exceptional. I had a one-hour foot massage and a one-hour Thai massage, and both were amazing—especially the Thai massage, which was the best I’ve ever had.

If you’re in Chiang Mai, come here first. You won’t regret it like I did!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: The essence of massage is relaxation and you got that from our shop. We are so glad that you enjoyed the massage. It's a pity that we met you too late. Thank you for using our service and we hope that you will come back again in the future. 🙏♥️

reviews.name: Alokah 0CS001
reviews.text: The male masseur they called in was extremely unprofessional. His massage was painfully rough and left my whole body feeling uncomfortable afterwards. He kept glancing around, touching me inappropriately with one hand while playing on his phone with the other, and gave me strange, unsettling smiles. As a woman, I felt very unsafe and uneasy. He clearly wasn’t focused on the massage — in fact, it felt like he had never been trained at all. On top of that, the massage time was also cut short.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely apologize for the incident regarding the masseuse's bad behavior. We have reprimanded him based on your feedback to prevent it from happening again. We accept our mistake and will work to improve. Thank you for your feedback.🙏

reviews.name: Amanda Cabot
reviews.text: I got a 1 hr foot massage immediately followed by a 1 hr Thai massage. reviews.text:
Finding someone who can actually do a deep tissue / sports massage is like finding a needle in a haystack. So Dream the male masseur with glasses is a rarity . I went needing my shoulders fixed and within 2 treatments of 1.5 hours each he managed to find and treat the affected muscularity . Those muscles that can only be accessed by working down through all the others in the way . It was part of the complete sports , back , neck shoulders package . You’re going to need to be firm in letting him know your pain tolerance and he’ll accommodate but I only had 2 days so let him get on with it . You can trust him , he has proper knowledge of the muscle groups and skeletal set up .
I can highly recommend this expert .
